2026-10-02 to 2026-10-08
Create a reusable GHL Troubleshooting Agent for my LofiStack workflow. The purpose of this agent is to help me troubleshoot real GoHighLevel client issues in a structured and reliable way. Core Workflow When I provide a GHL issue, the agent should: 1. Understand the Issue * Identify what is happening. * Identify what should happen instead. * Summarize the issue clearly before starting the troubleshooting process. 2. Analyze the Root Cause * Identify the most likely causes. * Review relevant areas such as workflow triggers, conditions, actions, pipelines, custom fields, tags, forms, calendars, integrations, permissions, and other applicable GHL settings. * Clearly separate confirmed information from assumptions. 3. Provide Troubleshooting Steps * Give me a clear, step-by-step troubleshooting process. * Tell me exactly what to check inside GHL. * Start with the most likely causes. * Avoid unnecessary checks or steps. 4. Recommend a Fix * Explain the recommended fix clearly. * Provide exact implementation steps whenever possible. * Warn me if the change could affect existing workflows, contacts, pipelines, or automations. 5. Create a Testing and QA Checklist * Provide a short checklist to use after applying the fix. * Include the exact test scenario. * Explain the expected result. * Help confirm whether the issue has actually been resolved. 6. Provide a Final Summary At the end, include: * Issue * Root Cause * Fix Applied * Test Result * Remaining Issues * Recommended Next Step Important Rules * Do not invent GHL features, settings, results, or test outcomes. * If important information is missing, ask for the required details before reaching a conclusion. * Clearly label all assumptions. * Do not say an issue is fixed unless it has been tested or verified. * Keep the troubleshooting focused on real client work. * Use clear, simple language. * Avoid unnecessary explanations. * If there are multiple possible causes, rank them by likelihood based on the available evidence. * Preserve existing working configurations unless there is a clear reason to change them. * Prioritize safe changes and explain any possible side effects. Reusability Make this agent reusable across different GHL client accounts and issue types, including: * Workflow problems * Trigger issues * Automation failures * Form submission issues * Pipeline problems * Custom field issues * Tag-related issues * Calendar and appointment issues * Lead routing * Attribution * Webhooks and integrations * Contact record issues * CRM data problems * Testing and QA The agent should allow me to provide a real GHL problem and receive guidance through the investigation, fix, and verification process.

Built a reusable GHL Troubleshooting Skill at .claude/skills/ghl-troubleshooter/SKILL.md.

LofiStack/Component Gallery/Component 01

Agent Log Card

A record of one AI-agent task: what was asked, which agent did it, and what came back. The prompt sits above the perforation and the result below it, like a ticket stub.

Build the first component for my LofiStack Component Gallery: an AI Agent Task Log Card. Create a polished, reusable UI component that displays: * Task name * AI Agent used * Prompt / Workflow * Result * Task type * Date * Status Design it to feel modern, premium, minimal, and suitable for LofiStack's internal/product library. Requirements: * Make it visually impressive but practical. * Fully responsive for mobile and desktop. * Use clean HTML/CSS/JS and keep the component reusable. * Give it a unique design, not a generic dashboard card. * Add subtle hover/micro-interactions. * Make all content easy to customize. * Build it as a standalone component that can later have its own direct URL in the gallery. Do not build the whole gallery yet. Only create this first component.

A reusable <agent-log-card> element in plain HTML, CSS and JS, published as its own page for the gallery.

  • Short fields are set as attributes; the prompt and result go in as child content.
  • Stacks to a single column at phone width; light and dark themes.
  • Draft, Selected and Submitted states; copy button and expandable prompt.
agent-log-card.htmlCustom elementNo dependencies

Sample content: the real prompt and output from building this component with Claude Code on 25 Sep 2026.

Status

Fields

taskTask name, shown as the title.
agentAgent or tool used, plus model if known.
typeTask category, e.g. Research, Coding, UI Component.
dateYYYY-MM-DD; displayed as 25 Sep 2026.
statusdraft, selected or submitted.
week · entryOptional. Shown in the top rail.
[data-field="prompt"]Plain text. Line breaks are kept; indentation is trimmed.
[data-field="result"]Any HTML: paragraphs, lists, .alc-chip tags.

Usage

<agent-log-card
  task="Task name"
  agent="Agent · Model"
  type="Task type"
  date="2026-09-25"
  status="draft"
  week="1" entry="1">
  <div data-field="prompt">
    The exact prompt or workflow…
  </div>
  <div data-field="result">
    <p>What the agent produced…</p>
  </div>
</agent-log-card>

// or from data:
card.data = { task, agent, type, date, status, prompt, result };

Campaign Performance Snapshot

A quick read of one ad campaign. Return on ad spend leads, shown against what was spent. Cost, reach and daily results sit beside it.

Example figures. Not real campaign data.

Status
Goal

Fields

name · platformCampaign name and ad platform.
statusactive, learning, paused or ended.
start · endDate range, YYYY-MM-DD.
spend · currencyTotal spend; any ISO currency code (default USD).
results · result-labelLead or conversion count, and what to call it.
cost · cost-labelOptional. Worked out as spend ÷ results. Shown as CPL for leads, CPA otherwise.
ctr · roasCTR in percent; ROAS as a multiple (4.2 = 4.2×).
seriesComma-separated daily results for the chart.
*-deltaOptional % change vs the previous period. A lower CPL/CPA shows as good.

Usage

<campaign-snapshot
  name="Campaign name"
  platform="Ad platform"
  status="active"
  start="2026-09-01" end="2026-09-24"
  spend="12480" currency="USD"
  results="386" result-label="Leads"
  ctr="1.84" roas="4.2"
  series="9,11,10,13,…">
</campaign-snapshot>

// or from data:
el.data = { name, platform, spend, results, roas, series: [...] };

Revenue is worked out as spend × ROAS. Every value can be updated live, and the card redraws itself.

LofiStack/Component Gallery/Component 03

Pricing Comparison Card

Three plans side by side, with a switch between monthly and yearly billing. One plan is highlighted as the recommended choice. Every plan, price and feature comes from a small block of JSON.

Example plans. Not real pricing.

Popular plan

Fields

billingAttribute. monthly or yearly. The switch updates it.
featuredAttribute. The id of the plan to highlight.
currencyAny ISO currency code (default USD). Attribute or JSON.
eyebrow · title · subtitleOptional header text.
footnoteOptional line under the plans.
tiers[].id · namePlan key and display name.
tiers[].descriptionOne-line summary of who the plan is for.
tiers[].price{ monthly, yearly }, both per month. Yearly is the per-month price when billed yearly. Use null with priceLabel (e.g. "Custom") for quote-only plans.
tiers[].priceNoteOptional. Replaces the billing line under the price.
tiers[].cta{ label, href }. Without href it renders a button.
tiers[].featuresStrings are included. { text, included: false } shows as not included.
tiers[].badgeLabel on the highlighted plan (default "Most popular").

Usage

<pricing-compare billing="monthly" featured="growth">
  <script type="application/json">
    {
      "title": "Plans that grow with you",
      "currency": "USD",
      "tiers": [
        {
          "id": "growth", "name": "Growth",
          "description": "For small teams.",
          "price": { "monthly": 79, "yearly": 64 },
          "cta": { "label": "Choose Growth", "href": "/signup" },
          "features": ["5 workspaces",
            { "text": "SSO", "included": false }]
        }
      ]
    }
  </script>
</pricing-compare>

// or from data:
el.data = { title, currency, tiers: [...] };
el.addEventListener("planselect", e => e.detail);

The yearly "Save" label is worked out from the plan prices. Clicking a plan's button fires a planselect event with the plan, billing period and price. Changing the switch fires billingchange.

LofiStack/Component Gallery/Component 04

Lead Funnel Analytics

How many people make it from visit to sale. Each stage shows its count and the share of visitors who reached it. The rate between stages shows where people drop off.

Example figures. Not real client data.

Bar scale

Fields

stages[]{ label, count } in funnel order. Two or more stages; four is typical.
eyebrow · title · subtitleOptional header text.
periodOptional date-range text, shown top right.
compareOptional { label, stages: [counts] } for the previous period. Adds a change in points to the overall rate.
sourceOptional footer note, e.g. where the data comes from.
scaleAttribute or JSON. sqrt (default) keeps small stages readable; linear draws bars exactly to scale.
labelsOptional. Override any built-in text, e.g. { "overall": "Win rate" }.
localeNumber formatting locale (default en-US).

Usage

<lead-funnel scale="sqrt">
  <script type="application/json">
    {
      "title": "Inbound pipeline",
      "period": "1 Jul – 30 Sep 2026",
      "stages": [
        { "label": "Visitors",  "count": 8640 },
        { "label": "Leads",     "count": 1296 },
        { "label": "Booked",    "count": 544 },
        { "label": "Converted", "count": 196 }
      ]
    }
  </script>
</lead-funnel>

// or from data:
el.data = { title, stages: [...] };
el.replay();  // re-run the entry animation

Every rate is worked out from the counts: each stage against the one before it, against the first stage, and overall. The summary picks out the biggest drop-off and the strongest step automatically.

.kpi-intro { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.kpi-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--kpi-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--kpi-accent-ink); }
.kpi-eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--kpi-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--kpi-accent-soft); }
.kpi-title { margin: 0; font: 650 clamp(19px, 3cqi, 24px)/1.15 var(--kpi-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.kpi-sub { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--kpi-muted); }
.kpi-eyebrow:empty, .kpi-title:empty, .kpi-sub:empty, .kpi-source:empty { display: none; }
.kpi-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.kpi-range { font: 500 12.5px/1 var(--kpi-sans); color: var(--kpi-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.kpi-seg {
  position: relative; display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--kpi-tile); border: 1px solid var(--kpi-line);
}
.kpi-seg-thumb {
  position: absolute; top: 3px; bottom: 3px; left: 0; width: 0; border-radius: 7px;
  background: var(--kpi-ink);
}
.kpi-seg.kpi-is-ready .kpi-seg-thumb { transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1), width .35s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1); }
.kpi-seg button {
  appearance: none; position: relative; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  min-width: 46px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 7px;
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--kpi-mono); letter-spacing: .02em; color: var(--kpi-muted);
  transition: color .25s;
}
.kpi-seg button:hover { color: var(--kpi-ink); }
.kpi-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--kpi-tile); }
.kpi-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kpi-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* bento grid */
.kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-auto-rows: minmax(148px, auto);
  gap: 12px;
}
.kpi-tile {
  position: relative; min-width: 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--kpi-tile);
  border: 1px solid var(--kpi-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 16px 16px 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px -1px var(--kpi-shadow);
  transition: border-color .25s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
}
.kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero):hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kpi-accent) 45%, var(--kpi-line)); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -22px var(--kpi-shadow); }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero {
  grid-column: span 2; grid-row: span 2;
  padding: 22px 22px 16px;
  border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kpi-accent) 30%, var(--kpi-line));
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 70% at 100% 0%, var(--kpi-accent-soft), transparent 60%),
    var(--kpi-tile);
}
.kpi-in { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; }

.kpi-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 22px; }
.kpi-pick {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--kpi-sans); color: var(--kpi-muted); text-align: left;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 0;
}
.kpi-pick::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 14px; }
.kpi-pick:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.kpi-pick:focus-visible::after { outline: 2px solid var(--kpi-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-pick { cursor: default; color: var(--kpi-ink); font-size: 14px; }
.kpi-swatch { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--kpi-faint); flex: none; transition: background .25s; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-swatch { background: var(--kpi-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--kpi-accent-soft); }
.kpi-pin {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; flex: none;
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--kpi-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--kpi-faint); padding: 5px 7px; border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--kpi-raise); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-2px);
  transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.kpi-pin svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
.kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero):hover .kpi-pin, .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero):focus-within .kpi-pin { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-pin { opacity: 1; transform: none; color: var(--kpi-accent-ink); background: var(--kpi-accent-soft); }

.kpi-figure { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; }
.kpi-value {
  font: 650 clamp(24px, 3.4cqi, 30px)/1 var(--kpi-display);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
}
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-value { font-size: clamp(40px, 6.2cqi, 56px); letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
.kpi-delta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
  padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 6px;
  font: 650 11.5px/1 var(--kpi-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--kpi-muted); background: var(--kpi-raise);
}
.kpi-delta svg { width: 9px; height: 9px; }
.kpi-delta[data-tone="good"] { color: var(--kpi-good); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kpi-good) 12%, transparent); }
.kpi-delta[data-tone="bad"]  { color: var(--kpi-bad);  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kpi-bad) 12%, transparent); }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-delta { font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 8px; }
.kpi-note { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--kpi-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-note { font-size: 13px; color: var(--kpi-muted); }

/* sparkline */
.kpi-chart {
  position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 10px;
  height: 48px; flex: none; outline: none; cursor: crosshair; touch-action: pan-y;
}
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-chart { grid-area: chart; margin-top: 0; height: auto; min-height: 118px; padding-top: 16px; }
.kpi-plot { position: relative; height: 100%; }
.kpi-chart:focus-visible .kpi-plot { outline: 2px solid var(--kpi-accent); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; }
.kpi-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.kpi-area { fill: var(--kpi-accent-soft); }
.kpi-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--kpi-faint); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; transition: stroke .25s; }
.kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-area { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kpi-faint) 10%, transparent); }
.kpi-tile:hover .kpi-line, .kpi-chart:focus-visible .kpi-line { stroke: var(--kpi-accent); }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-line { stroke: var(--kpi-accent); stroke-width: 2.25; }
.kpi-gridline { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed var(--kpi-grid); display: none; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-gridline { display: block; }
.kpi-prev {
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 0; display: none;
  border-top: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--kpi-faint) 70%, transparent);
  transition: top .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.kpi-prev span {
  position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 3px;
  font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--kpi-mono); color: var(--kpi-faint); background: var(--kpi-tile); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 4px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
}
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-prev { display: block; }
.kpi-cross { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 0; border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--kpi-ink) 35%, transparent); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .15s; }
.kpi-dot {
  position: absolute; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin: -4.5px 0 0 -4.5px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--kpi-tile); border: 2px solid var(--kpi-accent); box-sizing: border-box;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .15s;
}
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; margin: -6px 0 0 -6px; border-width: 2.5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--kpi-accent-soft); }
.kpi-tip {
  position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 6px); left: 0; z-index: 3;
  padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 7px;
  background: var(--kpi-tip-bg); color: var(--kpi-tip-ink);
  font: 500 11.5px/1.25 var(--kpi-sans); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px var(--kpi-shadow);
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: translate(var(--kpi-tx, -50%), 3px);
  transition: opacity .15s, transform .15s;
}
.kpi-tip b { display: block; font-weight: 650; font-size: 13px; }
.kpi-tip small { font-size: 10.5px; opacity: .78; }
.kpi-chart.kpi-is-reading .kpi-cross, .kpi-chart.kpi-is-reading .kpi-dot { opacity: 1; }
.kpi-chart.kpi-is-reading .kpi-tip { opacity: 1; transform: translate(var(--kpi-tx, -50%), 0); }
.kpi-axis { display: none; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--kpi-mono); color: var(--kpi-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-axis { display: flex; }

/* hero stats */
/* hero layout: figures left, high / low right, chart full width beneath */
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-in {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  grid-template-areas: "top top" "fig stats" "note stats" "chart chart" "axis axis";
  column-gap: 24px;
}
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-top { grid-area: top; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-figure { grid-area: fig; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-note { grid-area: note; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-axis { grid-area: axis; }
.kpi-stats { display: none; grid-area: stats; align-self: end; margin: 0; padding: 4px 0 2px 18px; border-left: 1px solid var(--kpi-line); gap: 12px; min-width: 128px; }
.kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-stats { display: grid; }
.kpi-stat { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.kpi-stat dt { font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--kpi-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--kpi-faint); }
.kpi-stat dd { margin: 0; font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--kpi-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.kpi-stat dd small { display: block; font: 400 11.5px/1.3 var(--kpi-sans); color: var(--kpi-faint); }

.kpi-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 14px 4px 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--kpi-faint); }
.kpi-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet: two columns, hero spans the full width */
@container kpi (max-width: 760px) {
  .kpi { padding: 18px 16px 14px; border-radius: 18px; }
  .kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows: minmax(150px, auto); }
  .kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: auto; }
  .kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-chart { height: 170px; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero):last-child:nth-child(even) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
/* phone: one column; small tiles become compact rows */
@container kpi (max-width: 480px) {
  .kpi { padding: 14px 12px 12px; border-radius: 16px; }
  .kpi-head { padding: 2px 2px 14px; }
  .kpi-tools { width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; }
  .kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-auto-rows: auto; gap: 10px; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero):last-child:nth-child(even) { grid-column: auto; }
  .kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero { padding: 18px 16px 14px; }
  .kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-value { font-size: 40px; }
  .kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-chart { height: 140px; }
  .kpi-tile.kpi-is-hero .kpi-in { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "top" "fig" "note" "chart" "axis" "stats"; grid-template-rows: none; }
  .kpi-stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin-top: 14px; padding: 12px 0 0; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--kpi-line); min-width: 0; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) { padding: 12px 14px; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-in {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 42%; grid-template-areas: "top chart" "fig chart" "note chart";
    column-gap: 12px; align-items: center;
  }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-top { grid-area: top; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-figure { grid-area: fig; margin-top: 6px; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-note { grid-area: note; margin-top: 4px; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-chart { grid-area: chart; height: 52px; padding-top: 0; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-value { font-size: 22px; }
  .kpi-tile:not(.kpi-is-hero) .kpi-pin { display: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .kpi-tile, .kpi-seg.kpi-is-ready .kpi-seg-thumb, .kpi-seg button, .kpi-pin, .kpi-line, .kpi-prev,
  .kpi-cross, .kpi-dot, .kpi-tip, .kpi-swatch { transition: none; }
}

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <kpi-dashboard> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    period: "Period", periodBtn: "Last {n} days", vs: "vs {prev} previous {n} days", ratioNote: "{of} ÷ {per}",
    ratioPct: "{of} of {per}", prevAvg: "Prev. avg {v}", pinned: "Pinned", pin: "Pin",
    high: "High", low: "Low",
    pinHint: "Move {label} into the main tile", isHero: "{label} is in the main tile",
    chart: "{label} by {unit}, {n} points. Use the arrow keys to read values.",
    day: "day", block: "{n}-day block", pts: "pts", hint: "Click a tile to pin it · arrow keys read a chart",
    announcePin: "{label} moved to the main tile", announcePeriod: "Showing the last {n} days"
  };
  const ICON_UP = '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 10" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 1.5 9 8H1z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>';
  const ICON_DOWN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 10" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 8.5 1 2h8z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>';
  const ICON_PIN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.2 1.5h3.6L7.3 4.6l2 1.9H2.7l2-1.9zM6 6.5v4"/></svg>';
  const SAMPLES = 72;

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <section class="kpi">
      <header class="kpi-head">
        <div class="kpi-intro">
          <span class="kpi-eyebrow"></span>
          <h2 class="kpi-title"></h2>
          <p class="kpi-sub"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-tools">
          <span class="kpi-range"></span>
          <div class="kpi-seg" role="group"><span class="kpi-seg-thumb" aria-hidden="true"></span></div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="kpi-grid"></div>
      <footer class="kpi-foot"><span class="kpi-hint"></span><span class="kpi-source"></span></footer>
      <p class="kpi-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </section>`;

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const sum = a => a.reduce((s, v) => s + (num(v) ?? 0), 0);
  const ease = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
  const resample = (ys, n) => {
    if (!ys.length) return new Array(n).fill(36);
    if (ys.length === 1) return new Array(n).fill(ys[0]);
    return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, j) => {
      const t = j / (n - 1) * (ys.length - 1), i = Math.floor(t), f = t - i;
      return i >= ys.length - 1 ? ys[ys.length - 1] : ys[i] + (ys[i + 1] - ys[i]) * f;
    });
  };
  const pathOf = ys => {
    const n = ys.length;
    if (!n) return { line: "", area: "" };
    const pts = n === 1 ? [[0, ys[0]], [100, ys[0]]] : ys.map((y, i) => [i / (n - 1) * 100, y]);
    const line = pts.map((p, i) => (i ? "L" : "M") + p[0].toFixed(2) + " " + p[1].toFixed(2)).join(" ");
    return { line, area: line + " L100 40 L0 40 Z" };
  };

  class KpiDashboard extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["period", "hero"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<kpi-dashboard>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        eyebrow: q(".kpi-eyebrow"), title: q(".kpi-title"), sub: q(".kpi-sub"), range: q(".kpi-range"),
        seg: q(".kpi-seg"), thumb: q(".kpi-seg-thumb"), grid: q(".kpi-grid"),
        hint: q(".kpi-hint"), source: q(".kpi-source"), sr: q(".kpi-sr")
      };
      this._shown = new Map();
      this._built = true;
      this._render();
      const place = () => this._placeThumb();
      if ("ResizeObserver" in window) { this._ro = new ResizeObserver(place); this._ro.observe(this.$.seg); }
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => this.$.seg.classList.add("kpi-is-ready")));
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      if (this._raf) cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf);
      this._raf = 0;
    }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      if (name === "period") this._update(true);
      else this._applyHero(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; if (this._built) { this._shown = new Map(); this._order = null; this._render(); } }
    get period() { return this._periodId(); }
    set period(v) { this.setAttribute("period", v); }
    get hero() { return this._heroId(); }
    set hero(v) { this.setAttribute("hero", v); }
    pin(id) { if (this._metric(id) && !this._metric(id).hidden) this.setAttribute("hero", id); }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _periods() {
      const p = Array.isArray(this._data.periods) ? this._data.periods.filter(x => x && x.id) : [];
      return p.length ? p : [{ id: "30d", label: "30D", days: 30, bucket: 1 }];
    }
    _periodId() {
      const ps = this._periods(), want = this.getAttribute("period") || this._data.period;
      return (ps.find(p => p.id === want) || ps[0]).id;
    }
    _periodObj() { return this._periods().find(p => p.id === this._periodId()); }
    _metrics() { return (Array.isArray(this._data.metrics) ? this._data.metrics : []).filter(m => m && m.id); }
    _metric(id) { return this._metrics().find(m => m.id === id); }
    _visible() { return this._metrics().filter(m => !m.hidden); }
    _heroId() {
      const vis = this._visible(), want = this.getAttribute("hero") || this._data.hero;
      return (vis.find(m => m.id === want) || vis[0] || {}).id;
    }

    /* ---------- numbers ---------- */
    _locale() { return this._data.locale || "en-US"; }
    _fmt(m, v) {
      if (v == null || !Number.isFinite(v)) return "—";
      const f = m.format || "int", loc = this._locale(), cur = this._data.currency || "USD";
      try {
        if (f === "currency") return new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: "currency", currency: cur, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(v);
        if (f === "currency2") return new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: "currency", currency: cur, minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(v);
      } catch (e) { return cur + " " + v.toFixed(f === "currency2" ? 2 : 0); }
      if (f === "percent") return (v * 100).toLocaleString(loc, { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) + "%";
      return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(loc);
    }
    _calc(m, pid) {
      if (m.ratio) {
        const a = this._metric(m.ratio.of), b = this._metric(m.ratio.per);
        if (!a || !b || a.ratio || b.ratio) return { points: [], value: null, previous: null };
        const A = this._calc(a, pid), B = this._calc(b, pid);
        const points = A.points.map((v, i) => (B.points[i] > 0 ? v / B.points[i] : null)).filter(v => v != null);
        return {
          points, value: B.value > 0 ? A.value / B.value : null,
          previous: A.previous != null && B.previous > 0 ? A.previous / B.previous : null,
          parts: { of: a, per: b, ofValue: A.value, perValue: B.value }
        };
      }
      const raw = m.series && Array.isArray(m.series[pid]) ? m.series[pid] : [];
      const points = raw.map(num).map(v => v ?? 0);
      return { points, value: points.length ? sum(points) : null, previous: num(m.previous && m.previous[pid]) };
    }
    _delta(m, c) {
      if (c.value == null || c.previous == null) return null;
      const better = m.better === "down" ? -1 : 1;
      if (m.format === "percent") {
        const pts = (c.value - c.previous) * 100, r = Math.round(pts * 10) / 10;
        return { r, text: `${Math.abs(r).toFixed(1)} ${this._labels().pts}`, tone: r === 0 ? "flat" : (r * better > 0 ? "good" : "bad") };
      }
      if (!(c.previous > 0)) return null;
      const pct = (c.value / c.previous - 1) * 100, r = Math.round(pct * 10) / 10;
      return { r, text: `${Math.abs(r).toFixed(1)}%`, tone: r === 0 ? "flat" : (r * better > 0 ? "good" : "bad") };
    }

    /* ---------- dates ---------- */
    _end() {
      const s = this._data.end;
      const d = s && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s) ? new Date(s + "T12:00:00") : new Date();
      return isNaN(d) ? new Date() : d;
    }
    _day(offset) { const d = new Date(this._end()); d.setDate(d.getDate() - offset); return d; }
    _dfmt(d, opts) { return d.toLocaleDateString(this._locale(), opts); }
    _span(a, b, year) {
      const opts = { month: "short", day: "numeric" };
      if (year) opts.year = "numeric";
      try {
        const f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(this._locale(), opts);
        return f.formatRange ? f.formatRange(a, b) : `${f.format(a)} – ${f.format(b)}`;
      } catch (e) { return `${a.toDateString()} – ${b.toDateString()}`; }
    }
    _pointLabel(i, n, p) {
      const bucket = Math.max(1, num(p.bucket) || 1);
      const endOff = (n - 1 - i) * bucket, startOff = endOff + bucket - 1;
      if (bucket === 1) return this._dfmt(this._day(endOff), { weekday: "short", day: "numeric", month: "short" });
      return this._span(this._day(startOff), this._day(endOff));
    }

    /* ---------- render ---------- */
    _render() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.eyebrow.textContent = d.eyebrow || "";
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.sub.textContent = d.subtitle || "";
      $.source.textContent = d.source || "";
      $.hint.textContent = L.hint;
      $.seg.setAttribute("aria-label", L.period);

      $.seg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.remove());
      this._periods().forEach(p => {
        const b = make("button", null, p.label || p.id);
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.period = p.id;
        if (p.days) b.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.periodBtn, { n: p.days }));
        b.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (p.id === this._periodId()) return;
          this.setAttribute("period", p.id);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("periodchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { period: p.id } }));
        });
        $.seg.append(b);
      });

      const vis = this._visible();
      if (!this._order || this._order.length !== vis.length || this._order.some(id => !this._metric(id))) {
        const hero = this._heroId();
        this._order = [hero, ...vis.map(m => m.id).filter(id => id !== hero)].filter(Boolean);
      }
      $.grid.replaceChildren(...this._order.map(id => this._tile(this._metric(id), L)));
      this._applyHero(false);
      this._update(false);
    }

    _tile(m, L) {
      const art = make("article", "kpi-tile");
      art.dataset.id = m.id;
      const inner = make("div", "kpi-in");

      const top = make("div", "kpi-top");
      const pick = make("button", "kpi-pick");
      pick.type = "button";
      pick.append(make("span", "kpi-swatch"), make("span", null, m.label || m.id));
      pick.addEventListener("click", () => this._select(m.id));
      const pin = make("span", "kpi-pin");
      pin.innerHTML = ICON_PIN;
      pin.append(make("span", "kpi-pin-t"));
      pin.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      top.append(pick, pin);

      const fig = make("div", "kpi-figure");
      fig.append(make("span", "kpi-value"), make("span", "kpi-delta"));
      fig.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const note = make("p", "kpi-note");
      note.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

      const chart = make("div", "kpi-chart");
      chart.tabIndex = 0;
      chart.setAttribute("role", "group");
      chart.setAttribute("aria-roledescription", "sparkline");
      const plot = make("div", "kpi-plot");
      [0, 1, 2].forEach(i => { const g = make("span", "kpi-gridline"); g.style.top = (10 + i * 40) + "%"; plot.append(g); });
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      const svg = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg");
      svg.setAttribute("class", "kpi-svg"); svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 100 40");
      svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none"); svg.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const area = document.createElementNS(NS, "path"); area.setAttribute("class", "kpi-area");
      const line = document.createElementNS(NS, "path"); line.setAttribute("class", "kpi-line");
      svg.append(area, line);
      const prev = make("span", "kpi-prev"); prev.append(make("span"));
      prev.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const cross = make("span", "kpi-cross"), dot = make("span", "kpi-dot");
      const tip = make("span", "kpi-tip");
      tip.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      plot.append(svg, prev, cross, dot, tip);
      chart.append(plot);
      const axis = make("div", "kpi-axis");
      axis.append(make("span"), make("span"));
      axis.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

      const stats = make("dl", "kpi-stats");
      ["high", "low"].forEach(k => {
        const s = make("div", "kpi-stat"); s.dataset.k = k;
        s.append(make("dt"), make("dd"));
        stats.append(s);
      });

      inner.append(top, fig, note, chart, axis, stats);
      art.append(inner);
      art._m = m;
      art.$ = { pick, pin: pin.querySelector(".kpi-pin-t"), value: fig.firstChild, delta: fig.lastChild, note, chart, area, line, prev, cross, dot, tip, axis, stats };
      this._wireChart(art);
      return art;
    }

    _wireChart(art) {
      const c = art.$.chart;
      const read = i => {
        const pts = art._calc ? art._calc.points : [];
        if (!pts.length) return;
        art._idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(pts.length - 1, i));
        this._showPoint(art);
      };
      const fromX = e => {
        const r = art.$.chart.querySelector(".kpi-plot").getBoundingClientRect();
        const n = art._calc ? art._calc.points.length : 0;
        if (!n || !r.width) return 0;
        return Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width)) * (n - 1));
      };
      c.addEventListener("pointermove", e => read(fromX(e)));
      c.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => read(fromX(e)));
      c.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { if (document.activeElement !== c) c.classList.remove("kpi-is-reading"); });
      c.addEventListener("focus", () => read(art._idx ?? (art._calc ? art._calc.points.length - 1 : 0)));
      c.addEventListener("blur", () => c.classList.remove("kpi-is-reading"));
      c.addEventListener("click", () => { if (!art.classList.contains("kpi-is-hero")) this._select(art.dataset.id); });
      c.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const n = art._calc ? art._calc.points.length : 0, i = art._idx ?? n - 1;
        const map = { ArrowLeft: i - 1, ArrowDown: i - 1, ArrowRight: i + 1, ArrowUp: i + 1, Home: 0, End: n - 1 };
        if (e.key in map) { e.preventDefault(); read(map[e.key]); this.$.sr.textContent = [...art.$.tip.children].map(x => x.textContent).join(", "); }

    _showPoint(art) {
      const calc = art._calc, i = art._idx, m = art._m;
      if (!calc || i == null || !calc.points.length) return;
      const n = calc.points.length, x = n === 1 ? 50 : i / (n - 1) * 100, y = art._ys[i];
      const $ = art.$;
      $.cross.style.left = x + "%";
      $.dot.style.left = x + "%"; $.dot.style.top = (y / 40 * 100) + "%";
      $.tip.replaceChildren(make("b", null, this._fmt(m, calc.points[i])), make("small", null, this._pointLabel(i, n, this._periodObj())));
      $.tip.style.left = x + "%";
      $.tip.style.setProperty("--kpi-tx", x < 18 ? "-12%" : x > 82 ? "-88%" : "-50%");
      $.chart.classList.add("kpi-is-reading");
    }

    _select(id) {
      if (id === this._heroId()) return;
      this.setAttribute("hero", id);
      const m = this._metric(id), c = this._calc(m, this._periodId());
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("kpiselect", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { id, label: m.label || id, period: this._periodId(), value: c.value, previous: c.previous }
      }));
    }

    _applyHero(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), hero = this._heroId(), grid = this.$.grid;
      if (!hero) return;
      if (this._order[0] !== hero) {
        const i = this._order.indexOf(hero);
        if (i > 0) { this._order[i] = this._order[0]; this._order[0] = hero; }
      }
      const tiles = [...grid.children];
      const motion = animate && !reduceMotion() && "animate" in Element.prototype;
      const first = motion ? new Map(tiles.map(t => [t, t.getBoundingClientRect()])) : null;

      const byId = new Map(tiles.map(t => [t.dataset.id, t]));
      this._order.forEach(id => { const t = byId.get(id); if (t) grid.append(t); });
      tiles.forEach(t => {
        const on = t.dataset.id === hero, label = t._m.label || t.dataset.id;

      });
      if (animate) this.$.sr.textContent = fill(L.announcePin, { label: this._metric(hero).label || hero });

      if (!motion) return;
      tiles.forEach(t => {
        const a = first.get(t), b = t.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!a || !b.width || !b.height) return;
        const dx = a.left - b.left, dy = a.top - b.top, sx = a.width / b.width, sy = a.height / b.height;
        if (Math.abs(dx) < 1 && Math.abs(dy) < 1 && Math.abs(sx - 1) < .01 && Math.abs(sy - 1) < .01) return;
        t.animate([
          { transformOrigin: "0 0", transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px) scale(${sx}, ${sy})` },
          { transformOrigin: "0 0", transform: "none" }
        ], { duration: 420, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)" });
        if (Math.abs(sx - 1) > .05 || Math.abs(sy - 1) > .05) {
          t.querySelector(".kpi-in").animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 0, offset: .35 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 420, easing: "ease-out" });
        }
      });
    }

    _update(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), p = this._periodObj(), pid = p.id, $ = this.$;
      $.seg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.period === pid)));
      this._placeThumb();
      const days = num(p.days) || 0;
      $.range.textContent = days ? this._span(this._day(days - 1), this._day(0), true) : "";
      if (animate) $.sr.textContent = fill(L.announcePeriod, { n: days });

      const jobs = [];
      [...$.grid.children].forEach(t => {
        const m = t._m, c = this._calc(m, pid), pts = c.points;
        t._calc = c;
        // y scale (include the previous-period average so the reference line always fits)
        const prevAvg = c.previous == null ? null : (m.ratio ? c.previous : (pts.length ? c.previous / pts.length : null));
        const vals = pts.concat(prevAvg != null ? [prevAvg] : []);
        let lo = vals.length ? Math.min(...vals) : 0, hi = vals.length ? Math.max(...vals) : 1;
        if (hi === lo) { hi += 1; lo -= 1; }
        const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.08;
        lo -= pad; hi += pad;
        const Y = v => 36 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * 32;
        t._ys = pts.map(Y);
        if (t._idx != null && t._idx >= pts.length) t._idx = pts.length - 1;

        // text
        const dl = this._delta(m, c);
        t.$.delta.replaceChildren();
        if (dl) {
          t.$.delta.dataset.tone = dl.tone;
          if (dl.r) t.$.delta.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin", dl.r > 0 ? ICON_UP : ICON_DOWN);
          t.$.delta.append(dl.text);
          t.$.delta.hidden = false;
        } else t.$.delta.hidden = true;
        if (c.parts) {
          const tpl = m.format === "percent" ? L.ratioPct : L.ratioNote;
          t.$.note.textContent = fill(tpl, {
            of: `${this._fmt(c.parts.of, c.parts.ofValue)} ${(c.parts.of.label || "").toLowerCase()}`,
            per: `${this._fmt(c.parts.per, c.parts.perValue)} ${(c.parts.per.label || "").toLowerCase()}`
          });
        } else t.$.note.textContent = c.previous != null ? fill(L.vs, { prev: this._fmt(m, c.previous), n: days }) : "";

        // hero extras
        if (prevAvg != null) {
          t.$.prev.hidden = false;
          t.$.prev.style.top = (Y(prevAvg) / 40 * 100) + "%";
          t.$.prev.firstChild.textContent = fill(L.prevAvg, { v: this._fmt(m, prevAvg) });
        } else t.$.prev.hidden = true;
        const n = pts.length;
        const [a0, a1] = t.$.axis.children;
        a0.textContent = n ? this._pointLabel(0, n, p) : "";
        a1.textContent = n > 1 ? this._pointLabel(n - 1, n, p) : "";
        const hiI = n ? pts.indexOf(Math.max(...pts)) : -1, loI = n ? pts.indexOf(Math.min(...pts)) : -1;
        const stat = (k, title, val, sub) => {
          const s = t.$.stats.querySelector(`[data-k="${k}"]`);
          s.querySelector("dt").textContent = title;
          const dd = s.querySelector("dd"); dd.replaceChildren(val);
          if (sub) dd.append(make("small", null, sub));
        };
        const unit = (num(p.bucket) || 1) === 1 ? L.day : fill(L.block, { n: p.bucket });
        stat("high", `${L.high} · ${unit}`, this._fmt(m, hiI >= 0 ? pts[hiI] : null), hiI >= 0 ? this._pointLabel(hiI, n, p) : "");
        stat("low", `${L.low} · ${unit}`, this._fmt(m, loI >= 0 ? pts[loI] : null), loI >= 0 ? this._pointLabel(loI, n, p) : "");

        // accessible summary
        const label = m.label || m.id;
        t._summary = `${this._fmt(m, c.value)}${dl ? `, ${dl.r > 0 ? "up" : dl.r < 0 ? "down" : "unchanged"} ${dl.text}` : ""}. ${t.$.note.textContent}`;
        const on = t.classList.contains("kpi-is-hero");

        t.$.chart.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.chart, { label, unit, n }));

        // tween
        const from = this._shown.get(m.id);
        const toSamples = resample(t._ys, SAMPLES);
        jobs.push({ t, m, fromV: from ? from.v : c.value, toV: c.value, fromS: from ? from.s : toSamples, toS: toSamples });
        this._shown.set(m.id, { v: c.value, s: toSamples });
      });

      const final = () => jobs.forEach(j => {
        j.t.$.value.textContent = this._fmt(j.m, j.toV);
        const p2 = pathOf(j.t._ys);
        j.t.$.line.setAttribute("d", p2.line); j.t.$.area.setAttribute("d", p2.area);
        if (j.t.$.chart.classList.contains("kpi-is-reading")) this._showPoint(j.t);

        jobs.forEach(j => {
          const v = j.fromV != null && j.toV != null ? j.fromV + (j.toV - j.fromV) * k : j.toV;

          j.t.$.line.setAttribute("d", p2.line); j.t.$.area.setAttribute("d", p2.area);

    _placeThumb() {

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("kpi-note");
  const initialHero = el.getAttribute("hero");
  el.addEventListener("kpiselect", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = `${d.label} · ${d.period.toUpperCase()}`;
    note.append(b, " pinned. The dashboard sent a kpiselect event. Example data, not real client results.");
  });
  document.getElementById("reset-hero").addEventListener("click", () => el.pin(initialHero));

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };

  });
})();

.apc-vars { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 14px; padding: 16px 18px 18px; background: var(--apc-panel); border-left: 1px solid var(--apc-line); min-width: 0; }
.apc-vars-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.apc-vars-title { margin: 0; font: 600 11px/1 var(--apc-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--apc-muted); }
.apc-fillstate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--apc-sans); color: var(--apc-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.apc-fillstate::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--apc-green); }
.apc-fillstate.is-partial::before { background: var(--apc-red); }
.apc-fields { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.apc-field {
  display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 11px 12px 12px; border-radius: 11px;
  background: var(--apc-bg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--apc-line-soft);
  transition: box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease;
}
.apc-field.is-linked { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--apc-amber-line), 0 0 0 3px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.08); }
.apc-field.is-unused { opacity: .62; }
.apc-field-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.apc-key { font: 500 12px/1 var(--apc-mono); color: var(--apc-amber); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.apc-uses { flex: none; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--apc-mono); color: var(--apc-faint); padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--apc-line-soft); }
.apc-flabel { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--apc-muted); }
.apc-input {
  box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--apc-line); background: var(--apc-raise); color: var(--apc-text);
  font: 400 13.5px/1.35 var(--apc-sans);
  transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.apc-input::placeholder { color: var(--apc-faint); }
.apc-input:hover { border-color: #34376A; }
.apc-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--apc-violet); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--apc-violet-soft); }
.apc-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; }
.apc-chip {
  appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--apc-sans); color: var(--apc-muted); background: var(--apc-line-soft);
  transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease;
}
.apc-chip:hover { color: var(--apc-text); background: var(--apc-line); }
.apc-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--apc-amber); background: var(--apc-amber-bg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--apc-amber-line); }
.apc-vars-note { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--apc-faint); }
.apc-vars-note:empty { display: none; }

/* buttons */
.apc-btn {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px;
  min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 8px;
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--apc-sans); color: var(--apc-text);
  background: var(--apc-raise); border: 1px solid var(--apc-line);
  transition: background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
}
.apc-btn svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: none; }
.apc-btn:hover { border-color: #3A3D74; background: #22244A; }
.apc-btn:active { transform: scale(.98); }
.apc-btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--apc-muted); }
.apc-btn--ghost:hover { color: var(--apc-text); }
.apc-btn--primary { background: var(--apc-violet-strong); border-color: var(--apc-violet-strong); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -12px var(--apc-violet-strong); }
.apc-btn--primary:hover { background: var(--apc-violet-deep); border-color: var(--apc-violet-deep); }
.apc-btn.is-done { background: #0F3B2E; border-color: #1E6A52; color: var(--apc-green); box-shadow: none; }
.apc-copy-ico, .apc-done-ico { display: inline-flex; }
.apc-btn .apc-done-ico, .apc-btn.is-done .apc-copy-ico { display: none; }
.apc-btn.is-done .apc-done-ico { display: inline-flex; }

/* status bar */
.apc-status {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 10px 14px 10px 18px; background: var(--apc-bar); border-top: 1px solid var(--apc-line);
}
.apc-stats { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 400 11.5px/1.3 var(--apc-mono); color: var(--apc-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.apc-stats b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--apc-text); }
.apc-stat-sep { width: 1px; height: 12px; background: var(--apc-line); }
.apc-vmeta { color: var(--apc-faint); }
.apc-changed-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--apc-faint); }
.apc-changed-key::before { content: ""; width: 3px; height: 11px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--apc-violet); }
.apc-changed-key:empty { display: none; }
.apc-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.apc-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet: variables move under the editor */
@container apc (max-width: 759px) {
  .apc-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .apc-vars { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--apc-line); }
  .apc-fields { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr)); }
  .apc-code { max-height: 380px; }
}
/* phone */
@container apc (max-width: 479px) {
  .apc { border-radius: 14px; }
  .apc-bar { padding: 12px 14px; }
  .apc-file { flex-basis: 100%; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .apc-file-text { flex: 1 1 calc(100% - 46px); }
  .apc-model { margin-left: 46px; }
  .apc-tabs { width: 100%; }
  .apc-tab { flex: 1; justify-content: center; }
  .apc-ed-head { padding: 10px 12px; }
  .apc-mode { width: 100%; }
  .apc-mode button { flex: 1; justify-content: center; }
  .apc-code { font-size: 12px; padding-top: 10px; }
  .apc-line { grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .apc-ln { padding-right: 10px; }
  .apc-lc { padding-right: 12px; }
  .apc-vars { padding: 14px 12px 14px; }
  .apc-status { padding: 12px; }
  .apc-actions, .apc-actions .apc-btn { width: 100%; }
  .apc-actions .apc-btn { flex: 1; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .apc-tab, .apc-mode button, .apc-line, .apc-var, .apc-field, .apc-input, .apc-chip, .apc-btn { transition: none; }
  .apc-btn:active { transform: none; }
  .apc-caret { animation: none; }
}

  const ICON_EYE = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1.5 8S4 3.5 8 3.5 14.5 8 14.5 8 12 12.5 8 12.5 1.5 8 1.5 8z"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="2"/></svg>';
  const ICON_COPY = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="5.5" y="5.5" width="8" height="8" rx="1.6"/><path d="M10.5 5.5V4A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 9 2.5H4A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 2.5 4v5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 10.5h1.5"/></svg>';
  const ICON_CHECK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m3.5 8.4 3 3 6-6.4"/></svg>';
  const ICON_RESET = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.8 7.5A5.2 5.2 0 1 1 4.3 11.6"/><path d="M2.5 3.5v4h4"/></svg>';

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <div class="apc">
      <header class="apc-bar">
        <div class="apc-file">
          <span class="apc-file-ico">${ICON_FILE}</span>
          <div class="apc-file-text"><h2 class="apc-name"></h2><span class="apc-desc"></span></div>
          <span class="apc-model"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="apc-tabs" role="tablist"></div>
      </header>
      <div class="apc-body">
        <div class="apc-editor">
          <div class="apc-ed-head">
            <span class="apc-path"></span>
            <div class="apc-mode" role="group">
              <button type="button" data-mode="template" aria-pressed="true">${ICON_BRACES}<span></span></button>
              <button type="button" data-mode="preview" aria-pressed="false">${ICON_EYE}<span></span></button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="apc-code" role="tabpanel" tabindex="0"></div>
        </div>
        <aside class="apc-vars">
          <div class="apc-vars-head"><h3 class="apc-vars-title"></h3><span class="apc-fillstate"></span></div>
          <div class="apc-fields"></div>
          <p class="apc-vars-note"></p>
          <button type="button" class="apc-btn apc-btn--ghost apc-reset">${ICON_RESET}<span></span></button>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <footer class="apc-status">
        <div class="apc-stats">
          <span><b class="apc-chars"></b> <span class="apc-chars-l"></span></span>
          <span>≈ <b class="apc-tokens"></b> <span class="apc-tokens-l"></span></span>
          <span class="apc-stat-sep" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="apc-lines"></span>
          <span class="apc-vmeta"></span>
          <span class="apc-changed-key"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="apc-actions">
          <button type="button" class="apc-btn apc-btn--primary apc-copy"><span class="apc-copy-ico">${ICON_COPY}</span><span class="apc-done-ico">${ICON_CHECK}</span><span class="apc-copy-l"></span></button>
        </div>
      </footer>
      <p class="apc-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>`;

  const VAR_RE = /\{\{\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\}\}/g;
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let uid = 0;

  class AiPromptCard extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["version", "mode"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      this._uid = "apc" + (++uid);
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<ai-prompt-card>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
        this._resetValues();
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        card: q(".apc"), name: q(".apc-name"), desc: q(".apc-desc"), model: q(".apc-model"), tabs: q(".apc-tabs"),
        path: q(".apc-path"), mode: q(".apc-mode"), code: q(".apc-code"),
        varsTitle: q(".apc-vars-title"), fillstate: q(".apc-fillstate"), fields: q(".apc-fields"), varsNote: q(".apc-vars-note"),
        reset: q(".apc-reset"), chars: q(".apc-chars"), charsL: q(".apc-chars-l"), tokens: q(".apc-tokens"), tokensL: q(".apc-tokens-l"),
        lines: q(".apc-lines"), vmeta: q(".apc-vmeta"), changedKey: q(".apc-changed-key"), copy: q(".apc-copy"), copyL: q(".apc-copy-l"), sr: q(".apc-sr")
      };
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._render();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { clearTimeout(this._copyTimer); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      if (name === "version") this._renderVersion(true);
      else this._applyMode();
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; this._resetValues(); if (this._built) this._render(); }

    get version() {
      const vs = this._versions();
      const want = this.getAttribute("version") || (this._data && this._data.activeVersion);
      const hit = vs.find(v => v.id === want);
      return hit ? hit.id : (vs.length ? vs[vs.length - 1].id : "");
    }
    set version(v) { this.setAttribute("version", v); }

    get mode() { return (this.getAttribute("mode") || (this._data && this._data.mode) || "template").toLowerCase() === "preview" ? "preview" : "template"; }
    set mode(v) { this.setAttribute("mode", v === "preview" ? "preview" : "template"); }

    get values() { return Object.assign({}, this._values); }

    setVariable(key, value) {
      if (!this._defs().some(d => d.key === key)) return;
      this._values[key] = value == null ? "" : String(value);
      if (!this._built) return;
      const input = this.$.fields.querySelector(`[data-key="${key}"] .apc-input`);
      if (input && input.value !== this._values[key]) input.value = this._values[key];
      this._refreshValues();
    }

    resetVariables() {
      this._resetValues();
      if (!this._built) return;
      this.$.fields.querySelectorAll(".apc-field").forEach(f => { f.querySelector(".apc-input").value = this._values[f.dataset.key] || ""; });
      this._refreshValues();
      this._announce(this._labels().announceReset);
    }

    filledText() {
      const v = this._current();
      const defs = new Set(this._defs().map(d => d.key));
      return v ? String(v.text || "").replace(VAR_RE, (m, k) => (defs.has(k) && String(this._values[k] || "").trim() ? this._values[k] : m)) : "";
    }

    copy() {
      const L = this._labels(), text = this.filledText(), v = this._current();
      const detail = { version: v ? v.id : "", text, chars: text.length, tokens: Math.ceil(text.length / 4), values: this.values };
      const done = method => {
        this._flashCopy(method === "clipboard" ? L.copied : L.selected);
        this._announce(method === "clipboard" ? fill(L.announceCopy, { chars: text.length.toLocaleString("en-US") }) : L.announceSelect);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("promptcopy", { bubbles: true, detail: Object.assign(detail, { method }) }));
      };
      const select = () => {
        if (this.mode !== "preview") this.mode = "preview";
        const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(this.$.code);
        const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);
        done("selection");
      };
      try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => done("clipboard"), select); }
      catch (e) { select(); }
    }

    /* internals */
    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _versions() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      return (Array.isArray(d.versions) ? d.versions : []).filter(Boolean).map((v, i) => Object.assign({}, v, { id: String(v.id || `v${i + 1}`) }));
    }
    _defs() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      return (Array.isArray(d.variables) ? d.variables : []).filter(x => x && /^[A-Za-z_]\w*$/.test(x.key || ""));
    }
    _current() { const id = this.version; return this._versions().find(v => v.id === id) || null; }
    _resetValues() { this._values = {}; this._defs().forEach(d => { this._values[d.key] = d.default == null ? "" : String(d.default); }); }
    _date(s) {
      const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(s || "");
      if (!m) return s || "";
      const date = new Date(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]);
      if (this._data.locale) return date.toLocaleDateString(this._data.locale, { day: "numeric", month: "short" });
      return `${date.getDate()} ${"Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec".split(" ")[date.getMonth()]}`;
    }
    _announce(t) { this.$.sr.textContent = ""; requestAnimationFrame(() => { this.$.sr.textContent = t; }); }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      // tabs: roving focus with arrow keys, automatic activation
      $.tabs.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const t = e.target.closest(".apc-tab"); if (!t) return;
        this._selectTab(t.dataset.id);
      });
      $.tabs.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const tabs = [...$.tabs.querySelectorAll(".apc-tab")];
        const i = tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement); if (i < 0) return;
        let n = null;
        if (e.key === "ArrowRight") n = (i + 1) % tabs.length;
        else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") n = (i - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        else if (e.key === "Home") n = 0;
        else if (e.key === "End") n = tabs.length - 1;
        if (n == null) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        tabs[n].focus();
        this._selectTab(tabs[n].dataset.id);
      });
      $.mode.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b || b.dataset.mode === this.mode) return;
        this.mode = b.dataset.mode;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("modechange", { bubbles: true, detail: { mode: this.mode } }));
      });
      $.reset.addEventListener("click", () => this.resetVariables());
      $.copy.addEventListener("click", () => this.copy());

      // variables: typing updates the preview, focus links the input to its pills
      $.fields.addEventListener("input", e => {
        const f = e.target.closest(".apc-field"); if (!f || !e.target.classList.contains("apc-input")) return;
        this._values[f.dataset.key] = e.target.value;
        this._refreshValues();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("variablechange", { bubbles: true, detail: { key: f.dataset.key, value: e.target.value } }));
      });
      $.fields.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const c = e.target.closest(".apc-chip"); if (!c) return;
        const f = c.closest(".apc-field");
        f.querySelector(".apc-input").value = c.dataset.value;
        this._values[f.dataset.key] = c.dataset.value;
        this._refreshValues();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("variablechange", { bubbles: true, detail: { key: f.dataset.key, value: c.dataset.value } }));
      });
      $.fields.addEventListener("focusin", e => { const f = e.target.closest(".apc-field"); this._focusKey = f ? f.dataset.key : null; this._link(this._focusKey); });
      $.fields.addEventListener("focusout", e => { if (!$.fields.contains(e.relatedTarget)) { this._focusKey = null; this._link(null); } });
      $.fields.addEventListener("pointerover", e => { const f = e.target.closest(".apc-field"); this._link(f ? f.dataset.key : this._focusKey); });
      $.fields.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => this._link(this._focusKey));
      $.code.addEventListener("pointerover", e => { const p = e.target.closest(".apc-var"); this._link(p ? p.dataset.key : this._focusKey); });
      $.code.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => this._link(this._focusKey));
    }

    _selectTab(id) {
      if (id === this.version) return;
      this.version = id;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("versionchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { version: id } }));
    }

    _link(key) {
      this.$.code.querySelectorAll(".apc-var").forEach(p => p.classList.toggle("is-linked", p.dataset.key === key));
      this.$.fields.querySelectorAll(".apc-field").forEach(f => f.classList.toggle("is-linked", f.dataset.key === key));
    }

    _render() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.name.textContent = d.name || "Untitled prompt";
      $.desc.textContent = d.description || "";
      $.model.replaceChildren();
      if (d.model) {
        $.model.innerHTML = ICON_SPARK;
        $.model.append(d.model);
        if (d.temperature != null && Number.isFinite(+d.temperature)) $.model.append(make("i", null, ` · temp ${(+d.temperature).toFixed(1)}`));
      }
      $.tabs.setAttribute("aria-label", L.versions);
      $.mode.setAttribute("aria-label", L.view);
      $.mode.querySelector('[data-mode="template"] span').textContent = L.template;
      $.mode.querySelector('[data-mode="preview"] span').textContent = L.preview;
      $.varsTitle.textContent = L.variables;
      $.reset.querySelector("span").textContent = L.reset;
      $.copyL.textContent = L.copy;
      $.charsL.textContent = L.chars;
      $.tokensL.textContent = L.tokens;

      // version tabs
      const vs = this._versions();
      $.tabs.replaceChildren(...vs.map((v, i) => {
        const b = make("button", "apc-tab");
        b.type = "button"; b.setAttribute("role", "tab");
        b.id = `${this._uid}-tab-${i}`; b.dataset.id = v.id;
        b.setAttribute("aria-controls", `${this._uid}-panel`);
        b.append(make("span", null, v.id));
        if (i === vs.length - 1 && vs.length > 1) { const dot = make("span", "apc-tab-dot"); dot.title = L.latest; b.append(dot); b.setAttribute("aria-description", L.latest); }
        return b;
      }));
      $.code.id = `${this._uid}-panel`;
      $.tabs.hidden = vs.length < 2;

      // variable inputs
      $.fields.replaceChildren(...this._defs().map(def => {
        const f = make("div", "apc-field"); f.dataset.key = def.key;
        const id = `${this._uid}-var-${def.key}`;
        const top = make("div", "apc-field-top");
        const lab = make("label", "apc-key", `{{${def.key}}}`); lab.htmlFor = id;
        top.append(lab, make("span", "apc-uses"));
        const input = make("input", "apc-input");
        input.type = "text"; input.id = id; input.autocomplete = "off"; input.spellcheck = false;
        input.value = this._values[def.key] || "";
        input.placeholder = def.placeholder || def.label || def.key;
        f.append(top);
        if (def.label) { const s = make("span", "apc-flabel", def.label); s.id = id + "-l"; input.setAttribute("aria-describedby", s.id); f.append(s); }
        f.append(input);
        if (Array.isArray(def.suggestions) && def.suggestions.length) {
          const chips = make("div", "apc-chips"); chips.setAttribute("role", "group");
          chips.setAttribute("aria-label", `${def.label || def.key} suggestions`);
          def.suggestions.slice(0, 6).forEach(s => { const c = make("button", "apc-chip", String(s)); c.type = "button"; c.dataset.value = String(s); chips.append(c); });
          f.append(chips);
        }
        return f;
      }));
      this._renderVersion(false);
    }

    _renderVersion(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, vs = this._versions(), id = this.version;
      const idx = vs.findIndex(v => v.id === id), v = vs[idx];
      $.tabs.querySelectorAll(".apc-tab").forEach(t => {
        const on = t.dataset.id === id;
        t.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on)); t.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
        if (on) $.code.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", t.id);
      });
      const d = this._data || {};
      $.path.replaceChildren();
      if (d.path || v) {
        if (d.path) $.path.append(String(d.path).replace(/\/?$/, "/"));
        $.path.append(make("b", null, `${v ? v.id : ""}.md`));
      }

      // gutter marks: lines that did not exist in the previous version
      const prev = idx > 0 ? new Set(String(vs[idx - 1].text || "").split(/\r?\n/).map(s => s.trim())) : null;
      const text = v ? String(v.text || "") : "";
      const lines = text ? text.split(/\r?\n/) : [];
      let changed = 0;
      const rows = lines.map((line, i) => {
        const row = make("div", "apc-line");
        const isNew = prev && line.trim() && !prev.has(line.trim());
        if (isNew) { row.classList.add("is-changed"); changed++; }
        const ln = make("span", "apc-ln", String(i + 1)); ln.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const lc = make("span", "apc-lc");
        this._tokenize(line, lc);
        if (i === lines.length - 1) lc.append(make("span", "apc-caret"));
        row.append(ln, lc);
        return row;
      });
      if (!rows.length) rows.push(make("p", "apc-empty", L.empty));
      $.code.replaceChildren(...rows);
      $.code.querySelector(".apc-caret") && $.code.querySelector(".apc-caret").setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

      $.lines.textContent = fill(L.lines, { n: lines.length });
      $.vmeta.textContent = v && v.updated ? fill(L.edited, { date: this._date(v.updated) }) + (v.note ? ` · ${v.note}` : "") : (v && v.note) || "";
      $.changedKey.textContent = changed && idx > 0 ? fill(L.changed, { prev: vs[idx - 1].id }) : "";

      // uses per variable in this version, plus variables with no input
      const used = {}; let m; VAR_RE.lastIndex = 0;
      while ((m = VAR_RE.exec(text))) used[m[1]] = (used[m[1]] || 0) + 1;
      const defs = new Set(this._defs().map(x => x.key));
      $.fields.querySelectorAll(".apc-field").forEach(f => {
        const n = used[f.dataset.key] || 0;
        f.classList.toggle("is-unused", !n);
        f.querySelector(".apc-uses").textContent = n ? fill(L.uses, { n }) : fill(L.unused, { version: v ? v.id : "" });
      });
      const undef = Object.keys(used).filter(k => !defs.has(k));
      $.varsNote.textContent = undef.length ? fill(L.undefinedNote, { list: undef.map(k => `{{${k}}}`).join(", ") }) : "";

      this._applyMode();
      this._link(this._focusKey);
      if (animate) {
        this._announce(fill(L.announceVersion, { version: id }));
        if (!reduceMotion() && "animate" in Element.prototype) {
          $.code.animate([{ opacity: 0, transform: "translateY(5px)" }, { opacity: 1, transform: "none" }], { duration: 260, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" });
        }
      }
    }

    _tokenize(line, host) {
      let rest = line;
      const h = /^(#{1,6})(\s.*)?$/.exec(line);
      const b = !h && /^(\s*)([-*•]|\d+[.)])(\s+)/.exec(line);
      if (h) { host.classList.add("is-h"); host.append(make("span", "apc-tk-hash", h[1])); rest = h[2] || ""; }
      else if (b) { if (b[1]) host.append(b[1]); host.append(make("span", "apc-tk-bullet", b[2]), b[3]); rest = line.slice(b[0].length); }
      let last = 0, m;
      const re = new RegExp(VAR_RE.source, "g");
      while ((m = re.exec(rest))) {
        if (m.index > last) this._plain(host, rest.slice(last, m.index), !!h);
        const p = make("span", "apc-var"); p.dataset.key = m[1];
        host.append(p);
        last = m.index + m[0].length;
      }
      if (last < rest.length) this._plain(host, rest.slice(last), !!h);
    }

    _plain(host, s, heading) {
      if (heading) { host.append(s); return; }
      s.split(/(\b\d+\b)/).forEach((part, i) => { if (!part) return; host.append(i % 2 ? make("span", "apc-tk-num", part) : part); });
    }

    _applyMode() {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, mode = this.mode;
      $.card.dataset.mode = mode;
      $.mode.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.mode === mode)));
      $.code.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.codeLabel, { version: this.version, mode: mode === "preview" ? L.preview.toLowerCase() : L.template.toLowerCase() }));
      this._refreshValues();
    }

    _refreshValues() {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, preview = this.mode === "preview";
      const defs = new Set(this._defs().map(x => x.key));
      $.code.querySelectorAll(".apc-var").forEach(p => {
        const key = p.dataset.key, def = defs.has(key), val = String(this._values[key] || "");
        const empty = def && !val.trim();
        p.classList.toggle("is-undef", !def);
        p.classList.toggle("is-empty", preview && empty);
        p.textContent = preview && def && !empty ? val : `{{${key}}}`;
      });
      $.fields.querySelectorAll(".apc-chip").forEach(c => {
        const f = c.closest(".apc-field");
        c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String((this._values[f.dataset.key] || "") === c.dataset.value));
      });
      const keys = [...defs], filledN = keys.filter(k => String(this._values[k] || "").trim()).length;
      $.fillstate.textContent = keys.length ? fill(L.filled, { n: filledN, total: keys.length }) : "";
      $.fillstate.classList.toggle("is-partial", filledN < keys.length);
      $.fillstate.hidden = !keys.length;
      const text = this.filledText();
      $.chars.textContent = text.length.toLocaleString("en-US");
      $.tokens.textContent = Math.ceil(text.length / 4).toLocaleString("en-US");
    }

    _flashCopy(label) {
      const $ = this.$, L = this._labels();
      $.copy.classList.add("is-done");
      $.copyL.textContent = label;
      clearTimeout(this._copyTimer);
      this._copyTimer = setTimeout(() => { $.copy.classList.remove("is-done"); $.copyL.textContent = L.copy; }, 1800);
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("ai-prompt-card")) customElements.define("ai-prompt-card", AiPromptCard);
})();

      { key: "tone", label: "Tone of voice", default: "upbeat", suggestions: ["upbeat", "calm", "bold"] }
    ],
    versions: [
      { id: "v1", updated: "2026-09-21", note: "First draft", text: "Write 3 social ad captions for {{client_name}} promoting {{offer}}.\nThe audience is {{audience}}." },
      { id: "v2", updated: "2026-09-30", note: "Added format rules", text: "# Task\nWrite 3 social ad captions for {{client_name}} promoting {{offer}}.\n\n# Audience\n{{audience}}\n\n# Rules\n- Keep the tone {{tone}}.\n- Each caption is under 90 characters.\n- Open with a question or a number.\n- End with one call to action.\n\n# Output\nA numbered list, one caption per line." }
    ]
  };
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".seg button");
  buttons.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.removeAttribute("version");
    el.data = b.dataset.value === "ad" ? adData : emailData;
    buttons.forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x === b)));
  }));

  el.addEventListener("promptcopy", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = `${d.version} ${d.method === "clipboard" ? "copied" : "selected"} · ${d.chars.toLocaleString("en-US")} chars, ≈${d.tokens} tokens.`;
    note.append(b, " The card sent a promptcopy event. Example prompt, fictional client.");
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

</body>

client-overview {

.cov-tabs { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 0 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cov-line); }

.cov-panel { padding: 24px 30px 28px; outline: none; }

.cov-h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1; color: var(--cov-faint); }

}
.cov-opp:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cov-accent) 40%, var(--cov-line)); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 22px -18px var(--cov-shadow); }
.cov-opp-name { font: 600 14px/1.3 var(--cov-sans); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cov-opp-val { font: 600 15px/1 var(--cov-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

.cov-facts { margin: 0; display: grid; }

.cov-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.cov-chip { padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1; background: var(--cov-tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cov-line); color: var(--cov-ink); }
.cov-health-note { margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--cov-ink); background: var(--cov-tone-soft); border-left: 3px solid var(--cov-tone); }
.cov-health-note[data-status="healthy"] { --cov-tone: var(--cov-accent); --cov-tone-soft: var(--cov-accent-soft); }
.cov-health-note[data-status="at-risk"] { --cov-tone: var(--cov-warn); --cov-tone-soft: var(--cov-warn-soft); }
.cov-health-note[data-status="critical"] { --cov-tone: var(--cov-bad); --cov-tone-soft: var(--cov-bad-soft); }
.cov-health-note:empty { display: none; }

/* contacts */
.cov-people { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.cov-person {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 4px 12px; align-items: start;
  padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--cov-line);
  transition: border-color .2s;

.cov-person:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cov-accent) 35%, var(--cov-line)); }
.cov-p-av { grid-row: span 3; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--cov-tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cov-line); font: 600 13px/1 var(--cov-display); color: var(--cov-ink); }
.cov-person.is-primary .cov-p-av { background: var(--cov-navy); color: var(--cov-navy-ink); box-shadow: none; }
.cov-p-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 600 14.5px/1.25 var(--cov-sans); }
.cov-badge { padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; color: var(--cov-accent-strong); background: var(--cov-accent-soft); }
.cov-p-role { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--cov-muted); }
.cov-p-line { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.cov-email { font: 400 12.5px/1.4 var(--cov-mono); color: var(--cov-ink); overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0; }

.cov-copy {

.cov-copy svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.cov-copy.is-done { color: var(--cov-accent-strong); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cov-accent) 50%, var(--cov-line)); background: var(--cov-accent-soft); }
