.cov-form-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cov-hint { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--cov-muted); }
.cov-hint kbd { font: 500 11px/1 var(--cov-mono); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--cov-card); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cov-line); }
.cov-add {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; border: 0;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--cov-navy); color: var(--cov-navy-ink);
  font: 600 13px/1 var(--cov-sans);
  transition: background .2s, opacity .2s, transform .15s;
}
.cov-add:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cov-navy), #000 18%); }
.cov-add:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.98); }

.cov-notes { list-style: none; margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; }

.cov-note-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px 10px; font-size: 13px; }
.cov-note-head b { font-weight: 600; }
.cov-note-head time { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--cov-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.cov-note-text { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cov-note.is-new { animation: cov-note-in .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.cov-note.is-new .cov-note-av { background: var(--cov-navy); color: var(--cov-navy-ink); }
@keyframes cov-note-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); background: var(--cov-accent-soft); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; background: transparent; } }
.cov-empty { padding: 22px; text-align: center; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--cov-muted); border: 1px dashed var(--cov-line); border-radius: 12px; }

.cov-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet */
@container cov (max-width: 719px) {
  .cov-band { padding: 24px 22px 20px; }
  .cov-stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .cov-stat:nth-child(3) { border-left: 0; }
  .cov-stat:nth-child(n+3) { border-top: 1px solid var(--cov-line); }
  .cov-stat, .cov-stat:first-child, .cov-stat:nth-child(3) { padding: 16px 22px; }
  .cov-tabs { padding: 0 14px; }
  .cov-panel { padding: 22px 22px 24px; }
  .cov-ov { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
  .cov-people { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
/* phone */
@container cov (max-width: 479px) {
  .cov { border-radius: 16px; }
  .cov-band { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "id" "owner" "actions"; padding: 20px 16px 16px; gap: 14px; }
  .cov-id { gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .cov-avatar { width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 13px; font-size: 18px; }
  .cov-owner { padding-left: 0; }
  .cov-actions { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .cov-stat, .cov-stat:first-child, .cov-stat:nth-child(3) { padding: 14px 16px; }
  .cov-val { font-size: 19px; }
  .cov-tabs { padding: 0 6px; gap: 0; }
  .cov-tab { flex: 1; padding: 14px 6px 13px; font-size: 13.5px; gap: 6px; }
  .cov-panel { padding: 18px 16px 20px; }
  .cov-fact { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; }
  .cov-p-line { flex-wrap: wrap; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .cov-health, .cov-fav, .cov-fav svg, .cov-fav svg path, .cov-tab, .cov-count, .cov-tabs.is-ready .cov-ink-bar,
  .cov-opp, .cov-person, .cov-copy, .cov-textarea, .cov-add { transition: none; }
  .cov-fav.is-pop svg, .cov-panel.is-entering, .cov-note.is-new { animation: none; }
  .cov-opp:hover, .cov-add:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; }

  const initialsOf = name => String(name || "").replace(/&/g, " ").split(/\s+/).filter(w => /[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(w)).slice(0, 2).map(w => w[0].toUpperCase()).join("") || "?";
  const parseDate = s => {
    if (s instanceof Date) return s;
    if (!s) return null;
    const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(String(s));
    const d = m ? new Date(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]) : new Date(s);
    return isNaN(d) ? null : d;
  };

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="cov">
      <header class="cov-band">
        <div class="cov-id">
          <span class="cov-avatar" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <div class="cov-id-text">
            <p class="cov-kicker cov-sc"></p>
            <h2 class="cov-name"></h2>
            <p class="cov-meta"><span class="cov-industry"></span><span class="cov-location"></span></p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="cov-owner"><span class="cov-owner-av" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="cov-owner-text"></span></div>
        <div class="cov-actions">
          <span class="cov-health"><span class="cov-health-ico"></span><span class="cov-sr">Health: </span><span class="cov-health-label"></span><span class="cov-health-score"></span></span>
          <button type="button" class="cov-fav" aria-pressed="false"><span class="cov-fav-ico"></span><span class="cov-fav-label"></span></button>
        </div>
      </header>
      <dl class="cov-stats"></dl>
      <div class="cov-tabs" role="tablist"><span class="cov-ink-bar" aria-hidden="true"></span></div>
      <div class="cov-panels"></div>
      <p class="cov-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </article>`;

  class ClientOverview extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["tab", "favourite", "health"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<client-overview>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
        this._notes = this._copyNotes();
      }
      this._id = "cov" + (++uid);
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        avatar: q(".cov-avatar"), kicker: q(".cov-kicker"), name: q(".cov-name"),
        industry: q(".cov-industry"), location: q(".cov-location"),
        owner: q(".cov-owner"), ownerAv: q(".cov-owner-av"), ownerText: q(".cov-owner-text"),
        health: q(".cov-health"), healthIco: q(".cov-health-ico"), healthLabel: q(".cov-health-label"), healthScore: q(".cov-health-score"),
        fav: q(".cov-fav"), favIco: q(".cov-fav-ico"), favLabel: q(".cov-fav-label"),
        stats: q(".cov-stats"), tabs: q(".cov-tabs"), bar: q(".cov-ink-bar"), panels: q(".cov-panels"), sr: q(".cov-sr")
      };
      this.$.favIco.innerHTML = ICON.star;
      this.$.fav.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const on = !this.favourite;
        this.favourite = on;
        if (on && !reduceMotion()) {
          this.$.fav.classList.remove("is-pop"); void this.$.fav.offsetWidth; this.$.fav.classList.add("is-pop");
        }
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("favouritechange", { bubbles: true, detail: { favourite: on, company: this._data.company || "" } }));
      });
      this.$.fav.addEventListener("animationend", () => this.$.fav.classList.remove("is-pop"));
      this._buildTabs();
      this._built = true;
      this._render();
      const place = () => this._placeBar();
      if ("ResizeObserver" in window) { this._ro = new ResizeObserver(place); this._ro.observe(this.$.tabs); }
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => this.$.tabs.classList.add("is-ready")));
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      if (this._ro) { this._ro.disconnect(); this._ro = null; }
      clearTimeout(this._copyTimer);
      this._built = false;
    }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      if (name === "tab") this._applyTab(false);
      else if (name === "favourite") this._applyFav();
      else this._render();
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; this._notes = this._copyNotes(); if (this._built) this._render(); }
    get notes() { return this._notes.map(n => Object.assign({}, n)); }

    get tab() { const t = (this.getAttribute("tab") || "").toLowerCase(); return TABS.includes(t) ? t : "overview"; }
    set tab(v) { this.setAttribute("tab", TABS.includes(v) ? v : "overview"); }

    get favourite() { return this.hasAttribute("favourite") ? this.getAttribute("favourite") !== "false" : !!(this._data && this._data.favourite); }
    set favourite(v) { if (v) this.setAttribute("favourite", ""); else this.setAttribute("favourite", "false"); }

    addNote(text, author) {
      const t = String(text == null ? "" : text).trim();
      if (!t) return null;
      const note = { author: author || this._data.noteAuthor || this._labels().you, date: new Date().toISOString(), text: t, isNew: true };
      this._notes.unshift(note);
      if (this._built) {
        this._renderCounts();
        if (this.tab === "notes") this._renderNotesList(true);
        this.$.sr.textContent = this._labels().noteAdded;
      }
      const detail = { note: { author: note.author, date: note.date, text: note.text }, count: this._notes.length, company: this._data.company || "" };
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("noteadd", { bubbles: true, detail }));
      return detail.note;
    }

    _copyNotes() { return (Array.isArray(this._data && this._data.notes) ? this._data.notes : []).filter(n => n && n.text).map(n => Object.assign({}, n)); }
    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _locale() { return (this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-GB"; }
    _money(v) {
      try { return new Intl.NumberFormat(this._locale(), { style: "currency", currency: (this._data.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(), currencyDisplay: "narrowSymbol", maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(v); }
      catch (e) { return "$" + Math.round(v).toLocaleString(); }
    }
    _date(d, withTime) {
      if (!d) return "";
      const o = { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" };
      if (withTime) Object.assign(o, { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
      try { return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(this._locale(), o).format(d); } catch (e) { return d.toDateString(); }
    }
    _asOf() { return parseDate(this._data.asOf) || new Date(); }
    _status() {
      const a = (this.getAttribute("health") || "").toLowerCase();
      const h = this._data.health || {};
      const s = STATUSES.includes(a) ? a : String(h.status || "healthy").toLowerCase();
      return STATUSES.includes(s) ? s : "healthy";
    }

    _buildTabs() {
      const list = this.$.tabs;
      this._tabBtns = {};
      this._panels = {};
      TABS.forEach(t => {
        const b = make("button", "cov-tab");
        b.type = "button";
        b.setAttribute("role", "tab");
        b.id = `${this._id}-tab-${t}`;
        b.setAttribute("aria-controls", `${this._id}-panel-${t}`);
        b.dataset.tab = t;
        b.append(make("span", "cov-tab-label"));
        if (t !== "overview") b.append(make("span", "cov-count"));
        b.addEventListener("click", () => this._select(t, false));
        list.insertBefore(b, this.$.bar);
        this._tabBtns[t] = b;
        const p = make("section", "cov-panel");
        p.id = `${this._id}-panel-${t}`;
        p.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
        p.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", b.id);
        p.tabIndex = 0;
        this.$.panels.append(p);
        this._panels[t] = p;
      });
      list.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const i = TABS.indexOf(e.target.dataset && e.target.dataset.tab);
        if (i < 0) return;
        let n = null;
        if (e.key === "ArrowRight") n = (i + 1) % TABS.length;
        else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") n = (i - 1 + TABS.length) % TABS.length;
        else if (e.key === "Home") n = 0;
        else if (e.key === "End") n = TABS.length - 1;
        if (n == null) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        this._select(TABS[n], true);
      });
    }

    _select(t, focus) {
      const changed = t !== this.tab;
      this.tab = t;
      if (focus) this._tabBtns[t].focus();
      if (changed) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("tabchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { tab: t } }));
    }

    _render() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.avatar.textContent = d.initials || initialsOf(d.company);
      $.kicker.textContent = [L.client, d.plan].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      $.name.textContent = d.company || "Untitled client";
      $.industry.replaceChildren(); $.location.replaceChildren();
      if (d.industry) { $.industry.innerHTML = ICON.tag; $.industry.append(d.industry); }
      if (d.location) { $.location.innerHTML = ICON.pin; $.location.append(d.location); }

      const o = d.owner || null;
      $.owner.hidden = !(o && o.name);
      if (o && o.name) {
        $.ownerAv.textContent = initialsOf(o.name);
        $.ownerText.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode((o.role || L.owner) + " · "), make("b", null, o.name));
      }

      // health
      const st = this._status(), h = d.health || {};
      $.health.dataset.status = st;
      $.healthIco.innerHTML = st === "healthy" ? ICON.ok : st === "at-risk" ? ICON.warn : ICON.bad;
      $.healthLabel.textContent = L[st];
      const score = num(h.score);
      $.healthScore.replaceChildren();
      if (score != null) $.healthScore.append(`· ${Math.round(score)}`, make("span", "cov-sr", " out of 100"));

      this._renderStats();
      this._renderCounts();
      this._applyFav();
      this._renderPanel(this.tab);
      this._applyTab(false, true);
    }

    _renderStats() {
      const d = this._data, L = this._labels(), asOf = this._asOf();
      const stat = (label, value, sub) => {
        const w = make("div", "cov-stat");
        const dt = make("dt", "cov-sc", label);
        const v = make("dd", "cov-val", value);
        const s = make("dd", "cov-sub");
        (Array.isArray(sub) ? sub : [sub]).forEach(x => x != null && x !== "" && s.append(x));
        w.append(dt, v, s);
        return w;
      };
      // MRR + change
      const mrr = num(d.mrr), prev = num(d.mrrPrevious);
      const delta = make("span", "cov-delta");
      if (mrr != null && prev > 0) {
        const p = (mrr - prev) / prev * 100, r = Math.round(p * 10) / 10;
        delta.dataset.tone = r > 0 ? "good" : r < 0 ? "bad" : "flat";
        delta.textContent = `${r > 0 ? ICON.up : r < 0 ? ICON.down : "▶"} ${Math.abs(r).toFixed(1)}%`;
      }
      const mrrSub = delta.textContent ? [delta, d.mrrCompareLabel ? fill(L.vs, { label: d.mrrCompareLabel }) : ""] : [""];

      // tenure
      const since = parseDate(d.clientSince);
      let tenure = "";
      if (since) {
        let months = (asOf.getFullYear() - since.getFullYear()) * 12 + (asOf.getMonth() - since.getMonth());
        if (asOf.getDate() < since.getDate()) months--;
        months = Math.max(0, months);
        const y = Math.floor(months / 12), m = months % 12;
        tenure = [y ? `${y} yr` : "", m || !y ? `${m} mo` : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      }
      let sinceTxt = "—";
      if (since) { try { sinceTxt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(this._locale(), { month: "short", year: "numeric" }).format(since); } catch (e) { sinceTxt = String(d.clientSince); } }

      // opportunities
      const opps = Array.isArray(d.opportunities) ? d.opportunities : [];
      const total = opps.reduce((a, x) => a + (num(x && x.value) || 0), 0);

      // last activity
      const la = d.lastActivity || {};
      const laDate = parseDate(la.date);
      let rel = "—";
      if (laDate) {
        const day = x => new Date(x.getFullYear(), x.getMonth(), x.getDate());
        const days = Math.round((day(laDate) - day(asOf)) / 864e5);
        try { rel = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(this._locale(), { numeric: "auto" }).format(days, "day"); } catch (e) { rel = `${Math.abs(days)} days ago`; }
        rel = rel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + rel.slice(1);
      }

      this.$.stats.replaceChildren(
        stat(L.mrr, mrr == null ? "—" : this._money(mrr), mrrSub),
        stat(L.since, sinceTxt, tenure),
        stat(L.opps, String(opps.length), opps.length ? fill(L.pipeline, { value: this._money(total) }) : L.none),
        stat(L.activity, rel, la.summary || "")
      );
    }

    _renderCounts() {
      const d = this._data, L = this._labels();
      const counts = { contacts: (Array.isArray(d.contacts) ? d.contacts : []).length, notes: this._notes.length };
      TABS.forEach(t => {
        const b = this._tabBtns[t];
        b.querySelector(".cov-tab-label").textContent = L[t];
        const c = b.querySelector(".cov-count");
        if (c) c.textContent = counts[t];
      });
      this.$.tabs.setAttribute("aria-label", L.tabs);
      this._placeBar();
    }

    _applyFav() {
      const L = this._labels(), on = this.favourite;
      this.$.fav.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
      this.$.fav.setAttribute("aria-label", on ? L.removeFavourite : L.addFavourite);
      this.$.favLabel.textContent = L.favourite;
    }

    _applyTab(animate, skipRender) {
      const t = this.tab;
      TABS.forEach(k => {
        const b = this._tabBtns[k], p = this._panels[k], on = k === t;
        b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
        b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
        p.hidden = !on;
      });
      if (!skipRender) this._renderPanel(t);
      const p = this._panels[t];
      if (!reduceMotion() && !skipRender) { p.classList.remove("is-entering"); void p.offsetWidth; p.classList.add("is-entering"); }
      this._placeBar();
    }

    _placeBar() {
      const b = this._tabBtns && this._tabBtns[this.tab];
      if (!b || !b.offsetWidth) return;
      this.$.bar.style.width = (b.offsetWidth - 16) + "px";
      this.$.bar.style.transform = `translateX(${b.offsetLeft + 8}px)`;
    }

    _renderPanel(t) {
      const p = this._panels[t];
      if (t === "overview") this._renderOverview(p);
      else if (t === "contacts") this._renderContacts(p);
      else this._renderNotes(p);
    }

    _renderOverview(p) {
      const d = this._data, L = this._labels();
      const wrap = make("div", "cov-ov");

      // opportunities
      const left = make("div");
      const opps = (Array.isArray(d.opportunities) ? d.opportunities : []).filter(Boolean);
      const stages = Array.isArray(d.stages) && d.stages.length ? d.stages : DEFAULT_STAGES;
      const h = make("h3", "cov-h3");
      h.append(make("span", "cov-sc", L.oppsHead), make("small", null, fill(L.oppsTotal, { n: opps.length })));
      left.append(h);
      if (!opps.length) left.append(make("p", "cov-empty", L.noOpps));
      else {
        const ul = make("ul", "cov-opps");
        opps.forEach(o => {
          const li = make("li", "cov-opp");
          const v = num(o.value);
          li.append(make("span", "cov-opp-name", o.name || "Untitled"), make("span", "cov-opp-val", v == null ? "—" : this._money(v)));
          const meta = make("div", "cov-opp-meta");
          const si = Math.max(0, stages.findIndex(s => String(s).toLowerCase() === String(o.stage || "").toLowerCase()));
          const steps = make("span", "cov-steps");
          const ticks = make("span", "cov-ticks");
          ticks.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          stages.forEach((_, i) => { const tk = make("i"); if (i <= si) tk.className = "is-on"; ticks.append(tk); });
          steps.append(ticks, make("span", null, o.stage || stages[si]), make("span", "cov-sr", ", " + fill(L.stageOf, { i: si + 1, n: stages.length })));
          meta.append(steps);
          const close = parseDate(o.close);
          if (close) meta.append(make("span", null, fill(L.closes, { date: this._date(close) })));
          li.append(meta);
          ul.append(li);
        });
        left.append(ul);
        const total = opps.reduce((a, x) => a + (num(x.value) || 0), 0);
        const tot = make("div", "cov-opp-total");
        tot.append(make("span", null, fill(L.oppsTotal, { n: opps.length })), make("b", null, fill(L.pipeline, { value: this._money(total) })));
        left.append(tot);
      }

      // account facts
      const right = make("div");
      const h2 = make("h3", "cov-h3");
      h2.append(make("span", "cov-sc", L.account));
      right.append(h2);
      const dl = make("dl", "cov-facts");
      const fact = (k, v) => {
        if (v == null || v === "" || (v instanceof Node && !v.childNodes.length)) return;
        const row = make("div", "cov-fact");
        const dd = make("dd");
        dd.append(v);
        row.append(make("dt", "cov-sc", k), dd);
        dl.append(row);
      };
      fact(L.plan, d.plan);
      const ren = parseDate(d.renewal);
      fact(L.renewal, ren ? this._date(ren) : "");
      fact(L.billing, d.billing);
      fact(L.website, d.website);
      const chips = make("div", "cov-chips");
      (Array.isArray(d.services) ? d.services : []).forEach(s => chips.append(make("span", "cov-chip", s)));
      fact(L.services, chips);
      right.append(dl);
      const h0 = d.health || {};
      const note = make("p", "cov-health-note", h0.note || "");
      note.dataset.status = this._status();
      right.append(note);

      wrap.append(left, right);
      p.replaceChildren(wrap);
    }

    _renderContacts(p) {
      const d = this._data, L = this._labels();
      const people = (Array.isArray(d.contacts) ? d.contacts : []).filter(Boolean);
      if (!people.length) { p.replaceChildren(make("p", "cov-empty", L.noContacts)); return; }
      const ul = make("ul", "cov-people");
      people.forEach(c => {
        const li = make("li", "cov-person" + (c.primary ? " is-primary" : ""));
        const av = make("span", "cov-p-av", initialsOf(c.name));
        av.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const name = make("div", "cov-p-name", c.name || "Unnamed");
        if (c.primary) name.append(make("span", "cov-badge cov-sc", L.primary));
        const role = make("div", "cov-p-role", [c.role, c.phone].filter(Boolean).join(" · "));
        li.append(av, name, role);
        if (c.email) {
          const line = make("div", "cov-p-line");
          const em = make("span", "cov-email", c.email);
          const btn = make("button", "cov-copy");
          btn.type = "button";
          btn.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.copyFor, { name: c.name || c.email }));
          btn.innerHTML = ICON.copy;
          btn.append(make("span", "cov-copy-txt", L.copy));
          btn.addEventListener("click", () => this._copyEmail(btn, em, c));
          line.append(em, btn);
          li.append(line);
        }
        ul.append(li);
      });
      p.replaceChildren(ul);
    }

    _copyEmail(btn, emNode, c) {
      const L = this._labels();
      const done = (ok) => {
        btn.classList.toggle("is-done", ok);
        btn.innerHTML = ok ? ICON.check : ICON.copy;
        btn.append(make("span", "cov-copy-txt", ok ? L.copied : L.pressCopy));
        this.$.sr.textContent = ok ? fill(L.copiedAnnounce, { name: c.name || c.email }) : L.pressCopy;
        clearTimeout(btn._t);
        btn._t = setTimeout(() => {
          if (!btn.isConnected) return;
          btn.classList.remove("is-done");
          btn.innerHTML = ICON.copy;
          btn.append(make("span", "cov-copy-txt", L.copy));
        }, 1800);
        if (ok) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("emailcopy", { bubbles: true, detail: { name: c.name || "", email: c.email } }));
      };
      const select = () => {
        const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(emNode);
        const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);
        done(false);
      };
      try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(c.email).then(() => done(true), select); }
      catch (e) { select(); }
    }

    _renderNotes(p) {
      const L = this._labels();
      const form = make("form", "cov-form");
      const tid = `${this._id}-note`;
      const old = p.querySelector(".cov-textarea"), draft = old ? old.value : "";
      const label = make("label", "cov-sc", L.addLabel);
      label.htmlFor = tid;
      const ta = make("textarea", "cov-textarea");
      ta.id = tid; ta.rows = 3; ta.placeholder = L.placeholder; ta.maxLength = 1000; ta.value = draft;
      const row = make("div", "cov-form-row");
      const hint = make("span", "cov-hint");
      hint.append(make("kbd", null, "Ctrl"), " + ", make("kbd", null, "Enter"), L.hint.replace(/^Ctrl \+ Enter/, ""));
      const add = make("button", "cov-add");
      add.type = "submit"; add.disabled = !draft.trim();
      add.innerHTML = ICON.plus;
      add.append(L.add);
      row.append(hint, add);
      form.append(label, ta, row);
      ta.addEventListener("input", () => { add.disabled = !ta.value.trim(); });
      ta.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) { e.preventDefault(); form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.dispatchEvent(new Event("submit", { cancelable: true })); }
      });
      form.addEventListener("submit", e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!ta.value.trim()) return;
        this.addNote(ta.value);
        ta.value = ""; add.disabled = true; ta.focus();
      });
      const list = make("ol", "cov-notes");
      list.setAttribute("aria-label", L.notes);
      p.replaceChildren(form, list);
      this._renderNotesList(false);
    }

    _renderNotesList(animateFirst) {
      const L = this._labels();
      const list = this._panels.notes.querySelector(".cov-notes");
      if (!list) return;
      if (!this._notes.length) { list.replaceChildren(make("li", "cov-empty", L.noNotes)); return; }
      list.replaceChildren(...this._notes.map((n, i) => {
        const li = make("li", "cov-note");
        if (animateFirst && i === 0) li.classList.add("is-new");
        const av = make("span", "cov-note-av", initialsOf(n.author || L.you));
        av.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const head = make("div", "cov-note-head");
        head.append(make("b", null, n.author || L.you));
        const dt = parseDate(n.date);
        if (dt) {
          const time = make("time", null, n.isNew && (Date.now() - dt) < 6e4 ? `${L.justNow} · ${this._date(dt, true)}` : this._date(dt, /T\d/.test(String(n.date))));
          time.dateTime = dt.toISOString();
          head.append(time);
        }
        li.append(av, head, make("p", "cov-note-text", n.text));
        return li;
      }));
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("client-overview")) customElements.define("client-overview", ClientOverview);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const original = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.data || {}));
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".seg button");
  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = strong;
    note.append(b, " " + rest + " Example data, not real results.");
  };
  buttons.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.setAttribute("health", b.dataset.value);
    buttons.forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x === b)));
  }));
  document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.removeAttribute("health");
    el.removeAttribute("favourite");
    buttons.forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x.dataset.value === "healthy")));
    el.data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original));
    el.tab = "overview";
    say("Demo reset.", "Notes and favourite are back to the start.");
  });
  el.addEventListener("noteadd", e => say("noteadd", `fired. The client now has ${e.detail.count} notes.`));
  el.addEventListener("favouritechange", e => say("favouritechange", e.detail.favourite ? "fired. Marked as a favourite." : "fired. Removed from favourites."));
  el.addEventListener("emailcopy", e => say("emailcopy", `fired for ${e.detail.name}.`));

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

/* =========================================================
   Task Board component  (copy this block + the script)
   ========================================================= */
task-board {
  display: block;
  container: tpb / inline-size;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1000px;
  font-family: var(--tpb-sans);
  color: var(--tpb-ink);
}
.tpb {
  position: relative;
  background: radial-gradient(var(--tpb-dots) 1px, transparent 1.2px) 0 0 / 16px 16px, var(--tpb-board);
  border: 1px solid var(--tpb-line);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 26px 24px 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -48px var(--tpb-shadow), 0 2px 6px -4px var(--tpb-shadow-sm);
}

/* header: title + progress */
.tpb-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 18px 32px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tpb-intro { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; max-width: 52ch; }
.tpb-eyebrow { font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--tpb-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tpb-accent); }
.tpb-title { margin: 0; font: 650 clamp(20px, 3.2cqi, 26px)/1.15 var(--tpb-display); letter-spacing: -0.018em; text-wrap: balance; }
.tpb-sub { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--tpb-muted); }
.tpb-eyebrow:empty, .tpb-title:empty, .tpb-sub:empty { display: none; }

.tpb-progress { flex: 0 1 320px; min-width: 240px; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.tpb-prog-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.tpb-prog-label { font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--tpb-mono); letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tpb-faint); }
.tpb-prog-pct { font: 650 28px/1 var(--tpb-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tpb-prog-bar { display: flex; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tpb-tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--tpb-line); }
.tpb-seg { height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--tpb-c-solid); transition: width .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.tpb-seg + .tpb-seg { box-shadow: -1px 0 0 var(--tpb-card); }
.tpb-prog-sub { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tpb-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tpb-prog-sub span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.tpb-prog-sub i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--tpb-c-solid); }

/* toolbar: assignee chips + hint */
.tpb-toolbar { margin: 20px 0 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tpb-filter { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.tpb-chip {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 4px 11px 4px 4px; min-height: 32px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--tpb-line); background: var(--tpb-card); color: var(--tpb-muted);
  font: 500 12.5px/1 var(--tpb-sans);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.tpb-chip:hover { color: var(--tpb-ink); border-color: var(--tpb-faint); }
.tpb-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--tpb-ink); border-color: var(--tpb-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--tpb-accent-soft); }
.tpb-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tpb-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.tpb-chip--all { padding-left: 11px; }
.tpb-chip b { font: 600 11px/1 var(--tpb-mono); color: var(--tpb-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tpb-hint { margin: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tpb-faint); }
.tpb-hint kbd {
  font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--tpb-mono); color: var(--tpb-muted);
  padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--tpb-line); border-bottom-width: 2px; background: var(--tpb-card);
}

/* avatar */
.tpb-av {
  flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--tpb-av, #555); color: #FFFFFF;
  font: 700 9.5px/1 var(--tpb-sans); letter-spacing: .02em;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--tpb-card);
}

/* columns */
.tpb-cols { --tpb-n: 4; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--tpb-n), minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; align-items: start; }
.tpb-col {
  --tpb-c: var(--tpb-slate); --tpb-c-ink: var(--tpb-slate-ink); --tpb-c-solid: var(--tpb-slate-solid);
  min-width: 0; display: grid; align-content: start;
  border-radius: 16px; padding: 6px 6px 8px;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tpb-c) 60%, var(--tpb-board));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--tpb-c-solid) 18%, transparent);
  transition: box-shadow .2s ease, background .2s ease;
}
task-board [data-tone="slate"] { --tpb-c: var(--tpb-slate); --tpb-c-ink: var(--tpb-slate-ink); --tpb-c-solid: var(--tpb-slate-solid); }
task-board [data-tone="blue"]  { --tpb-c: var(--tpb-blue);  --tpb-c-ink: var(--tpb-blue-ink);  --tpb-c-solid: var(--tpb-blue-solid); }
task-board [data-tone="amber"] { --tpb-c: var(--tpb-amber); --tpb-c-ink: var(--tpb-amber-ink); --tpb-c-solid: var(--tpb-amber-solid); }
task-board [data-tone="green"] { --tpb-c: var(--tpb-green); --tpb-c-ink: var(--tpb-green-ink); --tpb-c-solid: var(--tpb-green-solid); }
.tpb-col.tpb-col--over { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--tpb-c-solid), 0 14px 28px -20px var(--tpb-c-solid); }

.tpb-col-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 8px 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-radius: 11px;
  background: var(--tpb-c); color: var(--tpb-c-ink);
}
.tpb-col-name { margin: 0; flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 650 13.5px/1.2 var(--tpb-sans); }
.tpb-col-dot { flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tpb-c-solid); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tpb-c-solid) 25%, transparent); }
.tpb-col-count {
  font: 600 11.5px/1 var(--tpb-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--tpb-card); color: var(--tpb-c-ink);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s;
}
.tpb-col-count.tpb-col-count--over { background: var(--tpb-late); color: var(--tpb-card); }
.tpb-col-toggle {
  display: none; appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
  width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; place-items: center;
  background: transparent; color: var(--tpb-c-ink);
}
.tpb-col-toggle svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; transition: transform .25s ease; }
.tpb-col-toggle[aria-expanded="false"] svg { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.tpb-col-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tpb-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

.tpb-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 8px; min-height: 64px; align-content: start; }
.tpb-empty {
  margin: 0; padding: 18px 10px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--tpb-c-solid) 45%, transparent);
  font-size: 12px; text-align: center; color: var(--tpb-muted);
}
.tpb-list:not(:empty) + .tpb-empty { display: none; }
.tpb-list:empty { min-height: 0; }
.tpb-ph {
  list-style: none; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--tpb-c-solid);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tpb-c-solid) 10%, transparent);
}

/* task card */
.tpb-card {
  position: relative;
  display: grid; gap: 9px;
  padding: 11px 12px 10px;
  background: var(--tpb-card); color: var(--tpb-ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--tpb-line); border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px var(--tpb-shadow-sm), 0 8px 16px -14px var(--tpb-shadow);
  cursor: grab; outline: none;
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.tpb-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tpb-c-solid) 50%, var(--tpb-line)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px var(--tpb-shadow-sm), 0 14px 22px -16px var(--tpb-shadow); }
.tpb-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tpb-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.tpb-card.tpb-card--menu { z-index: 5; }
.tpb-card.tpb-lifted { display: none; }
.tpb-card.tpb-landed { animation: tpb-land .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
@keyframes tpb-land {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--tpb-c-solid), 0 16px 28px -18px var(--tpb-shadow); transform: scale(1.02); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px var(--tpb-shadow-sm), 0 8px 16px -14px var(--tpb-shadow); transform: none; }
}
.tpb-ghost {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 1000; margin: 0;
  pointer-events: none; cursor: grabbing;
  font-family: var(--tpb-sans);
  box-shadow: 0 28px 44px -20px var(--tpb-shadow), 0 0 0 1px var(--tpb-line);
  opacity: .96; transition: none; animation: none;
}
.tpb-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.tpb-prio { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 600 11px/1 var(--tpb-sans); color: var(--tpb-muted); }
.tpb-prio i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tpb-p); }
.tpb-prio[data-p="high"]   { --tpb-p: var(--tpb-high); }
.tpb-prio[data-p="medium"] { --tpb-p: var(--tpb-medium); }
.tpb-prio[data-p="low"]    { --tpb-p: var(--tpb-low); }
.tpb-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--tpb-mono); color: var(--tpb-faint); }
.tpb-grip { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: -4px -6px -4px 0; color: var(--tpb-faint); touch-action: none; cursor: grab; border-radius: 5px; }
.tpb-grip svg { width: 10px; height: 14px; }
.tpb-card:hover .tpb-grip { color: var(--tpb-muted); background: var(--tpb-tint); }
.tpb-card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 13.5px/1.35 var(--tpb-sans); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tpb-col[data-done] .tpb-card-title { color: var(--tpb-muted); }

.tpb-check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 11px/1 var(--tpb-mono); color: var(--tpb-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tpb-check svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: none; }
.tpb-check-bar { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--tpb-tint); overflow: hidden; }
.tpb-check-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--tpb-c-solid); width: calc(var(--tpb-pct) * 1%); transition: width .4s ease; }
.tpb-check.tpb-check--full { color: var(--tpb-green-ink); }

.tpb-card-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 26px; }
.tpb-due { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--tpb-sans); color: var(--tpb-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.tpb-due svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: none; }
.tpb-due[data-tone="late"] { color: var(--tpb-late); font-weight: 650; }
.tpb-due[data-tone="soon"] { color: var(--tpb-soon); font-weight: 650; }
.tpb-due[data-tone="done"] { color: var(--tpb-faint); }
.tpb-move {
  appearance: none; margin-left: auto; cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--tpb-faint);
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--tpb-sans);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s;
}
.tpb-move svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.tpb-move:hover, .tpb-move[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--tpb-tint); color: var(--tpb-ink); border-color: var(--tpb-line); }
.tpb-move:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tpb-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

/* move menu */
.tpb-menu {
  position: absolute; right: 8px; top: calc(100% - 6px); z-index: 10;
  min-width: 176px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--tpb-card); border: 1px solid var(--tpb-line);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 40px -18px var(--tpb-shadow), 0 2px 6px -2px var(--tpb-shadow-sm);

  animation: tpb-pop .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);

.tpb-menu.tpb-menu--up { top: auto; bottom: calc(100% - 30px); }

  appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--tpb-ink);
  font: 500 13px/1.2 var(--tpb-sans);
}
.tpb-menu-item:hover, .tpb-menu-item:focus-visible { background: var(--tpb-tint); outline: none; }
.tpb-menu-item:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--tpb-accent); }

/* tablet: two columns per row */
@container tpb (max-width: 759px) {
  .tpb { padding: 22px 18px 18px; border-radius: 18px; }

}
/* phone: one stacked column, sections collapse */
@container tpb (max-width: 519px) {
  .tpb { padding: 18px 12px 14px; }

    _setData(d) {

    _people() {

    _due(t, isDone, L) {

    _render() {

      // tasks whose status matches no column are kept but not shown
      // progress

      const doneCol = cols.find(c => c.done);

    _say(text) { this.$.live.textContent = ""; requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (this.$) this.$.live.textContent = text; }); }

    /* ---------- events ---------- */

      if (r.bottom > window.innerHeight - 8 && card.getBoundingClientRect().top > r.height + 16) menu.classList.add("tpb-menu--up");
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      btn.setAttribute("aria-controls", menu.id);
      const enabled = items.filter(b => b.getAttribute("aria-disabled") !== "true");
      menu.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const i = enabled.indexOf(document.activeElement);
        if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
          e.preventDefault();
          const n = enabled.length;
          enabled[(i + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1) + n) % n].focus();
        } else if (e.key === "Home" || e.key === "End") { e.preventDefault(); enabled[e.key === "Home" ? 0 : enabled.length - 1].focus(); }
        else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); this._closeMenu(true); }
        else if (e.key === "Tab") this._closeMenu(false);
        e.stopPropagation();
      });
      const outside = e => { if (!menu.contains(e.target) && e.target !== btn && !btn.contains(e.target)) this._closeMenu(false); };
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true);
      this._menu = { menu, btn, card, outside };
      if (enabled[0]) enabled[0].focus();
    }

    _closeMenu(refocus) {
      const m = this._menu;
      if (!m) return;
      this._menu = null;
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", m.outside, true);
      m.menu.remove();
      m.card.classList.remove("tpb-card--menu");
      m.btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      m.btn.removeAttribute("aria-controls");
      if (refocus && m.btn.isConnected) m.btn.focus();
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("task-board")) customElements.define("task-board", TaskBoard);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const original = JSON.stringify(el.data);
  const names = {};
  (el.data.columns || []).forEach(c => (names[c.id] = c.label));

  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = strong;
    note.replaceChildren(b, rest);
  };
  el.addEventListener("taskmove", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    say(`${d.id} → ${names[d.to] || d.to}`, ` via ${d.via}. The board fired a taskmove event (progress ${d.progress}%). Example data, not real client work.`);
  });
  document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.setAttribute("assignee", "all");
    el.data = JSON.parse(original);
    say("Example data.", " Not real client work.");
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

  /* abstract stand-in artwork, drawn on a 200 × 150 canvas */
  const PATTERNS = {
    sun(g, r) {
      const cx = 60 + r() * 80;
      g.append(svg("circle", { cx, cy: 84, r: 38, class: "acp-l" }));
      g.append(svg("rect", { x: 0, y: 84, width: 200, height: 70, class: "acp-p" }));
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) g.append(svg("rect", { x: 0, y: 88 + i * 9, width: 200, height: 3.5 + i * 0.5, class: "acp-i" }));
    },
    stripes(g, r) {
      const off = r() * 20;
      for (let i = -6; i < 14; i++) g.append(svg("rect", { x: i * 24 + off, y: -60, width: 10, height: 280, class: "acp-i", transform: "rotate(28 100 75)" }));
      g.append(svg("circle", { cx: 150, cy: 46, r: 30, class: "acp-l" }));
      g.append(svg("circle", { cx: 150, cy: 46, r: 30, class: "acp-is", "stroke-width": 4 }));
    },
    dots(g, r) {
      const lx = Math.floor(r() * 9) + 1, ly = Math.floor(r() * 6) + 1;
      for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 11; x++) {
        const t = (x / 10 + y / 7) / 2;
        const rr = x === lx && y === ly ? 9 : 1.2 + t * 6.4;
        g.append(svg("circle", { cx: 10 + x * 18, cy: 12 + y * 18, r: rr.toFixed(2), class: x === lx && y === ly ? "acp-l" : "acp-i" }));
      }
    },
    arch(g, r) {
      const cx = 70 + r() * 60;
      [128, 106, 84, 62].forEach(rad => g.append(svg("circle", { cx, cy: 160, r: rad, class: "acp-is", "stroke-width": 7 })));
      g.append(svg("circle", { cx, cy: 160, r: 40, class: "acp-l" }));
    },
    blocks(g, r) {
      const w = 80 + r() * 30, h = 60 + r() * 20;
      g.append(svg("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width: w, height: h, class: "acp-i" }));
      g.append(svg("rect", { x: w + 8, y: h + 8, width: 200 - w - 8, height: 150 - h - 8, class: "acp-l" }));
      g.append(svg("rect", { x: 12, y: h + 20, width: w - 24, height: 150 - h - 34, class: "acp-is", "stroke-width": 4 }));
      g.append(svg("rect", { x: w + 22, y: 14, width: 200 - w - 36, height: h - 28, class: "acp-is", "stroke-width": 4 }));
      g.append(svg("rect", { x: w, y: 0, width: 8, height: 150, class: "acp-i" }));
      g.append(svg("rect", { x: 0, y: h, width: 200, height: 8, class: "acp-i" }));
    },
    wave(g, r) {

      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {

      g.append(svg("rect", { x: 14, y: 120, width: 60 + r() * 50, height: 9, class: "acp-l" }));

    }
  };

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="acp">
      <header class="acp-head">
        <div class="acp-intro">
          <span class="acp-eyebrow"></span>
          <h2 class="acp-title"></h2>
          <p class="acp-sub"></p>
        </div>
        <span class="acp-period"></span>

      <dl class="acp-sum">

        <div class="acp-kpi"><dt data-k="conversions"></dt><dd data-v="conversions"></dd></div>
        <div class="acp-kpi"><dt data-k="blendedCpa"></dt><dd data-v="cpa"></dd></div>

      </div>
      <ol class="acp-grid"></ol>
      <p class="acp-empty" hidden></p>
      <section class="acp-drawer" aria-label="Creative comparison">

    get sort() { const v = (this.getAttribute("sort") || (this._data && this._data.sort) || "ctr").toLowerCase(); return SORTS[v] ? v : "ctr"; }
    set sort(v) { this.setAttribute("sort", SORTS[v] ? v : "ctr"); }
    get format() { const v = (this.getAttribute("format") || (this._data && this._data.format) || "all").toLowerCase(); return FORMATS.includes(v) ? v : "all"; }
    set format(v) { this.setAttribute("format", FORMATS.includes(v) ? v : "all"); }
    get selected() { return this._sel.slice(); }
    compare(ids) {

    clearCompare() { if (!this._built) return; this._sel = []; this._syncCompare(true); }

    _labels() {

    _cur() { return (this.getAttribute("currency") || (this._data && this._data.currency) || "USD").toUpperCase(); }
    _money(v, digits) {

    _fmt(key, v) {

    }

    _render() {

      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.sub.textContent = d.subtitle || "";
      $.period.textContent = d.period || "";
      $.foot.textContent = d.source || "";

      $.lFormat.textContent = L.format;

      $.formats.setAttribute("aria-label", L.format);

      this._items = (Array.isArray(d.creatives) ? d.creatives : []).filter(Boolean).map((c, i) => {

        seen.add(id);
        const imp = Math.max(0, num(c.impressions) || 0), clk = Math.max(0, num(c.clicks) || 0);
        const sp = Math.max(0, num(c.spend) || 0), cv = Math.max(0, num(c.conversions) || 0);
        const format = ["image", "video", "carousel"].includes(String(c.format).toLowerCase()) ? String(c.format).toLowerCase() : "image";
        return {
          id, raw: c, format, name: c.name || `Creative ${i + 1}`, copy: c.copy || "",
          imp, clk, sp, cv,
          ctr: imp > 0 ? clk / imp : null, cpc: clk > 0 ? sp / clk : null,
          cvr: clk > 0 ? cv / clk : null, cpa: cv > 0 ? sp / cv : null
        };
      });
      this._sel = this._sel.filter(id => seen.has(id));

      // sort buttons
      $.sorts.replaceChildren(...Object.keys(SORTS).map(k => {
        const b = make("button", "acp-sortbtn");

        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.format = f;
        b.append(L[f], make("b", null, String(n)));
        b.hidden = f !== "all" && n === 0;
        return b;
      }));

      $.grid.replaceChildren(...this._items.map(c => { const li = this._tile(c, L); this._tiles.set(c.id, li); return li; }));

    }

    _art(c, small) {
      const art = c.raw.art || {};
      const box = make("div", "acp-art");
      if (art.invert) box.dataset.invert = "";
      const s = svg("svg", { viewBox: "0 0 200 150", preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice", class: "acp-pic", "aria-hidden": "true", focusable: "false" });
      s.append(svg("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width: 200, height: 150, class: "acp-p" }));
      const g = svg("g", {});
      (PATTERNS[art.pattern] || PATTERNS.blocks)(g, seeded(c.id + (art.pattern || "")), art);
      s.append(g);
      box.append(s);
      if (!small && c.format === "video") { const p = make("span", "acp-play"); p.innerHTML = ICON.play; box.append(p); }
      if (!small && c.format === "carousel") {
        const dots = make("span", "acp-dots");
        const n = Math.min(8, Math.max(2, num(c.raw.slides) || 3));
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) dots.append(make("i"));

      return box;
    }

    _tile(c, L) {
      const li = make("li", "acp-tile");
      li.dataset.id = c.id;
      const inner = make("article", "acp-tile-in");
      const art = this._art(c, false);

      const badge = make("span", "acp-badge");
      badge.innerHTML = ICON[c.format];
      badge.append(L[c.format]);
      const extra = c.format === "video" ? c.raw.duration : c.format === "carousel" && num(c.raw.slides) ? `${num(c.raw.slides)}` : "";
      if (extra) badge.append(make("span", null, extra));

      rank.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const ov = make("div", "acp-ov");
      ov.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      ov.append(make("span", "acp-ov-k"), make("span", "acp-ov-v"));
      art.append(badge, rank, ov);

      const body = make("div", "acp-body");
      const name = make("h3", "acp-name", c.name);
      const dl = make("dl", "acp-mets");
      [["ctr", L.ctr], ["cpa", L.cpa], ["sp", L.spend], ["cv", L.conversions]].forEach(([k, label]) => {
        const m = make("div", "acp-met");
        m.dataset.key = k;
        m.append(make("dt", null, label), make("dd", null, this._fmt(k, c[k])));
        dl.append(m);
      });
      const btn = make("button", "acp-cmp");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      btn.innerHTML = ICON.plus;
      btn.append(make("span", "acp-cmp-l", L.compare), make("span", "acp-sr", " " + c.name));
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => this._toggle(c.id));
      body.append(name, make("p", "acp-copy", c.copy), dl, btn);

      inner.append(art, body);
      li.append(inner);
      li._c = c;
      return li;
    }

    /* sort + filter, with a FLIP reflow so tiles glide to their new places */
    _arrange(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, sort = this.sort, format = this.format, cfg = SORTS[sort];
      $.sorts.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.sort === sort)));
      $.formats.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.format === format)));

      const motion = animate && !reduceMotion() && "animate" in Element.prototype;

      const visible = this._items.filter(c => format === "all" || c.format === format);
      const ordered = visible.slice().sort((a, b) => {
        const x = a[cfg.key], y = b[cfg.key];

        if (y == null) return -1;

      });

      const order = ordered.map(c => this._tiles.get(c.id));
      tiles.forEach(t => { if (!order.includes(t)) t.hidden = true; });
      order.forEach((t, i) => {
        t.hidden = false;
        $.grid.append(t);
        const c = t._c;
        t.querySelector(".acp-rank").textContent = String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0");
        t.querySelector(".acp-ov-k").textContent = keyName;
        const v = t.querySelector(".acp-ov-v"), txt = this._fmt(cfg.key, c[cfg.key]);

        }
        t.querySelectorAll(".acp-met").forEach(m => m.classList.toggle("is-sort", m.dataset.key === cfg.key));
        const old = t.querySelector(".acp-crown");
        if (c.id === best) {
          if (!old || old.dataset.sort !== sort) {
            if (old) old.remove();
            const cr = make("span", "acp-crown");
            cr.dataset.sort = sort;
            cr.innerHTML = ICON.crown;
            cr.append(L.crown[sort] || L.leader);
            t.querySelector(".acp-badge").after(cr);
          }

        const sr = t.querySelector(".acp-art > .acp-sr") || t.querySelector(".acp-art").appendChild(make("span", "acp-sr"));
        sr.textContent = `Rank ${i + 1} by ${keyName}${c.id === best ? `, ${L.crown[sort] || L.leader}` : ""}.`;
      });

      this._summary(visible, animate);

      if (motion) {
        order.forEach((t, i) => {

            return;

              { duration: 440, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" });
          }

      }
      if (animate) $.sr.textContent = fill(L.announce, { sort: keyName, n: order.length });
    }

    _summary(list, animate) {
      const t = list.reduce((a, c) => ({ imp: a.imp + c.imp, clk: a.clk + c.clk, sp: a.sp + c.sp, cv: a.cv + c.cv }), { imp: 0, clk: 0, sp: 0, cv: 0 });
      const vals = { spend: t.sp, conversions: t.cv, cpa: t.cv > 0 ? t.sp / t.cv : null, ctr: t.imp > 0 ? t.clk / t.imp : null };
      const fmt = { spend: v => this._money(v, 0), conversions: v => this._int(v), cpa: v => this._money(v, 2), ctr: v => this._pct(v) };
      this.$.sum.querySelectorAll("dd[data-v]").forEach(dd => {
        const k = dd.dataset.v, to = vals[k], from = dd._v;

    }

    _toggle(id) {

      else if (this._sel.length >= 2) { this.$.sr.textContent = L.limit; return; }

    }

    _syncCompare(fire) {

          s.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

            creatives: picked.map(c => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, format: c.format, impressions: c.imp, clicks: c.clk, spend: c.sp, conversions: c.cv, ctr: c.ctr, cpc: c.cpc, cvr: c.cvr, cpa: c.cpa })),
            winner: result ? result.winner : null,
            wins: result ? result.wins : null

      }
    }

    _metrics(L) {
      return [
        { key: "ctr", label: L.ctr, better: 1 }, { key: "cpc", label: L.cpc, better: -1 },
        { key: "cvr", label: L.cvr, better: 1 }, { key: "cpa", label: L.cpaLong, better: -1 },
        { key: "cv", label: L.conversions, better: 1 }, { key: "sp", label: L.spend, better: 0 }
      ];
    }

    _score(pair) {

      let total = 0;
      this._metrics(L).forEach(m => {

        const w = (x - y) * m.better > 0 ? a.id : b.id;
        per[m.key] = w; wins[w]++;

      const winner = wins[a.id] === wins[b.id] ? null : (wins[a.id] > wins[b.id] ? a.id : b.id);
      return { wins, per, total, winner };
    }

    _drawer(picked, L) {
      const panel = this.$.panel;
      const head = make("div", "acp-dhead");
      const ttl = make("h3", "acp-dtitle");
      ttl.append(make("small", null, L.vsEyebrow), make("span", null, picked.map(c => c.name).join(" vs ")));
      const clear = make("button", "acp-clear", L.clear);
      clear.type = "button";
      clear.addEventListener("click", () => {
        this.clearCompare();
        const first = this.$.grid.querySelector(".acp-tile:not([hidden]) .acp-cmp");
        if (first) first.focus();
      });
      head.append(ttl, clear);

      const result = picked.length === 2 ? this._score(picked) : null;
      const vs = make("div", "acp-vs");
      [0, 1].forEach(i => {
        const c = picked[i];
        if (!c) { vs.append(make("div", "acp-who is-empty", L.pickOne)); return; }
        const who = make("div", "acp-who");
        const mini = make("div", "acp-mini");
        mini.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        mini.append(this._art(c, true));
        const txt = make("div");
        txt.append(make("b", null, c.name), make("span", null, `${i === 0 ? "A" : "B"} · ${L[c.format]}`));
        if (result && result.winner === c.id) txt.append(make("em", "acp-tag", L.leader));
        who.append(mini, txt);
        vs.append(who);
      });
      const nodes = [head, vs];

      if (result) {
        const [a, b] = picked;
        const ul = make("ul", "acp-rows");
        this._metrics(L).forEach(m => {
          const x = a[m.key], y = b[m.key], max = Math.max(x || 0, y || 0);
          const li = make("li", "acp-row");
          const side = (c, v, cls) => {
            const s = make("div", "acp-side " + cls);
            s.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            if (m.better && result.per[m.key] === c.id) s.classList.add("is-win");
            const bar = make("span", "acp-bar"), i = make("i");
            i.style.setProperty("--acp-w", max > 0 ? ((v || 0) / max * 100).toFixed(1) : 0);
            bar.append(i);
            s.append(make("span", "acp-val", this._fmt(m.key, v)), bar);
            return s;
          };
          const lab = make("div", "acp-mlabel");
          lab.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          lab.append(make("b", null, m.label), make("span", null, m.better > 0 ? L.higher : m.better < 0 ? L.lower : L.noWinner));
          const w = result.per[m.key];
          const srText = `${m.label}: ${a.name} ${this._fmt(m.key, x)}, ${b.name} ${this._fmt(m.key, y)}.` +
            (m.better ? (w ? ` ${w === a.id ? a.name : b.name} wins.` : " Even.") : "");
          li.append(side(a, x, "acp-side--a"), lab, side(b, y, "acp-side--b"), make("span", "acp-sr", srText));
          ul.append(li);
        });
        const foot = make("p", "acp-dfoot");
        if (result.winner) {
          const wn = result.winner === a.id ? a.name : b.name;
          const parts = fill(L.wins, { name: "\u0000", n: result.wins[result.winner], total: result.total }).split("\u0000");
          foot.append(parts[0], make("b", null, wn), parts[1] || "");
        } else foot.textContent = fill(L.tie, { n: result.wins[a.id], total: result.total });
        nodes.push(ul, foot);
      }
      panel.replaceChildren(...nodes);
    }

    _wire() {
      this.$.sorts.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button[data-sort]");
        if (!b || b.dataset.sort === this.sort) return;
        this.sort = b.dataset.sort;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("creativesort", { bubbles: true, detail: { sort: this.sort, format: this.format } }));
      });
      this.$.formats.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button[data-format]");
        if (!b || b.dataset.format === this.format) return;
        this.format = b.dataset.format;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("creativesort", { bubbles: true, detail: { sort: this.sort, format: this.format } }));
      });
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("ad-creative-performance")) customElements.define("ad-creative-performance", AdCreativePerformance);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = strong;
    note.replaceChildren(b, " " + rest);
  };

  el.addEventListener("creativecompare", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    if (!d.ids.length) return say("Example data.", "Not real client results.");
    if (d.ids.length === 1) return say(d.creatives[0].name, "picked. Choose one more to compare. Example data.");
    const w = d.creatives.find(c => c.id === d.winner);
    say("creativecompare", `fired. ${w ? w.name + " leads" : "It's even"}. Example data, not real client results.`);
  });
  el.addEventListener("creativesort", e => say("creativesort", `fired: ${e.detail.sort} · ${e.detail.format}. Example data.`));

  document.getElementById("compare-top").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const ids = [...el.querySelectorAll(".acp-tile:not([hidden])")].slice(0, 2).map(t => t.dataset.id);
    el.compare(ids);
  });
  document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.clearCompare();
    el.setAttribute("sort", "ctr");
    el.setAttribute("format", "all");
    say("Example data.", "Not real client results.");
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

.srt-chg[data-tone="new"] { font: 600 10px/1 var(--srt-mono); letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--srt-accent-soft); color: var(--srt-accent); }
.srt-best, .srt-vol { font: 500 13px/1 var(--srt-mono); color: var(--srt-muted); }
.srt-best b { color: var(--srt-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.srt-spark { display: block; width: 100px; height: 28px; margin-left: auto; overflow: visible; }
.srt-spark path { fill: none; stroke: var(--c); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.srt-spark circle { fill: var(--c); stroke: var(--srt-card); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.srt-spark .srt-spark-base { stroke: var(--srt-line); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 2 3; }

/* expanded detail */
.srt-detail > td { padding: 0 !important; border-top: 0 !important; background: var(--srt-tint); }
.srt-detail-in {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.65fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px 26px;
  padding: 6px 18px 20px 44px;
}
.srt-chart { position: relative; padding: 14px 16px 30px 44px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--srt-card); border: 1px solid var(--srt-line); min-width: 0; }
.srt-chart-title { margin: 0 0 12px -28px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--srt-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--srt-faint); }
.srt-plot { position: relative; height: 164px; cursor: crosshair; touch-action: pan-y; }

.srt-grid { stroke: var(--srt-line); stroke-width: 1; }
.srt-bandrect { fill: var(--srt-band); }
.srt-bestline { stroke: var(--srt-accent); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; opacity: .7; }
.srt-area { fill: var(--srt-accent); opacity: .08; }
.srt-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--srt-accent); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.srt-guide { stroke: var(--srt-faint); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 2 3; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s; }
.srt-plot.srt-has-active .srt-guide { opacity: .8; }
.srt-ylab, .srt-xlab, .srt-tag { position: absolute; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--srt-mono); color: var(--srt-faint); white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; }
.srt-ylab { left: -10px; transform: translate(-100%, -50%); }
.srt-xlab { bottom: -20px; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.srt-tag { left: 6px; transform: translateY(-120%); color: var(--srt-accent); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.srt-tag--band { left: auto; right: 2px; top: 2px; transform: none; opacity: .85; }
.srt-tag--below { transform: translateY(35%); }
.srt-dot {
  position: absolute; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin: -4.5px 0 0 -4.5px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--srt-card); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--srt-accent); pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform .18s ease, background .18s ease;
}
.srt-dot.srt-is-active { transform: scale(1.45); background: var(--srt-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--srt-accent-soft); }
.srt-dot.srt-is-last { background: var(--srt-accent); }
.srt-tip {
  position: absolute; z-index: 2; min-width: 96px; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none;
  padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--srt-ink); color: var(--srt-card);
  font: 500 12px/1.35 var(--srt-sans); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -12px var(--srt-shadow);
  transform: translate(-50%, calc(-100% - 12px)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s ease;
}
.srt-tip.srt-is-on { opacity: 1; }
.srt-tip.srt-is-below { transform: translate(-50%, 14px); }
.srt-tip b { display: block; font: 650 15px/1.2 var(--srt-mono); }
.srt-tip small { display: block; font: 400 11px/1.3 var(--srt-mono); opacity: .75; }

.srt-facts { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; align-content: start; border-top: 1px solid var(--srt-line); }
.srt-fact { margin: 0; padding: 11px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--srt-line); display: grid; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; }
.srt-fact:nth-child(odd) { padding-right: 12px; }
.srt-fact--wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.srt-fact dt { font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--srt-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--srt-faint); }
.srt-fact dd { margin: 0; font: 600 14px/1.3 var(--srt-sans); overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.srt-fact dd.srt-mono { font: 500 12.5px/1.4 var(--srt-mono); }
.srt-fact [data-tone="up"] { color: var(--srt-up); }
.srt-fact [data-tone="down"] { color: var(--srt-down); }

.srt-empty { padding: 30px 16px; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--srt-muted); }
.srt-empty button, .srt-linkbtn {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--srt-line); background: var(--srt-card); color: var(--srt-ink); font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--srt-sans);
}
.srt-empty button:hover { border-color: var(--srt-accent); color: var(--srt-accent); }
.srt-foot { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--srt-faint); }
.srt-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }

/* tablet */
@container srt (max-width: 759px) {
  .srt { padding: 22px 20px 16px; }
  .srt-summary { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .srt-stat:nth-child(3) { border-left: 0; }

  .srt-th-best, .srt-c-best { display: none; }
  .srt-search { max-width: none; flex-basis: 100%; }
  .srt-detail-in { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 4px 16px 18px; }
  .srt-th-trend { width: 112px; }
}
/* phone: rows become stacked cards */
@container srt (max-width: 539px) {
  .srt { padding: 20px 14px 14px; border-radius: 12px; }
  .srt-big { font-size: 26px; }
  .srt-stat { padding: 12px 12px 11px; }
  .srt-dist { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 11px 12px 12px; }
  .srt-sortsel { display: flex; width: 100%; }
  .srt-table, .srt-table tbody { display: block; }
  .srt-table thead { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
  .srt-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px 8px; padding: 14px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--srt-line); }
  .srt-table tbody .srt-row:first-child { border-top: 0; }
  .srt-row td { display: block; padding: 0; border: 0; text-align: left; }
  .srt-c-kw { grid-column: 1 / 4; }
  .srt-c-trend { grid-column: 4; align-self: start; }
  .srt-spark { width: 64px; height: 26px; }
  .srt-c-best { display: block; }
  .srt-c-pos::before, .srt-c-chg::before, .srt-c-best::before, .srt-c-vol::before {
    content: attr(data-label); display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;

  }
  .srt-pos { height: 26px; min-width: 34px; font-size: 14px; }
  .srt-detail { display: block; }
  .srt-detail[hidden] { display: none; }
  .srt-detail > td { display: block; }
  .srt-detail-in { padding: 0 12px 14px; }
  .srt-chart { padding: 12px 10px 28px 34px; }
  .srt-chart-title { margin-left: -22px; }
  .srt-plot { height: 140px; }
  .srt-xlab--odd { display: none; }
  .srt-fact dd { font-size: 13.5px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

}

      <div class="code-wrap"><pre class="code" id="usage-code"><span class="t"><seo-rank-tracker</span> <span class="a">sort=</span>"position:asc" <span class="a">filter=</span>"all"<span class="t">></span>
  <span class="t"><script</span> <span class="a">type=</span>"application/json"<span class="t">></span>
    {
      "title": "Organic keyword positions",
      "weeks": ["Sep 18", "Sep 25", "Oct 2"],
      "keywords": [
        { "keyword": "emergency dentist near me",
          "url": "/emergency-dental", "volume": 6600,
          "history": [6, 5, 4] }
      ]
    }
  <span class="t"></script></span>
<span class="t"></seo-rank-tracker></span>

<span class="a">// or from data:</span>
el.data = { title, weeks: [...], keywords: [...] };
el.addEventListener("keywordselect", e => e.detail);</pre></div>
      <p>Change, best position and the summary are all worked out from <code>history</code>. Opening or closing a row fires <code>keywordselect</code> with the keyword, position, change and URL. Sorting fires <code>sortchange</code> and filtering fires <code>filterchange</code>.</p>
    </div>
  </section>
