<script>
/* =========================================================
   <seo-rank-tracker> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    searchLabel: "Search keywords", searchPlaceholder: "Filter keywords or URLs",
    filterGroup: "Filter keywords", all: "All", top3: "Top 3", top10: "Top 10", improved: "Improved", declined: "Declined",
    keyword: "Keyword", position: "Position", change: "Change", best: "Best", volume: "Volume", trend: "8-week trend",
    avg: "Avg. position", inTop3: "In top 3", inTop10: "In top 10", thisWeek: "Moved this week",
    up: "up", down: "down", better: "better", worse: "worse", same: "no change",
    spread: "Position spread", notRanking: "Not ranking", notRankingLong: "Not in the top 100",
    showing: "Showing {shown} of {total} keywords", empty: "No keywords match these filters.", clear: "Clear filters",
    sortBy: "Sort", newLabel: "New", lost: "Lost", vsPrev: "vs previous week",
    url: "Ranking URL", bestEver: "Best position", range: "8-week range", moved: "Over 8 weeks", volumeLong: "Monthly searches", now: "This week",
    history: "Rank history", chartHint: "Use the left and right arrow keys to step through the weeks.",
    expand: "Show history for {kw}", announceFilter: "{n} keywords shown", announceSort: "Sorted by {col}, {dir}",
    asc: "ascending", desc: "descending", positions: "positions", position1: "position"
  };
  const FILTERS = ["all", "top3", "top10", "improved", "declined"];
  const COLS = [
    { key: "keyword", cls: "srt-th-kw", dir: "asc" },
    { key: "position", cls: "srt-th-pos srt-num", dir: "asc" },
    { key: "change", cls: "srt-th-chg srt-num", dir: "desc" },
    { key: "best", cls: "srt-th-best srt-num", dir: "asc" },
    { key: "volume", cls: "srt-th-vol srt-num", dir: "desc" },
    { key: "trend", cls: "srt-th-trend srt-num", dir: null }
  ];
  const SORT_OPTIONS = [
    ["position:asc", "Position · best first"], ["position:desc", "Position · worst first"],
    ["change:desc", "Change · biggest gain"], ["change:asc", "Change · biggest drop"],
    ["volume:desc", "Volume · highest"], ["best:asc", "Best position"], ["keyword:asc", "Keyword · A–Z"]
  ];
  const ICON_SEARCH = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4.5"/><path d="m10.5 10.5 3 3"/></svg>';
  const ICON_CAL = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2.5" y="3.5" width="11" height="10" rx="2"/><path d="M2.5 6.5h11M5.5 2v3M10.5 2v3"/></svg>';
  const ICON_SORT = '<svg viewBox="0 0 9 11" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.5 0 9 5H0z"/><path d="M4.5 11 0 6h9z" opacity=".35"/></svg>';
  const ICON_CHEV = '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m3.5 2 3 3-3 3"/></svg>';
  const ICON_UP = '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 1.5 9 8H1z"/></svg>';
  const ICON_DOWN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 8.5 1 2h8z"/></svg>';
  const SVGNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <section class="srt">
      <header class="srt-head">
        <div class="srt-intro">
          <span class="srt-eyebrow"></span>
          <h2 class="srt-title"></h2>
          <p class="srt-sub"></p>
        </div>
        <span class="srt-period"></span>
      </header>
      <dl class="srt-summary">
        <div class="srt-stat"><dt class="srt-k-avg"></dt><dd><span class="srt-big srt-avg"></span><span class="srt-delta"></span></dd></div>
        <div class="srt-stat"><dt class="srt-k-top3"></dt><dd><span class="srt-big srt-top3"></span><span class="srt-of srt-top3-of"></span></dd></div>
        <div class="srt-stat"><dt class="srt-k-top10"></dt><dd><span class="srt-big srt-top10"></span><span class="srt-of srt-top10-of"></span></dd></div>
        <div class="srt-stat"><dt class="srt-k-move"></dt><dd class="srt-move"></dd></div>
      </dl>
      <div class="srt-dist">
        <span class="srt-dist-label"></span>
        <div class="srt-dist-body"><div class="srt-dist-bar" aria-hidden="true"></div><ul class="srt-dist-key"></ul></div>
      </div>
      <div class="srt-tools">
        <label class="srt-search"><span class="srt-sr srt-search-label"></span><input type="search" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>
        <div class="srt-chips" role="group"></div>
        <label class="srt-sortsel"><span class="srt-sortsel-label"></span><select></select></label>
      </div>
      <div class="srt-wrap">
        <table class="srt-table">
          <thead><tr></tr></thead>
          <tbody></tbody>
        </table>
        <div class="srt-empty" hidden><span class="srt-empty-msg"></span><button type="button" class="srt-clear"></button></div>
      </div>
      <footer class="srt-foot"><span class="srt-count"></span><span class="srt-source"></span></footer>
      <p class="srt-sr srt-live" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </section>`;

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const svg = (tag, attrs) => { const n = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, tag); for (const k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let uid = 0;

  class SeoRankTracker extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["sort", "filter"]; }

    constructor() { super(); this._open = new Set(); this._query = ""; this._uid = "srt" + (++uid); }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<seo-rank-tracker>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        eyebrow: q(".srt-eyebrow"), title: q(".srt-title"), sub: q(".srt-sub"), period: q(".srt-period"),
        kAvg: q(".srt-k-avg"), avg: q(".srt-avg"), delta: q(".srt-delta"),
        kTop3: q(".srt-k-top3"), top3: q(".srt-top3"), top3Of: q(".srt-top3-of"),
        kTop10: q(".srt-k-top10"), top10: q(".srt-top10"), top10Of: q(".srt-top10-of"),
        kMove: q(".srt-k-move"), move: q(".srt-move"),
        distLabel: q(".srt-dist-label"), distBar: q(".srt-dist-bar"), distKey: q(".srt-dist-key"),
        searchLabel: q(".srt-search-label"), search: q(".srt-search input"), chips: q(".srt-chips"),
        sortLabel: q(".srt-sortsel-label"), sortSel: q(".srt-sortsel select"),
        headRow: q(".srt-table thead tr"), body: q(".srt-table tbody"),
        empty: q(".srt-empty"), emptyMsg: q(".srt-empty-msg"), clear: q(".srt-clear"),
        count: q(".srt-count"), source: q(".srt-source"), live: q(".srt-live")
      };
      this.$.search.insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin", ICON_SEARCH);
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._render();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { clearTimeout(this._liveT); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._syncControls();
      this._renderRows(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API: el.data = { eyebrow, title, site, period, weeks: [...], keywords: [...], source } */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; this._open.clear(); if (this._built) this._render(); }

    get filter() { const f = (this.getAttribute("filter") || "all").toLowerCase(); return FILTERS.includes(f) ? f : "all"; }
    set filter(v) { this.setAttribute("filter", FILTERS.includes(v) ? v : "all"); }
    get sort() {
      const [k, d] = (this.getAttribute("sort") || "position:asc").toLowerCase().split(":");
      const col = COLS.find(c => c.key === k && c.dir);
      if (!col) return { key: "position", dir: "asc" };
      return { key: k, dir: d === "desc" || d === "asc" ? d : col.dir };
    }
    set sort(v) { this.setAttribute("sort", typeof v === "string" ? v : `${v.key}:${v.dir}`); }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _int(v) { return Math.round(v).toLocaleString((this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-US"); }

    /* normalise keywords into rows with derived fields */
    _model() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      const list = Array.isArray(d.keywords) ? d.keywords : [];
      return list.map((k, i) => {
        const history = (Array.isArray(k && k.history) ? k.history : []).map(v => { const n = num(v); return n != null && n >= 1 ? Math.round(n) : null; });
        const len = history.length;
        const pos = len ? history[len - 1] : null;
        const prev = len > 1 ? history[len - 2] : null;
        const ranked = history.filter(v => v != null);
        let best = num(k && k.best);
        if (ranked.length) best = best == null ? Math.min(...ranked) : Math.min(best, ...ranked);
        const isNew = pos != null && prev == null && len > 1;
        const isLost = pos == null && prev != null;
        const change = pos != null && prev != null ? prev - pos : null;
        const first = ranked.length ? history.find(v => v != null) : null;
        return {
          id: i, keyword: String((k && k.keyword) || `Keyword ${i + 1}`), url: String((k && k.url) || ""),
          intent: (k && k.intent) ? String(k.intent) : "", volume: Math.max(0, num(k && k.volume) ?? 0),
          history, pos, prev, change, best, isNew, isLost,
          chgSort: isNew ? 0.5 : isLost ? -1000 : (change ?? 0),
          trend: first != null && pos != null ? first - pos : 0,
          min: ranked.length ? Math.min(...ranked) : null, max: ranked.length ? Math.max(...ranked) : null
        };
      });
    }

    _matches(r, f) {
      if (f === "top3") return r.pos != null && r.pos <= 3;
      if (f === "top10") return r.pos != null && r.pos <= 10;
      if (f === "improved") return (r.change != null && r.change > 0) || r.isNew;
      if (f === "declined") return (r.change != null && r.change < 0) || r.isLost;
      return true;
    }

    _render() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.eyebrow.innerHTML = d.eyebrow ? ICON_SEARCH : "";
      if (d.eyebrow) $.eyebrow.append(d.eyebrow);
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.sub.textContent = d.site || d.subtitle || "";
      $.period.innerHTML = d.period ? ICON_CAL : "";
      if (d.period) $.period.append(d.period);
      $.source.textContent = d.source || "";

      this._rows = this._model();
      const rows = this._rows, total = rows.length;

      // summary
      const now = rows.filter(r => r.pos != null), before = rows.filter(r => r.prev != null);
      const avg = now.length ? now.reduce((a, r) => a + r.pos, 0) / now.length : null;
      const avgPrev = before.length ? before.reduce((a, r) => a + r.prev, 0) / before.length : null;
      $.kAvg.textContent = L.avg;
      $.avg.textContent = avg == null ? "—" : avg.toFixed(1);
      $.delta.textContent = ""; delete $.delta.dataset.tone;
      if (avg != null && avgPrev != null) {
        const diff = Math.round((avgPrev - avg) * 10) / 10;
        $.delta.dataset.tone = diff > 0 ? "up" : diff < 0 ? "down" : "flat";
        $.delta.textContent = diff === 0 ? L.same : `${diff > 0 ? "▲" : "▼"} ${Math.abs(diff).toFixed(1)} ${diff > 0 ? L.better : L.worse}`;
      }
      const t3 = rows.filter(r => this._matches(r, "top3")).length, t10 = rows.filter(r => this._matches(r, "top10")).length;
      $.kTop3.textContent = L.inTop3; $.top3.textContent = String(t3); $.top3Of.textContent = `/ ${total}`;
      $.kTop10.textContent = L.inTop10; $.top10.textContent = String(t10); $.top10Of.textContent = `/ ${total}`;
      const up = rows.filter(r => this._matches(r, "improved")).length, dn = rows.filter(r => this._matches(r, "declined")).length;
      $.kMove.textContent = L.thisWeek;
      $.move.replaceChildren();
      const mUp = make("span", "srt-m-up"); mUp.innerHTML = ICON_UP;
      mUp.append(String(up), make("small", null, L.up));
      const mDn = make("span", "srt-m-down"); mDn.innerHTML = ICON_DOWN;
      mDn.append(String(dn), make("small", null, L.down));
      $.move.append(mUp, mDn);

      // distribution
      const buckets = [
        { label: "1–3", c: "var(--srt-d1)", n: rows.filter(r => r.pos != null && r.pos <= 3).length },
        { label: "4–10", c: "var(--srt-d2)", n: rows.filter(r => r.pos != null && r.pos > 3 && r.pos <= 10).length },
        { label: "11–20", c: "var(--srt-d3)", n: rows.filter(r => r.pos != null && r.pos > 10 && r.pos <= 20).length },
        { label: "21–100", c: "var(--srt-d4)", n: rows.filter(r => r.pos != null && r.pos > 20).length },
        { label: L.notRanking, c: "var(--srt-d5)", n: rows.filter(r => r.pos == null).length }
      ];
      $.distLabel.textContent = L.spread;
      $.distBar.replaceChildren(...buckets.filter(b => b.n > 0).map(b => {
        const s = make("span", "srt-dist-seg"); s.style.setProperty("--c", b.c); s.style.setProperty("--n", b.n); return s;
      }));
      $.distKey.replaceChildren(...buckets.filter((b, i) => b.n > 0 || i < 4).map(b => {
        const li = make("li"); const sw = make("i"); sw.style.setProperty("--c", b.c);
        li.append(sw, b.label + " ", make("b", null, String(b.n))); return li;
      }));

      // toolbar
      $.searchLabel.textContent = L.searchLabel;
      $.search.placeholder = L.searchPlaceholder;
      $.chips.setAttribute("aria-label", L.filterGroup);
      $.chips.replaceChildren(...FILTERS.map(f => {
        const b = make("button", "srt-chip");
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.filter = f;
        b.append(L[f] + " ", make("b", null, String(rows.filter(r => this._matches(r, f)).length)));
        return b;
      }));
      $.sortLabel.textContent = L.sortBy;
      $.sortSel.replaceChildren(...SORT_OPTIONS.map(([v, t]) => { const o = make("option", null, t); o.value = v; return o; }));

      // header
      $.headRow.replaceChildren(...COLS.map(c => {
        const th = make("th", c.cls); th.scope = "col"; th.dataset.key = c.key;
        if (c.dir) {
          const b = make("button", "srt-sortbtn"); b.type = "button"; b.dataset.key = c.key;
          b.append(make("span", null, L[c.key])); b.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_SORT);
          th.append(b);
        } else { th.classList.add("srt-th-static"); th.textContent = L[c.key]; }
        return th;
      }));
      $.emptyMsg.textContent = L.empty;
      $.clear.textContent = L.clear;

      this._syncControls();
      this._renderRows(false);
    }

    _syncControls() {
      const $ = this.$, f = this.filter, s = this.sort;
      $.chips.querySelectorAll(".srt-chip").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.filter === f)));
      $.headRow.querySelectorAll("th").forEach(th => {
        if (th.dataset.key === s.key) th.setAttribute("aria-sort", s.dir === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending");
        else th.removeAttribute("aria-sort");
      });
      const v = `${s.key}:${s.dir}`;
      const opt = [...$.sortSel.options].find(o => o.value === v) || [...$.sortSel.options].find(o => o.value.startsWith(s.key + ":"));
      if (opt) $.sortSel.value = opt.value;
    }

    _visible() {
      const f = this.filter, { key, dir } = this.sort, q = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
      const val = r => key === "keyword" ? r.keyword.toLowerCase() : key === "position" ? (r.pos ?? 999)
        : key === "change" ? r.chgSort : key === "best" ? (r.best ?? 999) : r.volume;
      return (this._rows || [])
        .filter(r => this._matches(r, f) && (!q || r.keyword.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.url.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const va = val(a), vb = val(b);
          let c = typeof va === "string" ? va.localeCompare(vb) : va - vb;
          if (dir === "desc") c = -c;
          return c || (a.pos ?? 999) - (b.pos ?? 999) || a.keyword.localeCompare(b.keyword);
        });
    }

    _renderRows(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      const rows = this._visible(), total = (this._rows || []).length;
      const motion = animate && !reduceMotion();
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      rows.forEach((r, i) => {
        const { tr, detail } = this._row(r, L);
        if (motion) { tr.classList.add("srt-is-enter"); tr.style.setProperty("--i", Math.min(i, 12)); }
        frag.append(tr, detail);
      });
      $.body.replaceChildren(frag);
      $.empty.hidden = rows.length > 0;
      $.count.textContent = fill(L.showing, { shown: rows.length, total });
    }

    _row(r, L) {
      const tr = make("tr", "srt-row");
      tr.dataset.id = r.id;
      const open = this._open.has(r.id);
      tr.classList.toggle("srt-is-open", open);
      const detailId = `${this._uid}-d${r.id}`;

      // keyword
      const tdK = make("td", "srt-c-kw");
      const btn = make("button", "srt-kw");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      btn.setAttribute("aria-controls", detailId);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.expand, { kw: r.keyword }));
      const chev = make("span", "srt-chev"); chev.innerHTML = ICON_CHEV;
      const txt = make("span", "srt-kw-text");
      txt.append(make("span", "srt-kw-name", r.keyword));
      const urlLine = make("span", "srt-kw-url");
      if (r.url) urlLine.append(make("span", null, r.url));
      if (r.intent) urlLine.append(make("span", "srt-intent", r.intent));
      if (urlLine.childNodes.length) txt.append(urlLine);
      btn.append(chev, txt);
      tdK.append(btn);

      // position
      const tdP = make("td", "srt-c-pos srt-num"); tdP.dataset.label = L.position;
      const pos = make("span", "srt-pos", r.pos == null ? "—" : String(r.pos));
      pos.dataset.tier = r.pos == null ? "none" : r.pos <= 3 ? "top3" : r.pos <= 10 ? "top10" : "rest";
      if (r.pos == null) pos.title = L.notRankingLong;
      tdP.append(pos);

      // change
      const tdC = make("td", "srt-c-chg srt-num"); tdC.dataset.label = L.change;
      tdC.append(this._chg(r, L));

      // best
      const tdB = make("td", "srt-c-best srt-num"); tdB.dataset.label = L.best;
      const best = make("span", "srt-best");
      if (r.best != null) best.append("#", make("b", null, String(r.best))); else best.textContent = "—";
      tdB.append(best);

      // volume
      const tdV = make("td", "srt-c-vol srt-num"); tdV.dataset.label = L.volume;
      tdV.append(make("span", "srt-vol", this._int(r.volume)));

      // sparkline
      const tdT = make("td", "srt-c-trend srt-num");
      tdT.append(this._spark(r, L));

      tr.append(tdK, tdP, tdC, tdB, tdV, tdT);

      // detail row
      const detail = make("tr", "srt-detail");
      detail.id = detailId;
      detail.hidden = !open;
      const td = make("td"); td.colSpan = COLS.length;
      if (open) td.append(this._detail(r, L));
      detail.append(td);
      return { tr, detail };
    }

    _chg(r, L) {
      const s = make("span", "srt-chg");
      if (r.isNew) { s.dataset.tone = "new"; s.textContent = L.newLabel; return s; }
      if (r.isLost) { s.dataset.tone = "down"; s.innerHTML = ICON_DOWN; s.append(L.lost); return s; }
      if (r.change == null || r.change === 0) {
        s.dataset.tone = "flat"; s.textContent = "—";
        s.append(make("span", "srt-sr", r.change === 0 ? L.same : ""));
        return s;
      }
      const upw = r.change > 0;
      s.dataset.tone = upw ? "up" : "down";
      s.innerHTML = upw ? ICON_UP : ICON_DOWN;
      s.append(String(Math.abs(r.change)), make("span", "srt-sr", ` ${upw ? L.up : L.down}`));
      return s;
    }

    _spark(r, L) {
      const W = 100, H = 28, P = 4;
      const s = svg("svg", { class: "srt-spark", viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, role: "img" });
      const pts = r.history, n = pts.length;
      const desc = `${L.trend}: ` + pts.map(v => v == null ? "–" : v).join(", ");
      s.setAttribute("aria-label", desc);
      const tone = r.trend > 0 ? "var(--srt-up)" : r.trend < 0 ? "var(--srt-down)" : "var(--srt-flat)";
      s.style.setProperty("--c", tone);
      s.append(svg("line", { class: "srt-spark-base", x1: 0, x2: W, y1: H - 1, y2: H - 1 }));
      if (!n || r.min == null) return s;
      const lo = r.min, hi = r.max === r.min ? r.min + 1 : r.max;
      const x = i => n > 1 ? P + i * (W - P * 2) / (n - 1) : W / 2;
      const y = v => r.max === r.min ? H / 2 : P + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (H - P * 2);
      let dStr = "", pen = false;
      pts.forEach((v, i) => {
        if (v == null) { pen = false; return; }
        dStr += `${pen ? "L" : "M"}${x(i).toFixed(1)} ${y(v).toFixed(1)} `;
        pen = true;
      });
      s.append(svg("path", { d: dStr.trim() }));
      if (pts[n - 1] != null) s.append(svg("circle", { cx: x(n - 1).toFixed(1), cy: y(pts[n - 1]).toFixed(1), r: 2.6 }));
      return s;
    }

    _detail(r, L) {
      const d = this._data || {};
      const weeks = Array.isArray(d.weeks) ? d.weeks : [];
      const wk = i => weeks[i] != null ? String(weeks[i]) : `W${i + 1}`;
      const wrap = make("div", "srt-detail-in");

      // chart
      const chart = make("div", "srt-chart");
      chart.tabIndex = 0;
      chart.setAttribute("role", "group");
      chart.setAttribute("aria-label", `${L.history}: ${r.keyword}. ${L.chartHint}`);
      const head = make("p", "srt-chart-title");
      head.append(make("span", null, L.history), make("span", null, `${wk(0)} – ${wk(r.history.length - 1)}`));
      head.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const plot = make("div", "srt-plot");
      plot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      chart.append(head, plot);

      const pts = r.history, n = pts.length;
      const vals = pts.filter(v => v != null);
      if (r.best != null) vals.push(r.best);
      let lo = vals.length ? Math.max(1, Math.min(...vals) - 1) : 1;
      let hi = vals.length ? Math.max(...vals) + 1 : 10;
      if (hi - lo < 4) hi = lo + 4;
      const xp = i => n > 1 ? 3 + i * 94 / (n - 1) : 50;
      const yp = v => 6 + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * 88;

      const s = svg("svg", { viewBox: "0 0 100 100", preserveAspectRatio: "none" });
      const range = hi - lo, step = range <= 6 ? 1 : range <= 12 ? 2 : range <= 30 ? 5 : 10;
      const ticks = [];
      if (lo === 1) ticks.push(1);
      for (let t = Math.ceil(lo / step) * step; t <= hi; t += step) if (!ticks.includes(t) && t >= lo) ticks.push(t);
      const bestY = r.best != null ? yp(r.best) : null;
      if (lo <= 10) {
        const bottom = yp(Math.min(10.5, hi));
        s.append(svg("rect", { class: "srt-bandrect", x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: bottom }));
        if (bestY == null || bestY > 26) plot.append(make("span", "srt-tag srt-tag--band", L.top10));
      }
      ticks.forEach(t => {
        s.append(svg("line", { class: "srt-grid", x1: 0, x2: 100, y1: yp(t), y2: yp(t), "vector-effect": "non-scaling-stroke" }));
        const lab = make("span", "srt-ylab", "#" + t); lab.style.top = yp(t) + "%"; plot.append(lab);
      });
      if (r.best != null) {
        s.append(svg("line", { class: "srt-bestline", x1: 0, x2: 100, y1: yp(r.best), y2: yp(r.best), "vector-effect": "non-scaling-stroke" }));
        const tag = make("span", "srt-tag" + (bestY < 20 ? " srt-tag--below" : ""), `${L.best} #${r.best}`);
        tag.style.top = bestY + "%";
        plot.append(tag);
      }
      // line + area per contiguous segment
      let seg = [];
      const flush = () => {
        if (!seg.length) return;
        const dLine = seg.map((i, k) => `${k ? "L" : "M"}${xp(i)} ${yp(pts[i])}`).join(" ");
        if (seg.length > 1) s.append(svg("path", { class: "srt-area", d: `${dLine} L${xp(seg[seg.length - 1])} 100 L${xp(seg[0])} 100 Z` }));
        s.append(svg("path", { class: "srt-line", d: dLine, "vector-effect": "non-scaling-stroke" }));
        seg = [];
      };
      pts.forEach((v, i) => { if (v == null) flush(); else seg.push(i); });
      flush();
      const guide = svg("line", { class: "srt-guide", x1: 0, x2: 0, y1: 0, y2: 100, "vector-effect": "non-scaling-stroke" });
      s.append(guide);
      plot.prepend(s);

      const dots = pts.map((v, i) => {
        const lab = make("span", "srt-xlab", wk(i)); lab.style.left = xp(i) + "%";
        if (n > 6 && (n - 1 - i) % 2 === 1) lab.classList.add("srt-xlab--odd");
        plot.append(lab);
        if (v == null) return null;
        const dot = make("span", "srt-dot" + (i === n - 1 ? " srt-is-last" : ""));
        dot.style.left = xp(i) + "%"; dot.style.top = yp(v) + "%";
        plot.append(dot);
        return dot;
      });
      const tip = make("div", "srt-tip");
      plot.append(tip);

      // visually hidden data table for screen readers
      const table = make("table", "srt-sr");
      const cap = make("caption", null, `${L.history}: ${r.keyword}`); table.append(cap);
      const tb = make("tbody");
      pts.forEach((v, i) => { const row = make("tr"); row.append(make("th", null, wk(i)), make("td", null, v == null ? L.notRankingLong : "#" + v)); tb.append(row); });
      table.append(tb);
      chart.append(table);

      let active = -1;
      const show = i => {
        active = i;
        dots.forEach((dt, k) => dt && dt.classList.toggle("srt-is-active", k === i));
        plot.classList.toggle("srt-has-active", i >= 0);
        if (i < 0) { tip.classList.remove("srt-is-on"); return; }
        const v = pts[i], p = i > 0 ? pts[i - 1] : null;
        guide.setAttribute("x1", xp(i)); guide.setAttribute("x2", xp(i));
        tip.replaceChildren(make("small", null, wk(i)), make("b", null, v == null ? L.notRanking : `#${v}`));
        let line = "";
        if (v != null && p != null) {
          const c = p - v;
          line = c === 0 ? L.same : `${c > 0 ? "▲" : "▼"} ${Math.abs(c)} ${L.vsPrev}`;
        }
        if (line) tip.append(make("small", null, line));
        tip.style.left = Math.min(Math.max(xp(i), 12), 88) + "%";
        tip.style.top = (v == null ? 50 : yp(v)) + "%";
        tip.classList.toggle("srt-is-below", v != null && yp(v) < 45);
        tip.classList.add("srt-is-on");
        this.$.live.textContent = `${wk(i)}: ${v == null ? L.notRankingLong : L.position1 + " " + v}${line ? ", " + line : ""}`;
      };
      plot.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
        const box = plot.getBoundingClientRect();
        const rel = (e.clientX - box.left) / box.width * 100;
        let best = 0, bd = Infinity;
        pts.forEach((_, i) => { const dd = Math.abs(xp(i) - rel); if (dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = i; } });
        if (best !== active) show(best);
      });
      plot.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { if (document.activeElement !== chart) show(-1); });
      chart.addEventListener("focus", () => show(active >= 0 ? active : n - 1));
      chart.addEventListener("blur", () => show(-1));
      chart.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (!n) return;
        let i = active < 0 ? n - 1 : active;
        if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowUp") i = Math.min(n - 1, i + 1);
        else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowDown") i = Math.max(0, i - 1);
        else if (e.key === "Home") i = 0;
        else if (e.key === "End") i = n - 1;
        else return;
        e.preventDefault();
        show(i);
      });

      // facts
      const facts = make("dl", "srt-facts");
      const fact = (k, v, opts = {}) => {
        const box = make("div", "srt-fact" + (opts.wide ? " srt-fact--wide" : ""));
        const dd = make("dd", opts.mono ? "srt-mono" : null, v);
        if (opts.tone) dd.dataset.tone = opts.tone;
        box.append(make("dt", null, k), dd);
        facts.append(box);
      };
      fact(L.url, r.url || "—", { wide: true, mono: true });
      fact(L.now, r.pos == null ? L.notRankingLong : `#${r.pos}`);
      fact(L.bestEver, r.best == null ? "—" : `#${r.best}`);
      fact(L.range, r.min == null ? "—" : (r.min === r.max ? `#${r.min}` : `#${r.min} – #${r.max}`));
      const firstIdx = pts.findIndex(v => v != null);
      let moved = "—", tone;
      if (firstIdx >= 0 && r.pos != null) {
        const m = pts[firstIdx] - r.pos;
        tone = m > 0 ? "up" : m < 0 ? "down" : undefined;
        moved = m === 0 ? L.same : `${m > 0 ? "▲" : "▼"} ${Math.abs(m)} ${Math.abs(m) === 1 ? L.position1 : L.positions}`;
        if (firstIdx > 0) moved += ` (${wk(firstIdx)})`;
      }
      fact(L.moved, moved, { tone });
      fact(L.volumeLong, this._int(r.volume));

      wrap.append(chart, facts);
      return wrap;
    }

    _toggle(id, btn) {
      const r = (this._rows || []).find(x => x.id === id);
      if (!r) return;
      const L = this._labels();
      const tr = btn.closest("tr"), detail = tr.nextElementSibling;
      const open = !this._open.has(id);
      if (open) this._open.add(id); else this._open.delete(id);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      tr.classList.toggle("srt-is-open", open);
      const td = detail.firstElementChild;
      const motion = !reduceMotion() && "animate" in Element.prototype;
      if (open) {
        td.replaceChildren(this._detail(r, L));
        detail.hidden = false;
        if (motion) {
          const inner = td.firstElementChild;
          const h = inner.offsetHeight;
          inner.animate([{ height: "0px", opacity: 0, overflow: "hidden" }, { height: h + "px", opacity: 1, overflow: "hidden" }], { duration: 320, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" });
        }
      } else if (motion && td.firstElementChild) {
        const inner = td.firstElementChild;
        const a = inner.animate([{ height: inner.offsetHeight + "px", opacity: 1, overflow: "hidden" }, { height: "0px", opacity: 0, overflow: "hidden" }], { duration: 220, easing: "ease-in" });
        a.onfinish = () => { if (!this._open.has(id)) { detail.hidden = true; td.replaceChildren(); } };
      } else { detail.hidden = true; td.replaceChildren(); }
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("keywordselect", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { keyword: r.keyword, position: r.pos, change: r.change, best: r.best, url: r.url, volume: r.volume, expanded: open }
      }));
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.search.addEventListener("input", () => {
        this._query = $.search.value;
        this._renderRows(false);
        clearTimeout(this._liveT);
        this._liveT = setTimeout(() => { $.live.textContent = fill(this._labels().announceFilter, { n: this._visible().length }); }, 500);
      });
      $.search.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape" && $.search.value) { e.preventDefault(); $.search.value = ""; this._query = ""; this._renderRows(false); } });
      $.chips.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".srt-chip");
        if (!b || b.dataset.filter === this.filter) return;
        this.filter = b.dataset.filter;
        $.live.textContent = fill(this._labels().announceFilter, { n: this._visible().length });
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("filterchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { filter: this.filter, shown: this._visible().length } }));
      });
      const setSort = (key, dir) => {
        this.sort = { key, dir };
        const L = this._labels();
        $.live.textContent = fill(L.announceSort, { col: L[key], dir: dir === "asc" ? L.asc : L.desc });
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("sortchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { key, dir } }));
      };
      $.headRow.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".srt-sortbtn");
        if (!b) return;
        const key = b.dataset.key, cur = this.sort, col = COLS.find(c => c.key === key);
        setSort(key, cur.key === key ? (cur.dir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc") : col.dir);
      });
      $.sortSel.addEventListener("change", () => { const [k, d] = $.sortSel.value.split(":"); setSort(k, d); });
      $.body.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".srt-kw");
        if (!b) return;
        this._toggle(+b.closest("tr").dataset.id, b);
      });
      $.clear.addEventListener("click", () => {
        $.search.value = ""; this._query = "";
        if (this.filter !== "all") this.filter = "all"; else this._renderRows(false);
        $.search.focus();
      });
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("seo-rank-tracker")) customElements.define("seo-rank-tracker", SeoRankTracker);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {

/* =========================================================
   Conversion Rate component  (copy this block + the script)
   ========================================================= */
conversion-rate-card {
  display: block;

  border: 1px solid var(--crc-line);

  padding: 22px 24px 20px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  color: var(--crc-dial-ink);
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 55% at 50% 58%, var(--crc-halo), transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, var(--crc-dial-2), var(--crc-dial) 62%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}

  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; border-radius: inherit;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.018) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px);
}
.crc-dial > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.crc-dial-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.crc-dial-ch { font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--crc-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--crc-dial-muted); }
.crc-mode {
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--crc-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--crc-dial-muted); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--crc-dial-line);
  transition: color .3s, background .3s, box-shadow .3s;
}
.crc.is-whatif .crc-mode { color: var(--crc-dial); background: var(--crc-dial-gold); box-shadow: none; }

.crc-gauge { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 380px; justify-self: center; container: crc-gauge / inline-size; }
.crc-svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; }
.crc-tick { stroke: var(--crc-dial-muted); stroke-width: 1; opacity: .35; }
.crc-tick.is-major { opacity: .75; stroke-width: 1.4; }
.crc-tick-label { fill: var(--crc-dial-muted); font: 500 9.5px var(--crc-mono); letter-spacing: .04em; }
.crc-track { fill: none; stroke: var(--crc-dial-track); stroke-width: 14; stroke-linecap: round; }
.crc-arc {
  fill: none; stroke-width: 14; stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 100 200; stroke-dashoffset: 100;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px var(--crc-halo));
}
.crc.is-whatif .crc-arc { stroke-dasharray: 100 200; opacity: .78; }
.crc-rot { transform-box: view-box; transform-origin: 150px 150px; }
.crc-target line { stroke: var(--crc-dial-ink); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; }
.crc-target circle { fill: var(--crc-dial-ink); }
.crc-actual circle { fill: var(--crc-dial-ink); stroke: var(--crc-dial); stroke-width: 2; }
.crc-actual { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s ease; }
.crc.is-whatif .crc-actual { opacity: 1; }
.crc-needle { stroke: var(--crc-dial-gold); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .85; }
.crc-bead { fill: var(--crc-dial); stroke: var(--crc-dial-gold); stroke-width: 3; }
.crc-bead-core { fill: var(--crc-dial-gold); }
.crc.is-ready .crc-arc { transition: stroke-dashoffset .62s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), opacity .3s; }
.crc.is-ready .crc-rot { transition: transform .62s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), opacity .3s ease; }
.crc.is-dragging .crc-arc { transition: stroke-dashoffset .1s linear, opacity .3s; }
.crc.is-dragging .crc-pointer { transition: transform .1s linear; }

.crc-readout {
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 9%;
  display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; pointer-events: none;
}
.crc-readout-k { font: 500 max(9.5px, 2.9cqi)/1 var(--crc-mono); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--crc-dial-muted); }
.crc-rate {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-start;
  font: 400 19cqi/1 var(--crc-serif); letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums;
  color: var(--crc-dial-gold);
  text-shadow: 0 0 26px var(--crc-halo);
}
.crc-rate-pct { font-size: .42em; margin: .16em 0 0 .06em; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--crc-dial-muted); }

.crc-status-row { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: -4px; }
.crc-status {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 7px 12px 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--crc-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: var(--crc-dial-ink); background: rgba(245, 240, 230, 0.07);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--crc-dial-line);
}
.crc-status::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.crc-status[data-tone="bad"] { color: var(--crc-dial-bad); }
.crc-status[data-tone="good"] { color: var(--crc-dial-good); }
.crc-status[data-tone="on"] { color: var(--crc-dial-gold); }
.crc-delta { font: 500 12px/1 var(--crc-sans); color: var(--crc-dial-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.crc-status:empty, .crc-delta:empty { display: none; }

/* by-channel breakdown */
.crc-break { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--crc-dial-line); }
.crc-break-title { margin: 0; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--crc-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--crc-dial-muted); }
.crc-break-list { display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.crc-ch {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; text-align: left;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 74px minmax(0, 1fr) 56px; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 10px; margin-inline: -10px; border-radius: 10px;
  font: 500 13px/1 var(--crc-sans);
  transition: background .25s ease;
}
.crc-ch:hover { background: rgba(245, 240, 230, 0.05); }
.crc-ch[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(240, 192, 90, 0.10); }
.crc-ch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--crc-dial-gold); outline-offset: 0; }
.crc-ch-name { line-height: 1.35; color: var(--crc-dial-muted); transition: color .25s; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.crc-ch[aria-pressed="true"] .crc-ch-name { color: var(--crc-dial-ink); }
.crc-ch-bar { position: relative; height: 6px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--crc-dial-track); }
.crc-ch-fill {
  position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; border-radius: inherit;
  width: calc(var(--w, 0) * 1%);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--crc-arc-from), var(--crc-arc-to));
  opacity: .55; transition: width .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), opacity .25s;
}
.crc-ch[aria-pressed="true"] .crc-ch-fill, .crc-ch:hover .crc-ch-fill { opacity: 1; }
.crc-ch-tgt {
  position: absolute; top: -4px; bottom: -4px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; border-radius: 2px;
  left: calc(var(--t, 0) * 1%); background: var(--crc-dial-ink); opacity: .8;
}
.crc-ch-rate { text-align: right; font: 400 15px/1 var(--crc-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--crc-dial-ink); }

/* ---------- details column ---------- */
.crc-main { display: grid; gap: 22px; align-content: start; padding: 14px 14px 10px 8px; min-width: 0; }
.crc-head { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.crc-eyebrow { font: 500 11px/1 var(--crc-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--crc-gold-ink); }
.crc-title { margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(23px, 3.4cqi, 30px)/1.12 var(--crc-serif); letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-wrap: balance; }
.crc-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--crc-muted); }
.crc-eyebrow:empty, .crc-title:empty, .crc-meta:empty { display: none; }

.crc-seg {
  position: relative; display: flex; padding: 4px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--crc-tint); border: 1px solid var(--crc-line);
}
.crc-thumb {
  position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 0; width: 0; border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--crc-raise);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px var(--crc-shadow), 0 0 0 1px var(--crc-line), inset 0 -2px 0 var(--crc-gold);
}
.crc.is-ready .crc-thumb { transition: transform .42s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1), width .42s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1); }
.crc-seg button {
  appearance: none; position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 10px 10px; border-radius: 10px;
  font: 600 13px/1 var(--crc-sans); color: var(--crc-muted);
  transition: color .25s;
}
.crc-seg button:hover, .crc-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--crc-ink); }
.crc-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--crc-gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

.crc-stats { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-block: 1px solid var(--crc-line); }
.crc-stat { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 16px 16px 0; min-width: 0; }
.crc-stat + .crc-stat { padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--crc-line); }
.crc-stat dt { font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--crc-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--crc-faint); }
.crc-stat dd { margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(22px, 3.3cqi, 28px)/1 var(--crc-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.crc-stat dd small { font: 500 12px/1 var(--crc-sans); letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--crc-faint); margin-left: 3px; }

/* what-if */
.crc-wi {
  display: grid; gap: 12px;
  padding: 18px 18px 16px; border-radius: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--crc-raise), var(--crc-card));
  border: 1px solid var(--crc-line);
  transition: border-color .3s, box-shadow .3s;
}
.crc.is-whatif .crc-wi { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--crc-gold) 55%, var(--crc-line)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--crc-gold-soft); }
.crc-wi-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.crc-wi-label { font: 600 14px/1.3 var(--crc-sans); }
.crc-wi-out { font: 400 26px/1 var(--crc-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--crc-gold-ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.crc-range {
  --p: 50%;
  -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 26px; margin: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.crc-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 6px; border-radius: 99px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--crc-gold) var(--p), var(--crc-line) var(--p));
}
.crc-range::-moz-range-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--crc-line); }
.crc-range::-moz-range-progress { height: 6px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--crc-gold); }
.crc-range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin-top: -8px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--crc-raise); border: 2px solid var(--crc-gold);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -1px var(--crc-shadow), 0 0 0 4px var(--crc-gold-soft);
  transition: transform .15s ease;
}
.crc-range::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--crc-raise); border: 2px solid var(--crc-gold);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -1px var(--crc-shadow), 0 0 0 4px var(--crc-gold-soft);
}
.crc-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: scale(1.1); }
.crc-range:focus { outline: none; }
.crc-range:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--crc-gold); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; }
.crc-wi-scale { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: -6px; font: 500 11px/1 var(--crc-mono); color: var(--crc-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.crc-wi-result { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--crc-muted); min-height: 2.9em; }
.crc-wi-result b { color: var(--crc-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.crc-wi-result [data-tone="bad"] { color: var(--crc-bad); }
.crc-wi-result [data-tone="good"] { color: var(--crc-good); }
.crc-wi-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.crc-btn {
  appearance: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--crc-line); background: var(--crc-raise); color: var(--crc-ink);
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--crc-sans);
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, color .2s, transform .15s;
}
.crc-btn svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.crc-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--crc-gold); color: var(--crc-gold-ink); }
.crc-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.97); }
.crc-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--crc-gold); outline-offset: 2px; }
.crc-btn:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
.crc-btn--gold { background: var(--crc-ink); border-color: var(--crc-ink); color: var(--crc-card); }
.crc-btn--gold:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--crc-gold-ink); border-color: var(--crc-gold-ink); color: var(--crc-card); }
.crc-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet: gauge on top, details beneath */
@container crc (max-width: 759px) {
  .crc { grid-template-columns: 1fr; border-radius: 22px; }
  .crc-dial { padding: 22px 22px 18px; }
  .crc-gauge { max-width: 400px; }
  /* flatten the details column so the order reads: title, switch, gauge, figures, what-if */
  .crc-main { display: contents; }
  .crc-head { order: 0; padding: 10px 8px 4px; }
  .crc-seg { order: 1; }
  .crc-dial { order: 2; }
  .crc-stats { order: 3; margin-inline: 8px; }
  .crc-wi { order: 4; }
  .crc-break-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: 28px; }
}
/* phone */
@container crc (max-width: 519px) {
  .crc { padding: 10px; gap: 10px; border-radius: 20px; }
  .crc-head { padding: 8px 6px 2px; }
  .crc-stats { margin-inline: 6px; }
  .crc-dial { padding: 18px 16px 16px; }
  .crc-break-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .crc-ch { grid-template-columns: 62px minmax(0, 1fr) 50px; gap: 10px; }
  .crc-stat { padding: 14px 8px 14px 0; gap: 6px; }
  .crc-stat + .crc-stat { padding-left: 10px; }
  .crc-stat dd { font-size: 20px; }
  .crc-stat dd small { display: block; margin: 4px 0 0; }
  .crc-seg button { padding: 10px 4px; font-size: 12.5px; }
  .crc-wi { padding: 16px 14px 14px; }
  .crc-wi-out { font-size: 22px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .crc.is-ready .crc-arc, .crc.is-ready .crc-rot, .crc.is-ready .crc-thumb,
  .crc-mode, .crc-actual, .crc-ch, .crc-ch-name, .crc-ch-fill, .crc-wi, .crc-btn, .crc-seg button, .crc-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { transition: none; }
  .crc-btn:active:not(:disabled), .crc-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: none; }
}

   Showcase shell

.seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ground); border: 1px solid var(--line); }

.fields-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.fields { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }
.fields td { padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
.fields tr:first-child td { border-top: 0; }
.fields td:first-child { font: 400 12.5px/1.5 var(--crc-mono); color: var(--accent); white-space: nowrap; padding-right: 16px; }
.fields td:last-child { color: var(--muted); }
.fields code, .doc p code { font: 400 .9em var(--crc-mono); }
.btn {
  appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--crc-raise); cursor: pointer;

  transition: color .2s, border-color .2s;
}
.btn:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--faint); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

</style>

    <div class="kicker"><span>LofiStack</span><span>/</span><span>Component Gallery</span><span>/</span><span>Component 11</span></div>
    <h1>Conversion Rate Card</h1>
    <p>A gauge that shows the conversion rate against its target, channel by channel. The what-if slider lets you try a different number of conversions and see how far it is from the target.</p>
  </header>

  <section class="stage" aria-label="Component preview">
    <conversion-rate-card id="demo" channel="all">
      <script type="application/json">
        {
          "eyebrow": "Conversion rate",
          "title": "Website visitor to booked consultation",
          "client": "Brightside Dental",
          "period": "1–30 Sep 2026",
          "compareLabel": "Aug",
          "target": 4.8,
          "max": 8,
          "channels": [
            { "id": "organic", "label": "Organic", "visitors": 6420, "conversions": 244, "target": 4.0,
              "previous": { "visitors": 6010, "conversions": 212 } },
            { "id": "paid", "label": "Paid", "visitors": 4180, "conversions": 196, "target": 5.0,
              "previous": { "visitors": 3870, "conversions": 190 } },
            { "id": "email", "label": "Email", "visitors": 1560, "conversions": 101, "target": 6.0,
              "previous": { "visitors": 1420, "conversions": 87 } }
          ]
        }
      </script>
    </conversion-rate-card>

    <div class="stage-bar">
      <p class="note" id="crc-note" aria-live="polite"><b>Example data.</b> Not real client results.</p>
      <div class="seg-wrap">
        <span class="seg-label">Target</span>
        <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Target override">
          <button type="button" data-value="" aria-pressed="true">Per channel</button>
          <button type="button" data-value="4.5" aria-pressed="false">4.5%</button>
          <button type="button" data-value="5.5" aria-pressed="false">5.5%</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="docs">
    <div class="doc">
      <h2>Fields</h2>
      <div class="fields-wrap">
        <table class="fields">
          <tr><td>channel</td><td>Attribute. The <code>id</code> of the channel to show, or <code>all</code> (default). The switch updates it.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>target</td><td>Attribute. A target rate in percent that overrides every channel's own target.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>eyebrow · title</td><td>Optional header text.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>client · period</td><td>Optional text for the line under the title.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>target</td><td>JSON. Target rate in percent for the combined "All" view (and any channel without its own).</td></tr>
          <tr><td>max</td><td>Top of the gauge scale in percent. Worked out from the data if left out.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>compareLabel</td><td>Name of the previous period, e.g. <code>"Aug"</code>.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>channels[].id · label</td><td>Channel key and button text.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>channels[].visitors · conversions</td><td>Counts for the period. The rate is worked out from them.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>channels[].target</td><td>Optional target rate in percent for this channel.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>channels[].previous</td><td>Optional <code>{ visitors, conversions }</code> for the previous period. Adds the change in points.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>showAll</td><td>Set to <code>false</code> to hide the combined "All" view.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>labels · locale</td><td>Override any built-in text; number locale (default <code>en-US</code>).</td></tr>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="doc">
      <div class="doc-head">
        <h2>Usage</h2>
        <button type="button" class="btn" id="copy-usage">Copy</button>
      </div>
      <div class="code-wrap"><pre class="code" id="usage-code"><span class="t"><conversion-rate-card</span> <span class="a">channel=</span>"all"<span class="t">></span>
  <span class="t"><script</span> <span class="a">type=</span>"application/json"<span class="t">></span>
    {
      "title": "Visitor to booked consultation",
      "period": "1–30 Sep 2026",
      "target": 4.8,
      "channels": [
        { "id": "organic", "label": "Organic",
          "visitors": 6420, "conversions": 244,
          "target": 4.0 },
        { "id": "paid", "label": "Paid",
          "visitors": 4180, "conversions": 196 }
      ]
    }
  <span class="t"></script></span>
<span class="t"></conversion-rate-card></span>

<span class="a">// or from data:</span>
el.data = { target, channels: [...] };
el.channel = "paid";
el.addEventListener("channelchange", e => e.detail);</pre></div>
      <p>The "All" view adds the channels together, so every rate is worked out from the counts. Picking a channel fires <code>channelchange</code> with the channel, rate and target. Letting go of the slider fires <code>whatifchange</code> with the tested conversions, rate and gap to target.</p>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

</footer>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <conversion-rate-card> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    all: "All", allLong: "All channels", channel: "Channel", conversions: "Conversions", visitors: "Visitors", target: "Target",
    actual: "Actual", whatif: "What-if", rateLabel: "Conversion rate", whatifLabel: "If conversions were…",
    below: "{gap} pts below target", above: "{gap} pts above target", on: "On target", noTarget: "No target set",
    need: "{n} more at this traffic would reach the {target} target.",
    spare: "{n} above the minimum needed for the {target} target.",
    exact: "Exactly the number needed for the {target} target.",
    same: "Showing the actual result. Drag the slider to test a different number.",
    result: "That would be a rate of {rate}, {status}.",
    vs: "vs {label}", pts: "pts", byChannel: "By channel", setTarget: "Set to target", reset: "Reset",
    announce: "{label}: {rate} conversion rate, {status}."
  };
  const ICON_TARGET = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="5.5"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="2"/></svg>';
  const ICON_RESET = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8a5 5 0 1 0 1.6-3.7"/><path d="M3 2.5v3h3"/></svg>';

  /* gauge geometry (viewBox units): centre 150,150 · radius 118 · half circle from left to right */
  const CX = 150, CY = 150, R = 118;
  const ARC = `M${CX - R} ${CY}A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${CX + R} ${CY}`;
  const point = (f, r) => { const a = Math.PI * (1 - f); return [CX + r * Math.cos(a), CY - r * Math.sin(a)]; };

  const TEMPLATE = uid => `
    <article class="crc">
      <section class="crc-dial">
        <div class="crc-dial-top"><span class="crc-dial-ch"></span><span class="crc-mode"></span></div>
        <div class="crc-gauge">
          <svg class="crc-svg" viewBox="0 0 300 168" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="${uid}-g" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="${CX - R}" y1="0" x2="${CX + R}" y2="0">
                <stop offset="0" style="stop-color: var(--crc-arc-from)"/>
                <stop offset="1" style="stop-color: var(--crc-arc-to)"/>
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <g class="crc-ticks"></g>
            <path class="crc-track" d="${ARC}" pathLength="100"/>
            <path class="crc-arc" d="${ARC}" pathLength="100" stroke="url(#${uid}-g)"/>
            <g class="crc-rot crc-target"><line x1="${CX - R - 15}" y1="${CY}" x2="${CX - R + 13}" y2="${CY}"/><circle cx="${CX - R - 17}" cy="${CY}" r="2.6"/></g>
            <g class="crc-rot crc-actual"><circle cx="${CX - R}" cy="${CY}" r="4.5"/></g>
            <g class="crc-rot crc-pointer">
              <line class="crc-needle" x1="${CX - R + 22}" y1="${CY}" x2="${CX - R + 40}" y2="${CY}"/>
              <circle class="crc-bead" cx="${CX - R}" cy="${CY}" r="9"/>
              <circle class="crc-bead-core" cx="${CX - R}" cy="${CY}" r="3"/>
            </g>
          </svg>
          <div class="crc-readout">
            <span class="crc-readout-k"></span>
            <span class="crc-rate"><span class="crc-rate-num">0.00</span><span class="crc-rate-pct">%</span></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="crc-status-row"><span class="crc-status"></span><span class="crc-delta"></span></div>
        <div class="crc-break">
          <h3 class="crc-break-title"></h3>
          <div class="crc-break-list" role="group"></div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section class="crc-main">
        <header class="crc-head">
          <span class="crc-eyebrow"></span>
          <h2 class="crc-title"></h2>
          <p class="crc-meta"></p>
        </header>
        <div class="crc-seg" role="group"><span class="crc-thumb" aria-hidden="true"></span></div>
        <dl class="crc-stats">
          <div class="crc-stat"><dt class="crc-k-conv"></dt><dd class="crc-v-conv"></dd></div>
          <div class="crc-stat"><dt class="crc-k-vis"></dt><dd class="crc-v-vis"></dd></div>
          <div class="crc-stat"><dt class="crc-k-tgt"></dt><dd class="crc-v-tgt"></dd></div>
        </dl>
        <div class="crc-wi">
          <div class="crc-wi-head">
            <label class="crc-wi-label" for="${uid}-r"></label>
            <output class="crc-wi-out" for="${uid}-r"></output>
          </div>
          <input class="crc-range" id="${uid}-r" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="0">
          <div class="crc-wi-scale" aria-hidden="true"><span class="crc-wi-min">0</span><span class="crc-wi-max"></span></div>
          <p class="crc-wi-result"></p>
          <div class="crc-wi-actions">
            <button type="button" class="crc-btn crc-btn--gold" data-act="target"></button>
            <button type="button" class="crc-btn" data-act="reset"></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <p class="crc-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </article>`;

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let uidCount = 0;

  class ConversionRateCard extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["channel", "target"]; }

    constructor() {
      super();
      this._uid = "crc" + (++uidCount);
      this._shown = 0;
      this._whatif = null;
    }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (!this._built) {
        if (!this._data) {
          const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
          try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
          catch (e) { console.warn("<conversion-rate-card>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
        }
        this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE(this._uid);
        const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
        this.$ = {
          card: q(".crc"), dialCh: q(".crc-dial-ch"), mode: q(".crc-mode"), ticks: q(".crc-ticks"), arc: q(".crc-arc"),
          target: q(".crc-target"), actual: q(".crc-actual"), pointer: q(".crc-pointer"),
          readK: q(".crc-readout-k"), rateNum: q(".crc-rate-num"), status: q(".crc-status"), delta: q(".crc-delta"),
          breakTitle: q(".crc-break-title"), breakList: q(".crc-break-list"),
          eyebrow: q(".crc-eyebrow"), title: q(".crc-title"), meta: q(".crc-meta"),
          seg: q(".crc-seg"), thumb: q(".crc-thumb"),
          kConv: q(".crc-k-conv"), vConv: q(".crc-v-conv"), kVis: q(".crc-k-vis"), vVis: q(".crc-v-vis"), kTgt: q(".crc-k-tgt"), vTgt: q(".crc-v-tgt"),
          wiLabel: q(".crc-wi-label"), wiOut: q(".crc-wi-out"), range: q(".crc-range"), wiMax: q(".crc-wi-max"), wiResult: q(".crc-wi-result"),
          btnTarget: q('[data-act="target"]'), btnReset: q('[data-act="reset"]'), sr: q(".crc-sr")
        };
        this._wire();
        this._built = true;
        this._render(false);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => this.$ && this.$.card.classList.add("is-ready")));
      }
      if ("ResizeObserver" in window && !this._ro) {
        this._ro = new ResizeObserver(() => this._placeThumb());
        this._ro.observe(this.$.seg);
      }
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf);
      if (this._ro) { this._ro.disconnect(); this._ro = null; }
    }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      if (name === "channel") this._apply(true);
      else this._render(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API: el.data = { eyebrow, title, client, period, target, max, compareLabel, channels: [...] } */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; if (this._built) this._render(true); }

    get channel() { return this.getAttribute("channel") || (this._data && this._data.channel) || "all"; }
    set channel(v) { this.setAttribute("channel", String(v)); }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _locale() { return (this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-US"; }
    _int(v) { return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(this._locale()); }
    _fix(v, d = 2) { return v.toLocaleString(this._locale(), { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d }); }
    _pct(v) { return v == null ? "—" : this._fix(v) + "%"; }

    _channels() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels();
      const over = num(this.getAttribute("target"));
      const base = num(d.target);
      const list = (Array.isArray(d.channels) ? d.channels : []).map((c, i) => {
        c = c || {};
        const visitors = Math.max(0, num(c.visitors) ?? 0);
        const conversions = clamp(num(c.conversions) ?? 0, 0, visitors || Infinity);
        const p = c.previous && num(c.previous.visitors) > 0 ? { visitors: num(c.previous.visitors), conversions: Math.max(0, num(c.previous.conversions) ?? 0) } : null;
        return { id: String(c.id || `channel-${i + 1}`), label: c.label || `Channel ${i + 1}`, long: c.label || `Channel ${i + 1}`, visitors, conversions, target: num(c.target) ?? base, prev: p };
      });
      if (list.length > 1 && d.showAll !== false) {
        const sum = k => list.reduce((a, c) => a + c[k], 0);
        const prevOk = list.every(c => c.prev);
        list.unshift({
          id: "all", label: L.all, long: L.allLong, visitors: sum("visitors"), conversions: sum("conversions"),
          target: base,
          prev: prevOk ? { visitors: list.reduce((a, c) => a + c.prev.visitors, 0), conversions: list.reduce((a, c) => a + c.prev.conversions, 0) } : null
        });
      }
      list.forEach(c => {
        if (over != null) c.target = over;
        c.rate = c.visitors > 0 ? c.conversions / c.visitors * 100 : null;
        c.prevRate = c.prev ? c.prev.conversions / c.prev.visitors * 100 : null;
        c.needed = c.target != null && c.visitors > 0 ? Math.ceil(c.target / 100 * c.visitors - 1e-9) : null;
      });
      return list;
    }

    _max(list) {
      const m = num(this._data && this._data.max);
      if (m > 0) return m;
      const top = Math.max(1, ...list.map(c => Math.max(c.rate || 0, c.target || 0)));
      return Math.ceil(top * 1.25 / 2) * 2;
    }

    _current() {
      const id = this.channel;
      return this._list.find(c => c.id === id) || this._list[0] || null;
    }

    _render(animate) {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      this._list = this._channels();
      this._scale = this._max(this._list);

      $.eyebrow.textContent = d.eyebrow || "";
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.meta.textContent = [d.client, d.period].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      $.seg.setAttribute("aria-label", L.channel);
      $.breakTitle.textContent = L.byChannel;
      $.breakList.setAttribute("aria-label", L.byChannel);
      $.kConv.textContent = L.conversions; $.kVis.textContent = L.visitors; $.kTgt.textContent = L.target;
      $.wiLabel.textContent = L.whatifLabel;
      $.btnTarget.innerHTML = ICON_TARGET; $.btnTarget.append(L.setTarget);
      $.btnReset.innerHTML = ICON_RESET; $.btnReset.append(L.reset);

      // channel switch
      $.seg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.remove());
      this._list.forEach(c => {
        const b = make("button", null, c.label);
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.ch = c.id;
        $.seg.append(b);
      });

      // breakdown rows
      $.breakList.replaceChildren(...this._list.map(c => {
        const b = make("button", "crc-ch");
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.ch = c.id;
        const bar = make("span", "crc-ch-bar");
        const fillEl = make("span", "crc-ch-fill");
        fillEl.style.setProperty("--w", clamp((c.rate || 0) / this._scale * 100, 0, 100).toFixed(2));
        bar.append(fillEl);
        if (c.target != null) {
          const t = make("span", "crc-ch-tgt");
          t.style.setProperty("--t", clamp(c.target / this._scale * 100, 0, 100).toFixed(2));
          bar.append(t);
        }
        bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const status = c.rate == null ? "" : ", " + this._statusText(c.rate, c.target, L);
        b.setAttribute("aria-label", `${c.long}: ${this._pct(c.rate)}${status}`);
        b.append(make("span", "crc-ch-name", c.label), bar, make("span", "crc-ch-rate", this._pct(c.rate)));
        return b;
      }));

      // gauge ticks + end labels (numbers only, so markup is safe)
      let t = "";
      const steps = Math.round(this._scale * 2);
      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        const f = i / steps, major = i % 2 === 0;
        const [x1, y1] = point(f, R + 11), [x2, y2] = point(f, R + (major ? 20 : 15));
        t += `<line class="crc-tick${major ? " is-major" : ""}" x1="${x1.toFixed(2)}" y1="${y1.toFixed(2)}" x2="${x2.toFixed(2)}" y2="${y2.toFixed(2)}"/>`;
      }
      t += `<text class="crc-tick-label" x="${CX - R}" y="166" text-anchor="middle">0%</text>`;
      t += `<text class="crc-tick-label" x="${CX + R}" y="166" text-anchor="middle">${this._fix(this._scale, Number.isInteger(this._scale) ? 0 : 1)}%</text>`;
      $.ticks.innerHTML = t;

      this._apply(animate);
    }

    _apply(animate) {
      const c = this._current(), $ = this.$, L = this._labels();
      if (!c) {
        $.vConv.textContent = $.vVis.textContent = $.vTgt.textContent = "—";
        $.rateNum.textContent = "—"; $.status.textContent = ""; $.delta.textContent = "";
        $.range.disabled = true; $.btnTarget.disabled = $.btnReset.disabled = true;
        return;
      }
      $.seg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.ch === c.id)));
      $.breakList.querySelectorAll(".crc-ch").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.ch === c.id)));
      this._placeThumb();

      $.dialCh.textContent = `${c.long} · ${L.rateLabel}`;
      $.vConv.textContent = this._int(c.conversions);
      $.vVis.textContent = this._int(c.visitors);
      $.vTgt.textContent = c.target == null ? "—" : this._fix(c.target) + "%";

      const top = Math.max(c.conversions, Math.ceil(c.visitors * this._scale / 100), c.needed || 0);
      $.range.disabled = !(c.visitors > 0);
      $.range.max = String(top);
      $.wiMax.textContent = this._int(top);
      $.btnTarget.disabled = c.needed == null;
      this._whatif = c.conversions;
      $.range.value = String(this._whatif);
      this._update(animate);

      const tgt = this.$.target;
      tgt.style.display = c.target == null ? "none" : "";
      if (c.target != null) tgt.style.transform = `rotate(${clamp(c.target / this._scale, 0, 1) * 180}deg)`;
      this.$.actual.style.transform = `rotate(${clamp((c.rate || 0) / this._scale, 0, 1) * 180}deg)`;

      if (animate) $.sr.textContent = fill(L.announce, { label: c.long, rate: this._pct(c.rate), status: this._statusText(c.rate, c.target, L) });
    }

    _statusText(rate, target, L) {
      if (rate == null || target == null) return L.noTarget;
      const gap = Math.round((rate - target) * 100) / 100;
      if (gap === 0) return L.on;
      return fill(gap < 0 ? L.below : L.above, { gap: this._fix(Math.abs(gap)) });
    }

    _update(animate) {
      const c = this._current(), $ = this.$, L = this._labels();
      if (!c) return;
      const conv = this._whatif;
      const rate = c.visitors > 0 ? conv / c.visitors * 100 : 0;
      const isWhat = conv !== c.conversions;
      $.card.classList.toggle("is-whatif", isWhat);
      $.mode.textContent = isWhat ? L.whatif : L.actual;
      $.readK.textContent = isWhat ? L.whatif : L.actual;

      const f = clamp(rate / this._scale, 0, 1);
      $.arc.style.strokeDashoffset = String(100 - f * 100);
      $.pointer.style.transform = `rotate(${f * 180}deg)`;
      this._tween(rate, animate);

      const status = this._statusText(rate, c.target, L);
      const gap = c.target == null ? null : Math.round((rate - c.target) * 100) / 100;
      const tone = gap == null ? "" : gap < 0 ? "bad" : gap > 0 ? "good" : "on";
      $.status.textContent = status;
      if (tone) $.status.dataset.tone = tone; else delete $.status.dataset.tone;

      if (!isWhat && c.prevRate != null && c.rate != null) {
        const dp = Math.round((c.rate - c.prevRate) * 100) / 100;
        const arrow = dp > 0 ? "▲" : dp < 0 ? "▼" : "▶";
        $.delta.textContent = `${arrow} ${this._fix(Math.abs(dp))} ${L.pts} ${fill(L.vs, { label: (this._data && this._data.compareLabel) || "" })}`.trim();
      } else if (isWhat) {
        $.delta.textContent = `${L.actual} ${this._pct(c.rate)}`;
      } else $.delta.textContent = "";

      // what-if panel
      $.wiOut.textContent = this._int(conv);
      const max = +$.range.max || 1;
      $.range.style.setProperty("--p", (conv / max * 100).toFixed(2) + "%");
      $.range.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", `${this._int(conv)} conversions, ${this._pct(rate)}`);
      $.btnReset.disabled = !isWhat;
      $.btnTarget.disabled = c.needed == null || conv === c.needed;

      $.wiResult.replaceChildren();
      if (!isWhat) {
        $.wiResult.append(L.same);
      } else {
        const parts = fill(L.result, { rate: "\u0000", status: "\u0001" }).split(/(\u0000|\u0001)/);
        parts.forEach(p => {
          if (p === "\u0000") $.wiResult.append(make("b", null, this._pct(rate)));
          else if (p === "\u0001") { const s = make("b", null, status); if (tone) s.dataset.tone = tone; $.wiResult.append(s); }
          else if (p) $.wiResult.append(p);
        });
      }
      if (c.needed != null) {
        const diff = c.needed - conv, tgt = this._fix(c.target) + "%";
        const line = diff > 0 ? fill(L.need, { n: this._int(diff), target: tgt })
          : diff < 0 ? fill(L.spare, { n: this._int(-diff), target: tgt })
          : fill(L.exact, { target: tgt });
        $.wiResult.append(" ", line);
      }
    }

    _tween(to, animate) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf);
      const el = this.$.rateNum, from = this._shown;
      const show = v => { el.textContent = this._fix(v); };
      if (!animate || reduceMotion() || Math.abs(to - from) < 0.005) { this._shown = to; show(to); return; }
      const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 600;
      const step = now => {
        const k = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3);
        this._shown = from + (to - from) * e;
        show(k < 1 ? this._shown : to);
        if (k < 1) this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      };
      this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    _pick(id) {
      if (id === this.channel) return;
      this.channel = id;
      const c = this._current();
      if (!c) return;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("channelchange", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { channel: c.id, label: c.long, rate: c.rate, target: c.target, visitors: c.visitors, conversions: c.conversions }
      }));
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      const onPick = e => { const b = e.target.closest("button[data-ch]"); if (b) this._pick(b.dataset.ch); };
      $.seg.addEventListener("click", onPick);
      $.breakList.addEventListener("click", onPick);

      const endDrag = () => $.card.classList.remove("is-dragging");
      $.range.addEventListener("input", () => {
        $.card.classList.add("is-dragging");
        this._whatif = Math.round(+$.range.value);
        this._update(false);
      });
      $.range.addEventListener("change", () => {
        endDrag();
        const c = this._current();
        if (!c) return;
        const rate = c.visitors > 0 ? this._whatif / c.visitors * 100 : 0;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("whatifchange", {
          bubbles: true,
          detail: { channel: c.id, conversions: this._whatif, actual: c.conversions, rate, target: c.target, gap: c.target == null ? null : rate - c.target }
        }));
      });
      $.range.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
      $.range.addEventListener("blur", endDrag);

      const setTo = v => {
        endDrag();
        this._whatif = v;
        $.range.value = String(v);
        this._update(true);
      };
      $.btnTarget.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const c = this._current();
        if (c && c.needed != null) setTo(clamp(c.needed, 0, +$.range.max));
      });
      $.btnReset.addEventListener("click", () => { const c = this._current(); if (c) setTo(c.conversions); });
    }

    _placeThumb() {
      const b = this.$.seg.querySelector('button[aria-pressed="true"]');
      if (!b || !b.offsetWidth) { this.$.thumb.style.width = "0"; return; }
      this.$.thumb.style.width = b.offsetWidth + "px";
      this.$.thumb.style.transform = `translateX(${b.offsetLeft}px)`;
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("conversion-rate-card")) customElements.define("conversion-rate-card", ConversionRateCard);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("crc-note");
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".seg button");
  buttons.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (b.dataset.value) el.setAttribute("target", b.dataset.value);
    else el.removeAttribute("target");
    buttons.forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x === b)));
  }));

  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = strong;
    note.append(b, " " + rest);
  };
  el.addEventListener("channelchange", e => say(`${e.detail.label} selected.`, "The card sent a channelchange event. Example data, not real client results."));
  el.addEventListener("whatifchange", e => say(`What-if: ${e.detail.conversions.toLocaleString("en-US")} conversions.`, "The card sent a whatifchange event. Example data, not real client results."));

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>
