.wac-power { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex: none; padding: 6px 6px 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--wac-line); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); }
.wac-pstate { display: grid; gap: 4px; text-align: right; }
.wac-pstate b { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 7px; font: 600 13px/1 var(--wac-sans); }
.wac-pstate b::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--wac-faint); transition: background .3s, box-shadow .3s; }
.wac[data-on="true"] .wac-pstate b::before { background: var(--wac-ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.18); }
.wac-pstate small { font: 400 11px/1.2 var(--wac-sans); color: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-switch {
  appearance: none; flex: none; position: relative; width: 52px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border-radius: 99px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--wac-line-strong); background: #0A1830; transition: background .3s, border-color .3s;
}
.wac-switch::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--wac-muted); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1), background .3s;
}
.wac-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--wac-cyan); border-color: var(--wac-cyan); }
.wac-switch[aria-checked="true"]::after { transform: translateX(22px); background: #FFFFFF; }

/* stats strip */
.wac-stats { margin: 0; padding: 0 24px 18px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; }
.wac-stat { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px; display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--wac-line); }
.wac-stat:first-child { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; }
.wac-stat dt { font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-stat dd { margin: 0; font: 600 18px/1.1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-stat dd small { margin-left: 6px; font: 500 11px/1 var(--wac-sans); letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--wac-faint); }

/* body: canvas + side panel */
.wac-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; border-top: 1px solid var(--wac-line); }
.wac-canvas {
  position: relative; min-width: 0;
  background-color: var(--wac-bg);
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(var(--wac-grid-major) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--wac-grid-major) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(var(--wac-grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--wac-grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 120px 120px, 120px 120px, 24px 24px, 24px 24px;
  background-position: -1px -1px;
  transition: filter .4s ease;
}
.wac-canvas::before, .wac-canvas::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; width: 14px; height: 14px; pointer-events: none;
  border-color: rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.5); border-style: solid;
}
.wac-canvas::before { top: 10px; left: 10px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; }
.wac-canvas::after { bottom: 10px; right: 10px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; }
.wac[data-on="false"] .wac-canvas { filter: saturate(.45) brightness(.92); }
.wac-meta { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 14px; z-index: 2; font: 500 10px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-stamp {
  position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 14px; z-index: 2; display: flex; gap: 0;
  font: 500 9.5px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint);
  border: 1px solid var(--wac-line-strong);
}
.wac-stamp span { padding: 5px 7px; }
.wac-stamp span + span { border-left: 1px solid var(--wac-line-strong); }
.wac-stamp:empty { display: none; }

.wac-flow { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 40px; padding: 38px 24px 48px; }
.wac-wires { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.wac-wire { fill: none; stroke: var(--wac-wire); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke .3s, opacity .3s; }
.wac-wire.wac-is-live { stroke: var(--wac-cyan); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 6 6; animation: wac-flow .6s linear infinite; }
.wac-wire.wac-is-done { stroke: var(--wac-cyan); stroke-width: 2; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(34, 211, 238, .55)); }
.wac-wire.wac-is-skip { opacity: .22; stroke-dasharray: 3 5; }
@keyframes wac-flow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -12; } }

.wac-branch { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 100%; max-width: 580px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0 28px; }
.wac-lane { display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: start; gap: 40px; min-width: 0; }
.wac-pill {
  position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-bottom: -16px;
  padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--wac-bg); border: 1px solid var(--wac-line-strong);
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-muted);
  transition: color .3s, border-color .3s, opacity .3s;
}
.wac-lane[data-branch="yes"] .wac-pill { color: var(--wac-teal); }
.wac-pill.wac-is-taken { border-color: var(--wac-teal); color: var(--wac-ink); background: #0F3240; }
.wac-pill.wac-is-skip { opacity: .4; }

.wac-node {
  --t: var(--wac-cyan);
  appearance: none; position: relative; z-index: 1; box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%; max-width: 268px; padding: 10px 12px 10px 10px; cursor: pointer;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 11px; align-items: center; text-align: left;
  border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 45%, transparent);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035), transparent), var(--wac-node);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -18px #000;
  transition: border-color .25s, background-color .25s, box-shadow .3s, opacity .35s;
}
.wac-node[data-type="trigger"] { --t: var(--wac-amber); }
.wac-node[data-type="condition"] { --t: var(--wac-teal); }
.wac-node[data-type="wait"] { --t: var(--wac-peri); }
.wac-node::before, .wac-node::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-left: -4.5px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--wac-bg); border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 70%, transparent);
}
.wac-node::before { top: -5px; }
.wac-node::after { bottom: -5px; }
.wac-node[data-type="trigger"]::before { display: none; }
.wac-node:hover { border-color: var(--t); background-color: var(--wac-node-hi); }
.wac-node[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--t); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 24%, transparent), 0 14px 30px -18px #000; }
.wac-node:focus-visible { outline-offset: 4px; }
.wac-ico { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--t); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 15%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 28%, transparent); }
.wac-ico svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.wac-ntext { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.wac-ntype { font: 600 9.5px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--t); }
.wac-ntitle { font: 600 13.5px/1.25 var(--wac-sans); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-ndetail { font: 400 11.5px/1.3 var(--wac-sans); color: var(--wac-muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-ndetail:empty { display: none; }
.wac-badge {
  position: absolute; top: -9px; right: -9px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--wac-ok); color: #052E16;
  transform: scale(0); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1);
}
.wac-badge svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }
.wac-node.wac-is-done .wac-badge { transform: scale(1); }
.wac-node.wac-is-run { border-color: var(--t); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 22%, transparent), 0 0 28px -4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 60%, transparent); }
.wac-node.wac-is-run .wac-ico { animation: wac-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
.wac-node.wac-is-done { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--wac-ok) 70%, transparent); }
.wac-node.wac-is-skip { opacity: .32; }
@keyframes wac-pulse { 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--t), 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--t) 18%, transparent); } }

.wac-end { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px dashed var(--wac-line-strong); background: var(--wac-bg); font: 600 10px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint); transition: color .3s, border-color .3s; }
.wac-end::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; background: currentColor; }
.wac-end.wac-is-done { color: var(--wac-ok); border-color: var(--wac-ok); border-style: solid; }

/* side panel */
.wac-side { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr); min-width: 0; background: var(--wac-panel); border-left: 1px solid var(--wac-line); }
.wac-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wac-line); }
.wac-tab {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; position: relative;
  padding: 14px 10px 13px; font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--wac-sans); color: var(--wac-faint); transition: color .2s;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
}
.wac-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--wac-cyan); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.wac-tab:hover { color: var(--wac-ink); }
.wac-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--wac-ink); }
.wac-tab[aria-selected="true"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.wac-tab:focus-visible { outline-offset: -3px; border-radius: 6px; }
.wac-count { font: 600 10px/1 var(--wac-mono); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); color: var(--wac-muted); }
.wac-count:empty { display: none; }
.wac-pane { padding: 18px 18px 20px; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 16px; align-content: start; }
.wac-pane[hidden] { display: none; }

.wac-cfg-head { --t: var(--wac-cyan); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; align-items: center; }
.wac-cfg-head[data-type="trigger"] { --t: var(--wac-amber); }
.wac-cfg-head[data-type="condition"] { --t: var(--wac-teal); }
.wac-cfg-head[data-type="wait"] { --t: var(--wac-peri); }
.wac-cfg-head .wac-ico { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; }
.wac-cfg-title { margin: 0; font: 600 16px/1.25 var(--wac-display); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-cfg-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--wac-muted); }
.wac-cfg-desc:empty { display: none; }
.wac-cfg { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.wac-cfg div { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
.wac-cfg dt { font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-cfg dd { margin: 0; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(2, 10, 24, 0.45); border: 1px solid var(--wac-line); font: 500 12.5px/1.45 var(--wac-mono); color: var(--wac-ink); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-reach { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--wac-line-strong); }
.wac-reach-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-reach-top b { font: 600 13px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--wac-ink); text-transform: none; }
.wac-reach-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); overflow: hidden; }
.wac-reach-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; width: calc(var(--p) * 1%); border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--wac-teal), var(--wac-cyan)); transition: width .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.wac-reach-sub { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--wac-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.wac-runstate { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--wac-line); background: rgba(2, 10, 24, 0.35); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--wac-muted); }
.wac-runstate b { color: var(--wac-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.wac-dot { flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-runstate[data-state="running"] .wac-dot { background: var(--wac-cyan); animation: wac-blink 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
.wac-runstate[data-state="paused"] .wac-dot { background: var(--wac-amber); }
.wac-runstate[data-state="done"] .wac-dot { background: var(--wac-ok); }
.wac-runstate[data-state="stopped"] .wac-dot { background: var(--wac-stop); }
@keyframes wac-blink { 50% { opacity: .3; } }
.wac-log { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 0; counter-reset: wac; }
.wac-log li {
  counter-increment: wac; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; align-items: start;
  padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wac-line); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4;
}
.wac-log li.wac-is-new { animation: wac-in .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both; }
@keyframes wac-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.wac-lg-ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.16); color: var(--wac-ok); margin-top: 1px; }
.wac-lg-ico svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
.wac-log li[data-kind="skip"] .wac-lg-ico { background: rgba(165, 180, 252, 0.16); color: var(--wac-peri); }
.wac-log li[data-kind="stop"] .wac-lg-ico { background: rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.16); color: var(--wac-stop); }
.wac-lg-text { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.wac-lg-text b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--wac-ink); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-lg-text small { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--wac-muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-lg-ms { font: 600 11.5px/1.4 var(--wac-mono); color: var(--wac-cyan); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.wac-log-total { margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font: 600 12px/1 var(--wac-mono); color: var(--wac-ink); }
.wac-log-total:empty { display: none; }
.wac-log-empty { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--wac-muted); }

/* run bar */
.wac-runbar { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 14px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--wac-line); background: rgba(3, 12, 28, 0.35); }
.wac-progress { position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; }
.wac-progress span { display: block; height: 100%; width: calc(var(--p, 0) * 1%); background: var(--wac-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--wac-cyan); transition: width .4s ease; }
.wac-testgrp { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }
.wac-contact { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.wac-avatar { flex: none; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #173A63; color: var(--wac-ink); font: 600 11.5px/1 var(--wac-mono); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--wac-line-strong); }
.wac-contact span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.wac-contact small { font: 500 9.5px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-contact b { font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--wac-sans); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.wac-tests { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.wac-tsw {
  appearance: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 6px 11px 6px 7px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid var(--wac-line-strong); background: transparent;
  font: 500 12.5px/1.2 var(--wac-sans); text-align: left; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s, opacity .2s;
}
.wac-tsw:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--wac-teal); }
.wac-tsw:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }
.wac-tsw-track { position: relative; flex: none; width: 30px; height: 18px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); transition: background .25s; }
.wac-tsw-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--wac-muted); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1), background .25s; }
.wac-tsw[aria-checked="true"] .wac-tsw-track { background: var(--wac-teal); }
.wac-tsw[aria-checked="true"] .wac-tsw-track::after { transform: translateX(12px); background: #FFFFFF; }
.wac-tsw-val { font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--wac-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wac-faint); }
.wac-tsw[aria-checked="true"] .wac-tsw-val { color: var(--wac-teal); }
.wac-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.wac-btn {
  appearance: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--wac-line-strong); background: transparent;
  font: 600 13px/1 var(--wac-sans); transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, color .2s, transform .15s, opacity .2s;
}
.wac-btn svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.wac-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--wac-cyan); }
.wac-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.98); }
.wac-btn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.wac-btn--go { background: var(--wac-cyan); border-color: var(--wac-cyan); color: var(--wac-on-accent); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -12px var(--wac-cyan); }
.wac-btn--go:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #67E8F9; border-color: #67E8F9; }
.wac-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet: side panel moves under the canvas */
@container wac (max-width: 759px) {
  .wac-head { padding: 20px 18px 14px; }
  .wac-stats { padding: 0 18px 16px; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); row-gap: 14px; }
  .wac-stat:nth-child(3) { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; }
  .wac-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .wac-side { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--wac-line); }
  .wac-runbar { padding: 14px 18px; }
}
/* phone: compact nodes, stacked run bar */
@container wac (max-width: 479px) {
  .wac-head { padding: 18px 14px 12px; }
  .wac-power { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; justify-content: space-between; }
  .wac-pstate { text-align: left; }
  .wac-pstate b { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .wac-stats { padding: 0 14px 14px; }
  .wac-stat { padding: 0 10px; }
  .wac-stat dd { font-size: 16px; }
  .wac-flow { padding: 34px 10px 46px; gap: 34px; }
  .wac-branch { gap: 0 10px; }
  .wac-lane { gap: 34px; }
  .wac-node { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 9px 10px; justify-items: start; }
  .wac-flow > .wac-node { grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; }
  .wac-ico { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; }
  .wac-ico svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
  .wac-branch .wac-ndetail { display: none; }
  .wac-ntitle { font-size: 12.5px; }
  .wac-pane { padding: 16px 14px 18px; }
  .wac-runbar { padding: 14px; }
  .wac-actions { width: 100%; }
  .wac-actions .wac-btn { flex: 1; }
  .wac-meta { display: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .wac-switch, .wac-switch::after, .wac-canvas, .wac-wire, .wac-pill, .wac-node, .wac-badge, .wac-end, .wac-tab, .wac-tab::after,
  .wac-reach-bar span, .wac-progress span, .wac-tsw, .wac-tsw-track, .wac-tsw-track::after, .wac-btn { transition: none; }

        : state === "done" ? fill(L.doneSub, { n, ms: this._int(r.total) + " ms" })
        : fill(L.stoppedSub, { k, n });
      $.rsText.append(make("b", null, title), " · " + sub + (state !== "idle" && !this.enabled ? ` ${L.offNote}` : ""));
      $.logEmpty.textContent = L.emptyLog;
      $.logEmpty.hidden = !!(r && r.log.length);
      $.logCount.textContent = r && r.log.length ? String(r.log.filter(x => x.kind !== "stop").length) : "";
      $.logTotal.replaceChildren();
      if (r && (state === "done" || state === "stopped")) $.logTotal.append(make("span", null, L.total), make("span", null, `${this._int(r.total)} ms`));
      $.progress.parentElement.style.setProperty("--p", n ? (k / n * 100).toFixed(1) : 0);
      $.progress.style.width = (n ? k / n * 100 : 0) + "%";

      const btn = $.runBtn;
      btn.replaceChildren();
      if (state === "running") { btn.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_PAUSE); btn.append(L.pause); }
      else if (state === "paused") { btn.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_PLAY); btn.append(L.resume); }
      else { btn.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_PLAY); btn.append(state === "idle" ? L.testRun : L.runAgain); }
      btn.disabled = !n;
      $.stopBtn.replaceChildren(); $.stopBtn.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_STOPX); $.stopBtn.append(L.stop);
      $.stopBtn.disabled = !(state === "running" || state === "paused");
      this._syncTests();
    }

    _emit(status) {
      const r = this._run;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("workflowrun", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: {
          status, workflow: (this._data && this._data.name) || "",
          step: r ? r.i : 0, steps: r ? r.plan.steps.length : 0, totalMs: r ? r.total : 0,
          branches: Object.assign({}, this._tests),
          path: r ? r.plan.steps.slice(0, r.i).map(s => s.node.id) : []
        }
      }));
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.sw.addEventListener("click", () => {
        this.enabled = !this.enabled;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("workflowtoggle", { bubbles: true, detail: { enabled: this.enabled } }));
        const L = this._labels();
        $.live.textContent = this.enabled ? `${L.on}. ${L.onSub}` : `${L.off}. ${L.offSub}`;
      });
      $.flow.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".wac-node");
        if (!b) return;
        this._select(b.dataset.id);
        this._tab("node", false);
      });
      $.flow.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key !== "ArrowDown" && e.key !== "ArrowUp") return;
        const list = [...$.flow.querySelectorAll(".wac-node")];
        const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement);
        if (i < 0) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const next = list[Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, i + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1)))];
        next.focus();
      });
      const tabsEl = this.querySelector(".wac-tabs");
      tabsEl.addEventListener("click", e => { const t = e.target.closest(".wac-tab"); if (t) this._tab(t.dataset.tab, false); });
      tabsEl.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const keys = ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Home", "End"];
        if (!keys.includes(e.key)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const names = $.tabs.map(t => t.dataset.tab), i = names.indexOf(this._tabName);
        const j = e.key === "Home" ? 0 : e.key === "End" ? names.length - 1 : (i + (e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1) + names.length) % names.length;
        this._tab(names[j], true);
      });
      $.tests.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".wac-tsw");
        if (!b || b.disabled) return;
        this._tests[b.dataset.cond] = !this._tests[b.dataset.cond];
        if (this._run && (this._run.state === "done" || this._run.state === "stopped")) this._reset();
        this._renderRunUI();
      });
      $.runBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const s = this._run && this._run.state;
        if (s === "running") this._pause(); else if (s === "paused") this._resume(); else this._start();
      });
      $.stopBtn.addEventListener("click", () => this.stop());
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("workflow-automation")) customElements.define("workflow-automation", WorkflowAutomation);
})();

  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap;
  font: 500 10px/1 var(--asp-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--asp-faint);
}

.asp-act { grid-area: act; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 4px; }
.asp-ibtn {
  appearance: none; position: relative; width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--asp-line); background: transparent; color: var(--asp-muted);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s, transform .12s;
}
.asp-ibtn svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.asp-ibtn:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--asp-ink); border-color: var(--asp-faint); background: var(--asp-bg); }
.asp-ibtn[data-act="start"]:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--asp-run); border-color: var(--asp-run); }
.asp-ibtn[data-act="pause"]:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--asp-pause); border-color: var(--asp-pause); }
.asp-ibtn[data-act="restart"]:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--asp-restart); border-color: var(--asp-restart); }
.asp-ibtn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
.asp-ibtn:disabled { opacity: .3; cursor: default; }
.asp-ibtn::after {
  content: attr(data-tip); position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 7px); left: 50%; z-index: 3;
  transform: translate(-50%, 3px); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 5px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--asp-ink); color: var(--asp-bg);
  font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--asp-mono);
  transition: opacity .15s, transform .15s;
}
.asp-ibtn:hover:not(:disabled)::after, .asp-ibtn:focus-visible::after { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }

.asp-detail {
  grid-column: 1 / -1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px 16px; align-items: start;
  padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--asp-err) 7%, var(--asp-bg));
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--asp-err) 45%, transparent);
}
.asp-err-log { margin: 0; font: 400 12px/1.6 var(--asp-mono); color: var(--asp-ink); white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.asp-err-log b { color: var(--asp-err); font-weight: 600; }
.asp-detail .asp-btn { border-color: var(--asp-err); color: var(--asp-err); }
.asp-detail .asp-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--asp-err); color: var(--asp-bg); border-color: var(--asp-err); }
.asp-detail[hidden] { display: none; }

.asp-empty { margin: -6px 0 0; padding: 22px; text-align: center; border: 1px dashed var(--asp-line); border-radius: 10px; font: 400 12.5px/1.4 var(--asp-mono); color: var(--asp-faint); }

/* event log */
.asp-log { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--asp-line); }
.asp-log-title { margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font: 500 10px/1 var(--asp-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--asp-faint); }
.asp-log-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 3px; min-height: calc(5 * 19px); align-content: end; }
.asp-log-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 66px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; font: 400 11.5px/16px var(--asp-mono); color: var(--asp-muted); }
.asp-log-list li span:first-child { color: var(--asp-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.asp-log-list li span:last-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.asp-log-list li[data-tone="good"] span:last-child { color: var(--asp-run); }
.asp-log-list li[data-tone="bad"] span:last-child { color: var(--asp-err); }
.asp-log-list li[data-tone="warn"] span:last-child { color: var(--asp-pause); }
.asp-log-list li:last-child { color: var(--asp-ink); }
.asp-log-list li.is-new { animation: asp-in .3s ease; }
@keyframes asp-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.asp-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* compact desktop: drop the throughput column header width a little */
@container asp (max-width: 879px) {
  .asp-cols, .asp-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(140px, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1.5fr) 56px 68px 104px 112px; column-gap: 12px; }
}
/* tablet: each agent becomes a two-line card with labelled figures */
@container asp (max-width: 759px) {
  .asp { padding: 20px 18px 16px; }
  .asp-sum { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .asp-stat--tp { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-left: 0 !important; border-top: 1px dashed var(--asp-line); }
  .asp-stat:nth-child(1) { border-left: 0; }
  .asp-fleet { max-width: none; }
  .asp-cols { display: none; }
  .asp-list { margin-top: 0; }
  .asp-row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr) auto;
    grid-template-areas: "agent agent agent act" "task task task task" "queue succ tp tp";
    row-gap: 12px; padding: 14px 14px 14px 16px;
  }
  .asp-queue, .asp-succ { text-align: left; }
  .asp-m { padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--asp-line); align-self: stretch; }
  .asp-tp { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto; }
  .asp-tp .asp-k { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .asp-k { position: static; width: auto; height: auto; overflow: visible; clip: auto; }
  .asp-task-text { white-space: normal; }
}
/* phone */
@container asp (max-width: 479px) {
  .asp { padding: 18px 14px 14px; gap: 16px; border-radius: 12px; }
  .asp-head { flex-direction: column; }
  .asp-live { width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; }
  .asp-live .asp-btn { flex: 1 1 100%; }
  .asp-sum { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .asp-stat { padding: 11px 12px; }

  .asp-stat:nth-child(n+3) { border-top: 1px dashed var(--asp-line); }
  .asp-stat dd { font-size: 18px; }
  .asp-hint { display: none; }
  .asp-row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr);
    grid-template-areas: "agent agent agent" "act act act" "task task task" "queue succ tp";
    padding: 13px 12px 13px 14px;
  }
  .asp-act { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .asp-ibtn { width: 40px; height: 36px; }
  .asp-tp { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); row-gap: 5px; }
  .asp-bars { height: 18px; }
  .asp-detail { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .asp-log-list li { grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

}

  el.addEventListener("agentaction", e => say(`${e.detail.name}: ${e.detail.action}.`, `The panel sent an agentaction event (${e.detail.from} → ${e.detail.to}). Simulated agents, not a real system.`));

  document.getElementById("trigger-error").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const pick = el.agents.find(a => a.status === "running") || el.agents[0];
    if (!pick) return;
    el.setStatus(pick.id, "error", "Request to the CRM timed out after 30 s. The item was put back in the queue.");
    say(`${pick.name} set to Error.`, "Open it with “Show error” and press Retry now. Simulated agents, not a real system.");
  });
  document.getElementById("reset-demo").addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.removeAttribute("filter");
    el.data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original));
    say("Demo reset.", "Simulated agents, not a real system.");
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

@keyframes ntc-ring {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); } 15% { transform: rotate(14deg); } 30% { transform: rotate(-12deg); }
  45% { transform: rotate(8deg); } 60% { transform: rotate(-5deg); } 75% { transform: rotate(2deg); }

.ntc-badge {
  position: absolute; top: -6px; right: -6px; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; box-sizing: border-box;
  display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--ntc-accent); color: var(--ntc-on-accent);
  font: 700 11px/1 var(--ntc-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

}
.ntc-badge[hidden] { display: grid !important; transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; }

  padding: 10px 10px 10px 10px; border-radius: 12px;

}
.ntc-item:hover { background: var(--ntc-tint); }
.ntc-item.ntc-is-unread { background: var(--ntc-unread); }
.ntc-item.ntc-is-unread:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ntc-unread), var(--ntc-accent) 5%); }

}
.ntc-av svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--ntc-hue, var(--ntc-accent)); }
.ntc-av--sys { border-radius: 11px; }
.ntc-av-kind {
  position: absolute; right: -5px; bottom: -4px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;

  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ntc-panel);
}
.ntc-av-kind svg { width: 9px; height: 9px; color: currentColor; }

.ntc-body { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.ntc-open {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; text-align: left;
  font: 400 13.5px/1.42 var(--ntc-sans); overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.ntc-open::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 12px; }
.ntc-open:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.ntc-open:focus-visible::after { outline: 2px solid var(--ntc-accent); outline-offset: -2px; }
.ntc-open b { font-weight: 650; }

.ntc-item:not(.ntc-is-unread) .ntc-open b { color: var(--ntc-ink); font-weight: 600; }

  font: 600 12px/1 var(--ntc-sans);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s;
}
.ntc-action:hover { background: var(--ntc-accent); color: var(--ntc-on-accent); border-color: var(--ntc-accent); }

.ntc-item:hover .ntc-x, .ntc-x:focus-visible, .ntc-item:focus-within .ntc-x { opacity: 1; }

.ntc-empty { padding: 34px 24px 30px; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 6px; text-align: center; }

.ntc-foot a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ntc-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.ntc-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* narrow panels (phones): tighter rows */
@container ntc (max-width: 380px) {
  .ntc-head { padding: 14px 12px 8px 14px; }

  .ntc-bell, .ntc-badge, .ntc-panel, .ntc-markall, .ntc-tab, .ntc-tab-n, .ntc-item, .ntc-dot, .ntc-x, .ntc-action { transition: none; }

}

   Showcase shell

  class NotificationCenter extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["open", "tab"]; }
    constructor() { super(); this._uid = ++uid; this._seq = 0; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (!this._built) {
        if (!this._data) {
          const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
          try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
          catch (e) { console.warn("<notification-center>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
        }
        this._items = this._normalise(this._data.items);
        this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
        const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
        this.$ = {
          root: q(".ntc"), bell: q(".ntc-bell"), badge: q(".ntc-badge"), panel: q(".ntc-panel"),
          title: q(".ntc-title-t"), titleN: q(".ntc-title-n"), markAll: q(".ntc-markall"),
          tabs: q(".ntc-tabs"), list: q(".ntc-list"), foot: q(".ntc-foot"), sr: q(".ntc-sr")
        };
        const pid = `ntc-${this._uid}-panel`;
        this.$.panel.id = pid;
        this.$.bell.setAttribute("aria-controls", pid);
        this._wire();
        this._built = true;
        this._render();
        this._applyOpen(false);

.chs {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--chs-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--chs-line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) inset, 0 32px 60px -46px var(--chs-shadow), 0 2px 6px -4px var(--chs-shadow);
}
.chs [data-band="healthy"]  { --chs-c: var(--chs-good); --chs-c-bg: var(--chs-good-bg); --chs-c-fill: var(--chs-good-fill); }
.chs [data-band="risk"]     { --chs-c: var(--chs-warn); --chs-c-bg: var(--chs-warn-bg); --chs-c-fill: var(--chs-warn-fill); }
.chs [data-band="critical"] { --chs-c: var(--chs-bad);  --chs-c-bg: var(--chs-bad-bg);  --chs-c-fill: var(--chs-bad-fill); }
.chs-cap { font: 600 12px/1 var(--chs-sans); font-variant: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: .09em; color: var(--chs-faint); }

/* header */
.chs-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 14px 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 24px 28px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--chs-line); }
.chs-intro { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.chs-client { margin: 0; font: 650 clamp(21px, 3.4cqi, 27px)/1.12 var(--chs-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.chs-segment { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--chs-muted); }
.chs-segment:empty { display: none; }
.chs-period { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--chs-tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--chs-line); }
.chs-period button {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--chs-sans); color: var(--chs-muted);
  transition: background .25s ease, color .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
}
.chs-period button:hover { color: var(--chs-ink); }
.chs-period button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--chs-raise); color: var(--chs-ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px -1px var(--chs-shadow), 0 0 0 1px var(--chs-line); }
.chs-period button:focus-visible, .chs-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--chs-good); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* body */
.chs-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 332px minmax(0, 1fr); }
.chs-left { padding: 24px 26px 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--chs-line); display: grid; gap: 20px; align-content: start; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--chs-raise), var(--chs-card)); }

/* dial */
.chs-dial { position: relative; width: 240px; max-width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; margin: 0 auto; }
.chs-dial svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.chs-track { fill: none; stroke: var(--chs-line); stroke-width: 16; stroke-linecap: round; }
.chs-zone { fill: none; stroke-width: 16; opacity: .3; }
.chs-zone--bad { stroke: var(--chs-bad-fill); } .chs-zone--warn { stroke: var(--chs-warn-fill); } .chs-zone--good { stroke: var(--chs-good-fill); }
.chs-arc { fill: none; stroke: var(--chs-c-fill); stroke-width: 16; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke .35s ease; }
.chs-knob { fill: var(--chs-raise); stroke: var(--chs-c-fill); stroke-width: 4; transition: stroke .35s ease; }
.chs-ghost { stroke: var(--chs-ink); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .55; }
.chs-tick-l { font: 600 10px/1 var(--chs-mono); fill: var(--chs-faint); }
.chs-center { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 6px; text-align: center; padding-top: 6px; }
.chs-score { font: 300 64px/0.9 var(--chs-display); letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chs-score small { font: 500 14px/1 var(--chs-sans); letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--chs-faint); margin-left: 2px; }
.chs-band {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 650 12.5px/1 var(--chs-sans); color: var(--chs-c); background: var(--chs-c-bg);
  transition: color .35s ease, background .35s ease;
}
.chs-band::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.chs-delta { font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--chs-sans); color: var(--chs-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chs-delta[data-tone="up"] { color: var(--chs-good); }
.chs-delta[data-tone="down"] { color: var(--chs-bad); }
.chs-legend { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: -6px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--chs-muted); }
.chs-legend li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.chs-legend i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--chs-c-fill); }

/* insight panel */
.chs-insight { border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 16px 15px; background: var(--chs-tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--chs-line); display: grid; gap: 8px; min-height: 118px; align-content: start; }
.chs-insight-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.chs-insight-name { margin: 0; font: 650 15px/1.25 var(--chs-display); }
.chs-insight-val { font: 600 13px/1 var(--chs-sans); color: var(--chs-c); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.chs-insight p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--chs-muted); }
.chs-insight p b { color: var(--chs-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.chs-insight.is-swap { animation: chs-fade .3s ease; }
@keyframes chs-fade { from { opacity: .35; transform: translateY(3px); } }

/* factors */
.chs-right { padding: 22px 28px 24px; display: grid; gap: 4px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.chs-fhead { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-bottom: 10px; }
.chs-fhead-l { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
.chs-ftitle { margin: 0; font: 650 16px/1.2 var(--chs-display); }
.chs-fnote { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--chs-muted); }
.chs-btn {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--chs-line); background: var(--chs-raise);
  font: 600 12px/1 var(--chs-sans); color: var(--chs-muted);
  transition: color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, opacity .2s ease;
}
.chs-btn svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.chs-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--chs-ink); border-color: var(--chs-faint); }
.chs-btn:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
.chs-factors { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; }
.chs-f {
  position: relative; display: grid; gap: 9px; padding: 14px 14px 13px; margin: 0 -14px; border-radius: 14px;
  transition: background .25s ease;
}
.chs-f + .chs-f::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 14px; right: 14px; height: 1px; background: var(--chs-line); }
.chs-f.is-active { background: var(--chs-tint); }
.chs-f.is-active::before, .chs-f.is-active + .chs-f::before { opacity: 0; }
.chs-f-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.chs-f-name { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.chs-f-name b { font: 600 14.5px/1.25 var(--chs-sans); }
.chs-f-share { font: 600 11px/1 var(--chs-mono); color: var(--chs-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chs-f-vals { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 9px; flex: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chs-f-score { font: 650 19px/1 var(--chs-display); color: var(--chs-c); transition: color .3s ease; }
.chs-f-delta { font: 600 11.5px/1 var(--chs-sans); color: var(--chs-muted); min-width: 3.4em; text-align: right; }
.chs-f-delta[data-tone="up"] { color: var(--chs-good); }
.chs-f-delta[data-tone="down"] { color: var(--chs-bad); }
.chs-bar { position: relative; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--chs-bad-bg) 0 40%, var(--chs-warn-bg) 40% 70%, var(--chs-good-bg) 70% 100%);
}
.chs-bar-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: calc(var(--chs-v, 0) * 1%); border-radius: inherit; background: var(--chs-c-fill); transition: width .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), background .35s ease; }
.chs-bar-ghost { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; left: calc(var(--chs-g, 0) * 1%); background: var(--chs-ink); opacity: .5; transition: left .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.chs-f-weight { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.chs-f-weight label { font: 600 11.5px/1 var(--chs-sans); font-variant: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--chs-faint); white-space: nowrap; }
.chs-f-pts { font: 500 12px/1 var(--chs-sans); color: var(--chs-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 9.5em; text-align: right; }
.chs-f-pts b { color: var(--chs-ink); font-weight: 650; }

/* weight slider */
.chs-range { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 22px; margin: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; }
.chs-range:focus { outline: none; }
.chs-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--chs-ink) 0 calc(var(--chs-p, 0) * 1%), var(--chs-line) calc(var(--chs-p, 0) * 1%) 100%); }
.chs-range::-moz-range-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--chs-line); }
.chs-range::-moz-range-progress { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--chs-ink); }
.chs-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: -6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--chs-raise); border: 2px solid var(--chs-ink); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -2px var(--chs-shadow); transition: transform .15s ease; }
.chs-range::-moz-range-thumb { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--chs-raise); border: 2px solid var(--chs-ink); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -2px var(--chs-shadow); }
.chs-range:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: scale(1.12); }
.chs-range:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--chs-good-bg), 0 0 0 6px var(--chs-good); }
.chs-range:focus-visible::-moz-range-thumb { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--chs-good-bg), 0 0 0 6px var(--chs-good); }
.chs-foot { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--chs-faint); }
.chs-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet: dial and insight side by side above the factors */
@container chs (max-width: 759px) {
  .chs-head { padding: 22px 22px 18px; }
  .chs-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .chs-left { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--chs-line); grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 16px 24px; padding: 22px; }
  .chs-dial { width: 220px; grid-row: span 2; }
  .chs-legend { justify-content: flex-start; margin: 0; }
  .chs-right { padding: 18px 22px 22px; }
}
/* phone */
@container chs (max-width: 499px) {
  .chs { border-radius: 18px; }
  .chs-head { padding: 18px 16px 16px; }
  .chs-period { width: 100%; }
  .chs-period button { flex: 1; }
  .chs-left { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 18px 16px; }
  .chs-dial { width: 210px; grid-row: auto; }
  .chs-legend { justify-content: center; }
  .chs-score { font-size: 56px; }
  .chs-right { padding: 14px 16px 18px; }
  .chs-f { padding: 13px 10px 12px; margin: 0 -10px; }
  .chs-f + .chs-f::before { left: 10px; right: 10px; }
  .chs-f-weight { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; row-gap: 4px; }
  .chs-f-weight label { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .chs-f-pts { min-width: 0; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .chs-period button, .chs-arc, .chs-knob, .chs-band, .chs-f, .chs-f-score, .chs-bar-fill, .chs-bar-ghost, .chs-btn, .chs-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { transition: none; }
  .chs-insight.is-swap { animation: none; }
  .chs-range:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: none; }
}

<span class="a">// or from code:</span>

el.addEventListener("scorechange", e => e.detail);</pre></div>
      <p>The score is the weighted average of the factor scores, so each factor's share of the weights is exactly how much of the score it can move. Changing a weight, the period or resetting fires <code>scorechange</code> with <code>{ score, band, period, previous, weights }</code>. <code>resetWeights()</code> restores the starting weights.</p>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <client-health-score> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    current: "Current", previous: "90 days ago", period: "Compare period", factors: "Score factors",
    factorsNote: "Drag a weight to change how much each factor counts.", reset: "Reset weights",
    weight: "Weight", of100: "/100", healthy: "Healthy", risk: "At risk", critical: "Critical",
    vsPrev: "{delta} vs {label}", vsNow: "{delta} to now", same: "No change vs {label}",
    pts: "{pts} pts", ofScore: "of score", now: "Now {n}",
    hintTitle: "What's driving this score", allZero: "All weights are at 0, so every factor counts equally.",
    foot: "Score = weighted average of the factor scores. Bands: Healthy {h}+, At risk {r}–{h1}, Critical below {r}.",
    dial: "Health score {score} out of 100, {band}."
  };
  const ICON_RESET = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.8 7.5A5.2 5.2 0 1 1 4.3 11.6"/><path d="M2.5 3.5v4h4"/></svg>';
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const R = 96, C = 2 * Math.PI * R, SWEEP = 0.75, ARC = C * SWEEP, START = 135; // 270° dial opening at the bottom

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="chs">
      <header class="chs-head">
        <div class="chs-intro">
          <span class="chs-cap">Client health</span>
          <h2 class="chs-client"></h2>
          <p class="chs-segment"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="chs-period" role="group">
          <button type="button" data-period="current" aria-pressed="true"></button>
          <button type="button" data-period="previous" aria-pressed="false"></button>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="chs-body">
        <div class="chs-left">
          <div class="chs-dial" role="img">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 240 240" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
            <div class="chs-center" aria-hidden="true">
              <span class="chs-score"><span class="chs-score-n">0</span><small></small></span>
              <span class="chs-band"></span>
              <span class="chs-delta"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <ul class="chs-legend" aria-hidden="true">
            <li data-band="healthy"><i></i><span class="chs-lg-h"></span></li>
            <li data-band="risk"><i></i><span class="chs-lg-r"></span></li>
            <li data-band="critical"><i></i><span class="chs-lg-c"></span></li>
          </ul>
          <section class="chs-insight">
            <div class="chs-insight-top"><h3 class="chs-insight-name"></h3><span class="chs-insight-val"></span></div>
            <p class="chs-insight-about"></p>
            <p class="chs-insight-note"></p>
          </section>
        </div>
        <div class="chs-right">
          <div class="chs-fhead">
            <div class="chs-fhead-l"><h3 class="chs-ftitle"></h3><span class="chs-fnote"></span></div>
            <button type="button" class="chs-btn chs-reset">${ICON_RESET}<span></span></button>
          </div>
          <ul class="chs-factors"></ul>
          <p class="chs-foot"></p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="chs-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </article>`;

  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const svg = (tag, attrs) => { const n = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); return n; };
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
  const num = (v, d) => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? d : +v);
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const MONTHS = "Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec".split(" ");
  const fmtDate = s => { const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(s || ""); return m ? `${+m[3]} ${MONTHS[+m[2] - 1]} ${m[1]}` : ""; };
  const point = v => { const a = (START + 270 * v / 100) * Math.PI / 180; return [120 + R * Math.cos(a), 120 + R * Math.sin(a)]; };
  let uid = 0;

  class ClientHealthScore extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["period"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      this._uid = "chs" + (++uid);
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<client-health-score>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
        this._resetWeights();
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        client: q(".chs-client"), segment: q(".chs-segment"), period: q(".chs-period"),
        left: q(".chs-left"), dial: q(".chs-dial"), svg: q(".chs-dial svg"), scoreN: q(".chs-score-n"), scoreSmall: q(".chs-score small"),
        band: q(".chs-band"), delta: q(".chs-delta"), legend: q(".chs-legend"),
        insight: q(".chs-insight"), inName: q(".chs-insight-name"), inVal: q(".chs-insight-val"), inAbout: q(".chs-insight-about"), inNote: q(".chs-insight-note"),
        ftitle: q(".chs-ftitle"), fnote: q(".chs-fnote"), reset: q(".chs-reset"), factors: q(".chs-factors"), foot: q(".chs-foot"), sr: q(".chs-sr")
      };
      this._buildDial();
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._shown = 0;
      this._render();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._update(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; this._resetWeights(); this._active = null; if (this._built) this._render(); }

    get period() { return this.getAttribute("period") === "previous" ? "previous" : "current"; }
    set period(v) { this.setAttribute("period", v === "previous" ? "previous" : "current"); }

    get weights() { return Object.assign({}, this._weights); }
    get score() { return { current: Math.round(this._calc("current")), previous: Math.round(this._calc("previous")) }; }

    setWeight(key, value) {
      if (!(key in this._weights)) return;
      this._weights[key] = clamp(Math.round(num(value, 0)), 0, 10);
      if (!this._built) return;
      const r = this.$.factors.querySelector(`[data-key="${key}"] .chs-range`);
      if (r) r.value = this._weights[key];
      this._update(true);
      this._emit("weight");
    }

    resetWeights() { this._resetWeights(); if (this._built) { this._syncRanges(); this._update(true); this._emit("reset"); } }

    /* internals */
    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}, this._data && this._data.compareLabel ? { previous: this._data.compareLabel } : {}); }
    _factors() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      return (Array.isArray(d.factors) ? d.factors : []).filter(Boolean).map((f, i) => ({
        key: String(f.key || `f${i + 1}`), name: f.name || `Factor ${i + 1}`,
        score: clamp(num(f.score, 0), 0, 100), previous: clamp(num(f.previous, num(f.score, 0)), 0, 100),
        weight: clamp(Math.round(num(f.weight, 5)), 0, 10), about: f.about || "", note: f.note || "", previousNote: f.previousNote || ""
      }));
    }
    _bands() { const b = (this._data && this._data.bands) || {}; return { healthy: num(b.healthy, 70), risk: num(b.risk, 40) }; }
    _band(v) { const b = this._bands(), r = Math.round(v); return r >= b.healthy ? "healthy" : r >= b.risk ? "risk" : "critical"; }
    _resetWeights() { this._weights = {}; this._factors().forEach(f => { this._weights[f.key] = f.weight; }); }
    _shares() {
      const fs = this._factors(), total = fs.reduce((a, f) => a + (this._weights[f.key] || 0), 0);
      const raw = fs.map(f => (total > 0 ? (this._weights[f.key] || 0) / total : 1 / Math.max(1, fs.length)));
      // whole-number percentages that always add up to 100 (largest remainder)
      const pct = raw.map(r => Math.floor(r * 100));
      let left = 100 - pct.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      raw.map((r, i) => [r * 100 - pct[i], i]).sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0]).forEach(([, i]) => { if (left > 0) { pct[i]++; left--; } });
      return { raw, pct, zero: total === 0 };
    }
    _calc(period) {
      const fs = this._factors(), { raw } = this._shares();
      return fs.reduce((a, f, i) => a + (period === "previous" ? f.previous : f.score) * raw[i], 0);
    }
    _emit(reason) {
      const s = this._shares(), w = {};
      this._factors().forEach((f, i) => { w[f.key] = s.pct[i]; });
      const p = this.period, v = Math.round(this._calc(p));
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("scorechange", { bubbles: true, detail: { score: v, band: this._band(v), period: p, previous: Math.round(this._calc("previous")), current: Math.round(this._calc("current")), weights: w, reason } }));
    }

    _buildDial() {
      const s = this.$.svg, b = this._bands();
      const ring = (cls, from, to) => svg("circle", {
        class: cls, cx: 120, cy: 120, r: R,
        "stroke-dasharray": `${Math.max(0, (to - from) / 100 * ARC)} ${C}`,
        "stroke-dashoffset": `${-from / 100 * ARC}`, transform: `rotate(${START} 120 120)`
      });
      s.append(ring("chs-track", 0, 100));
      // faint risk zones under the score arc, with a hairline gap between them
      s.append(ring("chs-zone chs-zone--bad", 0, b.risk - 0.6), ring("chs-zone chs-zone--warn", b.risk + 0.6, b.healthy - 0.6), ring("chs-zone chs-zone--good", b.healthy + 0.6, 100));
      this._arc = ring("chs-arc", 0, 0);
      s.append(this._arc);
      [0, b.risk, b.healthy, 100].forEach(v => {
        const a = (START + 270 * v / 100) * Math.PI / 180, rr = R + 20;
        const t = svg("text", { class: "chs-tick-l", x: (120 + rr * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(1), y: (120 + rr * Math.sin(a) + 3.5).toFixed(1), "text-anchor": "middle" });
        t.textContent = String(v);
        s.append(t);
      });
      this._ghost = svg("line", { class: "chs-ghost" });
      this._knob = svg("circle", { class: "chs-knob", r: 9, cx: 0, cy: 0 });
      s.append(this._ghost, this._knob);
    }

    _drawDial(v) {
      this._arc.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", `${Math.max(0.001, v / 100 * ARC)} ${C}`);
      const [x, y] = point(v);
      this._knob.setAttribute("cx", x.toFixed(2)); this._knob.setAttribute("cy", y.toFixed(2));
      this.$.scoreN.textContent = String(Math.round(v));
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.period.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b || b.dataset.period === this.period) return;
        this.period = b.dataset.period;
        this._emit("period");
      });
      $.reset.addEventListener("click", () => this.resetWeights());
      $.factors.addEventListener("input", e => {
        const r = e.target.closest(".chs-range"); if (!r) return;
        this._weights[r.closest(".chs-f").dataset.key] = +r.value;
        this._update(false);
      });
      $.factors.addEventListener("change", e => { if (e.target.closest(".chs-range")) this._emit("weight"); });
      const activate = key => { if (key === this._active) return; this._active = key; this._renderInsight(true); this._markActive(); };
      $.factors.addEventListener("pointerover", e => { const f = e.target.closest(".chs-f"); if (f) activate(f.dataset.key); });
      $.factors.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { const f = document.activeElement && document.activeElement.closest && document.activeElement.closest(".chs-f"); activate(f && $.factors.contains(f) ? f.dataset.key : null); });
      $.factors.addEventListener("focusin", e => { const f = e.target.closest(".chs-f"); if (f) activate(f.dataset.key); });
      $.factors.addEventListener("focusout", e => { if (!$.factors.contains(e.relatedTarget)) activate(null); });
    }

    _render() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, b = this._bands();
      $.client.textContent = d.client || "Client";
      $.segment.textContent = d.segment || "";
      $.period.setAttribute("aria-label", L.period);
      const cur = $.period.querySelector('[data-period="current"]'), prev = $.period.querySelector('[data-period="previous"]');
      cur.textContent = L.current; prev.textContent = L.previous;
      cur.title = fmtDate(d.asOf); prev.title = fmtDate(d.compareDate);
      $.scoreSmall.textContent = L.of100;
      this.querySelector(".chs-lg-h").textContent = `${L.healthy} ${b.healthy}+`;
      this.querySelector(".chs-lg-r").textContent = `${L.risk} ${b.risk}–${b.healthy - 1}`;
      this.querySelector(".chs-lg-c").textContent = `${L.critical} <${b.risk}`;
      $.ftitle.textContent = L.factors;
      $.fnote.textContent = L.factorsNote;
      $.reset.querySelector("span").textContent = L.reset;
      $.foot.textContent = fill(L.foot, { h: b.healthy, r: b.risk, h1: b.healthy - 1 });
      // the dial zones depend on the bands, so rebuild it in case they changed
      $.svg.replaceChildren(); this._buildDial();

      $.factors.replaceChildren(...this._factors().map(f => {
        const li = make("li", "chs-f"); li.dataset.key = f.key;
        const id = `${this._uid}-w-${f.key}`;
        const top = make("div", "chs-f-top");
        const name = make("div", "chs-f-name");
        name.append(make("b", null, f.name), make("span", "chs-f-share"));
        const vals = make("div", "chs-f-vals");
        vals.append(make("span", "chs-f-delta"), make("span", "chs-f-score"));
        top.append(name, vals);
        const bar = make("div", "chs-bar"); bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        bar.append(make("span", "chs-bar-fill"), make("span", "chs-bar-ghost"));
        const w = make("div", "chs-f-weight");
        const lab = make("label", null, L.weight); lab.htmlFor = id;
        const r = make("input", "chs-range");
        r.type = "range"; r.id = id; r.min = 0; r.max = 10; r.step = 1; r.value = this._weights[f.key];
        r.setAttribute("aria-label", `${L.weight} for ${f.name}`);
        w.append(lab, r, make("span", "chs-f-pts"));
        li.append(top, bar, w, make("span", "chs-sr chs-f-sr"));
        return li;
      }));
      this._shown = this._shown || 0;
      this._update(true);
    }

    _syncRanges() { this.$.factors.querySelectorAll(".chs-f").forEach(li => { li.querySelector(".chs-range").value = this._weights[li.dataset.key]; }); }

    _update(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, p = this.period, fs = this._factors(), sh = this._shares();
      const v = this._calc(p), other = this._calc(p === "current" ? "previous" : "current");
      const band = this._band(v);
      const rounded = Math.round(v), otherR = Math.round(other);

      $.period.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.period === p)));
      $.left.dataset.band = band;
      $.band.textContent = L[band];
      const diff = p === "current" ? rounded - otherR : otherR - rounded;
      $.delta.dataset.tone = diff > 0 ? "up" : diff < 0 ? "down" : "flat";
      const sign = diff > 0 ? "▲ " : diff < 0 ? "▼ " : "";
      $.delta.textContent = diff === 0 ? fill(L.same, { label: L.previous.toLowerCase() })
        : fill(p === "current" ? L.vsPrev : L.vsNow, { delta: sign + Math.abs(diff), label: L.previous.toLowerCase() });
      $.dial.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.dial, { score: rounded, band: L[band] }) + " " + $.delta.textContent + ".");

      // ghost tick on the dial for the other period
      const a = (START + 270 * clamp(other, 0, 100) / 100) * Math.PI / 180;
      this._ghost.setAttribute("x1", (120 + (R - 12) * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2)); this._ghost.setAttribute("y1", (120 + (R - 12) * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2));
      this._ghost.setAttribute("x2", (120 + (R + 12) * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2)); this._ghost.setAttribute("y2", (120 + (R + 12) * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2));

      // factor rows
      $.factors.querySelectorAll(".chs-f").forEach(li => {
        const i = fs.findIndex(f => f.key === li.dataset.key); if (i < 0) return;
        const f = fs[i], s = p === "previous" ? f.previous : f.score, o = p === "previous" ? f.score : f.previous;
        li.dataset.band = this._band(s);
        li.querySelector(".chs-f-share").textContent = `${sh.pct[i]}%`;
        li.querySelector(".chs-f-score").textContent = String(Math.round(s));
        const dl = li.querySelector(".chs-f-delta"), dd = Math.round(f.score) - Math.round(f.previous);
        if (p === "current") { dl.textContent = dd === 0 ? "±0" : `${dd > 0 ? "▲" : "▼"} ${Math.abs(dd)}`; dl.dataset.tone = dd > 0 ? "up" : dd < 0 ? "down" : "flat"; }
        else { dl.textContent = fill(L.now, { n: Math.round(f.score) }); dl.dataset.tone = "flat"; }
        li.querySelector(".chs-bar").style.setProperty("--chs-v", s.toFixed(1));
        li.querySelector(".chs-bar").style.setProperty("--chs-g", o.toFixed(1));
        const r = li.querySelector(".chs-range");
        r.style.setProperty("--chs-p", (+r.value * 10).toFixed(0));
        r.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", `${r.value} of 10, ${sh.pct[i]}% of the score`);
        const pts = li.querySelector(".chs-f-pts");
        pts.replaceChildren(make("b", null, fill(L.pts, { pts: (s * sh.raw[i]).toFixed(1) })), ` ${L.ofScore}`);
        li.querySelector(".chs-f-sr").textContent = `${f.name}: ${Math.round(s)} out of 100, ${L[this._band(s)]}. Counts for ${sh.pct[i]}% of the score.`;
      });
      $.fnote.textContent = sh.zero ? L.allZero : L.factorsNote;
      const base = {}; fs.forEach(f => { base[f.key] = f.weight; });
      $.reset.disabled = fs.every(f => this._weights[f.key] === base[f.key]);

      this._renderInsight(false);
      this._animateTo(clamp(v, 0, 100), animate);
      if (Math.round(this._lastAnnounced ?? -1) !== rounded) {
        this._lastAnnounced = rounded;
        clearTimeout(this._srTimer);
        this._srTimer = setTimeout(() => { $.sr.textContent = fill(L.dial, { score: rounded, band: L[band] }); }, 500);
      }
    }

    _animateTo(target, animate) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf);
      const from = this._shown || 0;
      if (!animate || reduceMotion() || Math.abs(target - from) < 0.05) { this._shown = target; this._drawDial(target); return; }
      const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 520, ease = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
      const tick = now => {
        const k = ease(Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur));
        this._shown = from + (target - from) * k;
        this._drawDial(this._shown);
        if (k < 1) this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }

    _markActive() { this.$.factors.querySelectorAll(".chs-f").forEach(li => li.classList.toggle("is-active", li.dataset.key === this._active)); }

    _renderInsight(swap) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, p = this.period, fs = this._factors();
      const f = fs.find(x => x.key === this._active);
      $.inAbout.replaceChildren(); $.inNote.replaceChildren();
      if (f) {
        const s = p === "previous" ? f.previous : f.score;
        $.insight.dataset.band = this._band(s);
        $.inName.textContent = f.name;
        $.inVal.textContent = `${Math.round(s)} · ${L[this._band(s)]}`;
        $.inAbout.textContent = f.about;
        $.inNote.textContent = (p === "previous" ? f.previousNote : f.note) || "";
      } else {
        // default summary: the factors adding and costing the most against a perfect score
        const sh = this._shares();
        const gaps = fs.map((x, i) => ({ f: x, lost: (100 - (p === "previous" ? x.previous : x.score)) * sh.raw[i], gain: (p === "previous" ? x.previous : x.score) * sh.raw[i] }));
        const lift = gaps.slice().sort((a, b) => b.gain - a.gain)[0];
        const drag = gaps.filter(g => gaps.length < 2 || g !== lift).sort((a, b) => b.lost - a.lost)[0];
        delete $.insight.dataset.band;
        $.inName.textContent = L.hintTitle;
        $.inVal.textContent = "";
        if (lift) $.inAbout.append("Biggest lift: ", make("b", null, lift.f.name), ` adds ${lift.gain.toFixed(1)} pts.`);
        if (drag) $.inNote.append("Biggest drag: ", make("b", null, drag.f.name), ` costs ${drag.lost.toFixed(1)} pts. Hover or focus a factor for details.`);
      }
      if (swap && !reduceMotion()) { $.insight.classList.remove("is-swap"); void $.insight.offsetWidth; $.insight.classList.add("is-swap"); }
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("client-health-score")) customElements.define("client-health-score", ClientHealthScore);
})();

    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };

.abt-foot { padding: 14px 26px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--abt-line); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--abt-faint); }

.abt-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

@container abt (max-width: 719px) {

    display: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2.5" y="3.5" width="15" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M2.5 7.5h15M8 7.5v9"/></svg>',
    dot: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="4" fill="currentColor"/></svg>'
  };
  const ST_ICON = {
    ok: '<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.4 6.3 4.9 8.6 9.6 3.6"/></svg>',

  };
  const PEN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 10l.5-2.3L8 2.2 9.8 4 4.3 9.5z"/></svg>';
  const OK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.4 6.3 4.9 8.6 9.6 3.6"/></svg>';
  const X = '<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l6 6M9 3 3 9"/></svg>';
  const SORT = '<svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.5 3.5h9M2.5 7h6M2.5 10.5h3"/></svg>';

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="abt">
      <header class="abt-head">
        <div class="abt-top">
          <div class="abt-intro">
            <span class="abt-eyebrow"></span>
            <h2 class="abt-title"></h2>
          </div>
          <div class="abt-tools">

  class AdBudgetTracker extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["view", "sort"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<ad-budget-tracker>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        card: q(".abt"), eyebrow: q(".abt-eyebrow"), title: q(".abt-title"), seg: q(".abt-seg"), sort: q(".abt-sort"),
        monthLabel: q(".abt-month-label"), days: q(".abt-days"), left: q(".abt-left"), summary: q(".abt-summary"),
        list: q(".abt-list"), legend: q(".abt-legend"), foot: q(".abt-foot-note"), tip: q(".abt-tip"), live: q(".abt-live")
      };
      this.$.seg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (b.dataset.view === this.view) return;
        this.view = b.dataset.view;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("viewchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { view: this.view } }));
      }));
      this.$.sort.addEventListener("click", () => {
        this.sort = this.sort === "used" ? "default" : "used";
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("sortchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { sort: this.sort } }));
      });
      this.$.list.addEventListener("pointermove", e => this._tipMove(e));
      this.$.list.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => this._tipHide());
      this._built = true;
      this._setup();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { this._built = false; }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._update(name === "sort");
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; if (this._built) this._setup(); }

    get view() { return (this.getAttribute("view") || (this._data && this._data.view) || "") === "projected" ? "projected" : "spent"; }
    set view(v) { this.setAttribute("view", v === "projected" ? "projected" : "spent"); }
    get sort() { return (this.getAttribute("sort") || (this._data && this._data.sort) || "") === "used" ? "used" : "default"; }
    set sort(v) { this.setAttribute("sort", v === "used" ? "used" : "default"); }

    setBudget(id, value) {
      const ch = (this._channels || []).find(c => c.id === id);
      const v = num(value);
      if (!ch || v == null || v <= 0) return false;
      const previous = ch.budget;
      ch.budget = Math.round(v * 100) / 100;
      const src = (this._data.channels || []).find(c => c && String(c.id || c.label) === id);
      if (src) src.budget = ch.budget;
      this._update(this.sort === "used");
      const m = this._metrics(ch), L = this._labels();
      this.$.live.textContent = fill(L.announce, { name: ch.label, v: this._money(ch.budget), pct: this._pct(m.projRatio * 100, 1), status: L[m.status].toLowerCase() });
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("budgetchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { id, label: ch.label, budget: ch.budget, previous, spent: ch.spent, projected: Math.round(m.projected), status: m.status } }));
      return true;
    }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _locale() { return (this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-US"; }
    _money(v, dp) {
      try { return new Intl.NumberFormat(this._locale(), { style: "currency", currency: (this._data.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(), maximumFractionDigits: dp || 0, minimumFractionDigits: dp || 0 }).format(v); }
      catch (e) { return "$" + Math.round(v).toLocaleString(); }
    }
    _pct(v, dp = 1) { return v.toLocaleString(this._locale(), { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp }) + "%"; }

    _calendar() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      const today = new Date();
      let y = today.getFullYear(), m = today.getMonth() + 1, day = today.getDate();
      const mm = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(d.month || ""));
      const aa = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(d.asOf || ""));

    _setup() {

    _row(ch, L) {

          const b = make("b", null, Math.abs(diff) < 0.5 ? L.onBudget : fill(diff > 0 ? L.overBy : L.underBy, { v: this._money(Math.abs(diff)) }));
          notes.push(b);

          else notes.push(make("span", null, fill(L.perDay, { v: this._money(m.daily) })));
        } else {

          notes.push(make("b", null, Math.abs(pts) < 0.05 ? L.level : fill(pts > 0 ? L.ahead : L.behind, { pts: Math.abs(pts).toFixed(1) })));
          notes.push(make("span", null, fill(L.perDay, { v: this._money(m.daily) })));

    _dayLabel(day) {

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const original = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.data || {}));
  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    note.replaceChildren();

    b.textContent = strong;

    el.data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original));

    const d = e.detail;

    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
