  --fcc-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
}

/* =========================================================
   Form Conversion component  (copy this block + the script)
   ========================================================= */
form-conversion {
  display: block;
  container: fcc / inline-size;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 960px;
  font-family: var(--fcc-sans);
  color: var(--fcc-ink);
}
.fcc {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--fcc-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--fcc-line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  padding: 26px 26px 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -46px var(--fcc-shadow), 0 2px 6px -4px var(--fcc-shadow);
}

/* header */
.fcc-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.fcc-intro { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; max-width: 48ch; }
.fcc-eyebrow { font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--fcc-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fcc-accent); }
.fcc-title { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(19px, 3cqi, 24px)/1.18 var(--fcc-round); letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-wrap: balance; }
.fcc-sub { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fcc-muted); }
.fcc-eyebrow:empty, .fcc-title:empty, .fcc-sub:empty { display: none; }

.fcc-seg { position: relative; display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--fcc-tint); border: 1px solid var(--fcc-line); }
.fcc-seg button {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--fcc-sans); color: var(--fcc-muted);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.fcc-seg button svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: none; }
.fcc-seg button:hover { color: var(--fcc-ink); }
.fcc-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--fcc-card); color: var(--fcc-accent); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px -1px var(--fcc-shadow), 0 0 0 1px var(--fcc-line); }
.fcc-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fcc-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* KPI strip */
.fcc-kpis { margin: 22px 0 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.fcc-kpi { margin: 0; min-width: 0; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--fcc-tint); display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; }
.fcc-kpi--main { background: var(--fcc-accent); color: var(--fcc-accent-ink); }
.fcc-kpi dt { font: 600 10.5px/1.2 var(--fcc-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fcc-faint); }
.fcc-kpi--main dt { color: inherit; opacity: .82; }
.fcc-kpi dd { margin: 0; }
.fcc-kpi-val { font: 700 clamp(24px, 4cqi, 32px)/1 var(--fcc-round); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.fcc-kpi-sub { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--fcc-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.fcc-kpi--main .fcc-kpi-sub { color: inherit; opacity: .86; }

/* body: mock form + step bars */
.fcc-body { margin-top: 18px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.78fr) minmax(0, 1.22fr); gap: 22px; align-items: start; }

/* mock form */
.fcc-mock-wrap {
  display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: start;
  padding: 20px 18px; border-radius: 16px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, var(--fcc-tint-2) 1px, transparent 1.4px) 0 0 / 14px 14px,
    var(--fcc-tint);
}
.fcc-mock {
  width: 100%; max-width: 320px;
  background: var(--fcc-card); border: 1px solid var(--fcc-line); border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 22px 40px -30px var(--fcc-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: max-width .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), border-radius .45s ease;
}
.fcc-mock[data-device="mobile"] { max-width: 228px; border-radius: 26px; }
.fcc-chrome { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 26px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fcc-line); background: var(--fcc-tint); }
.fcc-chrome i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fcc-skel); }
.fcc-chrome b { flex: 1; height: 8px; margin-left: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fcc-skel); max-width: 60%; }
.fcc-mock[data-device="mobile"] .fcc-chrome { justify-content: center; border-bottom: 0; background: transparent; height: 24px; }
.fcc-mock[data-device="mobile"] .fcc-chrome i { display: none; }
.fcc-mock[data-device="mobile"] .fcc-chrome b { flex: none; width: 54px; height: 10px; margin: 0; background: var(--fcc-ink); opacity: .85; }
.fcc-mbody { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; transition: box-shadow .2s ease; }
.fcc-mbody.fcc-hl { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--fcc-accent-soft); }

.fcc-mtarget {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
  display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 6px; margin: 0; border-radius: 10px;
  font: inherit;
  transition: background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.fcc-mhead { margin-bottom: 4px; }
.fcc-seg[hidden] { display: none; }
.fcc-mtarget:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fcc-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
.fcc-mtarget.fcc-hl { background: var(--fcc-accent-soft); }
.fcc-mtarget[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--fcc-accent-soft); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--fcc-accent); }
.fcc-mtarget.fcc-worst.fcc-hl, .fcc-mtarget.fcc-worst[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--fcc-worst-soft); }
.fcc-mtarget.fcc-worst[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--fcc-worst); }
.fcc-mhead { gap: 6px; }
.fcc-mtitle { font: 700 14px/1.25 var(--fcc-round); }
.fcc-mlines { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
.fcc-mlines span { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fcc-skel); }
.fcc-mlines span:last-child { width: 62%; }
.fcc-mlabel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font: 600 11.5px/1.2 var(--fcc-sans); color: var(--fcc-muted); }
.fcc-mbadge {
  font: 700 10.5px/1 var(--fcc-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fcc-tint); color: var(--fcc-accent);
  transition: background .25s, color .25s;
}
.fcc-minput {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--fcc-line); background: var(--fcc-card);
  transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s;
}
.fcc-minput span { height: 7px; width: var(--fcc-skw, 55%); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fcc-skel); }
.fcc-worst .fcc-minput { border-color: var(--fcc-worst); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--fcc-worst-soft); }
.fcc-worst .fcc-mbadge { background: var(--fcc-worst); color: var(--fcc-card); }
.fcc-worst .fcc-mlabel { color: var(--fcc-worst); }
.fcc-msubmit-btn {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; margin-top: 4px;
  border-radius: 9px; background: var(--fcc-accent); color: var(--fcc-accent-ink);
  font: 700 12.5px/1 var(--fcc-round);
}
.fcc-msubmit-btn .fcc-mbadge { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--fcc-accent-ink) 12%, transparent); color: var(--fcc-accent-ink); }
.fcc-device-note { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fcc-faint); text-align: center; }

/* step bars */
.fcc-steps { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.fcc-row {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
  width: 100%; display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
  font: inherit;
  transition: background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.fcc-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fcc-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
.fcc-row.fcc-hl { background: var(--fcc-tint); }
.fcc-row[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--fcc-tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--fcc-accent); }
.fcc-row.fcc-worst { background: var(--fcc-worst-soft); }
.fcc-row.fcc-worst[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--fcc-worst); }
.fcc-row-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.fcc-row-name { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 0; font: 600 13.5px/1.2 var(--fcc-sans); }
.fcc-row-idx { flex: none; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--fcc-mono); color: var(--fcc-faint); padding: 4px 5px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--fcc-tint); }
.fcc-row.fcc-hl .fcc-row-idx, .fcc-row[aria-pressed="true"] .fcc-row-idx { background: var(--fcc-card); }
.fcc-tag { font: 700 9.5px/1 var(--fcc-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fcc-worst); color: var(--fcc-card); white-space: nowrap; }
.fcc-row-count { font: 700 18px/1 var(--fcc-round); letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.fcc-track { position: relative; display: flex; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fcc-skel); overflow: hidden; }
.fcc-bar {
  width: calc(var(--fcc-w, 0) * 1%); height: 100%; border-radius: 999px 0 0 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--fcc-accent), var(--fcc-accent-2));
  transition: width .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.fcc-lost {
  width: calc(var(--fcc-l, 0) * 1%); height: 100%;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--fcc-muted) 45%, transparent) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px);
  transition: width .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.fcc-worst .fcc-lost { background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--fcc-worst) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); }
.fcc-row-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fcc-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.fcc-drop { font-weight: 600; }
.fcc-worst .fcc-drop { color: var(--fcc-worst); }
.fcc-legend { margin: 6px 12px 0; display: flex; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fcc-faint); }
.fcc-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.fcc-legend i { width: 14px; height: 8px; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--fcc-accent), var(--fcc-accent-2)); }
.fcc-legend i.fcc-legend-lost { background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--fcc-muted) 55%, transparent) 0 2px, transparent 2px 4px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--fcc-line); }

.fcc-detail { margin: 10px 12px 0; min-height: 1.4em; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fcc-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.fcc-detail b { color: var(--fcc-ink); font-weight: 650; }

/* suggestions */
.fcc-foot { margin-top: 18px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--fcc-line); display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.fcc-foot-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.fcc-period { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fcc-faint); }
.fcc-tip-btn {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fcc-accent); background: var(--fcc-card); color: var(--fcc-accent);
  font: 650 13px/1 var(--fcc-sans);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s;
}
.fcc-tip-btn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.fcc-tip-btn:hover { background: var(--fcc-accent); color: var(--fcc-accent-ink); }
.fcc-tip-btn[aria-expanded="true"] svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.fcc-tip-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fcc-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.fcc-tip {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; align-items: start;
  padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--fcc-worst-soft); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--fcc-worst) 30%, transparent);
  animation: fcc-in .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
@keyframes fcc-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } }
.fcc-tip-ico { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--fcc-worst); color: var(--fcc-card); }
.fcc-tip-ico svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.fcc-tip-title { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 700 14.5px/1.3 var(--fcc-round); }
.fcc-tip-text { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fcc-muted); }
.fcc-tip-gain { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fcc-ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.fcc-tip-gain b { color: var(--fcc-good); }
.fcc-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet */
@container fcc (max-width: 759px) {
  .fcc { padding: 22px 20px 18px; }
  .fcc-body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.25fr); gap: 16px; }
  .fcc-mock-wrap { padding: 14px 10px; }
  .fcc-kpi { padding: 12px 13px; }
  .fcc-row { padding: 9px 10px; }
  .fcc-row-count { font-size: 16px; }
}
/* narrow tablet / phone: mock above the bars */
@container fcc (max-width: 579px) {
  .fcc-body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .fcc-mock-wrap { padding: 16px 12px; }
  .fcc-kpis { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .fcc-kpi--main { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
@container fcc (max-width: 419px) {
  .fcc { padding: 18px 14px 14px; border-radius: 18px; }
  .fcc-seg { width: 100%; }
  .fcc-seg button { flex: 1; justify-content: center; padding-inline: 6px; }
  .fcc-seg button svg { display: none; }
  .fcc-kpi { padding: 12px; }
  .fcc-kpi-sub { font-size: 12px; }
  .fcc-row-meta { font-size: 11.5px; }
  .fcc-tip { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 14px; }
  .fcc-tip-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .fcc-seg button, .fcc-mock, .fcc-mbody, .fcc-mtarget, .fcc-mbadge, .fcc-minput, .fcc-row, .fcc-bar, .fcc-lost, .fcc-tip-btn, .fcc-tip-btn svg { transition: none; }
  .fcc-tip { animation: none; }
}

/* =========================================================

.doc { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px; display: grid; gap: 14px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }

.fields-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.fields { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }

</style>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <form-conversion> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    device: "Device", conversion: "Form conversion", conversionSub: "{n} of {views} views submitted",
    completion: "Start to submit", completionSub: "of people who start, finish",
    time: "Avg. time to submit", timeSub: "for people who finished",
    ofViews: "{pct} of views", didntStart: "{pct} didn't start", leftHere: "−{pct} left here", leftSubmit: "−{pct} left at submit",
    worst: "Biggest drop-off", reached: "reached", completed: "completed", left: "left",
    retained: "Completed", lost: "Left at this step",
    show: "Show suggestions", hide: "Hide suggestions",
    tipTitle: "Start with the {field} field",
    gain: "If {field} kept pace with your other fields ({rate}), you could get about {extra} more submissions: {from} → {to} conversion. Estimate.",
    tipFallback: "{rate} of people who reach {field} leave there. Try making it optional, shorter, or easier to fill in.",
    noTip: "No field drop-off to fix.",
    selectHint: "Select a bar or a field to see its numbers.",
    mobileNote: "Showing the mobile layout", desktopNote: "Showing the desktop layout", allNote: "All devices combined"
  };
  const ICON = {
    all: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="1.5" y="3" width="9" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="11" y="5.5" width="3.5" height="7.5" rx="1"/><path d="M4 13h4"/></svg>',
    desktop: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="1.5" y="2.5" width="13" height="8.5" rx="1.5"/><path d="M5.5 14h5M8 11v3"/></svg>',
    mobile: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4.5" y="1.5" width="7" height="13" rx="1.8"/><path d="M7 12.2h2"/></svg>'
  };
  const ICON_BULB = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.5 15.5h5M8.3 18h3.4M10 2.2a5.6 5.6 0 0 0-3.4 10c.6.5.9 1.1.9 1.8v.2h5v-.2c0-.7.3-1.3.9-1.8A5.6 5.6 0 0 0 10 2.2Z"/></svg>';
  const ICON_CHEV = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4"/></svg>';
  const SKEL = [58, 66, 44, 52, 61];

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="fcc">
      <header class="fcc-head">
        <div class="fcc-intro">
          <span class="fcc-eyebrow"></span>
          <h2 class="fcc-title"></h2>
          <p class="fcc-sub"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="fcc-seg" role="group"></div>
      </header>
      <dl class="fcc-kpis">
        <div class="fcc-kpi fcc-kpi--main"><dt class="fcc-k-conv"></dt><dd class="fcc-kpi-val fcc-conv"></dd><dd class="fcc-kpi-sub fcc-conv-sub"></dd></div>
        <div class="fcc-kpi"><dt class="fcc-k-comp"></dt><dd class="fcc-kpi-val fcc-comp"></dd><dd class="fcc-kpi-sub fcc-comp-sub"></dd></div>
        <div class="fcc-kpi"><dt class="fcc-k-time"></dt><dd class="fcc-kpi-val fcc-time"></dd><dd class="fcc-kpi-sub fcc-time-sub"></dd></div>
      </dl>
      <div class="fcc-body">
        <div class="fcc-mock-wrap">
          <div class="fcc-mock">
            <div class="fcc-chrome" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><b></b></div>
            <div class="fcc-mbody"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="fcc-device-note"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="fcc-bars">
          <ol class="fcc-steps"></ol>
          <div class="fcc-legend" aria-hidden="true"><span><i></i><span class="fcc-leg-a"></span></span><span><i class="fcc-legend-lost"></i><span class="fcc-leg-b"></span></span></div>
          <p class="fcc-detail" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <footer class="fcc-foot">
        <div class="fcc-foot-row">
          <button type="button" class="fcc-tip-btn" aria-expanded="false"><span class="fcc-tip-btn-label"></span></button>
          <span class="fcc-period"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="fcc-tip-panel" hidden></div>
      </footer>
    </article>`;

  let uid = 0;
  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const ease = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

  class FormConversion extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["device"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<form-conversion>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this._uid = ++uid;
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        eyebrow: q(".fcc-eyebrow"), title: q(".fcc-title"), sub: q(".fcc-sub"), seg: q(".fcc-seg"),
        kConv: q(".fcc-k-conv"), conv: q(".fcc-conv"), convSub: q(".fcc-conv-sub"),
        kComp: q(".fcc-k-comp"), comp: q(".fcc-comp"), compSub: q(".fcc-comp-sub"),
        kTime: q(".fcc-k-time"), time: q(".fcc-time"), timeSub: q(".fcc-time-sub"),
        mock: q(".fcc-mock"), mbody: q(".fcc-mbody"), deviceNote: q(".fcc-device-note"),
        steps: q(".fcc-steps"), legA: q(".fcc-leg-a"), legB: q(".fcc-leg-b"), detail: q(".fcc-detail"),
        tipBtn: q(".fcc-tip-btn"), tipBtnLabel: q(".fcc-tip-btn-label"), tipPanel: q(".fcc-tip-panel"), period: q(".fcc-period")
      };
      this.$.tipPanel.id = `fcc-tip-${this._uid}`;
      this.$.tipBtn.setAttribute("aria-controls", this.$.tipPanel.id);
      this.$.tipBtn.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_CHEV);
      this._selected = null;
      this._tipOpen = false;
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._render(false);
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (this._built && oldVal !== newVal) this._render(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API: el.data = { eyebrow, title, subtitle, period, form, steps, segments, tips } */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; this._selected = null; if (this._built) this._render(false); }
    get device() { const keys = this._keys(); const v = this.getAttribute("device"); return keys.includes(v) ? v : keys[0] || "all"; }
    set device(v) { this.setAttribute("device", v); }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _keys() { return Object.keys((this._data && this._data.segments) || {}); }
    _int(v) { return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(this._data.locale || "en-US"); }
    _pct(r) {
      if (r == null || !Number.isFinite(r)) return "—";
      return (r * 100).toLocaleString(this._data.locale || "en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) + "%";
    }
    _time(s) {
      if (s == null) return "—";
      const m = Math.floor(s / 60), r = Math.round(s % 60);
      return m ? `${m}m ${String(r).padStart(2, "0")}s` : `${r}s`;
    }

    /* the model: one row per step, with counts and rates worked out */
    _model() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      const steps = (Array.isArray(d.steps) ? d.steps : []).map((s, i) => ({
        id: String((s && s.id) || `step-${i + 1}`), label: (s && s.label) || `Step ${i + 1}`,
        type: ["view", "start", "field", "submit"].includes(s && s.type) ? s.type : "field"
      }));
      const seg = (d.segments || {})[this.device] || {};
      const counts = Array.isArray(seg.counts) ? seg.counts : [];
      const rows = steps.map((s, i) => {
        const count = Math.max(0, num(counts[i]) ?? 0);
        return Object.assign({}, s, { i, count });
      });
      const views = rows.length ? rows[0].count : 0;
      rows.forEach((r, i) => {
        const prev = i > 0 ? rows[i - 1].count : null;
        r.prev = prev;
        r.lost = prev != null ? Math.max(0, prev - r.count) : 0;
        r.dropRate = prev > 0 ? r.lost / prev : null;
        r.share = views > 0 ? r.count / views : null;
      });
      const fields = rows.filter(r => r.type === "field" && r.dropRate != null);
      const worst = fields.reduce((a, r) => (!a || r.dropRate > a.dropRate ? r : a), null);
      const sub = rows.find(r => r.type === "submit") || rows[rows.length - 1];
      const start = rows.find(r => r.type === "start");
      return { rows, views, worst: worst && worst.lost > 0 ? worst : null, fields, submitted: sub ? sub.count : 0, started: start ? start.count : null, seg };
    }

    /* ---------- render ---------- */
    _render(animate) {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.eyebrow.textContent = d.eyebrow || "";
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.sub.textContent = d.subtitle || "";
      $.period.textContent = d.period || "";

      // device switch
      const keys = this._keys(), device = this.device;
      $.seg.setAttribute("aria-label", L.device);
      $.seg.replaceChildren(...keys.map(k => {
        const b = make("button");
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.device = k;
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(k === device));
        if (ICON[k]) b.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin", ICON[k]);
        b.append(((d.segments[k] || {}).label) || k);
        return b;
      }));
      $.seg.hidden = keys.length < 2;

      const m = this._model();
      this._m = m;
      if (this._selected && !m.rows.some(r => r.id === this._selected)) this._selected = null;

      // KPIs
      const conv = m.views > 0 ? m.submitted / m.views : null;
      const comp = m.started > 0 ? m.submitted / m.started : null;
      $.kConv.textContent = L.conversion;
      this._count($.conv, conv, "pct", animate);
      $.convSub.textContent = fill(L.conversionSub, { n: this._int(m.submitted), views: this._int(m.views) });
      $.kComp.textContent = L.completion;
      this._count($.comp, comp, "pct", animate);
      $.compSub.textContent = L.completionSub;
      $.kTime.textContent = L.time;
      $.time.textContent = this._time(num(m.seg.avgSeconds));
      $.timeSub.textContent = L.timeSub;

      // mock form + bars
      $.mock.dataset.device = device === "mobile" ? "mobile" : "desktop";
      $.deviceNote.textContent = device === "mobile" ? L.mobileNote : device === "desktop" ? L.desktopNote : L.allNote;
      this._renderMock(m, L);
      this._renderRows(m, L, animate);
      $.legA.textContent = L.retained;
      $.legB.textContent = L.lost;
      this._renderDetail();
      this._renderTip();
    }

    _count(el, to, kind, animate) {
      const fmt = v => (kind === "pct" ? this._pct(v) : this._int(v));
      const from = el._v;
      el._v = to;
      if (!animate || to == null || from == null || reduceMotion()) { el.textContent = fmt(to); return; }
      const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 480;
      const tick = now => {
        const k = ease(Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur));
        el.textContent = fmt(from + (to - from) * k);
        if (k < 1 && el._v === to) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }

    _renderMock(m, L) {
      const d = this._data || {}, f = d.form || {}, $ = this.$;
      const nodes = [];
      const head = make("button", "fcc-mtarget fcc-mhead");
      head.type = "button";
      const viewRow = m.rows.find(r => r.type === "view");
      if (viewRow) head.dataset.step = viewRow.id;
      head.append(make("span", "fcc-mtitle", f.title || d.title || "Form"));
      const lines = make("span", "fcc-mlines"); lines.append(make("span"), make("span"));
      head.append(lines);
      if (viewRow) head.setAttribute("aria-label", `${viewRow.label}: ${this._int(viewRow.count)}`);
      else head.disabled = true;
      nodes.push(head);

      m.rows.filter(r => r.type === "field").forEach((r, k) => {
        const b = make("button", "fcc-mtarget fcc-mfield" + (m.worst && m.worst.id === r.id ? " fcc-worst" : ""));
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.step = r.id;
        const label = make("span", "fcc-mlabel");
        const isWorst = m.worst && m.worst.id === r.id;
        label.append(make("span", null, r.label), make("span", "fcc-mbadge", isWorst ? `−${Math.round(r.dropRate * 100)}%` : (r.prev > 0 ? `${Math.round(r.count / r.prev * 100)}%` : "—")));
        const input = make("span", "fcc-minput");
        const sk = make("span"); sk.style.setProperty("--fcc-skw", SKEL[k % SKEL.length] + "%");
        input.append(sk);
        b.append(label, input);
        b.setAttribute("aria-label", `${r.label} field: ${this._int(r.prev ?? 0)} ${L.reached}, ${this._int(r.count)} ${L.completed}, ${this._pct(r.dropRate)} ${L.left}${isWorst ? ". " + L.worst : ""}`);
        nodes.push(b);
      });

      const subRow = m.rows.find(r => r.type === "submit");
      const sub = make("button", "fcc-mtarget fcc-msubmit");
      sub.type = "button";
      const btn = make("span", "fcc-msubmit-btn");
      btn.append(make("span", null, f.button || "Submit"));
      if (subRow) {
        sub.dataset.step = subRow.id;
        btn.append(make("span", "fcc-mbadge", this._pct(m.views > 0 ? subRow.count / m.views : null)));
        sub.setAttribute("aria-label", `${subRow.label}: ${this._int(subRow.count)}, ${fill(L.ofViews, { pct: this._pct(subRow.share) })}`);
      } else sub.disabled = true;
      sub.append(btn);
      nodes.push(sub);
      $.mbody.replaceChildren(...nodes);
      const startRow = m.rows.find(r => r.type === "start");
      $.mbody.dataset.step = startRow ? startRow.id : "";
      this._syncPressed();
    }

    _renderRows(m, L, animate) {
      const $ = this.$;
      const old = new Map([...$.steps.querySelectorAll(".fcc-row")].map(b => [b.dataset.step, b]));
      const items = m.rows.map((r, i) => {
        const li = make("li");
        const b = make("button", "fcc-row" + (m.worst && m.worst.id === r.id ? " fcc-worst" : ""));
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.step = r.id;
        const top = make("span", "fcc-row-top");
        const name = make("span", "fcc-row-name");
        name.append(make("span", "fcc-row-idx", String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")), make("span", null, r.label));
        if (m.worst && m.worst.id === r.id) name.append(make("span", "fcc-tag", L.worst));
        const count = make("span", "fcc-row-count");
        top.append(name, count);
        const track = make("span", "fcc-track");
        const bar = make("span", "fcc-bar"), lost = make("span", "fcc-lost");
        track.append(bar, lost);
        const meta = make("span", "fcc-row-meta");
        const dropText = r.prev == null ? "" : r.type === "start" ? fill(L.didntStart, { pct: this._pct(r.dropRate) })
          : r.type === "submit" ? fill(L.leftSubmit, { pct: this._pct(r.dropRate) }) : fill(L.leftHere, { pct: this._pct(r.dropRate) });
        meta.append(make("span", null, i === 0 ? "100%" : fill(L.ofViews, { pct: this._pct(r.share) })), make("span", "fcc-drop", dropText));
        b.append(top, track, meta);
        [top, track, meta].forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"));
        const parts = [`${r.label}: ${this._int(r.count)}`];
        if (i > 0) parts.push(fill(L.ofViews, { pct: this._pct(r.share) }));
        if (dropText) parts.push(`${this._int(r.lost)} ${L.left} (${this._pct(r.dropRate)})`);
        if (m.worst && m.worst.id === r.id) parts.push(L.worst);
        b.append(make("span", "fcc-sr", parts.join(", ") + "."));
        li.append(b);

        // widths: start from the old values so the bars glide between devices
        const w = m.views > 0 ? r.count / m.views * 100 : 0;
        const l = m.views > 0 ? r.lost / m.views * 100 : 0;
        const prevBtn = old.get(r.id);
        if (animate && prevBtn && !reduceMotion()) {
          bar.style.setProperty("--fcc-w", prevBtn._w); lost.style.setProperty("--fcc-l", prevBtn._l);
          count._v = prevBtn._count;
          requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { bar.style.setProperty("--fcc-w", w.toFixed(2)); lost.style.setProperty("--fcc-l", l.toFixed(2)); }));
        } else { bar.style.setProperty("--fcc-w", w.toFixed(2)); lost.style.setProperty("--fcc-l", l.toFixed(2)); }
        b._w = w.toFixed(2); b._l = l.toFixed(2); b._count = r.count;
        this._count(count, r.count, "int", animate);
        return li;
      });
      $.steps.replaceChildren(...items);
      this._syncPressed();
    }

    _renderDetail() {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, m = this._m;
      const r = this._selected && m.rows.find(x => x.id === this._selected);
      $.detail.replaceChildren();
      if (!r) { $.detail.textContent = L.selectHint; return; }
      $.detail.append(make("b", null, r.label), " · ");
      if (r.prev != null) $.detail.append(`${this._int(r.prev)} ${L.reached} · ${this._int(r.count)} ${L.completed} · ${this._int(r.lost)} ${L.left} (${this._pct(r.dropRate)})`);
      else $.detail.append(`${this._int(r.count)}`);
    }

    _renderTip() {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, m = this._m, d = this._data || {};
      $.tipBtnLabel.textContent = this._tipOpen ? L.hide : L.show;
      $.tipBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(this._tipOpen));
      $.tipPanel.hidden = !this._tipOpen;
      if (!this._tipOpen) { $.tipPanel.replaceChildren(); return; }
      const w = m.worst;
      const box = make("div", "fcc-tip");
      const ico = make("span", "fcc-tip-ico"); ico.innerHTML = ICON_BULB;
      const body = make("div");
      if (!w) {
        body.append(make("p", "fcc-tip-text", L.noTip));
      } else {
        const vars = { rate: this._pct(w.dropRate), lost: this._int(w.lost), field: w.label };
        const tip = (d.tips || {})[w.id];
        body.append(make("p", "fcc-tip-title", fill(L.tipTitle, vars)), make("p", "fcc-tip-text", fill(tip || L.tipFallback, vars)));
        // estimate: worst field at the average pass rate of the other fields, the rest of the form unchanged
        const others = m.fields.filter(r => r !== w && r.prev > 0);
        if (others.length && w.count > 0 && m.views > 0) {
          const rate = others.reduce((a, r) => a + r.count / r.prev, 0) / others.length;
          const newCount = w.prev * rate;
          const extra = Math.max(0, (newCount - w.count) * (m.submitted / w.count));
          const rounded = extra >= 100 ? Math.round(extra / 10) * 10 : Math.round(extra);
          if (rounded > 0) {
            const gain = make("p", "fcc-tip-gain");
            const text = fill(L.gain, { field: w.label, rate: this._pct(rate), extra: "\u0000", from: this._pct(m.submitted / m.views), to: this._pct((m.submitted + rounded) / m.views) });
            const [a, b] = text.split("\u0000");
            gain.append(a, make("b", null, this._int(rounded)), b || "");
            body.append(gain);
          }
        }
      }
      box.append(ico, body);
      $.tipPanel.replaceChildren(box);
    }

    /* ---------- linking: hover/focus highlights both sides, click selects ---------- */
    _targets(id) { return id ? [...this.querySelectorAll(`.fcc-row, .fcc-mtarget, .fcc-mbody`)].filter(n => n.dataset.step === id) : []; }

    _hl(id) {
      if (this._hlId === id) return;
      this.querySelectorAll(".fcc-hl").forEach(n => n.classList.remove("fcc-hl"));
      this._hlId = id || null;
      this._targets(id).forEach(n => n.classList.add("fcc-hl"));
    }

    _syncPressed() {
      this.querySelectorAll(".fcc-row, .fcc-mtarget").forEach(n => { if (n.dataset.step) n.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(n.dataset.step === this._selected)); });
      if (this._hlId) { const id = this._hlId; this._hlId = null; this._hl(id); }
    }

    select(id) {
      const m = this._m, r = m && m.rows.find(x => x.id === id);
      this._selected = r ? r.id : null;
      this._syncPressed();
      this._renderDetail();
      if (r) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("fieldselect", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { id: r.id, label: r.label, type: r.type, device: this.device, count: r.count, reached: r.prev, lost: r.lost, dropRate: r.dropRate, worst: !!(m.worst && m.worst.id === r.id) }
      }));
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.seg.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button[data-device]");
        if (!b || b.dataset.device === this.device) return;
        this.device = b.dataset.device;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("devicechange", { bubbles: true, detail: { device: this.device } }));
        requestAnimationFrame(() => { const nb = $.seg.querySelector(`[data-device="${b.dataset.device}"]`); if (nb) nb.focus(); });
      });
      const find = e => { const t = e.target.closest(".fcc-row, .fcc-mtarget"); return t && this.contains(t) && t.dataset.step ? t : null; };
      this.addEventListener("pointerover", e => { const t = find(e); if (t) this._hl(t.dataset.step); });
      this.addEventListener("pointerout", e => {
        const t = find(e);
        if (t && !t.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
          const f = document.activeElement && this.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement.closest(".fcc-row, .fcc-mtarget") : null;
          this._hl(f && f.dataset.step ? f.dataset.step : null);
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener("focusin", e => { const t = find(e); this._hl(t ? t.dataset.step : null); });
      this.addEventListener("focusout", e => { if (!this.contains(e.relatedTarget)) this._hl(null); });
      this.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const t = find(e);
        if (!t) return;
        this.select(this._selected === t.dataset.step ? null : t.dataset.step);
      });
      $.tipBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { this._tipOpen = !this._tipOpen; this._renderTip(); });
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("form-conversion")) customElements.define("form-conversion", FormConversion);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const say = (strong, rest) => { const b = document.createElement("b"); b.textContent = strong; note.replaceChildren(b, rest); };
  el.addEventListener("fieldselect", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    say(`${d.label} · ${d.device}`, ` selected. The card fired a fieldselect event${d.dropRate != null ? ` (${(d.dropRate * 100).toFixed(1)}% left here)` : ""}. Example data, not real client results.`);
  });
  el.addEventListener("devicechange", e => say(`Device: ${e.detail.device}`, " · devicechange fired. Example data, not real client results."));

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

.sas-ring-v { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 650 19px/1 var(--sas-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--sas-c); }

@keyframes sas-rise { from { transform: translateY(5px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }

.sas-toolbar { margin-top: 22px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <seo-audit-scorecard> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const SEVS = ["critical", "warning", "notice"];
  const FILTERS = ["all", "critical", "warning", "notice", "fixed"];
  const LABELS = {
    all: "All", critical: "Critical", warning: "Warning", notice: "Notice", fixed: "Fixed",
    issues: "Issues", filter: "Filter issues by severity", categories: "Category scores",
    overall: "Overall score", grade: "Grade", potential: "Fix everything to reach {score} · {grade}", maxed: "Every issue is fixed",
    pages: "{n} pages crawled", lastRun: "Last run {when}", justNow: "just now",
    open: "{n} open", openOne: "1 open", none: "No open issues", gain: "+{n} from fixes",
    pagesAffected: "{n} pages", pageAffected: "1 page", pts: "+{n} pts",
    why: "Why it matters", how: "How to fix", examples: "Example pages", more: "+{n} more",
    markFixed: "Mark as fixed", fixHint: "Adds <b>+{n}</b> to {cat}", fixedHint: "Added <b>+{n}</b> to {cat}",
    verified: "Verified on re-run",
    empty: "Nothing in this view. Nice work.", clearScope: "Show all categories",
    rerun: "Re-run audit", scanning: "Re-running audit", scanTitle: "Scanning {site}",
    steps: ["Fetching {pages} pages", "Checking performance", "Checking accessibility", "Checking best practices", "Checking on-page SEO", "Working out scores"],
    done: "Audit complete. {verified} fixes verified · overall {score} · grade {grade}.",
    doneNone: "Audit complete. No changes since the last run · overall {score} · grade {grade}.",
    fixedSr: "{title} marked as fixed. {cat} is now {score}. Overall {overall}, grade {grade}.",
    unfixedSr: "{title} reopened. {cat} is now {score}. Overall {overall}, grade {grade}."
  };
  const GRADES = [[90, "A"], [80, "B"], [70, "C"], [60, "D"], [0, "F"]];
  const ICON = {
    critical: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 1.8 15 14H1z"/><path d="M8 6.4v3.4M8 11.9v.1"/></svg>',
    warning: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.2"/><path d="M8 4.8v3.7M8 10.9v.1"/></svg>',
    notice: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.2"/><path d="M8 7.4v3.8M8 4.9v.1"/></svg>',
    fixed: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m3.2 8.4 3 3 6.6-6.8"/></svg>',
    chev: '<svg class="sas-chev" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4"/></svg>',
    globe: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.3"/><path d="M1.8 8h12.4M8 1.7c2 2 2 10.6 0 12.6M8 1.7c-2 2-2 10.6 0 12.6"/></svg>',
    rerun: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13.5 8a5.5 5.5 0 1 1-1.7-4"/><path d="M13.6 2.2v3.4h-3.4"/></svg>',
    x: '<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m3 3 6 6M9 3 3 9"/></svg>',
    ok: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.3"/><path d="m5.2 8.2 2 2 3.8-4"/></svg>'
  };
  const RING = '<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle class="sas-trk" cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke-width="{w}"/><circle class="sas-arc" cx="50" cy="50" r="42" stroke-width="{w}" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="100" stroke-dashoffset="100"/></svg>';

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="sas">
      <header class="sas-band">
        <div class="sas-site">
          <span class="sas-eyebrow"></span>
          <h2 class="sas-title"></h2>
          <span class="sas-url"></span>
          <ul class="sas-meta"><li class="sas-m-pages"></li><li class="sas-m-run"></li></ul>
          <button type="button" class="sas-rerun"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="sas-grade">
          <div class="sas-seal">${RING.replace(/\{w\}/g, "7")}<div class="sas-letter"><b></b><small></small></div></div>
          <div class="sas-overall">
            <span class="sas-overall-k"></span>
            <span class="sas-overall-v"></span>
            <span class="sas-potential"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="sas-body">
        <div class="sas-done" hidden></div>
        <div class="sas-cats" role="group"></div>
        <div class="sas-toolbar">
          <h3 class="sas-h"><span class="sas-h-t"></span></h3>
          <div class="sas-sevs" role="group"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="sas-groups"></div>
        <p class="sas-empty" hidden></p>
        <p class="sas-foot"></p>
        <div class="sas-scan" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="sas-scan-card">
            <div class="sas-scan-top"><span class="sas-scan-t"></span><span class="sas-scan-p"></span></div>
            <div class="sas-pulse"></div>
            <div class="sas-bar"><i></i></div>
            <p class="sas-scan-s"></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="sas-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </article>`;

  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const clamp = v => Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v));
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const gradeOf = s => GRADES.find(g => s >= g[0])[1];
  const toneOf = s => (s >= 90 ? "good" : s >= 50 ? "warn" : "bad");
  /* fills a template that contains <b> markers without using innerHTML on data */
  const rich = (el, tpl, vars) => {
    el.replaceChildren();
    String(tpl).split(/(<b>.*?<\/b>)/).forEach(part => {
      const m = /^<b>(.*)<\/b>$/.exec(part);
      if (m) el.append(make("b", null, fill(m[1], vars))); else if (part) el.append(fill(part, vars));
    });
  };
  let uid = 0;

  class SeoAuditScorecard extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["severity", "category"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<seo-audit-scorecard>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this._uid = "sas" + (++uid);
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        card: q(".sas"), eyebrow: q(".sas-eyebrow"), title: q(".sas-title"), url: q(".sas-url"),
        mPages: q(".sas-m-pages"), mRun: q(".sas-m-run"), rerun: q(".sas-rerun"),
        seal: q(".sas-seal"), sealArc: q(".sas-seal .sas-arc"), letter: q(".sas-letter b"), letterK: q(".sas-letter small"),
        overallK: q(".sas-overall-k"), overallV: q(".sas-overall-v"), potential: q(".sas-potential"),
        cats: q(".sas-cats"), h: q(".sas-h"), hT: q(".sas-h-t"), sevs: q(".sas-sevs"), groups: q(".sas-groups"),
        empty: q(".sas-empty"), done: q(".sas-done"), foot: q(".sas-foot"),
        scan: q(".sas-scan"), scanT: q(".sas-scan-t"), scanP: q(".sas-scan-p"), scanS: q(".sas-scan-s"), scanBar: q(".sas-bar"),
        sr: q(".sas-sr")
      };
      this._timers = [];
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._render();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { this._clearTimers(); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._renderIssues(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; if (this._built) { this._clearTimers(); this._scanning(false); this._render(); } }
    get severity() { const v = (this.getAttribute("severity") || "all").toLowerCase(); return FILTERS.includes(v) ? v : "all"; }
    set severity(v) { this.setAttribute("severity", FILTERS.includes(v) ? v : "all"); }
    get category() { const v = this.getAttribute("category"); return v && this._cats && this._cats.some(c => c.id === v) ? v : null; }
    set category(v) { if (v) this.setAttribute("category", v); else this.removeAttribute("category"); }
    get scores() { return this._built ? this._score() : null; }
    setFixed(id, fixed) { const it = this._issues && this._issues.find(i => i.id === id); if (it) this._setFixed(it, !!fixed, false); }
    rerun() { if (this._built) this._rerun(); }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _clearTimers() { (this._timers || []).forEach(t => clearTimeout(t)); this._timers = []; }
    _later(fn, ms) { const t = setTimeout(() => { this._timers = this._timers.filter(x => x !== t); fn(); }, ms); this._timers.push(t); }

    _render() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.eyebrow.textContent = d.eyebrow || "";
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.url.replaceChildren();
      if (d.site) { $.url.innerHTML = ICON.globe; $.url.append(d.site); }
      $.mPages.replaceChildren();
      if (num(d.pages) != null) rich($.mPages, fill(L.pages, { n: "<b>" + num(d.pages).toLocaleString("en-US") + "</b>" }), {});
      $.mPages.hidden = num(d.pages) == null;
      this._lastRun = d.lastRun || "";
      this._paintRun();
      $.rerun.innerHTML = ICON.rerun;
      $.rerun.append(L.rerun);
      $.overallK.textContent = L.overall;
      $.letterK.textContent = L.grade;
      $.cats.setAttribute("aria-label", L.categories);
      $.sevs.setAttribute("aria-label", L.filter);
      $.hT.textContent = L.issues;
      $.empty.textContent = L.empty;
      $.foot.textContent = d.source || "";
      $.done.hidden = true;

      const seen = new Set();
      this._cats = (Array.isArray(d.categories) ? d.categories : []).filter(Boolean).map((c, i) => {
        let id = String(c.id || `cat-${i + 1}`);
        while (seen.has(id)) id += "-" + i;
        seen.add(id);
        return { id, label: c.label || id, base: clamp(num(c.score) ?? 0), weight: Math.max(0, num(c.weight) ?? 1) };
      });
      const iseen = new Set();
      this._issues = (Array.isArray(d.issues) ? d.issues : []).filter(Boolean).map((x, i) => {
        let id = String(x.id || `issue-${i + 1}`);
        while (iseen.has(id)) id += "-" + i;
        iseen.add(id);
        return {
          id, raw: x, title: x.title || "Issue", severity: SEVS.includes(x.severity) ? x.severity : "notice",
          category: seen.has(x.category) ? x.category : (this._cats[0] || {}).id, impact: Math.max(0, num(x.impact) ?? 0),
          pages: num(x.pages), why: x.why || "", fix: x.fix || "", urls: Array.isArray(x.urls) ? x.urls.map(String) : [],
          fixed: !!x.fixed, verified: !!x.fixed
        };
      });
      // the base score in the data assumes listed issues are open; issues that start fixed already count
      this._nodes = new Map();
      this._open = null;

      $.cats.replaceChildren(...this._cats.map(c => {
        const b = make("button", "sas-cat");
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.id = c.id;
        const ring = make("span", "sas-ring");
        ring.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        ring.innerHTML = RING.replace(/\{w\}/g, "9");
        ring.append(make("span", "sas-ring-v"));
        const sub = make("span", "sas-cat-sub");
        sub.append(make("span", "sas-cat-open"), make("span", "sas-gain"));
        b.append(ring, make("span", "sas-cat-name", c.label), sub, make("span", "sas-sr sas-cat-sr"));
        return b;
      }));
      $.sevs.replaceChildren(...FILTERS.map(f => {
        const b = make("button", "sas-sev");
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.filter = f;
        if (f !== "all") b.dataset.sev = f;
        if (f !== "all") b.append(make("i"));
        b.append(L[f], make("b"));
        return b;
      }));
      this._prev = null;
      this._paintScores(false);
      this._renderIssues(false);
    }

    _paintRun() {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.mRun.replaceChildren();
      if (this._lastRun) rich($.mRun, fill(L.lastRun, { when: "<b>" + this._lastRun + "</b>" }), {});
      $.mRun.hidden = !this._lastRun;
    }

    _score() {
      const cats = this._cats.map(c => {
        const gained = this._issues.filter(i => i.fixed && i.category === c.id).reduce((s, i) => s + i.impact, 0);
        const left = this._issues.filter(i => !i.fixed && i.category === c.id).reduce((s, i) => s + i.impact, 0);
        return Object.assign({}, c, {
          score: Math.round(clamp(c.base + gained)), gained: Math.round(Math.min(gained, 100 - c.base)),
          max: Math.round(clamp(c.base + gained + left)),
          open: this._issues.filter(i => !i.fixed && i.category === c.id).length
        });
      });
      const w = cats.reduce((s, c) => s + c.weight, 0) || 1;
      const overall = Math.round(cats.reduce((s, c) => s + c.score * c.weight, 0) / w);
      const potential = Math.round(cats.reduce((s, c) => s + c.max * c.weight, 0) / w);
      return { cats, overall, potential, grade: gradeOf(overall), potentialGrade: gradeOf(potential) };
    }

    _paintScores(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, S = this._score(), prev = this._prev;
      const motion = animate && !reduceMotion() && !document.hidden;

      $.seal.dataset.tone = toneOf(S.overall);
      $.sealArc.style.strokeDashoffset = String(100 - S.overall);
      if ($.letter.textContent !== S.grade) {
        $.letter.textContent = S.grade;
        if (motion && prev) { $.letter.classList.remove("is-swap"); void $.letter.offsetWidth; $.letter.classList.add("is-swap"); }
      }
      this._tween($.overallV, prev ? prev.overall : S.overall, S.overall, motion, v => {
        $.overallV.replaceChildren(String(v), make("small", null, "/ 100"));
      });
      $.seal.setAttribute("role", "img");
      $.seal.setAttribute("aria-label", `${L.grade} ${S.grade}, ${L.overall.toLowerCase()} ${S.overall} / 100`);
      if (S.potential > S.overall) rich($.potential, L.potential.replace("{score} · {grade}", "<b>{score} · {grade}</b>"), { score: S.potential, grade: S.potentialGrade });
      else $.potential.textContent = L.maxed;

      S.cats.forEach((c, i) => {
        const b = $.cats.querySelector(`.sas-cat[data-id="${CSS.escape(c.id)}"]`);
        if (!b) return;
        const ring = b.querySelector(".sas-ring");
        ring.dataset.tone = toneOf(c.score);
        b.querySelector(".sas-arc").style.strokeDashoffset = String(100 - c.score);
        const v = b.querySelector(".sas-ring-v");
        this._tween(v, prev ? prev.cats[i].score : c.score, c.score, motion, n => (v.textContent = String(n)));
        b.querySelector(".sas-cat-open").textContent = c.open === 0 ? L.none : c.open === 1 ? L.openOne : fill(L.open, { n: c.open });
        const g = b.querySelector(".sas-gain"), gt = c.gained > 0 ? fill(L.gain, { n: c.gained }) : "";
        if (g.textContent !== gt) {
          g.textContent = gt;
          if (motion && gt) { g.classList.remove("is-swap"); void g.offsetWidth; g.classList.add("is-swap"); }
        }
        b.querySelector(".sas-cat-sr").textContent = `, score ${c.score} out of 100`;
      });
      this._prev = S;
      return S;
    }

    _tween(el, from, to, motion, paint) {
      el._to = to;
      if (!motion || from === to) { paint(to); return; }
      const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 650;
      const step = now => {
        if (el._to !== to) return;
        const p = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
        paint(Math.round(from + (to - from) * e));
        if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    _renderIssues(animate) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, sev = this.severity, cat = this.category;
      $.sevs.querySelectorAll(".sas-sev").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.filter === sev)));
      $.cats.querySelectorAll(".sas-cat").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.id === cat)));

      // scope chip next to the heading
      const old = $.h.querySelector(".sas-scope");
      if (old) old.remove();
      if (cat) {
        const c = this._cats.find(x => x.id === cat);
        const chip = make("span", "sas-scope", c.label);
        const x = make("button");
        x.type = "button";
        x.setAttribute("aria-label", L.clearScope);
        x.innerHTML = ICON.x;
        x.addEventListener("click", () => { this.category = null; const f = $.cats.querySelector(".sas-cat"); if (f) f.focus(); });
        chip.append(x);
        $.h.append(chip);
      }

      const inCat = this._issues.filter(i => !cat || i.category === cat);
      const count = f => f === "all" ? inCat.length : f === "fixed" ? inCat.filter(i => i.fixed).length : inCat.filter(i => !i.fixed && i.severity === f).length;
      $.sevs.querySelectorAll(".sas-sev").forEach(b => (b.querySelector("b").textContent = String(count(b.dataset.filter))));

      const groupKeys = sev === "all" ? [...SEVS, "fixed"] : [sev];
      const groups = groupKeys.map(k => {
        const items = inCat.filter(i => (k === "fixed" ? i.fixed : !i.fixed && i.severity === k))
          .sort((a, b) => b.impact - a.impact || a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
        if (!items.length) return null;
        const g = make("section", "sas-group");
        g.dataset.sev = k;
        const hid = `${this._uid}-g-${k}`;
        const h = make("h4", "sas-group-h", L[k]);
        h.id = hid;
        h.append(make("span", null, String(items.length)));
        g.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", hid);
        const ul = make("ul", "sas-list");
        items.forEach(it => ul.append(this._issue(it, L)));
        g.append(h, ul);
        return g;
      }).filter(Boolean);
      $.groups.replaceChildren(...groups);
      $.empty.hidden = groups.length > 0;
    }

    _issue(it, L) {
      let li = this._nodes.get(it.id);
      if (!li) {
        li = make("li", "sas-issue");
        li.dataset.id = it.id;
        const detId = `${this._uid}-d-${it.id.replace(/[^\w-]/g, "")}`;
        const btn = make("button", "sas-issue-btn");
        btn.type = "button";
        btn.setAttribute("aria-controls", detId);
        const ico = make("span", "sas-ico");
        const t = make("span", "sas-it");
        const meta = make("span", "sas-it-m");
        const cat = this._cats.find(c => c.id === it.category);
        meta.append(make("span", "sas-chip", cat ? cat.label : ""));
        if (it.pages != null) meta.append(make("span", null, it.pages === 1 ? L.pageAffected : fill(L.pagesAffected, { n: it.pages })));
        meta.append(make("span", "sas-verified"));
        t.append(make("span", "sas-sr sas-sev-sr"), make("span", "sas-it-t", it.title), meta);
        btn.append(ico, t, make("span", "sas-pts", fill(L.pts, { n: it.impact })));
        btn.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON.chev);

        const det = make("div", "sas-det");
        det.id = detId;
        const inner = make("div", "sas-det-in"), body = make("div", "sas-det-body");
        const sec = (k, v) => { const s = make("div", "sas-dsec"); s.append(make("h5", null, k), make("p", null, v)); return s; };
        if (it.why) body.append(sec(L.why, it.why));
        if (it.fix) body.append(sec(L.how, it.fix));
        if (it.urls.length) {
          const ul = make("ul", "sas-urls");
          ul.setAttribute("aria-label", L.examples);
          const shown = it.urls.slice(0, 4);
          shown.forEach(u => ul.append(make("li", null, u)));
          const rest = (it.pages != null ? it.pages : it.urls.length) - shown.length;
          if (rest > 0) ul.append(make("li", "sas-more", fill(L.more, { n: rest })));
          body.append(ul);
        }
        const fix = make("div", "sas-fix");
        const lab = make("label", "sas-check");
        const cb = make("input");
        cb.type = "checkbox";
        cb.addEventListener("change", () => this._setFixed(it, cb.checked, true));
        lab.append(cb, make("span", null, L.markFixed));
        fix.append(lab, make("span", "sas-fix-hint"));
        body.append(fix);
        inner.append(body);
        det.append(inner);

        btn.addEventListener("click", () => this._toggle(it.id));
        li.append(btn, det);
        li._it = it;
        this._nodes.set(it.id, li);
      }
      this._paintIssue(li, L);
      return li;
    }

    _paintIssue(li, L) {
      const it = li._it, open = this._open === it.id, sev = it.fixed ? "fixed" : it.severity;
      const cat = this._cats.find(c => c.id === it.category);
      li.dataset.sev = sev;
      li.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
      li.querySelector(".sas-issue-btn").setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      li.querySelector(".sas-det-in").inert = !open;
      li.querySelector(".sas-ico").innerHTML = ICON[sev];
      li.querySelector(".sas-sev-sr").textContent = L[sev] + ": ";
      li.querySelector(".sas-verified").textContent = it.fixed && it.verified ? L.verified : "";
      li.querySelector("input").checked = it.fixed;
      rich(li.querySelector(".sas-fix-hint"), it.fixed ? L.fixedHint : L.fixHint, { n: it.impact, cat: cat ? cat.label : "" });
    }

    _toggle(id) {
      const prev = this._open, L = this._labels();
      this._open = prev === id ? null : id;
      [prev, this._open].forEach(x => { const li = x && this._nodes.get(x); if (li) this._paintIssue(li, L); });
    }

    _setFixed(it, fixed, fromUi) {
      if (it.fixed === fixed) return;
      const L = this._labels(), li = this._nodes.get(it.id);
      const hadFocus = li && li.contains(document.activeElement);
      const before = li && li.isConnected ? li.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
      it.fixed = fixed;
      if (!fixed) it.verified = false;
      const S = this._paintScores(true);
      this._renderIssues(true);

      if (li && li.isConnected) {
        if (hadFocus) li.querySelector("input").focus({ preventScroll: true });
        if (before && !reduceMotion() && "animate" in Element.prototype) {
          const after = li.getBoundingClientRect();
          li.animate([{ transform: `translateY(${before.top - after.top}px)`, opacity: .6 }, { transform: "none", opacity: 1 }],
            { duration: 450, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" });
        }
        if (fromUi) { const r = li.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.top < 0 || r.bottom > window.innerHeight) li.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: reduceMotion() ? "auto" : "smooth" }); }
      } else if (hadFocus) {
        // the issue left the current view: hand focus to the filter that now holds it
        const target = this.$.sevs.querySelector(`.sas-sev[data-filter="${fixed ? "fixed" : it.severity}"]`) || this.$.sevs.querySelector(".sas-sev");
        if (target) target.focus();
      }
      const c = S.cats.find(x => x.id === it.category) || {};
      this._say(fill(fixed ? L.fixedSr : L.unfixedSr, { title: it.title, cat: c.label, score: c.score, overall: S.overall, grade: S.grade }));
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("issuefix", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: {
          id: it.id, fixed, issue: Object.assign({}, it.raw, { fixed }),
          category: it.category, categoryScore: c.score, overall: S.overall, grade: S.grade
        }
      }));
    }

    _rerun() {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, d = this._data || {};
      if ($.card.classList.contains("is-scanning")) return;
      this._clearTimers();
      const steps = (Array.isArray(L.steps) ? L.steps : LABELS.steps).map(s => fill(s, { pages: num(d.pages) ?? "" }).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim());
      const quick = reduceMotion();
      const stepMs = quick ? 160 : 340;
      $.done.hidden = true;
      this._scanning(true);
      $.scanT.textContent = fill(L.scanTitle, { site: d.site || "" }).trim();
      this._say(L.scanning);
      const show = i => {
        const p = Math.round((i / steps.length) * 100);
        $.scanBar.style.setProperty("--sas-p", p);
        $.scanP.textContent = p + "%";
        $.scanS.textContent = steps[Math.min(i, steps.length - 1)] + (i < steps.length ? "…" : "");
      };
      show(0);
      steps.forEach((_, i) => this._later(() => show(i + 1), stepMs * (i + 1)));
      this._later(() => {
        const verified = this._issues.filter(i => i.fixed && !i.verified);
        verified.forEach(i => (i.verified = true));
        this._lastRun = L.justNow;
        this._paintRun();
        this._scanning(false);
        $.rerun.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        const S = this._paintScores(true);
        this._renderIssues(true);
        const msg = fill(verified.length ? L.done : L.doneNone, { verified: verified.length, score: S.overall, grade: S.grade });
        $.done.innerHTML = ICON.ok;
        $.done.append(msg);
        $.done.hidden = false;
        if (!quick) { $.done.classList.remove("is-in"); void $.done.offsetWidth; $.done.classList.add("is-in"); }
        this._say(msg);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("auditrun", {
          bubbles: true,
          detail: { overall: S.overall, grade: S.grade, verified: verified.map(i => i.id), categories: S.cats.map(c => ({ id: c.id, score: c.score })) }
        }));
      }, stepMs * (steps.length + 1) + (quick ? 0 : 200));
    }

    _scanning(on) {
      const $ = this.$;

    _say(t) {
      this.$.sr.textContent = "";
      this._later(() => { this.$.sr.textContent = t; }, 60);
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.rerun.addEventListener("click", () => this._rerun());
      $.sevs.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".sas-sev");
        if (!b || b.dataset.filter === this.severity) return;
        this.severity = b.dataset.filter;

      $.cats.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".sas-cat");
        if (!b) return;
        this.category = this.category === b.dataset.id ? null : b.dataset.id;
      });
      $.groups.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key !== "Escape" || !this._open) return;

  }

  if (!customElements.get("seo-audit-scorecard")) customElements.define("seo-audit-scorecard", SeoAuditScorecard);
})();

(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const original = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.data || {}));
  const say = (strong, rest) => { const b = document.createElement("b"); b.textContent = strong; note.replaceChildren(b, " " + rest); };

  el.addEventListener("issuefix", e => {

    say("issuefix", `fired: ${d.fixed ? "fixed" : "reopened"} "${d.issue.title}". Overall ${d.overall}, grade ${d.grade}. Example data.`);
  });
  el.addEventListener("auditrun", e => say("auditrun", `fired: overall ${e.detail.overall}, grade ${e.detail.grade}. Example data, not a real audit.`));

  document.getElementById("fix-critical").addEventListener("click", () => {
    (el.data.issues || []).filter(i => i.severity === "critical").forEach(i => el.setFixed(i.id, true));
  });
  document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.removeAttribute("category");
    el.setAttribute("severity", "all");
    el.data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original));

  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");

    };

    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();

@keyframes isg-glow { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 8%, transparent); } }
.isg-name { margin: 14px 0 0; font: 650 15.5px/1.25 var(--isg-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.isg-desc { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--isg-muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.isg-issue {
  margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 10%, transparent); color: var(--isg-ink);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--c);
}
.isg-issue:empty { display: none; }
.isg-bars { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 14px; height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; }
.isg-bars[hidden] + .isg-meta { margin-top: auto; }
.isg-bars span { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: calc(max(var(--h), 4) * 1%); border-radius: 2px 2px 1px 1px; background: var(--isg-line); transition: height .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), background .3s; }
.isg-bars span:last-child { background: var(--isg-glyph); opacity: .75; }
.isg-tile[data-status="disconnected"] .isg-bars span:last-child { background: var(--isg-line); opacity: 1; }
.isg-meta { margin: 10px 0 0; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--isg-line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.isg-meta div { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.isg-meta dt { font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--isg-sans); letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--isg-faint); }
.isg-meta dd { margin: 0; font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--isg-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; transition: color .3s; }
.isg-meta dd.isg-is-fresh { color: var(--isg-ok); }
.isg-actions { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.isg-actions .isg-btn:first-child { flex: 1; }

.isg-empty { margin-top: 16px; padding: 34px 16px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px dashed var(--isg-line); display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--isg-muted); }
.isg-foot { margin-top: 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--isg-faint); }
.isg-foot span:empty { display: none; }

/* details drawer */
.isg-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 4; background: var(--isg-scrim); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s ease; }
.isg-scrim.isg-is-open { opacity: 1; }
.isg-drawer {
  position: absolute; z-index: 5; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(380px, 100%); box-sizing: border-box;
  display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  background: var(--isg-tile); border-left: 1px solid var(--isg-line);
  box-shadow: -24px 0 48px -32px var(--isg-shadow);
  transform: translateX(104%); transition: transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.isg-drawer.isg-is-open { transform: none; }
.isg-dr-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 18px 18px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--isg-line); }
.isg-dr-head .isg-glyph { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
.isg-dr-title { margin: 0; font: 650 17px/1.2 var(--isg-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.isg-dr-title:focus { outline: none; }
.isg-dr-head .isg-light { justify-self: start; margin-top: 6px; }
.isg-close { width: 34px; padding: 0; align-self: start; }
.isg-dr-body { overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 18px; display: grid; gap: 18px; align-content: start; }
.isg-dr-sec { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.isg-dr-sec h4 { margin: 0; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--isg-sans); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--isg-faint); }
.isg-dr-facts { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1px; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--isg-line); border: 1px solid var(--isg-line); }
.isg-dr-facts div { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 11px; background: var(--isg-tile); min-width: 0; }
.isg-dr-facts .isg-wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.isg-dr-facts dt { font-size: 11px; color: var(--isg-faint); }
.isg-dr-facts dd { margin: 0; font: 600 13px/1.3 var(--isg-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.isg-scopes { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 7px; }
.isg-scopes li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; }
.isg-scopes svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--isg-ok); }
.isg-hist { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; }
.isg-hist li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 0 0 12px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35; }
.isg-hist li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 6px; top: 14px; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--isg-line); }
.isg-hist li:last-child::before { display: none; }
.isg-hist i { width: 9px; height: 9px; margin: 3px 0 0 2px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 18%, transparent); }
.isg-hist b { display: block; font-weight: 600; }
.isg-hist small { display: block; color: var(--isg-muted); font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.isg-hist em { font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; color: var(--isg-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.isg-hist li.isg-is-enter { animation: isg-in .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both; }
.isg-dr-foot { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--isg-line); background: var(--isg-tint); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.isg-dr-foot .isg-btn:first-child { flex: 1; }
.isg-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet */
@container isg (max-width: 759px) {
  .isg { padding: 20px 18px 16px; }
  .isg-summary { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .isg-filters { justify-self: start; }
  .isg-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}
/* phone: one compact tile per row */
@container isg (max-width: 479px) {
  .isg { padding: 18px 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; }
  .isg-head .isg-btn { width: 100%; }
  .isg-summary { padding: 12px; }
  .isg-filters { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .isg-filter { justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 8px 4px; font-size: 12px; }
  .isg-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  .isg-tile { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 12px; padding: 14px 14px 12px; }
  .isg-tile-top { display: contents; }
  .isg-glyph { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
  .isg-light { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; justify-self: start; }
  .isg-name { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; margin-top: 8px; }
  .isg-desc, .isg-issue, .isg-meta, .isg-actions { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .isg-bars { display: none; }
  .isg-drawer { width: 100%; border-left: 0; }
  .isg-dr-head { padding: 16px 14px 14px; }
  .isg-dr-body { padding: 14px; }
  .isg-dr-foot { padding: 12px 14px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .isg-btn, .isg-meter span, .isg-filter, .isg-tile, .isg-bars span, .isg-meta dd, .isg-scrim, .isg-drawer { transition: none; }
  .isg-tile:hover { transform: none; }
  .isg-btn[aria-busy="true"] svg, .isg-tile.isg-is-enter, .isg-tile.isg-is-flash, .isg-tile[data-status="connected"] .isg-light i, .isg-hist li.isg-is-enter { animation: none; }
}

<script>
/* =========================================================

(() => {
  const LABELS = {

  const FILTERS = ["all", ...STATUSES];
  const GLYPHS = {
