    sheet: '<rect x="3.5" y="4" width="17" height="16" rx="2.5"/><path d="M3.5 9h17M3.5 14h17M9.5 9v11"/>',
    hub: '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="5" cy="5.5" r="1.8"/><circle cx="19" cy="5.5" r="1.8"/><circle cx="5" cy="18.5" r="1.8"/><circle cx="19" cy="18.5" r="1.8"/><path d="m6.4 6.8 3.4 3.1M17.6 6.8l-3.4 3.1M6.4 17.2l3.4-3.1M17.6 17.2l-3.4-3.1"/>',
    plug: '<path d="M9 3v4M15 3v4M7 7h10v4a5 5 0 0 1-10 0zM12 16v5"/>'
  };
  const glyph = k => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${GLYPHS[k] || GLYPHS.plug}</svg>`;
  const ICON_SYNC = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13.2 6.2A5.3 5.3 0 0 0 3.4 5M2.8 9.8A5.3 5.3 0 0 0 12.6 11"/><path d="M13.5 2.8v3.5H10M2.5 13.2V9.7H6"/></svg>';
  const ICON_PLUG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 2v3M10 2v3M4.5 5h7v2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-7 0zM8 11v3"/></svg>';
  const ICON_SPIN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 2a6 6 0 1 1-6 6" /></svg>';
  const ICON_INFO = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6"/><path d="M8 7.3v3.7M8 5h.01"/></svg>';
  const ICON_X = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 4 8 8M12 4l-8 8"/></svg>';
  const ICON_CHECK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m3.5 8.4 2.8 2.8 6.2-6.6"/></svg>';

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <section class="isg">
      <div class="isg-main">
        <header class="isg-head">
          <div class="isg-intro">
            <span class="isg-eyebrow"></span>
            <h2 class="isg-title"></h2>
            <p class="isg-sub"></p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="isg-btn isg-syncall"></button>
        </header>
        <div class="isg-summary">
          <div class="isg-health">
            <div class="isg-health-top"><span class="isg-health-big"></span><span class="isg-health-sub"></span></div>
            <div class="isg-meter" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="isg-filters" role="group"></div>
        </div>
        <ul class="isg-grid"></ul>
        <div class="isg-empty" hidden><span class="isg-empty-msg"></span><button type="button" class="isg-btn isg-showall"></button></div>
        <footer class="isg-foot"><span class="isg-foot-l"></span><span class="isg-foot-r"></span></footer>
      </div>
      <div class="isg-scrim" hidden></div>
      <div class="isg-drawer" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" hidden>
        <div class="isg-dr-head">
          <span class="isg-glyph isg-dr-glyph"></span>
          <div><h3 class="isg-dr-title" tabindex="-1"></h3><span class="isg-light isg-dr-light"><i></i><span></span></span></div>
          <button type="button" class="isg-btn isg-btn--ghost isg-close"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="isg-dr-body"></div>
        <div class="isg-dr-foot"></div>
      </div>
      <p class="isg-sr isg-live" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </section>`;

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const hash = s => { let h = 2166136261; for (const c of String(s)) { h ^= c.charCodeAt(0); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } return Math.abs(h); };
  const MIN = 60000;
  let uid = 0;

  class IntegrationStatusGrid extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["filter"]; }

    constructor() { super(); this._uid = "isg" + (++uid); this._busy = new Map(); this._timers = new Set(); this._allIds = new Set(); }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) { this._startClock(); return; }
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<integration-status-grid>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        root: q(".isg"), main: q(".isg-main"), eyebrow: q(".isg-eyebrow"), title: q(".isg-title"), sub: q(".isg-sub"), syncAll: q(".isg-syncall"),
        big: q(".isg-health-big"), healthSub: q(".isg-health-sub"), meter: q(".isg-meter"), filters: q(".isg-filters"),
        grid: q(".isg-grid"), empty: q(".isg-empty"), emptyMsg: q(".isg-empty-msg"), showAll: q(".isg-showall"),
        footL: q(".isg-foot-l"), footR: q(".isg-foot-r"),
        scrim: q(".isg-scrim"), drawer: q(".isg-drawer"), drGlyph: q(".isg-dr-glyph"), drTitle: q(".isg-dr-title"), drLight: q(".isg-dr-light"),
        close: q(".isg-close"), drBody: q(".isg-dr-body"), drFoot: q(".isg-dr-foot"), live: q(".isg-live")
      };
      this.$.drTitle.id = `${this._uid}-dt`;
      this.$.drawer.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", this.$.drTitle.id);
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._load();
      this._render(false);
      this._startClock();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      clearInterval(this._clock); this._clock = null;
      this._timers.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t)); this._timers.clear();
      this._busy.clear(); this._allIds.clear();
    }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._renderGrid(true);
      this._syncFilters();
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) {
      this._data = d || {};
      if (!this._built) return;
      this._timers.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t)); this._timers.clear(); this._busy.clear(); this._allIds.clear();
      this._closeDrawer(false);
      this._load();
      this._render(true);
    }
    get filter() { const f = (this.getAttribute("filter") || "all").toLowerCase(); return FILTERS.includes(f) ? f : "all"; }
    set filter(v) { this.setAttribute("filter", FILTERS.includes(v) ? v : "all"); }
    sync(id) { const it = this._get(id); if (it && it.status !== "disconnected") this._act(it, "sync"); }
    reconnect(id) { const it = this._get(id); if (it) this._act(it, "reconnect"); }
    syncAll() {
      const list = this._items.filter(it => it.status !== "disconnected" && !this._busy.has(it.id));
      if (!list.length) return;
      this._allIds = new Set(list.map(it => it.id));
      this._summary();
      list.forEach((it, i) => this._later(() => this._act(it, "sync"), i * 140));
    }
    setStatus(id, status, issue) {
      const it = this._get(id);
      if (!it || !STATUSES.includes(status)) return;
      it.status = status;
      it.issue = status === "connected" ? "" : (issue || it.issue || "");
      it.fix = status === "disconnected" ? "reconnect" : (it.fix || "sync");
      if (status !== "connected") it.history.unshift({ at: Date.now(), result: "fail", note: it.issue || LABELS.syncFail });
      this._refresh(it);
    }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _int(v) { return Math.round(v).toLocaleString((this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-US"); }
    _get(id) { return (this._items || []).find(it => it.id === id); }
    _later(fn, ms) { const t = setTimeout(() => { this._timers.delete(t); fn(); }, ms); this._timers.add(t); return t; }
    _startClock() { if (!this._clock) this._clock = setInterval(() => this._tickTimes(), 30000); }

    /* normalise data into a mutable model */
    _load() {
      const now = Date.now();
      const list = Array.isArray(this._data.integrations) ? this._data.integrations : [];
      this._items = list.map((x, i) => {
        x = x || {};
        const status = STATUSES.includes(x.status) ? x.status : "connected";
        const lastMin = num(x.lastSyncMinutes);
        const activity = (Array.isArray(x.activity) ? x.activity : []).map(v => Math.max(0, num(v) ?? 0)).slice(-12);
        const id = String(x.id || `integration-${i + 1}`);
        let history = Array.isArray(x.history) ? x.history.map(h => ({
          at: now - (num(h && h.minutesAgo) ?? 0) * MIN, result: h && h.result === "fail" ? "fail" : "ok",
          events: num(h && h.events), note: (h && h.note) ? String(h.note) : ""
        })) : null;
        if (!history && lastMin != null) {
          const per = Math.max(5, hash(id) % 15 + 5);
          history = [0, 1, 2].map(k => ({ at: now - (lastMin + k * per) * MIN, result: "ok", events: activity.length ? Math.max(1, Math.round(activity[activity.length - 1 - k] / 3 || 1)) : null, note: "" }));
        }
        return {
          id, name: String(x.name || `Integration ${i + 1}`), icon: x.icon || "plug", description: String(x.description || ""),
          status, issue: status === "connected" ? "" : String(x.issue || ""), fix: x.fix === "reconnect" || status === "disconnected" ? "reconnect" : "sync",
          lastSync: lastMin == null ? null : now - lastMin * MIN, events: Math.max(0, num(x.eventsToday) ?? 0), activity,
          account: x.account ? String(x.account) : "", since: x.connectedSince ? String(x.connectedSince) : "", interval: x.interval ? String(x.interval) : "",
          scopes: Array.isArray(x.scopes) ? x.scopes.map(String) : [], history: history || []
        };
      });
    }

    _ago(t) {
      const L = this._labels();
      if (t == null) return L.never;
      const m = Math.floor((Date.now() - t) / MIN);
      if (m < 1) return L.justNow;
      if (m < 60) return fill(L.minAgo, { n: m });
      const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
      if (h < 24) return fill(L.hAgo, { n: h });
      const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
      return d === 1 ? L.dAgo1 : fill(L.dAgo, { n: d });
    }

    _render(animate) {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      $.eyebrow.textContent = d.eyebrow || "";
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.sub.textContent = d.subtitle || "";
      $.footR.textContent = d.footnote || "";
      $.filters.setAttribute("aria-label", L.filterGroup);
      $.filters.replaceChildren(...FILTERS.map(f => {
        const b = make("button", "isg-filter"); b.type = "button"; b.dataset.filter = f;
        if (f !== "all") { const dot = make("span", "isg-fdot"); dot.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--isg-${f === "connected" ? "ok" : f === "warning" ? "warn" : "bad"})`); b.append(dot); }
        b.append(L[f] + " ", make("b"));
        return b;
      }));
      $.emptyMsg.textContent = L.empty;
      $.showAll.textContent = L.showAll;
      $.close.innerHTML = ICON_X;
      $.close.setAttribute("aria-label", L.close);
      this._renderGrid(animate);
      this._summary();
      this._syncFilters();
    }

    _summary() {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, items = this._items;
      const c = s => items.filter(it => it.status === s).length;
      const ok = c("connected"), warn = c("warning"), bad = c("disconnected"), n = items.length;
      $.big.textContent = fill(L.healthy, { ok, n });
      $.healthSub.textContent = warn + bad ? fill(L.needs, { n: warn + bad }) : L.allGood;
      const segs = [["ok", ok], ["warn", warn], ["bad", bad]].filter(x => x[1] > 0);
      $.meter.replaceChildren(...segs.map(([k, v]) => { const s = make("span"); s.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--isg-${k})`); s.style.setProperty("--n", v); return s; }));
      $.filters.querySelectorAll(".isg-filter").forEach(b => { b.querySelector("b").textContent = String(b.dataset.filter === "all" ? n : c(b.dataset.filter)); });
      $.footL.textContent = fill(L.eventsTotal, { n: this._int(items.reduce((a, it) => a + it.events, 0)) });
      const syncable = items.some(it => it.status !== "disconnected");
      $.syncAll.replaceChildren();
      const busyAll = !!(this._allIds && this._allIds.size);
      $.syncAll.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", busyAll ? ICON_SPIN : ICON_SYNC);
      $.syncAll.append(busyAll ? L.syncingAll : L.syncAll);
      $.syncAll.setAttribute("aria-busy", String(busyAll));
      $.syncAll.disabled = busyAll || !syncable;
    }

    _syncFilters() {
      const f = this.filter;
      this.$.filters.querySelectorAll(".isg-filter").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.filter === f)));
    }

    _renderGrid(animate) {
      const f = this.filter, motion = animate && !reduceMotion();
      const shown = this._items.filter(it => f === "all" || it.status === f);
      this.$.grid.replaceChildren(...shown.map((it, i) => {
        const li = this._tile(it);
        if (motion) { li.classList.add("isg-is-enter"); li.style.setProperty("--i", i); }
        return li;
      }));
      this.$.empty.hidden = shown.length > 0;
      this.$.grid.hidden = shown.length === 0;
    }

    _tile(it) {
      const L = this._labels();
      const li = make("li", "isg-tile");
      li.dataset.id = it.id;
      li.dataset.status = it.status;
      const top = make("div", "isg-tile-top");
      const g = make("span", "isg-glyph"); g.innerHTML = glyph(it.icon);
      top.append(g, this._light(it, L));
      const name = make("h3", "isg-name", it.name);
      name.id = `${this._uid}-n-${it.id}`;
      li.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", name.id);
      li.append(top, name, make("p", "isg-desc", it.description), make("p", "isg-issue", it.issue));

      const bars = make("div", "isg-bars");
      const max = Math.max(1, ...it.activity);
      it.activity.forEach(v => { const s = make("span"); s.style.setProperty("--h", (v / max * 100).toFixed(1)); bars.append(s); });
      bars.setAttribute("role", "img");
      bars.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.bars, { v: it.activity.join(", ") }));
      if (!it.activity.length) bars.hidden = true;
      li.append(bars);

      const meta = make("dl", "isg-meta");
      const m1 = make("div"), m2 = make("div");
      const ago = make("dd", "isg-ago", this._ago(it.lastSync));
      ago.dataset.t = it.lastSync ?? "";
      m1.append(make("dt", null, L.lastSync), ago);
      m2.append(make("dt", null, L.events), make("dd", "isg-ev", this._int(it.events)));
      meta.append(m1, m2);
      li.append(meta);

      const act = make("div", "isg-actions");
      act.append(this._mainBtn(it, L));
      const det = make("button", "isg-btn isg-btn--ghost isg-det");
      det.type = "button"; det.dataset.act = "details"; det.dataset.id = it.id;
      det.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "dialog");
      det.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.detailsOf, { name: it.name }));
      det.innerHTML = ICON_INFO; det.append(L.details);
      act.append(det);
      li.append(act);
      return li;
    }

    _light(it, L) {
      const s = make("span", "isg-light");
      s.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--isg-${it.status === "connected" ? "ok" : it.status === "warning" ? "warn" : "bad"})`);
      s.append(make("i"), make("span", null, L[it.status]));
      return s;
    }

    _mainBtn(it, L) {
      const busy = this._busy.get(it.id);
      const needsReconnect = it.status === "disconnected" || (it.status === "warning" && it.fix === "reconnect");
      const action = busy || (needsReconnect ? "reconnect" : "sync");
      const b = make("button", "isg-btn " + (action === "reconnect" ? (it.status === "disconnected" ? "isg-btn--fix" : "isg-btn--main") : "isg-btn--main"));
      b.type = "button"; b.dataset.act = action; b.dataset.id = it.id;
      b.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", busy ? ICON_SPIN : action === "reconnect" ? ICON_PLUG : ICON_SYNC);
      b.append(busy ? (busy === "reconnect" ? L.reconnecting : L.syncing) : (action === "reconnect" ? L.reconnect : L.syncNow));
      b.setAttribute("aria-busy", String(!!busy));
      if (busy) b.disabled = true;
      b.setAttribute("aria-describedby", `${this._uid}-n-${it.id}`);
      return b;
    }

    /* update one tile + summary + open drawer in place */
    _refresh(it, flash) {
      const old = this.$.grid.querySelector(`.isg-tile[data-id="${CSS.escape(it.id)}"]`);
      const f = this.filter;
      const hadFocus = old && old.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement.dataset.act : null;
      if (old) {
        if (f === "all" || it.status === f) {
          const fresh = this._tile(it);
          if (flash && !reduceMotion()) fresh.classList.add("isg-is-flash");
          old.replaceWith(fresh);
          if (hadFocus) {
            const target = fresh.querySelector(hadFocus === "details" ? ".isg-det" : ".isg-actions .isg-btn");
            if (target) target.focus();
          }
        } else old.remove();
      } else if (f === it.status) this._renderGrid(false);
      const visible = this.$.grid.children.length;
      this.$.empty.hidden = visible > 0; this.$.grid.hidden = visible === 0;
      if (hadFocus && !this.$.grid.contains(document.activeElement)) (visible ? this.$.grid.querySelector(".isg-btn") : this.$.showAll).focus();
      this._summary();
      if (this._open === it.id) this._fillDrawer(it);
    }

    _act(it, action) {
      if (this._busy.has(it.id)) return;
      const L = this._labels();
      this._busy.set(it.id, action);
      this._refresh(it);
      this._later(() => {
        if (!this._busy.has(it.id)) return;
        this._busy.delete(it.id);
        if (this._allIds) this._allIds.delete(it.id);
        const now = Date.now();
        this._lastHist = it.id + ":" + now;
        let added = 0;
        if (action === "reconnect") {
          it.status = "connected"; it.issue = ""; it.fix = "sync";
          added = 1 + hash(it.id + now) % 6;
          it.history.unshift({ at: now, result: "ok", events: added, note: L.reconnected });
          this.$.live.textContent = fill(L.announceReconnect, { name: it.name });
        } else {
          added = 2 + hash(it.id + it.events + now) % (it.events > 500 ? 40 : 12);
          if (it.status === "warning" && it.fix === "sync") { it.status = "connected"; it.issue = ""; }
          it.history.unshift({ at: now, result: "ok", events: added, note: "" });
          this.$.live.textContent = fill(L.announceSync, { name: it.name, n: added });
        }
        it.history = it.history.slice(0, 6);
        it.lastSync = now;
        it.events += added;
        if (it.activity.length) it.activity[it.activity.length - 1] += added;
        this._refresh(it, true);
        const dd = this.$.grid.querySelector(`.isg-tile[data-id="${CSS.escape(it.id)}"] .isg-ago`);
        if (dd) { dd.classList.add("isg-is-fresh"); this._later(() => dd.classList.remove("isg-is-fresh"), 2400); }
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("integrationsync", {
          bubbles: true, detail: { id: it.id, name: it.name, action, status: it.status, eventsAdded: added, eventsToday: it.events }
        }));
      }, action === "reconnect" ? 1700 : 1100 + hash(it.id) % 500);
    }

    _tickTimes() {
      this.querySelectorAll(".isg-ago").forEach(dd => { const t = num(dd.dataset.t); dd.textContent = this._ago(t); });
      if (this._open) { const it = this._get(this._open); if (it) this._fillDrawer(it); }
    }

    /* ---------- details drawer ---------- */
    _openDrawer(id, opener) {
      const it = this._get(id);
      if (!it) return;
      this._open = id;
      this._opener = opener || null;
      const $ = this.$;
      this._fillDrawer(it);
      $.scrim.hidden = false; $.drawer.hidden = false;
      // keep the drawer inside the part of the card that is on screen
      const box = $.root.getBoundingClientRect(), full = $.root.clientHeight, vh = window.innerHeight || full;
      const visTop = Math.max(0, -box.top), visBottom = Math.min(full, vh - box.top);
      let top = visTop, h = visBottom - visTop;
      if (h < 360) { h = Math.min(full, Math.max(360, vh)); top = Math.max(0, Math.min(visTop, full - h)); }
      $.drawer.style.top = top + "px";
      $.drawer.style.bottom = "auto";
      $.drawer.style.height = h + "px";
      $.main.inert = true;
      const show = () => { $.scrim.classList.add("isg-is-open"); $.drawer.classList.add("isg-is-open"); $.drTitle.focus({ preventScroll: true }); };
      if (reduceMotion()) show(); else requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(show));
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("integrationopen", { bubbles: true, detail: { id: it.id, name: it.name, status: it.status } }));
    }

    _closeDrawer(restore = true) {
      const $ = this.$;
      if (!this._open) return;
      this._open = null;
      $.main.inert = false;
      $.scrim.classList.remove("isg-is-open"); $.drawer.classList.remove("isg-is-open");
      const done = () => { if (!this._open) { $.scrim.hidden = true; $.drawer.hidden = true; } };
      if (reduceMotion()) done(); else this._later(done, 380);
      if (restore && this._opener && this._opener.isConnected) this._opener.focus();
      else if (restore && this._openId) { const b = this.$.grid.querySelector(`.isg-tile[data-id="${CSS.escape(this._openId)}"] .isg-det`); if (b) b.focus(); }
    }

    _fillDrawer(it) {
      const L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      this._openId = it.id;
      $.drGlyph.innerHTML = glyph(it.icon);
      $.drTitle.textContent = it.name;
      $.drLight.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--isg-${it.status === "connected" ? "ok" : it.status === "warning" ? "warn" : "bad"})`);
      $.drLight.lastElementChild.textContent = L[it.status];

      const body = [];
      if (it.issue) { const p = make("p", "isg-issue", it.issue); p.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--isg-${it.status === "warning" ? "warn" : "bad"})`); p.style.margin = "0"; body.push(p); }
      const sec1 = make("section", "isg-dr-sec");
      sec1.append(make("h4", null, L.connection));
      const facts = make("dl", "isg-dr-facts");
      const fact = (k, v, wide) => { const d = make("div", wide ? "isg-wide" : null); d.append(make("dt", null, k), make("dd", null, v)); facts.append(d); };
      if (it.account) fact(L.account, it.account, true);
      fact(L.lastSync, this._ago(it.lastSync));
      fact(L.events, this._int(it.events));
      if (it.interval) fact(L.interval, it.interval);
      if (it.since) fact(L.since, it.since);
      sec1.append(facts);
      body.push(sec1);
      if (it.scopes.length) {
        const sec = make("section", "isg-dr-sec");
        sec.append(make("h4", null, L.scopes));
        const ul = make("ul", "isg-scopes");
        it.scopes.forEach(s => { const li = make("li"); li.innerHTML = ICON_CHECK; li.append(make("span", null, s)); ul.append(li); });
        sec.append(ul);
        body.push(sec);
      }
      if (it.history.length) {
        const sec = make("section", "isg-dr-sec");
        sec.append(make("h4", null, L.recent));
        const ol = make("ol", "isg-hist");
        it.history.slice(0, 5).forEach((h, k) => {
          const li = make("li");
          if (k === 0 && this._lastHist === it.id + ":" + h.at && !reduceMotion()) li.classList.add("isg-is-enter");
          const dot = make("i"); dot.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--isg-${h.result === "ok" ? "ok" : "bad"})`);
          const txt = make("div");
          txt.append(make("b", null, h.note && h.result === "ok" ? h.note : h.result === "ok" ? L.syncOk : L.syncFail));
          const sub = h.result === "ok" ? (h.events ? fill(L.added, { n: this._int(h.events) }) : (h.events === 0 ? L.noEvents : "")) : h.note;
          if (sub) txt.append(make("small", null, sub));
          li.append(dot, txt, make("em", null, this._ago(h.at)));
          ol.append(li);
        });
        this._lastHist = null;
        sec.append(ol);
        body.push(sec);
      }
      $.drBody.replaceChildren(...body);

      const foot = [this._mainBtn(it, L)];
      if (it.status !== "disconnected") {
        const dis = make("button", "isg-btn isg-btn--ghost", L.disconnect);
        dis.type = "button"; dis.dataset.act = "disconnect"; dis.dataset.id = it.id;
        if (this._busy.has(it.id)) dis.disabled = true;
        foot.push(dis);
      }
      const keep = $.drFoot.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement.dataset.act : null;
      $.drFoot.replaceChildren(...foot);
      if (keep) { const t = $.drFoot.querySelector(".isg-btn"); if (t) t.focus(); }
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.filters.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".isg-filter");
        if (!b || b.dataset.filter === this.filter) return;
        this.filter = b.dataset.filter;
        const n = this.$.grid.hidden ? 0 : this.$.grid.children.length;
        $.live.textContent = fill(this._labels().announceFilter, { n });
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("filterchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { filter: this.filter, shown: n } }));
      });
      $.showAll.addEventListener("click", () => { this.filter = "all"; const b = $.filters.querySelector('[data-filter="all"]'); if (b) b.focus(); });
      $.syncAll.addEventListener("click", () => this.syncAll());
      const onAct = e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".isg-btn[data-act]");
        if (!b || b.disabled) return;
        const it = this._get(b.dataset.id);
        if (!it) return;
        if (b.dataset.act === "details") this._openDrawer(it.id, b);
        else if (b.dataset.act === "disconnect") {
          it.status = "disconnected"; it.fix = "reconnect"; it.issue = this._labels().disconnectedNote + ".";
          it.history.unshift({ at: Date.now(), result: "fail", note: this._labels().disconnectedNote });
          this._refresh(it);
          const r = $.drFoot.querySelector(".isg-btn"); if (r) r.focus();
        } else this._act(it, b.dataset.act);
      };
      $.grid.addEventListener("click", onAct);
      $.drFoot.addEventListener("click", onAct);
      $.close.addEventListener("click", () => this._closeDrawer());
      $.scrim.addEventListener("click", () => this._closeDrawer());
      $.drawer.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); this._closeDrawer(); return; }
        if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
        const f = [...$.drawer.querySelectorAll("button:not(:disabled), [tabindex='0']")].filter(x => x.offsetParent !== null);
        if (!f.length) return;
        const first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
        if (e.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || document.activeElement === $.drTitle)) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
        else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
      });
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("integration-status-grid")) customElements.define("integration-status-grid", IntegrationStatusGrid);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("isg-note");
  const ORIGINAL = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.data));
  document.getElementById("outage").addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.setStatus("payments", "disconnected", "The payment provider rejected the saved key.");
  });
  document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(ORIGINAL));
    el.filter = "all";
  });
  el.addEventListener("integrationsync", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = d.action === "reconnect" ? `${d.name} reconnected.` : `${d.name} synced, ${d.eventsAdded} new events.`;
    note.append(b, " The grid sent an integrationsync event. Syncs are simulated.");
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

  width: 100%; display: grid; place-items: start center; padding-top: 10px;
  border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), var(--tmp-pod-step));
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  font: 700 26px/1 var(--tmp-display); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}
.tmp-pod-col[data-place="1"] .tmp-step { height: 86px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.28), rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.06)); color: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.55); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.5); }
.tmp-pod-col[data-place="2"] .tmp-step { height: 60px; }
.tmp-pod-col[data-place="3"] .tmp-step { height: 42px; }

/* rank change chip */
.tmp-chg {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
  padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--tmp-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
  background: var(--tmp-tint); color: var(--tmp-faint);
}
.tmp-chg[data-dir="up"] { color: var(--tmp-good); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tmp-good) 11%, transparent); }
.tmp-chg[data-dir="down"] { color: var(--tmp-bad); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tmp-bad) 10%, transparent); }

/* detail (shared by podium and list) */
.tmp-pod-detail:empty { display: none; }
.tmp-detail {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px 26px;
  padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--tmp-raise); border: 1px solid var(--tmp-line);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -30px var(--tmp-shadow);
  animation: tmp-open .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
@keyframes tmp-open { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.tmp-d-title { margin: 0 0 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--tmp-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tmp-faint); }
.tmp-d-title b { color: var(--tmp-ink); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.tmp-spark { display: block; width: 100%; height: 86px; overflow: visible; }
.tmp-spark-area { fill: var(--tmp-purple-soft); }
.tmp-spark-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--tmp-purple); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.tmp-spark-wrap { position: relative; }
.tmp-dot { position: absolute; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin: -4px 0 0 -4px; border-radius: 50%; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--tmp-raise); border: 1.6px solid var(--tmp-purple); }
.tmp-dot.is-last { background: var(--tmp-gold); border-color: var(--tmp-gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--tmp-gold-soft); }
.tmp-spark-goal { stroke: var(--tmp-gold); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.tmp-axis { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 6px; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--tmp-mono); color: var(--tmp-faint); }
.tmp-axis span:last-child { color: var(--tmp-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.tmp-legend { margin: 8px 0 0; display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tmp-muted); }
.tmp-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.tmp-legend i { width: 14px; height: 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--tmp-purple); }
.tmp-legend i.is-goal { border-top: 2px dashed var(--tmp-gold); }
.tmp-goals { display: grid; gap: 12px; align-content: start; }
.tmp-goal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: baseline; font-size: 13px; }
.tmp-goal-name { color: var(--tmp-muted); }
.tmp-goal.is-active .tmp-goal-name { color: var(--tmp-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.tmp-goal-fig { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--tmp-muted); font-size: 12.5px; }
.tmp-goal-fig b { color: var(--tmp-ink); font-weight: 650; }
.tmp-goal-bar { grid-column: 1 / -1; position: relative; height: 7px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--tmp-tint); overflow: hidden; }
.tmp-goal-bar span {
  position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: calc(var(--p, 0) * 1%); border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--tmp-purple) 70%, transparent), var(--tmp-purple));
  animation: tmp-grow .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.tmp-goal.is-met .tmp-goal-bar span { background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--tmp-gold) 70%, transparent), var(--tmp-gold)); }
@keyframes tmp-grow { from { width: 0; } }

/* ---------- ranked list ---------- */
.tmp-cols, .tmp-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 34px 52px minmax(0, 1.6fr) repeat(4, minmax(0, .8fr)) 22px;
  column-gap: 12px; align-items: center;
}
.tmp-cols { padding: 0 14px; font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--tmp-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tmp-faint); }
.tmp-cols span { text-align: right; }
.tmp-cols span:nth-child(-n+3) { text-align: left; }
.tmp-cols span.is-active { color: var(--tmp-purple); }
.tmp-list { list-style: none; margin: -8px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.tmp-item { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.tmp-row {
  appearance: none; width: 100%; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; color: inherit;
  padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--tmp-line);
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.tmp-row:hover { background: var(--tmp-raise); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tmp-purple) 25%, var(--tmp-line)); }
.tmp-row[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--tmp-raise); border-color: var(--tmp-purple); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--tmp-purple-soft); }
.tmp-rank { font: 700 17px/1 var(--tmp-display); color: var(--tmp-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tmp-who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-width: 0; }
.tmp-who-text { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.tmp-name { font: 600 14.5px/1.2 var(--tmp-display); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.tmp-role { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tmp-faint); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.tmp-cell { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 5px; font: 500 14px/1 var(--tmp-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--tmp-muted); }
.tmp-cell.is-active { color: var(--tmp-ink); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--tmp-display); font-size: 15px; }
.tmp-meter { width: 100%; max-width: 86px; height: 4px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--tmp-tint); overflow: hidden; }
.tmp-meter span { display: block; height: 100%; width: calc(var(--p, 0) * 1%); border-radius: inherit; background: var(--tmp-purple); transition: width .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.tmp-cell:not(.is-active) .tmp-meter { visibility: hidden; }
.tmp-chev { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--tmp-faint); justify-self: end; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), color .2s; }
.tmp-row[aria-expanded="true"] .tmp-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--tmp-purple); }
.tmp-foot { margin: 0; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--tmp-line); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tmp-faint); }
.tmp-empty { margin: 0; padding: 26px; text-align: center; color: var(--tmp-faint); font-size: 13px; }
.tmp-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet: list shows the ranking metric only; the rest moves into the detail */
@container tmp (max-width: 759px) {
  .tmp { padding: 22px 20px 18px; }
  .tmp-podium { padding: 20px 14px 0; gap: 8px; }
  .tmp-pod-btn .tmp-av { --size: 52px; }
  .tmp-pod-col[data-place="1"] .tmp-av { --size: 64px; }
  .tmp-cols { display: none; }
  .tmp-list { margin-top: 0; }
  .tmp-row { grid-template-columns: 30px 50px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, auto) 18px; }
  .tmp-cell:not(.is-active) { display: none; }
  .tmp-cell.is-active { min-width: 86px; }
  .tmp-detail { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
/* phone: the podium becomes three stacked cards */
@container tmp (max-width: 519px) {
  .tmp { padding: 18px 14px 14px; gap: 16px; border-radius: 18px; }
  .tmp-head { align-items: stretch; }
  .tmp-head .tmp-seg { width: 100%; }
  .tmp-seg button { flex: 1 1 0; padding: 9px 6px; }
  .tmp-sortwrap { width: 100%; }
  .tmp-sortwrap .tmp-seg { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .tmp-podium { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 6px; padding: 10px; }
  .tmp-pod-col { order: 0 !important; }
  .tmp-step { display: none; }
  .tmp-pod-btn { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: "av name val" "av role chg"; justify-items: start; align-items: center; column-gap: 14px; row-gap: 4px; padding: 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); text-align: left; }
  .tmp-pod-btn .tmp-crown { display: none; }
  .tmp-pod-btn .tmp-av, .tmp-pod-col[data-place="1"] .tmp-av { grid-area: av; --size: 46px; }
  .tmp-pod-name { grid-area: name; margin: 0; }
  .tmp-pod-role { grid-area: role; }
  .tmp-pod-val, .tmp-pod-col[data-place="1"] .tmp-pod-val { grid-area: val; justify-self: end; margin: 0; font-size: 20px; }
  .tmp-pod-btn .tmp-chg { grid-area: chg; justify-self: end; }
  .tmp-row { grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, auto) 16px; column-gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; }
  .tmp-row .tmp-chg { display: none; }
  .tmp-row .tmp-av { --size: 34px; }
  .tmp-cell.is-active { min-width: 0; }
  .tmp-detail { padding: 14px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .tmp-detail, .tmp-goal-bar span { animation: none; }
  .tmp-seg button, .tmp-pod-btn, .tmp-row, .tmp-meter span, .tmp-chev { transition: none; }
}

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <team-performance> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    rankBy: "Rank by", period: "Period", deals: "Deals won", revenue: "Revenue", calls: "Calls", response: "Response time",
    dealsShort: "Deals", revenueShort: "Revenue", callsShort: "Calls", responseShort: "Response",
    rank: "#", member: "Member", min: "min", team: "Team", ofTarget: "{pct} of target",
    up: "Up {n} from {compare}", down: "Down {n} from {compare}", same: "Same rank as {compare}", fresh: "New",
    trend: "{metric} trend", target: "Target progress", goal: "Target", maxGoal: "≤ {v}",
    vs: "{delta} vs {compare}", rankChange: "▲▼ Rank change vs {compare}", empty: "No team members to show.",
    footResponse: "Response time is the average first reply to a new lead, in minutes. Lower is better.",
    open: "Show details for {name}", announce: "Ranked by {metric}, {period}. {name} leads with {value}."
  };
  const METRICS = ["deals", "revenue", "calls", "response"];
  const ICON_TROPHY = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 2.5h6v3.5a3 3 0 0 1-6 0V2.5Z"/><path d="M5 4H2.8a2 2 0 0 0 2.4 2.6M11 4h2.2a2 2 0 0 1-2.4 2.6M8 9v2.5M5.5 13.5h5"/></svg>';
  const ICON_CROWN = '<svg class="tmp-crown" viewBox="0 0 30 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 6.5 8.5 11 15 2l6.5 9L28 6.5 25.5 18h-21Z"/><circle cx="2" cy="5.5" r="2"/><circle cx="15" cy="2" r="2"/><circle cx="28" cy="5.5" r="2"/></svg>';
  const ICON_CHEV = '<svg class="tmp-chev" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4"/></svg>';

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="tmp">
      <header class="tmp-head">
        <div class="tmp-intro">
          <span class="tmp-eyebrow"></span>
          <h2 class="tmp-title"></h2>
          <p class="tmp-sub"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="tmp-seg tmp-period" role="group"></div>
      </header>
      <div class="tmp-sortbar">
        <div class="tmp-sortwrap"><span class="tmp-label tmp-rankby"></span><div class="tmp-seg tmp-metric" role="group"></div></div>
        <p class="tmp-team"></p>
      </div>
      <section class="tmp-podium"></section>
      <div class="tmp-pod-detail"></div>
      <div class="tmp-cols" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <ol class="tmp-list"></ol>
      <p class="tmp-foot"><span class="tmp-foot-a"></span><span class="tmp-foot-b"></span></p>
      <p class="tmp-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </article>`;

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const initials = name => String(name || "?").trim().split(/\s+/).map(w => w[0]).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).join("").toUpperCase();
  const hue = id => { let h = 0; for (const c of String(id)) h = (h * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) % 360; return h; };
  let uidCount = 0;

  class TeamPerformance extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["metric", "period"]; }

    constructor() { super(); this._uid = "tmp" + (++uidCount); this._open = null; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<team-performance>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        eyebrow: q(".tmp-eyebrow"), title: q(".tmp-title"), sub: q(".tmp-sub"), period: q(".tmp-period"),
        rankBy: q(".tmp-rankby"), metric: q(".tmp-metric"), team: q(".tmp-team"),
        podium: q(".tmp-podium"), podDetail: q(".tmp-pod-detail"), cols: q(".tmp-cols"), list: q(".tmp-list"),
        footA: q(".tmp-foot-a"), footB: q(".tmp-foot-b"), sr: q(".tmp-sr")
      };
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._render(false);
    }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._render(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; if (this._built) this._render(true); }
    get metric() { const m = this.getAttribute("metric") || (this._data && this._data.metric) || "revenue"; return METRICS.includes(m) ? m : "revenue"; }
    set metric(v) { this.setAttribute("metric", String(v)); }
    get period() {
      const keys = this._periodKeys();
      const p = this.getAttribute("period") || (this._data && this._data.period) || keys[0];
      return keys.includes(p) ? p : keys[0];
    }
    set period(v) { this.setAttribute("period", String(v)); }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _locale() { return (this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-US"; }
    _periodKeys() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      if (d.periods && typeof d.periods === "object") { const k = Object.keys(d.periods); if (k.length) return k; }
      const m = (d.members || [])[0];
      return m && m.periods ? Object.keys(m.periods) : ["week"];
    }
    _pinfo(key) { const p = ((this._data || {}).periods || {})[key] || {}; return { label: p.label || key, range: p.range || "", compare: p.compare || "", axis: Array.isArray(p.axis) ? p.axis : [] }; }

    _fmt(metric, v) {
      if (v == null) return "—";
      const L = this._labels();
      if (metric === "revenue") {
        try { return new Intl.NumberFormat(this._locale(), { style: "currency", currency: (this._data.currency || "USD"), maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(v); }
        catch (e) { return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(this._locale()); }
      }
      if (metric === "response") return `${Math.round(v).toLocaleString(this._locale())} ${L.min}`;
      return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(this._locale());
    }

    /* rank everyone for the current metric + period, and work out last period's rank too */
    _rows() {
      const d = this._data || {}, metric = this.metric, period = this.period, low = metric === "response";
      const rows = (Array.isArray(d.members) ? d.members : []).map((m, i) => {
        m = m || {};
        const p = (m.periods || {})[period] || {};
        const series = k => (Array.isArray(p[k]) ? p[k].map(num) : []);
        const s = {}; METRICS.forEach(k => { s[k] = series(k); });
        const cur = k => { const a = s[k]; return a.length ? a[a.length - 1] : null; };
        const prev = k => { const a = s[k]; return a.length > 1 ? a[a.length - 2] : null; };
        return {
          id: String(m.id || `m${i + 1}`), name: m.name || `Member ${i + 1}`, role: m.role || "",
          series: s, cur, prev, target: p.target || {}, value: cur(metric), prevValue: prev(metric)
        };
      });
      const cmp = (key, a, b) => {
        const x = key === "cur" ? a.value : a.prevValue, y = key === "cur" ? b.value : b.prevValue;
        if (x == null && y == null) return 0; if (x == null) return 1; if (y == null) return -1;
        if (x !== y) return low ? x - y : y - x;
        const rx = key === "cur" ? a.cur("revenue") : a.prev("revenue"), ry = key === "cur" ? b.cur("revenue") : b.prev("revenue");
        if ((rx || 0) !== (ry || 0)) return (ry || 0) - (rx || 0);
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      };
      [...rows].sort((a, b) => cmp("prev", a, b)).forEach((r, i) => { r.prevRank = r.prevValue == null ? null : i + 1; });
      rows.sort((a, b) => cmp("cur", a, b)).forEach((r, i) => { r.rank = i + 1; r.move = r.prevRank == null ? null : r.prevRank - r.rank; });
      return rows;
    }

    _render(animate) {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      const metric = this.metric, period = this.period, info = this._pinfo(period);
      const before = animate ? this._snap() : null;
      // remember which control had focus so it can be restored after the rebuild
      const ae = document.activeElement;
      const focusSel = ae && this.contains(ae)
        ? ["mid", "metric", "period"].map(k => (ae.dataset[k] != null ? `[data-${k}="${CSS.escape(ae.dataset[k])}"]` : null)).find(Boolean)
        : null;

      $.eyebrow.innerHTML = d.eyebrow ? ICON_TROPHY : "";
      if (d.eyebrow) $.eyebrow.append(d.eyebrow);
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.sub.textContent = [d.team, info.range].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      $.rankBy.textContent = L.rankBy;

      // period + metric switches
      $.period.setAttribute("aria-label", L.period);
      $.period.replaceChildren(...this._periodKeys().map(k => {
        const b = make("button", null, this._pinfo(k).label); b.type = "button"; b.dataset.period = k;
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(k === period)); return b;
      }));
      $.metric.setAttribute("aria-label", L.rankBy);
      $.metric.replaceChildren(...METRICS.map(k => {
        const b = make("button", null, L[k]); b.type = "button"; b.dataset.metric = k;
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(k === metric)); return b;
      }));

      const rows = this._rows();
      this._rowsCache = rows;
      if (this._open && !rows.some(r => r.id === this._open)) this._open = null;

      // team total for the ranking metric
      $.team.replaceChildren();
      const vals = rows.map(r => r.value).filter(v => v != null);
      if (vals.length) {
        const total = metric === "response" ? vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length : vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        const tg = rows.map(r => num(r.target[metric])).filter(v => v != null);
        $.team.append(make("span", null, `${L.team} ${metric === "response" ? "avg" : ""}`.trim()), make("b", null, this._fmt(metric, total)));
        if (tg.length === rows.length && metric !== "response") {
          const pct = total / tg.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          const chip = make("span", "tmp-team-pct", fill(L.ofTarget, { pct: Math.round(pct * 100) + "%" }));
          if (pct < 1) chip.dataset.tone = "low";
          $.team.append(chip);
        }
      }

      // podium
      const top = rows.slice(0, 3);
      $.podium.replaceChildren(...top.map(r => this._podCol(r, metric, info, L)));
      $.podium.hidden = !top.length;
      $.podDetail.replaceChildren();
      const openTop = top.find(r => r.id === this._open);
      if (openTop) $.podDetail.append(this._detail(openTop, metric, info, L));

      // list header
      $.cols.replaceChildren(...[L.rank, "", L.member, L.dealsShort, L.revenueShort, L.callsShort, L.responseShort, ""].map((t, i) => {
        const s = make("span", i >= 3 && i <= 6 && METRICS[i - 3] === metric ? "is-active" : null, t); return s;
      }));
      const rest = rows.slice(3);
      $.cols.hidden = !rest.length;
      const best = { };
      METRICS.forEach(k => {
        const v = rows.map(r => r.cur(k)).filter(x => x != null && x > 0);
        best[k] = v.length ? (k === "response" ? Math.min(...v) : Math.max(...v)) : null;
      });
      $.list.start = 4;
      $.list.replaceChildren(...rest.map(r => this._listItem(r, metric, info, L, best)));
      if (!rows.length) $.list.replaceChildren(make("li", "tmp-empty", L.empty));

      $.footA.textContent = metric === "response" ? L.footResponse : (d.footnote || "");
      $.footB.textContent = info.compare ? fill(L.rankChange, { compare: info.compare }) : "";

      if (focusSel) { const f = this.querySelector(focusSel); if (f) f.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
      if (animate) {
        this._flip(before);
        if (rows[0]) $.sr.textContent = fill(L.announce, { metric: L[metric].toLowerCase(), period: info.label.toLowerCase(), name: rows[0].name, value: this._fmt(metric, rows[0].value) });
      }
    }

    _chg(r, info, L) {
      const c = make("span", "tmp-chg");
      if (r.move == null) { c.textContent = L.fresh; return c; }
      c.dataset.dir = r.move > 0 ? "up" : r.move < 0 ? "down" : "same";
      c.textContent = r.move > 0 ? `▲ ${r.move}` : r.move < 0 ? `▼ ${-r.move}` : "–";
      c.title = fill(r.move > 0 ? L.up : r.move < 0 ? L.down : L.same, { n: Math.abs(r.move), compare: info.compare || "" });
      return c;
    }
    _av(r, cls) {
      const a = make("span", "tmp-av" + (cls ? " " + cls : ""), initials(r.name));
      a.style.setProperty("--h", hue(r.id));
      a.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      return a;
    }

    _podCol(r, metric, info, L) {
      const col = make("div", "tmp-pod-col");
      col.dataset.place = r.rank;
      const b = make("button", "tmp-pod-btn");
      b.type = "button"; b.dataset.mid = r.id;
      b.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(this._open === r.id));
      b.setAttribute("aria-controls", `${this._uid}-pod-detail`);
      b.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_CROWN);
      const av = this._av(r);
      av.append(make("span", "tmp-medal", String(r.rank)));
      const chg = this._chg(r, info, L);
      b.append(av, make("span", "tmp-pod-name", r.name), make("span", "tmp-pod-role", r.role), make("span", "tmp-pod-val", this._fmt(metric, r.value)), chg);
      b.setAttribute("aria-label", `${r.rank}. ${r.name}, ${L[metric]} ${this._fmt(metric, r.value)}. ${chg.title || chg.textContent}`);
      const step = make("div", "tmp-step", String(r.rank));
      step.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      col.append(b, step);
      this.$.podDetail.id = `${this._uid}-pod-detail`;
      return col;
    }

    _listItem(r, metric, info, L, best) {
      const li = make("li", "tmp-item");
      const b = make("button", "tmp-row");
      b.type = "button"; b.dataset.mid = r.id;
      const open = this._open === r.id;
      b.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      b.setAttribute("aria-controls", `${this._uid}-d-${r.id}`);
      const who = make("span", "tmp-who");
      const txt = make("span", "tmp-who-text");
      txt.append(make("span", "tmp-name", r.name), make("span", "tmp-role", r.role));
      who.append(this._av(r), txt);
      b.append(make("span", "tmp-rank", String(r.rank)), this._chg(r, info, L), who);
      METRICS.forEach(k => {
        const cell = make("span", "tmp-cell" + (k === metric ? " is-active" : ""));
        const v = r.cur(k);
        cell.append(make("span", "tmp-sr", L[k] + ": "), this._fmt(k, v));
        const meter = make("span", "tmp-meter"); const bar = make("span");
        const p = v == null || !best[k] ? 0 : k === "response" ? best[k] / v : v / best[k];
        bar.style.setProperty("--p", Math.max(2, Math.min(100, p * 100)).toFixed(1));
        meter.append(bar); meter.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        cell.append(meter);
        b.append(cell);
      });
      b.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_CHEV);
      li.append(b);
      if (open) { const det = this._detail(r, metric, info, L); det.id = `${this._uid}-d-${r.id}`; li.append(det); }
      return li;
    }

    _detail(r, metric, info, L) {
      const box = make("div", "tmp-detail");
      // trend
      const left = make("div");
      const series = r.series[metric].filter(v => v != null);
      const t = make("p", "tmp-d-title");
      t.append(make("span", null, fill(L.trend, { metric: L[metric] })));
      const diff = r.value != null && r.prevValue != null ? r.value - r.prevValue : null;
      if (diff != null) {
        const sign = diff > 0 ? "+" : diff < 0 ? "−" : "±";
        t.append(make("b", null, fill(L.vs, { delta: sign + this._fmt(metric, Math.abs(diff)), compare: info.compare })));
      }
      left.append(t);
      const goal = num(r.target[metric]);
      if (series.length > 1) {
        const W = 240, H = 70, pad = 6;
        const lo = Math.min(...series, goal ?? Infinity), hi = Math.max(...series, goal ?? -Infinity);
        const span = hi - lo || 1;
        const x = i => (i / (series.length - 1)) * W;
        const y = v => pad + (1 - (v - lo) / span) * (H - pad * 2);
        const pts = series.map((v, i) => `${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`);
        let svg = `<svg class="tmp-spark" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">`;
        svg += `<path class="tmp-spark-area" d="M0,${H} L${pts.join(" L")} L${W},${H} Z"/>`;
        if (goal != null) svg += `<line class="tmp-spark-goal" x1="0" x2="${W}" y1="${y(goal).toFixed(1)}" y2="${y(goal).toFixed(1)}"/>`;
        svg += `<polyline class="tmp-spark-line" points="${pts.join(" ")}"/>`;
        svg += `</svg>`;
        const wrap = make("div", "tmp-spark-wrap");
        wrap.innerHTML = svg;
        // dots as HTML so they stay round when the chart stretches (the chart is 86px tall)
        series.forEach((v, i) => {
          const dot = make("span", "tmp-dot" + (i === series.length - 1 ? " is-last" : ""));
          dot.style.left = (x(i) / W * 100).toFixed(2) + "%";
          dot.style.top = (y(v) / H * 86).toFixed(1) + "px";
          dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          wrap.append(dot);
        });
        left.append(wrap);
        const axis = make("div", "tmp-axis");
        axis.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const names = info.axis.length === series.length ? info.axis : series.map((_, i) => String(i + 1));
        names.forEach(n => axis.append(make("span", null, n)));
        left.append(axis);
        const leg = make("p", "tmp-legend");
        const a = make("span"); a.append(make("i"), L[metric]);
        leg.append(a);
        if (goal != null) { const g = make("span"); const gi = make("i", "is-goal"); g.append(gi, `${L.goal} ${metric === "response" ? fill(L.maxGoal, { v: this._fmt(metric, goal) }) : this._fmt(metric, goal)}`); leg.append(g); }
        left.append(leg);
        left.append(make("p", "tmp-sr", `${fill(L.trend, { metric: L[metric] })}: ` + series.map((v, i) => `${names[i]} ${this._fmt(metric, v)}`).join(", ") + "."));
      }
      // targets
      const right = make("div", "tmp-goals");
      const th = make("p", "tmp-d-title"); th.append(make("span", null, L.target), make("b", null, info.label));
      th.style.margin = "0";
      right.append(th);
      METRICS.forEach(k => {
        const v = r.cur(k), g = num(r.target[k]);
        if (g == null || v == null) return;
        const low = k === "response";
        const p = low ? (v <= 0 ? 1 : Math.min(1, g / v)) : Math.min(1, v / g);
        const met = low ? v <= g : v >= g;
        const row = make("div", "tmp-goal" + (k === metric ? " is-active" : "") + (met ? " is-met" : ""));
        const fig = make("span", "tmp-goal-fig");
        fig.append(make("b", null, this._fmt(k, v)), ` / ${low ? fill(L.maxGoal, { v: this._fmt(k, g) }) : this._fmt(k, g)}`);
        if (!low) fig.append(` · ${Math.round(v / g * 100)}%`);
        const bar = make("span", "tmp-goal-bar"); const fillEl = make("span");
        fillEl.style.setProperty("--p", (p * 100).toFixed(1));
        bar.append(fillEl); bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        row.append(make("span", "tmp-goal-name", L[k]), fig, bar);
        right.append(row);
      });
      box.append(left, right);
      return box;
    }

    _snap() {
      const m = new Map();
      this.querySelectorAll("[data-mid]").forEach(el => m.set(el.dataset.mid, el.getBoundingClientRect()));
      return m;
    }
    _flip(before) {
      if (!before || reduceMotion() || !("animate" in Element.prototype)) return;
      this.querySelectorAll("[data-mid]").forEach((el, i) => {
        const a = before.get(el.dataset.mid);
        const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!a) { el.animate([{ opacity: 0, transform: "translateY(8px)" }, { opacity: 1, transform: "none" }], { duration: 360, delay: i * 25, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)", fill: "backwards" }); return; }
        const dx = a.left - b.left, dy = a.top - b.top;
        if (Math.abs(dx) < 1 && Math.abs(dy) < 1) return;
        el.animate([{ transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)` }, { transform: "none" }], { duration: 480, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" });
      });
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.period.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button[data-period]");
        if (!b || b.dataset.period === this.period) return;
        this.period = b.dataset.period;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("periodchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { period: this.period } }));
      });
      $.metric.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button[data-metric]");
        if (!b || b.dataset.metric === this.metric) return;
        this.metric = b.dataset.metric;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("sortchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { metric: this.metric, period: this.period } }));
      });
      this.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".tmp-pod-btn, .tmp-row");
        if (!b || !this.contains(b)) return;
        const id = b.dataset.mid;
        this._open = this._open === id ? null : id;
        this._render(false);
        const r = (this._rowsCache || []).find(x => x.id === id);
        if (r) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("memberselect", {
          bubbles: true,
          detail: { id, name: r.name, rank: r.rank, metric: this.metric, period: this.period, value: r.value, expanded: this._open === id }
        }));
      });
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("team-performance")) customElements.define("team-performance", TeamPerformance);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("tmp-note");
  const full = el.data;
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".seg button");
  buttons.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const n = +b.dataset.value;
    el.data = Object.assign({}, full, { members: (full.members || []).slice(0, n) });
    buttons.forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x === b)));
  }));

  el.addEventListener("memberselect", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = `${d.name} · #${d.rank}`;
    note.append(b, ` ${d.expanded ? "opened" : "closed"}. The card sent a memberselect event. Fictional team, not real results.`);
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

/* =========================================================

revenue-goal-tracker {
  display: block;

}

.rgt button:focus-visible, .rgt input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rgt-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

.rgt-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.rgt-eyebrow svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

.rgt-eyebrow:empty, .rgt-title:empty { display: none; }
.rgt-period {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex: none;
  padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-card) 70%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--rgt-line);
  font: 500 12.5px/1 var(--rgt-sans); color: var(--rgt-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}
.rgt-period b { color: var(--rgt-ink); font-weight: 650; }
.rgt-period i { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--rgt-faint); opacity: .6; }

/* hero figures */
.rgt-hero { margin-top: 24px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.rgt-raised { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }

.rgt-raised-of { font-size: 14px; color: var(--rgt-muted); }
.rgt-raised-of b { color: var(--rgt-ink); font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rgt-pct { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 6px; }
.rgt-pct-v { font: 650 clamp(30px, 5cqi, 42px)/1 var(--rgt-display); letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--rgt-accent-ink); }
.rgt-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 650 11.5px/1 var(--rgt-sans); white-space: nowrap;

}
.rgt-pill::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

.rgt-pill[data-tone="done"] { color: var(--rgt-on-accent); background: var(--rgt-accent); }

/* meter */
.rgt-meter { position: relative; margin-top: 46px; padding-bottom: 44px; }
.rgt-track {
  position: relative; height: 22px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--rgt-track);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-shadow) 60%, transparent);
}
.rgt-fill {
  position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 0; border-radius: inherit; overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rgt-accent-2), var(--rgt-accent) 70%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-accent), #1E1B4B 25%));
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -8px var(--rgt-accent), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  transition: width .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1);
}

  transform: translateX(-100%);
  animation: rgt-shine 3.6s ease-in-out 1.2s infinite;
}
@keyframes rgt-shine { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%); } 55%, 100% { transform: translateX(100%); } }
.rgt-ms { position: absolute; top: 0; height: 22px; width: 0; }
.rgt-ms-dot {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: -8px 0 0 -8px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid; place-items: center; box-sizing: border-box;
  background: var(--rgt-card); border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-faint) 55%, var(--rgt-track));
  color: transparent; transition: background .35s, border-color .35s, color .35s, transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.rgt-ms-dot svg { width: 9px; height: 9px; }
.rgt-ms.rgt-is-hit .rgt-ms-dot { background: var(--rgt-card); border-color: var(--rgt-card); color: var(--rgt-accent); transform: scale(1.12); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -2px var(--rgt-shadow); }
.rgt-ms-l { position: absolute; top: 34px; left: 0; transform: translateX(-50%); display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 3px; white-space: nowrap; }
.rgt-ms:last-child .rgt-ms-l { transform: translateX(-100%); justify-items: end; }
.rgt-ms-l b { font: 650 12px/1 var(--rgt-sans); color: var(--rgt-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rgt-ms-l span { font: 500 11px/1 var(--rgt-mono); color: var(--rgt-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rgt-ms.rgt-is-hit .rgt-ms-l b { color: var(--rgt-accent-ink); }
.rgt-ms.rgt-is-next .rgt-ms-dot { border-color: var(--rgt-accent); animation: rgt-pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes rgt-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--rgt-accent-soft); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--rgt-accent-soft); } }
.rgt-pace { position: absolute; bottom: 100%; top: -30px; width: 0; transition: left .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.rgt-pace::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -1px; top: 20px; bottom: -22px; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--rgt-ink); opacity: .7; }
.rgt-pace span {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; transform: translateX(-50%);
  padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--rgt-ink); color: var(--rgt-card);
  font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--rgt-mono); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.rgt-caption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 13px; color: var(--rgt-muted); }
.rgt-caption b { color: var(--rgt-ink); font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rgt-confetti { position: absolute; inset: -40px 0 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: visible; z-index: 3; }
.rgt-bit { position: absolute; top: 40px; width: 8px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; opacity: 0; }

/* lower grid */
.rgt-grid { margin-top: 22px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.08fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; }
.rgt-box {
  min-width: 0; padding: 18px 18px 16px; border-radius: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-raise) 88%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--rgt-line);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.rgt-box-h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0 0 14px; }
.rgt-box-h h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--rgt-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rgt-faint); }

/* run-rate */
.rgt-rates { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.rgt-rate { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.rgt-rate-l { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--rgt-muted); }
.rgt-rate-bar { height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--rgt-track); overflow: hidden; }
.rgt-rate-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--rgt-accent); transition: width .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.rgt-rate--need .rgt-rate-bar i { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rgt-ink) 0 3px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-ink) 60%, transparent) 3px 6px); opacity: .55; }
.rgt-rate-v { font: 650 15px/1 var(--rgt-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; min-width: 82px; }
.rgt-rate-v small { font: 500 11px/1 var(--rgt-sans); color: var(--rgt-faint); }
.rgt-verdict { margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--rgt-tint); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--rgt-muted); }
.rgt-verdict b { color: var(--rgt-ink); font-weight: 650; }
.rgt-stats { margin: auto 0 0; padding-top: 14px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.rgt-stat { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rgt-line); }
.rgt-stat dt { font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--rgt-mono); letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rgt-faint); }
.rgt-stat dd { margin: 0; font: 650 18px/1.1 var(--rgt-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.rgt-stat dd small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font: 500 11.5px/1.2 var(--rgt-sans); color: var(--rgt-faint); letter-spacing: 0; }

/* log a sale */
.rgt-form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr) auto; gap: 8px; align-items: end; }
.rgt-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }

  transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.rgt-input:focus-within { border-color: var(--rgt-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--rgt-accent-soft); }

.rgt-input span { padding-left: 11px; font: 600 14px/1 var(--rgt-sans); color: var(--rgt-faint); }
.rgt-input input {
  appearance: none; -moz-appearance: textfield; width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
  border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 11px;
  font: 500 14px/1 var(--rgt-sans); color: var(--rgt-ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.rgt-add {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 11px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rgt-accent); background: var(--rgt-accent); color: var(--rgt-on-accent);
  font: 650 13.5px/1 var(--rgt-sans);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -12px var(--rgt-accent);
  transition: background .2s, transform .15s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.rgt-add:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-accent), #000 12%); }
.rgt-add:active { transform: scale(.97); }
.rgt-add svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.rgt-quick { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.rgt-chip {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--rgt-accent) 45%, var(--rgt-line)); background: transparent;

}
.rgt-chip:hover { background: var(--rgt-accent-soft); border-style: solid; }
.rgt-err { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--rgt-bad); }
.rgt-err:empty { display: none; }

.rgt-recent-h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 16px 0 6px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rgt-line); }
.rgt-recent-h h4 { margin: 0; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--rgt-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rgt-faint); }
.rgt-undo {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; border: 0; background: none; padding: 5px 6px; border-radius: 7px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;

  transition: background .2s, color .2s;
}
.rgt-undo svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

.rgt-sales { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; }
.rgt-sale { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 2px 12px; align-items: baseline; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--rgt-line); }

/* toast */
.rgt-toast {
  position: absolute; top: 18px; left: 50%; z-index: 5;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 10px 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--rgt-ink); color: var(--rgt-card);

  .rgt-toast { left: 16px; right: 16px; max-width: none; transform: translateY(-12px); }
  .rgt-toast.rgt-is-show { transform: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

}

(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("rgt-note");
  const original = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.data));
  el.addEventListener("goalprogress", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = `${d.kind === "undo" ? "Undone" : "Sale logged"} · ${d.pct}% of goal.`;
    note.append(b, " The tracker sent a goalprogress event. Example data, fictional clients.");
  });
  document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => { el.data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original)); });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <webhook-monitor> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {

  const FIRST = ["Ava", "Noah", "Mia", "Liam", "Zoe", "Ethan", "Ruby", "Owen", "Isla", "Leo"];
  const LAST = ["Thompson", "Nguyen", "Patel", "Garcia", "Okafor", "Kim", "Rossi", "Murphy", "Silva", "Novak"];
  const SVG = p => `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${p}</svg>`;
  const ICON = {
