  };

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <div class="wem">
      <header class="wem-top">
        <div class="wem-title">
          <span class="wem-logo">${ICON.hook}</span>
          <div class="wem-title-text"><h2 class="wem-name"></h2><p class="wem-endpoint"><span class="wem-env"></span><span class="wem-base"></span></p></div>
        </div>
        <div class="wem-live">
          <span class="wem-state"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="wem-state-t"></span></span>
          <button type="button" class="wem-btn wem-toggle"></button>
        </div>
      </header>
      <dl class="wem-stats">
        <div class="wem-stat"><dt>Deliveries</dt><dd class="wem-s-total"></dd></div>
        <div class="wem-stat"><dt>Success rate</dt><dd class="wem-s-rate"></dd></div>
        <div class="wem-stat"><dt>p95 latency</dt><dd class="wem-s-p95"></dd></div>
        <div class="wem-stat"><dt>Failed</dt><dd class="wem-s-fail"></dd></div>
      </dl>
      <div class="wem-filters">
        <div class="wem-chips" role="group" aria-label="Filter by status">
          <button type="button" class="wem-chip" data-cls="all" aria-pressed="true">All <b></b></button>
          <button type="button" class="wem-chip" data-cls="2xx" aria-pressed="false">2xx <b></b></button>
          <button type="button" class="wem-chip" data-cls="4xx" aria-pressed="false">4xx <b></b></button>
          <button type="button" class="wem-chip" data-cls="5xx" aria-pressed="false">5xx <b></b></button>
        </div>
        <label class="wem-search">${ICON.search}<input type="search" placeholder="Filter by event name" aria-label="Filter by event name" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>
      </div>
      <div class="wem-main">
        <div class="wem-stream">
          <div class="wem-scroll">
            <table class="wem-table">
              <caption class="wem-sr">Webhook deliveries, newest first</caption>
              <thead><tr>
                <th scope="col" class="wem-c-time">Time</th><th scope="col" class="wem-c-event">Event</th>
                <th scope="col" class="wem-c-path">Method · endpoint</th><th scope="col" class="wem-c-status">Status</th><th scope="col" class="wem-c-lat">Latency</th>
              </tr></thead>
              <tbody></tbody>
            </table>
            <p class="wem-empty" hidden></p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="wem-ins" aria-label="Delivery details">
          <div class="wem-ins-head">
            <div class="wem-ins-title"><span class="wem-code wem-ins-code"></span><h3 class="wem-ins-name"></h3></div>
            <span class="wem-ins-id"></span>
          </div>
          <dl class="wem-ins-meta"></dl>
          <div class="wem-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Delivery details">
            <button type="button" class="wem-tab" role="tab" data-tab="payload">Payload</button>
            <button type="button" class="wem-tab" role="tab" data-tab="headers">Headers<b></b></button>
            <button type="button" class="wem-tab" role="tab" data-tab="response">Response</button>
          </div>
          <div class="wem-panel" role="tabpanel" tabindex="0"><pre class="wem-pre"></pre></div>
          <div class="wem-ins-actions">
            <button type="button" class="wem-btn wem-btn--primary wem-replay">${ICON.replay}<span>Replay</span></button>
            <button type="button" class="wem-btn wem-copy">${ICON.copy}<span>Copy payload</span></button>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p class="wem-sr wem-live-region" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>`;

  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  const clsOf = s => (s >= 500 ? "5xx" : s >= 400 ? "4xx" : "2xx");
  const mulberry = seed => () => { seed |= 0; seed = (seed + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
  let uid = 0;

  class WebhookMonitor extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["paused", "interval"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) { this._schedule(); return; }
      this._uid = "wem" + (++uid);
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<webhook-monitor>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      if (reduceMotion() && !this.hasAttribute("paused")) this.setAttribute("paused", "");
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        card: q(".wem"), name: q(".wem-name"), env: q(".wem-env"), base: q(".wem-base"), stateT: q(".wem-state-t"), toggle: q(".wem-toggle"),
        sTotal: q(".wem-s-total"), sRate: q(".wem-s-rate"), sP95: q(".wem-s-p95"), sFail: q(".wem-s-fail"),
        chips: q(".wem-chips"), search: q(".wem-search input"), scroll: q(".wem-scroll"), tbody: q(".wem-table tbody"), empty: q(".wem-empty"),
        ins: q(".wem-ins"), insCode: q(".wem-ins-code"), insName: q(".wem-ins-name"), insId: q(".wem-ins-id"), insMeta: q(".wem-ins-meta"),
        tabs: q(".wem-tabs"), panel: q(".wem-panel"), pre: q(".wem-pre"), replay: q(".wem-replay"), copy: q(".wem-copy"), live: q(".wem-live-region")
      };
      const panelId = this._uid + "-panel";
      this.$.panel.id = panelId;
      this.$.tabs.querySelectorAll(".wem-tab").forEach((t, i) => { t.id = `${this._uid}-tab-${i}`; t.setAttribute("aria-controls", panelId); });
      this._filter = "all"; this._query = ""; this._tab = "payload";
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._reset();
      this._schedule();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { clearTimeout(this._timer); this._timer = null; clearTimeout(this._copyTimer); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      if (name === "paused") { this._renderLive(); this._schedule(); }
      else this._schedule();
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; if (this._built) { this._reset(); this._schedule(); } }
    get events() { return this._events.slice(); }
    get paused() { return this.hasAttribute("paused"); }
    pause() { if (!this.paused) { this.setAttribute("paused", ""); this._emitStream(); } }
    resume() { if (this.paused) { this.removeAttribute("paused"); this._emitStream(); } }

    /* Add a delivery (real or simulated). Returns the stored event. */
    addEvent(e) {
      if (!this._built) return null;
      const ev = this._normalise(e || {});
      ev.born = Date.now();
      this._events.unshift(ev);
      const max = Math.max(10, +this._data.max || 60);
      if (this._events.length > max) this._events.length = max;
      if (!this._selected) this._selected = ev;
      this._renderAll();
      return ev;
    }

    select(id) {
      const ev = this._events.find(x => x.id === id); if (!ev) return;
      this._selected = ev;
      this._renderRows(); this._renderInspector();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("eventselect", { bubbles: true, detail: { id: ev.id, name: ev.name, status: ev.status } }));
    }

    replay(id) {
      const orig = this._events.find(x => x.id === id) || (this._selected && this._selected.id === id ? this._selected : null);
      if (!orig) return null;
      const r = this._rnd;
      const transient = orig.status >= 500 || orig.status === 429;
      const status = transient ? 200 : orig.status;
      const ev = this.addEvent({
        name: orig.name, method: orig.method, path: orig.path, payload: orig.payload, account: orig.account,
        status, latency: Math.round(status < 300 ? 40 + r() * r() * 380 : 20 + r() * 160),
        replayOf: orig.id, attempt: (orig.attempt || 1) + 1
      });
      this._selected = ev;
      this._renderRows(); this._renderInspector();
      this._say(`Replayed ${orig.name}. New delivery returned ${status} ${STATUS_TEXT[status] || ""}.`);
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("webhookreplay", { bubbles: true, detail: { original: { id: orig.id, status: orig.status }, replay: { id: ev.id, status: ev.status, latency: ev.latency }, name: orig.name } }));
      return ev;
    }

    /* internals */
    _reset() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      this._rnd = mulberry(+d.seed || 2041);
      this._seq = 0;
      this._events = [];
      this._selected = null;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (Array.isArray(d.events) && d.events.length) {
        d.events.slice().reverse().forEach(e => this._events.unshift(this._normalise(e)));
      } else if (d.simulate !== false) {
        const n = Math.max(0, Math.min(+d.initial || 18, 60));
        let t = now - 1500;
        const seeded = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { seeded.push(this._generate(new Date(t))); t -= Math.round(6000 + this._rnd() * 22000); }
        this._events = seeded;
      }
      this._selected = this._events.find(e => e.status >= 500) || this._events[0] || null;
      this.$.name.textContent = d.title || "Webhook events";
      this.$.env.textContent = d.environment || "Live";
      this.$.env.hidden = !d.environment;
      this.$.base.textContent = d.endpoint || "";
      this._renderLive();
      this._renderAll();
    }

    _id(prefix, len) { let s = ""; for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) s += "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"[Math.floor(this._rnd() * 36)]; return prefix + s; }
    _pick(a) { return a[Math.floor(this._rnd() * a.length)]; }

    _generate(at, force) {
      const r = this._rnd, d = this._data || {};
      const accounts = Array.isArray(d.accounts) && d.accounts.length ? d.accounts : ["Brightside Dental"];
      const account = this._pick(accounts);
      const person = `${this._pick(FIRST)} ${this._pick(LAST)}`;
      const email = person.toLowerCase().replace(" ", ".") + "@example.com";
      const iso = at.toISOString();
      const kinds = [
        ["contact.created", "POST", "/hooks/crm/contacts", () => ({ contact: { id: this._id("con_", 8), name: person, email, source: this._pick(["Website form", "Social lead form", "Chat widget"]), tags: ["new-lead"] } })],
        ["form.submitted", "POST", "/hooks/forms/submissions", () => ({ form: { id: this._id("frm_", 6), name: this._pick(["Free consultation", "Get a quote", "Book a tour"]) }, fields: { name: person, email, consent: true }, page: "/offers/fall" })],
        ["appointment.booked", "POST", "/hooks/calendar/appointments", () => ({ appointment: { id: this._id("apt_", 8), type: "Discovery call", starts_at: new Date(at.getTime() + (2 + Math.floor(r() * 5)) * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 16) + "Z", duration_minutes: 30, contact: { name: person, email } } })],
        ["invoice.paid", "POST", "/hooks/payments/invoices", () => ({ invoice: { id: this._id("inv_", 8), number: `INV-${1040 + Math.floor(r() * 60)}`, amount: Math.round(450 + r() * 2400) * 1, currency: "USD", paid_at: iso } })],
        ["payment.failed", "POST", "/hooks/payments/charges", () => ({ charge: { id: this._id("ch_", 10), amount: Math.round(99 + r() * 900), currency: "USD", failure_code: this._pick(["card_declined", "insufficient_funds", "expired_card"]) }, retry_scheduled: true })],
        ["message.received", "POST", "/hooks/inbox/messages", () => ({ message: { id: this._id("msg_", 8), channel: this._pick(["SMS", "Email", "Web chat"]), from: person, preview: this._pick(["Is the offer still on?", "Can I move my booking?", "Thanks, see you Tuesday!"]) } })],
        ["opportunity.updated", "PUT", "/hooks/crm/opportunities", () => { const st = ["New", "Qualified", "Proposal", "Won"], i = Math.floor(r() * 3); return { opportunity: { id: this._id("opp_", 8), name: `${account} · retainer`, stage: { from: st[i], to: st[i + 1] }, value: Math.round(1200 + r() * 6000) } }; }],
        ["contact.deleted", "DELETE", "/hooks/crm/contacts", () => ({ contact: { id: this._id("con_", 8) }, reason: "Unsubscribed" })]
      ];
      const weights = [22, 20, 14, 12, 7, 14, 8, 3];
      let roll = r() * weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), k = 0;

      else if (s < 0.92) status = this._pick([400, 401, 404, 409, 422, 429]);

    _normalise(e) {

      if (payload.account === undefined) delete payload.account;
      return {
        id, name: String(e.name || "event"), method: String(e.method || "POST").toUpperCase(), path: String(e.path || "/"),
        status, latency: Math.max(0, Math.round(+e.latency || 0)), at: isNaN(at) ? new Date() : at,
        account, payload, attempt: e.attempt || 1, replayOf: e.replayOf || null,
        response: e.response || this._response(status), headers: e.headers || null, seq: ++this._seq

    }

    _response(status) {
      const bodies = {

        400: { error: "bad_request", message: "Payload is missing data.id" },
        401: { error: "invalid_signature", message: "Signature header did not match the shared secret" },
        404: { error: "not_found", message: "No handler is registered for this path" },
        409: { error: "duplicate", message: "This event id was already processed" },
        422: { error: "validation_failed", field: "data.contact.email" },
        429: { error: "rate_limited", retry_after_seconds: 30 },
        500: { error: "internal_error", message: "Handler threw an exception" },
        502: { error: "bad_gateway", message: "Upstream app server returned an invalid response" },
        503: { error: "unavailable", message: "Receiver is in maintenance mode" },
        504: { error: "timeout", message: "No response within 10 seconds" }

    _headers(ev) {
      if (ev.headers) return ev.headers;
      // derive a stable fake signature from the id so it doesn't change between renders
      let h = 2166136261; for (const c of ev.id) { h ^= c.charCodeAt(0); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); }
      const rnd = mulberry(h >>> 0); let sig = "";
      for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) sig += "0123456789abcdef"[Math.floor(rnd() * 16)];
      const out = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "User-Agent": "LofiStack-Webhooks/2.4",
        "X-Webhook-Id": ev.id,
        "X-Webhook-Event": ev.name,
        "X-Webhook-Timestamp": String(Math.floor(ev.at.getTime() / 1000)),
        "X-Webhook-Signature": `sha256=${sig}`,

    _schedule() {
      clearTimeout(this._timer); this._timer = null;
      if (!this._built || this.paused || (this._data && this._data.simulate === false) || !this.isConnected) return;
      const base = Math.max(600, +this.getAttribute("interval") || +this._data.interval || 2400);
      const wait = Math.round(base * (0.6 + this._rnd() * 0.8));

        this._schedule();

    }

    /* Add one simulated failing delivery right away (used by the demo). */
    simulateFailure() { const ev = this.addEvent(this._generate(new Date(), "fail")); return ev; }

    _emitStream() { this._say(this.paused ? "Live updates paused." : "Live updates resumed."); this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("streamchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { paused: this.paused } })); }
    _say(t) { this.$.live.textContent = ""; requestAnimationFrame(() => { this.$.live.textContent = t; }); }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.toggle.addEventListener("click", () => (this.paused ? this.resume() : this.pause()));
      $.chips.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const c = e.target.closest(".wem-chip"); if (!c) return;
        this._filter = c.dataset.cls; this._renderAll();
      });
      $.search.addEventListener("input", () => { this._query = $.search.value.trim().toLowerCase(); this._renderAll(); });
      $.tbody.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const tr = e.target.closest(".wem-row"); if (!tr) return;
        this.select(tr.dataset.id);
        if (!e.target.closest(".wem-row-btn")) { const b = tr.querySelector(".wem-row-btn"); if (b) b.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
      });
      $.tbody.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key !== "ArrowDown" && e.key !== "ArrowUp" && e.key !== "Home" && e.key !== "End") return;
        const btns = [...$.tbody.querySelectorAll(".wem-row-btn")];
        const i = btns.indexOf(document.activeElement); if (i < 0) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const n = e.key === "Home" ? 0 : e.key === "End" ? btns.length - 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(btns.length - 1, i + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1)));

      });
      $.tabs.addEventListener("click", e => { const t = e.target.closest(".wem-tab"); if (t) { this._tab = t.dataset.tab; this._renderInspector(); } });
      $.tabs.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const tabs = [...$.tabs.querySelectorAll(".wem-tab")], i = tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement);
        if (i < 0 || (e.key !== "ArrowRight" && e.key !== "ArrowLeft")) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const n = (i + (e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1) + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        tabs[n].focus(); this._tab = tabs[n].dataset.tab; this._renderInspector();

      $.insMeta.addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest(".wem-link"); if (b && !b.disabled) this.select(b.dataset.id); });
      $.replay.addEventListener("click", () => { if (this._selected) this.replay(this._selected.id); });
      $.copy.addEventListener("click", () => this._copyPayload());
    }

    _visible() {
      return this._events.filter(e => (this._filter === "all" || clsOf(e.status) === this._filter) && (!this._query || e.name.toLowerCase().includes(this._query) || e.id.toLowerCase().includes(this._query)));
    }

    _renderLive() {
      const $ = this.$, p = this.paused;
      $.card.classList.toggle("is-live", !p);
      $.stateT.textContent = p ? "Paused" : "Live";
      $.toggle.replaceChildren();

      $.sTotal.textContent = n.toLocaleString("en-US");
      const rate = n ? ok / n * 100 : 0;
      $.sRate.replaceChildren(n ? (rate === 100 ? "100" : rate.toFixed(1)) : "—", make("small", null, n ? "%" : ""));
      $.sRate.dataset.tone = !n ? "" : rate >= 95 ? "ok" : rate >= 85 ? "warn" : "err";
      const lats = all.map(e => e.latency).sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const p95 = lats.length ? lats[Math.min(lats.length - 1, Math.ceil(lats.length * 0.95) - 1)] : 0;
      $.sP95.replaceChildren(lats.length ? (p95 >= 1000 ? (p95 / 1000).toFixed(1) : String(p95)) : "—", make("small", null, lats.length ? (p95 >= 1000 ? "s" : "ms") : ""));
      $.sP95.dataset.tone = p95 >= 3000 ? "err" : p95 >= 1000 ? "warn" : "";

      $.sFail.dataset.tone = fail ? "err" : "ok";
      // chip counts respect the search box
      const base = this._events.filter(e => !this._query || e.name.toLowerCase().includes(this._query) || e.id.toLowerCase().includes(this._query));
      const count = { all: base.length, "2xx": 0, "4xx": 0, "5xx": 0 };

    _time(d) { return `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`; }
    _lat(ms) { return ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(ms >= 10000 ? 0 : 1)} s` : `${ms} ms`; }

    _renderRows() {

      const focusedId = document.activeElement && $.tbody.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement.closest(".wem-row").dataset.id : null;

      $.tbody.replaceChildren(...rows.map(ev => {

        if (ev.born && Date.now() - ev.born < 1200 && !reduceMotion()) tr.classList.add("is-new");

        const tP = make("td", "wem-c-path"); tP.append(make("span", "wem-method", ev.method), ev.path); tP.title = `${ev.method} ${ev.path}`;

      $.empty.textContent = this._events.length ? "No deliveries match these filters." : "Waiting for the first delivery…";
      if (focusedId) { const b = $.tbody.querySelector(`[data-id="${focusedId}"] .wem-row-btn`); if (b) b.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }

    _renderInspector() {

        $.insCode.textContent = ""; $.insCode.hidden = true;
        $.insName.textContent = "No delivery selected"; $.insId.textContent = "";

      $.insCode.hidden = false; $.insCode.textContent = String(ev.status); $.insCode.dataset.cls = cls;

      $.insId.textContent = ev.id;

        ["Delivered", `${ev.at.getFullYear()}-${pad(ev.at.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(ev.at.getDate())} ${this._time(ev.at)}`],
        ["Request", `${ev.method} ${ev.path}`],

      $.pre.replaceChildren();

    _json(v, depth, host) {
      const ind = n => "  ".repeat(n);
      if (v === null) return host.append(make("span", "wem-j-lit", "null"));
      if (typeof v === "boolean") return host.append(make("span", "wem-j-lit", String(v)));
      if (typeof v === "number") return host.append(make("span", "wem-j-num", String(v)));
      if (typeof v === "string") return host.append(make("span", "wem-j-str", JSON.stringify(v)));

        if (!keys.length) return host.append(make("span", "wem-j-p", "{}"));
        host.append(make("span", "wem-j-p", "{"), "\n");
        keys.forEach((k, i) => {
          host.append(ind(depth + 1), make("span", "wem-j-key", JSON.stringify(k)), make("span", "wem-j-p", ": "));
          this._json(v[k], depth + 1, host);
          host.append(make("span", "wem-j-p", i < keys.length - 1 ? "," : ""), "\n");
        });
        return host.append(ind(depth), make("span", "wem-j-p", "}"));

    _copyPayload() {
      const ev = this._selected; if (!ev) return;
      const text = JSON.stringify(ev.payload, null, 2), $ = this.$;

        clearTimeout(this._copyTimer);
        this._copyTimer = setTimeout(() => { $.copy.classList.remove("is-done"); $.copy.querySelector("span").textContent = "Copy payload"; }, 1600);
      };
      const select = () => {
        if (this._tab !== "payload") { this._tab = "payload"; this._renderInspector(); }
        const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents($.pre);
        const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);

      catch (e) { select(); }
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("webhook-monitor")) customElements.define("webhook-monitor", WebhookMonitor);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b"); b.textContent = strong;
    note.append(b, " " + rest);
  };
  document.getElementById("add-failure").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const ev = el.simulateFailure();
    el.select(ev.id);

  });

    const d = e.detail;
    say(`Replayed ${d.name}: ${d.original.status} → ${d.replay.status}.`, "The monitor sent a webhookreplay event. Simulated events, not real traffic.");
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>

  --aua-mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}

/* =========================================================
   AI Usage Analytics component  (copy this block + the script)
   ========================================================= */
ai-usage-analytics {
  display: block;
  container: aua / inline-size;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 980px;
  font-family: var(--aua-sans);
  color: var(--aua-ink);
}
.aua {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 290px;
  background: var(--aua-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--aua-line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -46px var(--aua-shadow), 0 2px 6px -4px var(--aua-shadow);
}
.aua-main { padding: 24px 26px 20px; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 18px; align-content: start; }

/* header + filters */
.aua-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.aua-intro { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.aua-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 11px/1 var(--aua-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--aua-lilac); }
.aua-eyebrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.aua-title { margin: 0; font: 650 clamp(19px, 3cqi, 24px)/1.15 var(--aua-display); letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-wrap: balance; }
.aua-title:empty, .aua-eyebrow-text:empty, .aua-foot:empty { display: none; }
.aua-filters { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.aua-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--aua-tint); border: 1px solid var(--aua-line); }
.aua-seg button {
  appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--aua-sans); color: var(--aua-muted);
  transition: background .2s, color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.aua-seg button:hover { color: var(--aua-ink); }
.aua-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--aua-card); color: var(--aua-lilac); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-lilac) 35%, transparent), 0 4px 10px -6px var(--aua-shadow); }
.aua-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--aua-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* kpis */
.aua-kpis { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; }
.aua-kpi { margin: 0; min-width: 0; padding: 0 16px; display: grid; gap: 5px; align-content: start; }
.aua-kpi:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.aua-kpi + .aua-kpi { border-left: 1px solid var(--aua-line); }
.aua-kpi dt { font: 600 10.5px/1.2 var(--aua-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--aua-faint); }
.aua-kpi dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
.aua-kv { font: 650 clamp(22px, 3.4cqi, 28px)/1.05 var(--aua-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.aua-ks { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--aua-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* legend */
.aua-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.aua-leg {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 7px 11px 7px 9px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--aua-line); background: var(--aua-card);
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--aua-sans); color: var(--aua-ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  transition: opacity .25s, border-color .2s, background .2s;
}
.aua-leg:hover { border-color: var(--aua-axis); }
.aua-leg i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--c); flex: none; }
.aua-leg span { font-weight: 500; color: var(--aua-muted); }
.aua-leg[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--aua-lilac-soft); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-lilac) 45%, transparent); }
.aua-legend.is-isolated .aua-leg[aria-pressed="false"] { opacity: .5; }
.aua-leg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--aua-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.aua-legend-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; }
.aua-c-by { margin-top: 6px; }
.aua-hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--aua-faint); align-self: center; margin-left: 4px; }

/* chart */
.aua-plot { position: relative; outline: none; border-radius: 12px; touch-action: pan-y; }
.aua-plot:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--aua-focus); }
.aua-svg { display: block; width: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.aua-grid line { stroke: var(--aua-grid); stroke-width: 1; shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
.aua-grid line.is-base { stroke: var(--aua-axis); }
.aua-ylab, .aua-xlab { font: 500 11px var(--aua-sans); fill: var(--aua-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.aua-xlab.is-active { fill: var(--aua-ink); font-weight: 650; }
.aua-col { transition: opacity .2s; }
.aua-cols.has-active .aua-col:not(.is-active) { opacity: .4; }
.aua-col .aua-hit { fill: transparent; }
.aua-col.is-active .aua-hit { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-lilac) 7%, transparent); }
.aua-col.is-weekend .aua-hit { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-tint) 70%, transparent); }
.aua-col.is-weekend.is-active .aua-hit { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-lilac) 9%, transparent); }
.aua-bars { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.aua.is-pending .aua-bars { transform: scaleY(0); }
.aua.is-anim .aua-bars { animation: aua-grow .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 14ms); }
@keyframes aua-grow { from { transform: scaleY(0); } to { transform: scaleY(1); } }

.aua-tip {
  position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 0; left: 0; pointer-events: none;
  min-width: 170px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--aua-tip); color: var(--aua-tip-ink);
  font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 32px -16px var(--aua-shadow);
  opacity: 0; translate: 0 4px; transition: opacity .15s, translate .15s;
}
.aua-tip.is-on { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; }
.aua-tip strong { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.aua-tip-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.aua-tip-row i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 2px; }
.aua-tip-row b { font-weight: 600; }
.aua-tip-tot { margin-top: 5px; padding-top: 5px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-tip-ink) 22%, transparent); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-weight: 650; }

.aua-foot { font-size: 12px; color: var(--aua-faint); }

/* charcoal side panel */
.aua-side {
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 60% at 100% 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-ring) 16%, transparent), transparent 60%),
    var(--aua-panel);
  color: var(--aua-panel-ink);
  padding: 24px 22px 22px;
  display: grid; gap: 18px; align-content: start;
  --aua-c1: var(--aua-pc1); --aua-c2: var(--aua-pc2); --aua-c3: var(--aua-pc3);
}
.aua-block { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.aua-block + .aua-block { padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--aua-panel-line); }
.aua-bh { margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font: 600 10.5px/1.2 var(--aua-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--aua-panel-muted); }
.aua-bh .aua-q-reset { font: 500 12px/1 var(--aua-sans); letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }

.aua-quota { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; align-items: center; }
.aua-ring { position: relative; width: 112px; height: 112px; }
.aua-ring svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.aua-ring circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 12; }
.aua-ring .aua-r-track { stroke: var(--aua-ring-track); }
.aua-ring .aua-r-proj { stroke: var(--aua-ring); opacity: .32; transition: stroke-dasharray .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.aua-ring .aua-r-used { stroke: var(--aua-ring); stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dasharray .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.aua-ring-c { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-content: center; text-align: center; gap: 3px; }
.aua-ring-c b { font: 650 26px/1 var(--aua-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.aua-ring-c span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--aua-panel-muted); }
.aua-qfacts { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 9px; font-size: 12.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.aua-qfacts div { display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.aua-qfacts dt { color: var(--aua-panel-muted); }
.aua-qfacts dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; }
.aua-qfacts dd small { font-weight: 500; color: var(--aua-panel-muted); font-size: 12px; }

.aua-cost-big { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.aua-cost-big b { font: 650 30px/1 var(--aua-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.aua-cost-big span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--aua-panel-muted); }
.aua-budget { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--aua-panel-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.aua-budget-bar { position: relative; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--aua-ring-track); overflow: hidden; }
.aua-budget-bar i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 4px; transition: width .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.aua-budget-bar .aua-bb-proj { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-mint) 55%, transparent) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); }
.aua-budget-bar .aua-bb-now { background: var(--aua-mint); }
.aua-budget[data-over="true"] .aua-bb-now { background: var(--aua-warn); }
.aua-budget[data-over="true"] .aua-bb-proj { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--aua-warn) 60%, transparent) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); }
.aua-budget-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.aua-budget-row b { color: var(--aua-panel-ink); font-weight: 600; }
.aua-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--aua-mint); }
.aua-budget[data-over="true"] .aua-status { color: var(--aua-warn); }
.aua-status svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
.aua-models { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.aua-model { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 4px 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.aua-model i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--c); }
.aua-model b { font-weight: 600; }
.aua-model small { grid-column: 2 / -1; color: var(--aua-panel-muted); font-size: 11.5px; }
.aua-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet: side panel moves under the chart, ring and cost side by side */
@container aua (max-width: 779px) {
  .aua { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .aua-main { padding: 22px 20px 18px; }
  .aua-side { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0 24px; padding: 22px 20px; }
  .aua-block + .aua-block { padding-top: 0; border-top: 0; padding-left: 24px; border-left: 1px solid var(--aua-panel-line); }
}
/* phone */
@container aua (max-width: 519px) {
  .aua { border-radius: 18px; }
  .aua-main { padding: 18px 14px 16px; gap: 16px; }
  .aua-filters, .aua-seg { width: 100%; }
  .aua-seg button { flex: 1; padding: 8px 6px; }
  .aua-kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); row-gap: 12px; }
  .aua-kpi:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 1 / -1; padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--aua-line); }
  .aua-hint { flex-basis: 100%; margin: 2px 0 0; }
  .aua-side { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 20px 14px; gap: 18px; }
  .aua-block + .aua-block { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--aua-panel-line); }
  .aua-quota { grid-template-columns: 108px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .aua-ring { width: 108px; height: 108px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .aua-seg button, .aua-leg, .aua-col, .aua-tip, .aua-ring .aua-r-proj, .aua-ring .aua-r-used, .aua-budget-bar i { transition: none; }
  .aua.is-anim .aua-bars { animation: none; }
  .aua.is-pending .aua-bars { transform: none; }
}

}
.shell { max-width: 1040px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 44px 20px 72px; display: grid; gap: 28px; }
.intro { display: grid; gap: 10px; }

.fields-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.fields { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <ai-usage-analytics> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    metricGroup: "Measure", rangeGroup: "Date range",
    tokens: "Tokens", requests: "Requests", cost: "Cost",
    range14: "14D", range30: "30D",
    kTotal: "Total · {n} days", kAvg: "Daily average", kPeak: "Peak day",
    weekdayAvg: "weekdays {v}", isolated: "{name} only",
    hint: "Select a model to show it alone",
    chart: "Daily {metric} by model, last {n} days. Use the left and right arrow keys to step through days.",
    total: "Total", day: "Day",
    quota: "Monthly token quota", through: "to {date}", resets: "Resets {date}", daysLeft: "{n} days left",
    used: "Used", projected: "Forecast", ofQuota: "of quota", leftLabel: "Left this month", days: "{n} days",
    ofTokens: "of quota",
    costHead: "Cost estimate", mtd: "month to date", projectedCost: "Projected {v}",
    budget: "Budget {v}", under: "Under budget", over: "Over budget",
    byModel: "By model, this month", perM: "{v} per 1M tokens",
    noData: "No usage in this range."
  };
  const METRICS = ["tokens", "requests", "cost"];
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const SPARK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 1.5 9.4 6.6 14.5 8 9.4 9.4 8 14.5 6.6 9.4 1.5 8 6.6 6.6z"/></svg>';
  const OK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5.6"/><path d="M4.6 7.2 6.3 8.8 9.4 5.4"/></svg>';
  const WARN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 1.8 12.8 12H1.2z"/><path d="M7 5.6v2.8M7 10.2v.1"/></svg>';
  const GAP = 2;

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? 0 : Math.max(0, +v));
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const svg = (tag, attrs) => { const n = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); if (attrs) for (const k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const parseDay = s => { const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(s || "")); return m ? new Date(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]) : null; };
  const addDays = (d, n) => { const x = new Date(d); x.setDate(x.getDate() + n); return x; };
  const sameDay = (a, b) => a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();
  function niceMax(v) {
    if (!(v > 0)) return { max: 1, step: 0.25 };
    const raw = v / 4, mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)));
    const step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(s => s * mag).find(s => s >= raw) || 10 * mag;
    return { max: step * Math.ceil(v / step), step };
  }

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <article class="aua">
      <div class="aua-main">
        <header class="aua-head">
          <div class="aua-intro">
            <span class="aua-eyebrow">${SPARK}<span class="aua-eyebrow-text"></span></span>
            <h2 class="aua-title"></h2>
          </div>
          <div class="aua-filters">
            <div class="aua-seg aua-seg-metric" role="group"></div>
            <div class="aua-seg aua-seg-range" role="group"></div>
          </div>
        </header>
        <dl class="aua-kpis"></dl>
        <div class="aua-legend-row">
          <ul class="aua-legend"></ul>
          <span class="aua-hint"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="aua-plot" tabindex="0" role="group">
          <svg class="aua-svg" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
          <div class="aua-tip" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        </div>
        <table class="aua-sr aua-table"></table>
        <p class="aua-foot"></p>
      </div>
      <aside class="aua-side">
        <section class="aua-block">
          <h3 class="aua-bh"><span class="aua-q-head"></span><span class="aua-q-reset"></span></h3>
          <div class="aua-quota">
            <div class="aua-ring">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 124 124" aria-hidden="true">
                <circle class="aua-r-track" cx="62" cy="62" r="52"></circle>
                <circle class="aua-r-proj" cx="62" cy="62" r="52"></circle>
                <circle class="aua-r-used" cx="62" cy="62" r="52"></circle>
              </svg>
              <div class="aua-ring-c"><b class="aua-q-pct"></b><span class="aua-q-sub"></span></div>
            </div>
            <dl class="aua-qfacts"></dl>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section class="aua-block">
          <h3 class="aua-bh"><span class="aua-c-head"></span></h3>
          <div class="aua-cost-big"><b class="aua-c-mtd"></b><span class="aua-c-mtd-l"></span></div>
          <div class="aua-budget">
            <div class="aua-budget-bar" aria-hidden="true"><i class="aua-bb-proj"></i><i class="aua-bb-now"></i></div>
            <div class="aua-budget-row"><span class="aua-c-proj"></span><span class="aua-status"></span></div>
          </div>
          <h4 class="aua-bh aua-c-by"></h4>
          <ul class="aua-models"></ul>
        </section>
      </aside>
      <p class="aua-sr aua-live" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </article>`;

  class AiUsageAnalytics extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["metric", "range", "model"]; }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<ai-usage-analytics>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        card: q(".aua"), eyebrow: q(".aua-eyebrow-text"), title: q(".aua-title"),
        segM: q(".aua-seg-metric"), segR: q(".aua-seg-range"), kpis: q(".aua-kpis"),
        legend: q(".aua-legend"), hint: q(".aua-hint"), plot: q(".aua-plot"), svg: q(".aua-svg"), tip: q(".aua-tip"),
        table: q(".aua-table"), foot: q(".aua-foot"),
        qHead: q(".aua-q-head"), qReset: q(".aua-q-reset"), rUsed: q(".aua-r-used"), rProj: q(".aua-r-proj"),
        qPct: q(".aua-q-pct"), qSub: q(".aua-q-sub"), qFacts: q(".aua-qfacts"),
        cHead: q(".aua-c-head"), cMtd: q(".aua-c-mtd"), cMtdL: q(".aua-c-mtd-l"), budget: q(".aua-budget"),
        bbProj: q(".aua-bb-proj"), bbNow: q(".aua-bb-now"), cProj: q(".aua-c-proj"), status: q(".aua-status"),
        cBy: q(".aua-c-by"), models: q(".aua-models"), live: q(".aua-live")
      };
      METRICS.forEach(m => this.$.segM.append(this._segBtn("metric", m)));
      ["14", "30"].forEach(r => this.$.segR.append(this._segBtn("range", r)));
      this._active = null;
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._render(false);
      if ("ResizeObserver" in window) {
        this._ro = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
          const nw = Math.round(entries[0].contentRect.width);
          if (nw && Math.abs(nw - (this._lastW || 0)) > 1) this._chart(false);
        });
        this._ro.observe(this.$.plot);
      }
      this._reveal();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      if (this._ro) { this._ro.disconnect(); this._ro = null; }
      if (this._io) { this._io.disconnect(); this._io = null; this.$.card.classList.remove("is-pending"); }
      clearTimeout(this._animT);
      this._built = false;
    }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._render(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; if (this._built) this._render(true); }

    get metric() { const m = (this.getAttribute("metric") || (this._data && this._data.metric) || "").toLowerCase(); return METRICS.includes(m) ? m : "tokens"; }
    set metric(v) { this.setAttribute("metric", METRICS.includes(v) ? v : "tokens"); }
    get range() { return String(this.getAttribute("range") || (this._data && this._data.range) || "30") === "14" ? 14 : 30; }
    set range(v) { this.setAttribute("range", String(v) === "14" ? "14" : "30"); }
    get model() { const m = this.getAttribute("model") || ""; return (this._models || []).some(x => x.id === m) ? m : null; }
    set model(v) { if (v) this.setAttribute("model", v); else this.removeAttribute("model"); }

    isolate(id) {
      const next = id && id !== this.model ? id : null;
      this.model = next;
      this._emit();
    }

    replay() { if (this._built && !reduceMotion()) this._chart(true); }

    _emit() { this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("usagefilter", { bubbles: true, detail: { metric: this.metric, range: this.range, model: this.model } })); }

    _segBtn(kind, value) {
      const b = make("button");
      b.type = "button"; b.dataset[kind] = value;
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (kind === "metric") { if (value === this.metric) return; this.metric = value; }
        else { if (+value === this.range) return; this.range = value; }
        this._emit();
      });
      return b;
    }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _locale() { return (this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-US"; }
    _money(v, dp = 2) {
      try { return new Intl.NumberFormat(this._locale(), { style: "currency", currency: (this._data.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(), minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp }).format(v); }
      catch (e) { return "$" + v.toFixed(dp); }
    }
    _compact(v, dp = 1) { return new Intl.NumberFormat(this._locale(), { notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: dp }).format(v); }
    _fmt(metric, v, short) {
      if (metric === "cost") return short && v >= 1000 ? "$" + this._compact(v) : this._money(v, v >= 100 && short ? 0 : 2);
      if (metric === "tokens") return this._compact(v, v >= 1e8 ? 0 : 1);
      return short ? this._compact(v) : Math.round(v).toLocaleString(this._locale());
    }
    _date(d, o) { try { return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(this._locale(), o || { month: "short", day: "numeric" }).format(d); } catch (e) { return d.toDateString(); } }

    /* normalise: days[], per model per metric arrays */
    _prepare() {
      const d = this._data || {};
      const models = (Array.isArray(d.models) ? d.models : []).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3).map((m, i) => ({
        id: String(m.id || `model-${i + 1}`), label: m.label || `Model ${i + 1}`, price: num(m.pricePerMillion), slot: i + 1
      }));
      const series = d.series || {};
      const len = Math.max(0, ...models.map(m => Math.max(((series[m.id] || {}).tokens || []).length, ((series[m.id] || {}).requests || []).length)));
      let start = parseDay(d.start);
      const asOf = parseDay(d.asOf);
      if (!start && asOf) start = addDays(asOf, -(len - 1));
      if (!start) start = addDays(new Date(), -(len - 1));
      const days = Array.from({ length: len }, (_, i) => addDays(start, i));
      models.forEach(m => {
        const s = series[m.id] || {};
        m.tokens = days.map((_, i) => num((s.tokens || [])[i]));
        m.requests = days.map((_, i) => num((s.requests || [])[i]));
        m.cost = m.tokens.map(t => t / 1e6 * m.price);
      });
      this._models = models;
      this._days = days;
    }

    _render(animate) {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      this._prepare();
      $.eyebrow.textContent = d.eyebrow || "";
      $.title.textContent = d.title || "";
      $.foot.textContent = d.source || "";
      $.segM.setAttribute("aria-label", L.metricGroup);
      $.segR.setAttribute("aria-label", L.rangeGroup);
      $.segM.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => { b.textContent = L[b.dataset.metric]; b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.metric === this.metric)); });
      $.segR.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => { b.textContent = L["range" + b.dataset.range]; b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(+b.dataset.range === this.range)); });
      $.hint.textContent = L.hint;
      this._legendAndKpis();
      this._chart(animate);
      this._side();
    }

    _window() {
      const n = Math.min(this.range, this._days.length);
      const from = this._days.length - n;
      return { n, from, days: this._days.slice(from) };
    }
    _visible() { const id = this.model; return this._models.filter(m => !id || m.id === id); }

    _legendAndKpis() {
      const L = this._labels(), metric = this.metric, w = this._window(), iso = this.model;
      const sumRange = m => m[metric].slice(w.from).reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0);
      this.$.legend.classList.toggle("is-isolated", !!iso);
      this.$.legend.replaceChildren(...this._models.map(m => {
        const li = make("li");
        const b = make("button", "aua-leg");
        b.type = "button";
        b.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--aua-c${m.slot})`);
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(iso === m.id));
        const sw = make("i"); sw.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        b.append(sw, m.label, make("span", null, this._fmt(metric, sumRange(m), true)));
        b.addEventListener("click", () => this.isolate(m.id));
        li.append(b);
        return li;
      }));

      const vis = this._visible();
      const totals = w.days.map((_, i) => vis.reduce((a, m) => a + m[metric][w.from + i], 0));
      const total = totals.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0);
      const avg = w.n ? total / w.n : 0;
      const wk = totals.filter((_, i) => { const g = w.days[i].getDay(); return g !== 0 && g !== 6; });
      const wkAvg = wk.length ? wk.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0) / wk.length : 0;
      let peak = -1; totals.forEach((v, i) => { if (peak < 0 || v > totals[peak]) peak = i; });
      const kpi = (k, v, s) => { const x = make("div", "aua-kpi"); x.append(make("dt", null, k), make("dd", "aua-kv", v), make("dd", "aua-ks", s)); return x; };
      const isoM = iso && this._models.find(m => m.id === iso);
      this.$.kpis.replaceChildren(
        kpi(fill(L.kTotal, { n: w.n }), this._fmt(metric, total), isoM ? fill(L.isolated, { name: isoM.label }) : L[metric]),
        kpi(L.kAvg, this._fmt(metric, avg), fill(L.weekdayAvg, { v: this._fmt(metric, wkAvg) })),
        kpi(L.kPeak, peak >= 0 ? this._fmt(metric, totals[peak]) : "—", peak >= 0 ? this._date(w.days[peak], { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" }) : "")
      );
      this._totals = totals;
    }

    _chart(animate) {
      if (!this._models) return;
      const L = this._labels(), metric = this.metric, w = this._window(), vis = this._visible();
      const plot = this.$.plot, s = this.$.svg;
      const W = Math.max(260, Math.round(plot.clientWidth || 640));
      this._lastW = Math.round(plot.clientWidth || 0);
      const H = W < 420 ? 210 : 250;
      const pad = { l: 44, r: 6, t: 12, b: 26 };
      const pw = W - pad.l - pad.r, ph = H - pad.t - pad.b;
      s.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
      s.setAttribute("width", W); s.setAttribute("height", H);
      const totals = w.days.map((_, i) => vis.reduce((a, m) => a + m[metric][w.from + i], 0));
      const { max, step } = niceMax(Math.max(0, ...totals));
      const y = v => pad.t + ph - v / max * ph;
      const band = w.n ? pw / w.n : pw;
      const bw = Math.max(3, Math.min(24, band * 0.64));
      this._geom = { pad, band, W, H, from: w.from, n: w.n };

      const grid = svg("g", { class: "aua-grid" });
      for (let v = 0; v <= max + step / 2; v += step) {
        const yy = Math.round(y(v)) + 0.5;
        grid.append(svg("line", { x1: pad.l, x2: W - pad.r, y1: yy, y2: yy, class: v === 0 ? "is-base" : "" }));
        const t = svg("text", { x: pad.l - 8, y: yy + 4, "text-anchor": "end", class: "aua-ylab" });
        t.textContent = v === 0 ? "0" : this._fmt(metric, v, true);
        grid.append(t);
      }
      const cols = svg("g", { class: "aua-cols" });
      const labelEvery = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(w.n / Math.max(2, Math.floor(pw / 58))));
      const xl = svg("g");
      w.days.forEach((day, i) => {
        const cx = pad.l + band * i + band / 2;
        const g = svg("g", { class: "aua-col" });
        g.dataset.i = i;
        g.style.setProperty("--i", i);
        const wd = day.getDay();
        if (wd === 0 || wd === 6) g.classList.add("is-weekend");
        g.append(svg("rect", { class: "aua-hit", x: (pad.l + band * i + 0.5).toFixed(2), y: pad.t, width: Math.max(1, band - 1).toFixed(2), height: ph, rx: 4 }));
        const bars = svg("g", { class: "aua-bars" });
        let acc = 0;
        const parts = vis.map(m => ({ m, v: m[metric][w.from + i] })).filter(p => p.v > 0);
        parts.forEach((p, k) => {
          const y0 = y(acc), y1 = y(acc + p.v);
          acc += p.v;
          const top = k === parts.length - 1;
          const yTop = top ? y1 : y1 + GAP;
          const h = y0 - yTop;
          if (h <= 0.4) return;
          const x0 = cx - bw / 2;
          const r = top ? Math.min(4, bw / 2, h) : 0;
          const dpath = r
            ? `M${x0} ${y0}V${yTop + r}Q${x0} ${yTop} ${x0 + r} ${yTop}H${x0 + bw - r}Q${x0 + bw} ${yTop} ${x0 + bw} ${yTop + r}V${y0}Z`
            : `M${x0} ${y0}V${yTop}H${x0 + bw}V${y0}Z`;
          bars.append(svg("path", { d: dpath, fill: `var(--aua-c${p.m.slot})` }));
        });
        g.append(bars);
        cols.append(g);
        if (i % labelEvery === (w.n - 1) % labelEvery) {
          const t = svg("text", { x: cx, y: H - 8, "text-anchor": "middle", class: "aua-xlab" });
          t.dataset.i = i;
          t.textContent = this._date(day);
          xl.append(t);
        }
      });
      s.replaceChildren(grid, cols, xl);
      plot.setAttribute("aria-label", fill(L.chart, { metric: L[metric].toLowerCase(), n: w.n }));
      if (this._active != null && this._active >= w.n) this._active = null;
      this._paintActive(false);
      this._table(w, vis, metric);

      if (animate && !reduceMotion()) {
        const card = this.$.card;
        card.classList.remove("is-anim"); void card.offsetWidth; card.classList.add("is-anim");
        clearTimeout(this._animT);
        this._animT = setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove("is-anim"), 500 + w.n * 14 + 60);
      }
    }

    _table(w, vis, metric) {
      const L = this._labels(), t = this.$.table;
      const cap = make("caption", null, fill(L.chart, { metric: L[metric].toLowerCase(), n: w.n }).split(".")[0]);
      const head = make("tr");
      head.append(make("th", null, L.day), ...vis.map(m => make("th", null, m.label)), make("th", null, L.total));
      const rows = w.days.map((d, i) => {
        const tr = make("tr");
        const th = make("th", null, this._date(d, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" }));
        th.scope = "row";
        tr.append(th, ...vis.map(m => make("td", null, this._fmt(metric, m[metric][w.from + i]))), make("td", null, this._fmt(metric, vis.reduce((a, m) => a + m[metric][w.from + i], 0))));
        return tr;
      });
      const thead = make("thead"); thead.append(head);
      const tbody = make("tbody"); tbody.append(...rows);
      t.replaceChildren(cap, thead, tbody);
    }

    _paintActive(announce) {
      const i = this._active, cols = this.$.svg.querySelector(".aua-cols");
      if (!cols) return;
      cols.classList.toggle("has-active", i != null);
      cols.querySelectorAll(".aua-col").forEach(g => g.classList.toggle("is-active", +g.dataset.i === i));
      this.$.svg.querySelectorAll(".aua-xlab").forEach(t => t.classList.toggle("is-active", +t.dataset.i === i));
      if (i == null) { this.$.tip.classList.remove("is-on"); return; }
      const L = this._labels(), metric = this.metric, g = this._geom, vis = this._visible();
      const day = this._days[g.from + i];
      const tip = this.$.tip;
      const rows = vis.slice().reverse().map(m => {
        const r = make("div", "aua-tip-row");
        const sw = make("i"); sw.style.background = `var(--aua-c${m.slot})`;
        r.append(sw, make("span", null, m.label), make("b", null, this._fmt(metric, m[metric][g.from + i])));
        return r;
      });
      const total = vis.reduce((a, m) => a + m[metric][g.from + i], 0);
      const tot = make("div", "aua-tip-tot");
      tot.append(make("span", null, L.total), make("span", null, this._fmt(metric, total)));
      tip.replaceChildren(make("strong", null, this._date(day, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" })), ...rows);
      if (vis.length > 1) tip.append(tot);
      // position above the column, kept inside the plot
      const scale = (this.$.plot.clientWidth || g.W) / g.W;
      const cx = (g.pad.l + g.band * i + g.band / 2) * scale;
      const tw = tip.offsetWidth || 180, pw = this.$.plot.clientWidth || g.W;
      let left = cx + 14;
      if (left + tw > pw) left = cx - tw - 14;
      tip.style.left = Math.max(0, left) + "px";
      tip.style.top = (g.pad.t * scale + 4) + "px";
      tip.classList.add("is-on");
      if (announce) {
        this.$.live.textContent = `${this._date(day, { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric" })}: ` +
          vis.map(m => `${m.label} ${this._fmt(metric, m[metric][g.from + i])}`).join(", ") + (vis.length > 1 ? `. ${L.total} ${this._fmt(metric, total)}.` : ".");
      }
    }

    _wire() {
      const plot = this.$.plot;
      const idxAt = e => {
        const g = this._geom; if (!g || !g.n) return null;
        const r = plot.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = (e.clientX - r.left) / (r.width / g.W);
        const i = Math.floor((x - g.pad.l) / g.band);
        return i >= 0 && i < g.n ? i : null;
      };
      plot.addEventListener("pointermove", e => { const i = idxAt(e); if (i !== this._active) { this._active = i; this._paintActive(false); } });
      plot.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { const i = idxAt(e); this._active = i; this._paintActive(false); });
      plot.addEventListener("pointerleave", e => { if (e.pointerType === "touch") return; if (document.activeElement !== plot) { this._active = null; this._paintActive(false); } });
      plot.addEventListener("focus", () => { if (this._active == null && this._geom) { this._active = this._geom.n - 1; this._paintActive(true); } });
      plot.addEventListener("blur", () => { this._active = null; this._paintActive(false); });
      plot.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const g = this._geom; if (!g || !g.n) return;
        let i = this._active == null ? g.n - 1 : this._active;
        if (e.key === "ArrowRight") i = Math.min(g.n - 1, i + 1);
        else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") i = Math.max(0, i - 1);
        else if (e.key === "Home") i = 0;
        else if (e.key === "End") i = g.n - 1;
        else if (e.key === "Escape") { this._active = null; this._paintActive(false); return; }
        else return;
        e.preventDefault();
        this._active = i;
        this._paintActive(true);
      });
    }

    _side() {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      const asOf = this._days.length ? this._days[this._days.length - 1] : new Date();
      const bStart = parseDay(d.billingStart) || new Date(asOf.getFullYear(), asOf.getMonth(), 1);
      const bEnd = new Date(bStart.getFullYear(), bStart.getMonth() + 1, bStart.getDate());
      const monthDays = Math.round((bEnd - bStart) / 864e5);
      const idx = this._days.map((day, i) => (day >= bStart && day < bEnd ? i : -1)).filter(i => i >= 0);
      const elapsed = Math.max(1, Math.round((asOf - bStart) / 864e5) + 1);
      const left = Math.max(0, monthDays - elapsed);
      const sum = (m, k) => idx.reduce((a, i) => a + m[k][i], 0);
      const usedTok = this._models.reduce((a, m) => a + sum(m, "tokens"), 0);
      const projTok = usedTok / elapsed * monthDays;
      const quota = num(d.quota);

      // quota ring
      $.qHead.textContent = L.quota;
      $.qReset.textContent = fill(L.resets, { date: this._date(bEnd) });
      const C = 2 * Math.PI * 52;
      const usedR = quota > 0 ? Math.min(1, usedTok / quota) : 0;
      const projR = quota > 0 ? Math.min(1, projTok / quota) : 0;
      $.rUsed.style.strokeDasharray = `${(usedR * C).toFixed(1)} ${C.toFixed(1)}`;
      $.rProj.style.strokeDasharray = `${(projR * C).toFixed(1)} ${C.toFixed(1)}`;
      $.qPct.textContent = quota > 0 ? Math.round(usedTok / quota * 100) + "%" : "—";
      $.qSub.textContent = L.ofTokens;
      const fact = (k, v, sm) => { const x = make("div"); const dd = make("dd", null, v); if (sm) dd.append(" ", make("small", null, sm)); x.append(make("dt", null, k), dd); return x; };
      $.qFacts.replaceChildren(
        fact(L.used, `${this._compact(usedTok)} / ${this._compact(quota, 0)}`),
        fact(L.projected, this._compact(projTok), quota > 0 ? `${Math.round(projTok / quota * 100)}% ${L.ofQuota}` : ""),
        fact(L.leftLabel, fill(L.days, { n: left }), fill(L.through, { date: this._date(addDays(bEnd, -1), { month: "short", day: "numeric" }) }))
      );

      // cost
      const costs = this._models.map(m => ({ m, v: sum(m, "cost") }));
      const mtd = costs.reduce((a, c) => a + c.v, 0);
      const projCost = mtd / elapsed * monthDays;
      const budget = num(d.budget);
      $.cHead.textContent = L.costHead;
      $.cMtd.textContent = this._money(mtd);
      $.cMtdL.textContent = L.mtd;
      const over = budget > 0 && projCost > budget;
      $.budget.dataset.over = String(over);
      $.budget.hidden = false;
      const scaleTo = Math.max(budget, projCost) || 1;
      $.bbNow.style.width = (mtd / scaleTo * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
      $.bbProj.style.width = (projCost / scaleTo * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
      $.cProj.replaceChildren(make("b", null, fill(L.projectedCost, { v: this._money(projCost) })));
      if (budget > 0) $.cProj.append(" · " + fill(L.budget, { v: this._money(budget, 0) }));
      $.status.innerHTML = budget > 0 ? (over ? WARN : OK) : "";
      if (budget > 0) $.status.append(over ? L.over : L.under);
      $.cBy.textContent = L.byModel;
      $.models.replaceChildren(...costs.map(c => {
        const li = make("li", "aua-model");
        li.style.setProperty("--c", `var(--aua-c${c.m.slot})`);
        const sw = make("i"); sw.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const share = mtd > 0 ? Math.round(c.v / mtd * 100) : 0;
        li.append(sw, make("span", null, c.m.label), make("b", null, this._money(c.v)), make("small", null, `${share}% · ${fill(L.perM, { v: this._money(c.m.price) })}`));
        return li;
      }));
      const ring = this.querySelector(".aua-ring");
      ring.setAttribute("role", "img");
      ring.setAttribute("aria-label", `${L.quota}: ${$.qPct.textContent} used, ${this._compact(usedTok)} of ${this._compact(quota, 0)} tokens. ${L.projected} ${this._compact(projTok)}.`);
    }

    /* bars grow in the first time the chart scrolls into view */
    _reveal() {
      if (reduceMotion() || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) return;
      const card = this.$.card;
      card.classList.add("is-pending");
      this._io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        if (!entries.some(e => e.isIntersecting)) return;
        this._io.disconnect(); this._io = null;
        card.classList.remove("is-pending");
        this._chart(true);
      }, { threshold: 0.2 });
      this._io.observe(this.$.plot);
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("ai-usage-analytics")) customElements.define("ai-usage-analytics", AiUsageAnalytics);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = strong;
    note.append(b, " " + rest + " Example data, not a real bill.");
  };
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".seg button");
  buttons.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.data = Object.assign({}, el.data, { quota: +b.dataset.value });
    buttons.forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x === b)));
  }));
  document.getElementById("replay").addEventListener("click", () => el.replay());
  el.addEventListener("usagefilter", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    say("usagefilter", `fired: ${d.metric}, ${d.range} days, ${d.model ? d.model + " only" : "all models"}.`);
  });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>
