customer-journey-map [data-tone="butter"] { --cjm-c: var(--cjm-butter); --cjm-cs: var(--cjm-butter-strong); }
customer-journey-map [data-tone="mint"]   { --cjm-c: var(--cjm-mint);   --cjm-cs: var(--cjm-mint-strong); }
customer-journey-map [data-tone="sky"]    { --cjm-c: var(--cjm-sky);    --cjm-cs: var(--cjm-sky-strong); }
customer-journey-map [data-tone="lilac"]  { --cjm-c: var(--cjm-lilac);  --cjm-cs: var(--cjm-lilac-strong); }
customer-journey-map [data-feel="pos"] { --cjm-f: var(--cjm-pos); }
customer-journey-map [data-feel="neu"] { --cjm-f: var(--cjm-neu); }
customer-journey-map [data-feel="neg"] { --cjm-f: var(--cjm-neg); }

/* header */
.cjm-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cjm-intro { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; max-width: 46ch; }
.cjm-eyebrow { font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--cjm-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cjm-peach-strong); }
.cjm-title { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(20px, 3.1cqi, 26px)/1.15 var(--cjm-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; }
.cjm-sub { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--cjm-muted); }
.cjm-eyebrow:empty, .cjm-title:empty, .cjm-sub:empty, .cjm-persona-sum:empty { display: none; }

.cjm-personas { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.cjm-persona {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 5px 12px 5px 5px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--cjm-line); background: var(--cjm-card); color: var(--cjm-muted);
  font: 500 12px/1.15 var(--cjm-sans);
  transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s, color .2s, background .2s;
}
.cjm-persona b { display: block; font: 650 12.5px/1.15 var(--cjm-sans); color: var(--cjm-ink); }
.cjm-persona small { font-size: 11px; color: var(--cjm-faint); }
.cjm-persona:hover { border-color: var(--cjm-faint); }
.cjm-persona[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--cjm-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-ink) 12%, transparent); background: var(--cjm-tint); }
.cjm-persona:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cjm-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }
.cjm-av { flex: none; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--cjm-av); color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 11px/1 var(--cjm-sans); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.cjm-persona-sum { margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--cjm-muted); }
.cjm-persona-sum b { color: var(--cjm-ink); font-weight: 650; }

/* the map: row labels + one column per stage (subgrid keeps rows aligned) */
.cjm-map {
  --cjm-n: 5;
  position: relative;
  margin-top: 20px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 96px repeat(var(--cjm-n), minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-template-rows: auto auto auto auto 156px;
  column-gap: 8px;
}
.cjm-rl {
  grid-column: 1; padding: 14px 8px 12px 0;
  font: 500 10px/1.3 var(--cjm-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cjm-faint);
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--cjm-line);
}
.cjm-rl:first-of-type { border-top: 0; align-self: center; padding-block: 0; }
.cjm-rl small { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font: 400 11px/1.35 var(--cjm-sans); letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: var(--cjm-faint); }
.cjm-stage {
  position: relative; min-width: 0;
  grid-row: 1 / span 5; grid-column: var(--cjm-col, auto);
  display: grid; grid-template-rows: subgrid;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--cjm-c);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity .3s ease, filter .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.cjm-stage:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-cs) 45%, transparent); }
.cjm-map.cjm-has-on .cjm-stage:not(.cjm-stage--on) { opacity: .42; filter: saturate(.55); }
.cjm-stage.cjm-stage--on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cjm-cs), 0 22px 36px -24px var(--cjm-shadow); transform: translateY(-2px); }

.cjm-cell { min-width: 0; padding: 12px 12px; border-top: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-cs) 28%, transparent); }
.cjm-cell--head { border-top: 0; padding: 6px; }
.cjm-cell-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
.cjm-stage-btn {
  appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; color: var(--cjm-ink);
  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 8px; border-radius: 11px;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-card) 55%, transparent);
  font: 700 14px/1.15 var(--cjm-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  transition: background .2s;
}
.cjm-stage-btn:hover { background: var(--cjm-card); }
.cjm-stage-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cjm-cs); outline-offset: 2px; }
.cjm-num { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--cjm-cs); color: var(--cjm-card); font: 700 10.5px/1 var(--cjm-mono); }
.cjm-stage-name { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cjm-chev { display: none; margin-left: auto; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--cjm-muted); transition: transform .25s ease; }
.cjm-stage--on .cjm-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }

.cjm-goal { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; }
.cjm-chips { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; }
.cjm-chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; max-width: 100%;
  padding: 4px 8px 4px 6px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-card) 70%, transparent); color: var(--cjm-ink);
  font: 500 11.5px/1.2 var(--cjm-sans);
}
.cjm-chip svg { flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; color: var(--cjm-cs); }
.cjm-pains { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.cjm-pains li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--cjm-muted); }
.cjm-pains li::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: 5px; border-radius: 2px; transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--cjm-neg); }
.cjm-cell--feel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding-bottom: 10px; }
.cjm-mood { font: 650 12.5px/1.2 var(--cjm-sans); text-align: center; }
.cjm-mood span { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--cjm-mono); color: var(--cjm-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.cjm-meter { display: none; }
.cjm-extra { display: none; }

/* emotion curve overlay */
.cjm-curve { grid-column: 2 / -1; grid-row: 5; position: relative; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; min-width: 0; }
.cjm-curve svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.cjm-base { stroke: var(--cjm-curve); stroke-opacity: .22; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 2 4; }
.cjm-area { fill: var(--cjm-curve); fill-opacity: .045; }
.cjm-path { fill: none; stroke: var(--cjm-curve); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.cjm-face { transition: opacity .3s ease; }
.cjm-face-bg { fill: var(--cjm-card); stroke: var(--cjm-f); stroke-width: 2.5; }
.cjm-face-halo { fill: var(--cjm-f); fill-opacity: 0; transition: fill-opacity .3s ease; }
.cjm-face-eye { fill: var(--cjm-ink); }
.cjm-face-mouth { fill: none; stroke: var(--cjm-ink); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; }
.cjm-has-on .cjm-face:not(.cjm-face--on) { opacity: .4; }
.cjm-face--on .cjm-face-halo { fill-opacity: .22; }

/* detail card (wide layout) */
.cjm-detail {
  margin-top: 16px; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--cjm-tint); border: 1px solid var(--cjm-line);
  display: grid; gap: 14px;
}
.cjm-detail[data-tone] { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-c) 55%, var(--cjm-card)); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-cs) 35%, transparent); }
.cjm-d-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cjm-d-title { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.cjm-kick { font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--cjm-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cjm-faint); }
.cjm-d-title h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 20px/1.15 var(--cjm-display); letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
.cjm-feel-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 12px 5px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cjm-card); font: 650 12.5px/1 var(--cjm-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--cjm-f); }
.cjm-feel-chip svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.cjm-d-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; }
.cjm-iconbtn {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center;
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--cjm-line); background: var(--cjm-card); color: var(--cjm-ink);
  transition: border-color .2s, background .2s;
}
.cjm-iconbtn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.cjm-iconbtn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--cjm-ink); }
.cjm-iconbtn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
.cjm-iconbtn:focus-visible, .cjm-textbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cjm-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }
.cjm-d-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: 12px; }
.cjm-block { min-width: 0; padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--cjm-card); display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; }
.cjm-label { font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--cjm-mono); letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cjm-faint); }
.cjm-block p { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
.cjm-metric-val { font: 700 30px/1 var(--cjm-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--cjm-cs, var(--cjm-ink)); }
.cjm-metric-lab { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--cjm-muted); }
.cjm-quote { margin: 0; }
.cjm-quote blockquote { margin: 0; font: italic 400 15px/1.45 var(--cjm-serif); }
.cjm-quote figcaption { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--cjm-muted); }
.cjm-empty { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cjm-empty .cjm-av { width: 40px; height: 40px; font-size: 13px; }
.cjm-empty-text { flex: 1 1 260px; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 3px; }
.cjm-empty-text b { font: 650 14.5px/1.3 var(--cjm-display); }
.cjm-empty-text span { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--cjm-muted); }
.cjm-textbtn {
  appearance: none; cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--cjm-ink); background: var(--cjm-ink); color: var(--cjm-card);
  font: 650 12.5px/1 var(--cjm-sans);
  transition: opacity .2s;
}
.cjm-textbtn:hover { opacity: .88; }
.cjm-textbtn--ghost { background: var(--cjm-card); color: var(--cjm-ink); border-color: var(--cjm-line); }
.cjm-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }
.cjm-fade { animation: cjm-fade .35s ease both; }
@keyframes cjm-fade { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } }

/* tablet + phone: stages become a vertical sequence with per-stage sentiment meters */
@container cjm (max-width: 759px) {
  .cjm { padding: 22px 18px 18px; }
  .cjm-map { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: none; row-gap: 12px; }
  .cjm-rl, .cjm-curve, .cjm-detail { display: none; }
  .cjm-stage {
    grid-row: auto; grid-column: 1; grid-template-rows: none;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-areas: "head head" "goal feel" "touch pain" "extra extra";
    cursor: default;
  }
  .cjm-stage:not(.cjm-stage--last)::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 28px; bottom: -13px; width: 2px; height: 12px; background: var(--cjm-line); }
  .cjm-map.cjm-has-on .cjm-stage:not(.cjm-stage--on) { opacity: .7; filter: none; }
  .cjm-stage.cjm-stage--on { transform: none; }
  .cjm-cell--head { grid-area: head; }
  .cjm-cell--goal { grid-area: goal; }
  .cjm-cell--feel { grid-area: feel; }
  .cjm-cell--touch { grid-area: touch; }
  .cjm-cell--pain { grid-area: pain; }
  .cjm-cell--feel, .cjm-cell--pain { border-left: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-cs) 28%, transparent); }
  .cjm-cell { display: grid; gap: 7px; align-content: start; }
  .cjm-cell-label { position: static; width: auto; height: auto; overflow: visible; clip: auto; white-space: normal; font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--cjm-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cjm-faint); }
  .cjm-cell--head .cjm-cell-label { display: none; }
  .cjm-chev { display: block; }
  .cjm-cell--feel { justify-content: start; flex-direction: initial; padding-bottom: 12px; }
  .cjm-mood { display: none; }
  .cjm-meter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; }
  .cjm-meter svg { grid-row: span 2; width: 30px; height: 30px; }
  .cjm-meter b { font: 650 13px/1.2 var(--cjm-sans); }
  .cjm-bar5 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; }
  .cjm-bar5 i { height: 6px; border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-ink) 12%, transparent); }
  .cjm-bar5 i.cjm-lit { background: var(--cjm-f); }
  .cjm-stage--on .cjm-extra { grid-area: extra; display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 0 10px 12px; animation: cjm-fade .3s ease both; }
  .cjm-extra .cjm-block { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-card) 82%, transparent); }
  .cjm-extra-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 0.6fr); gap: 10px; }
}
@container cjm (max-width: 479px) {
  .cjm { padding: 18px 12px 14px; border-radius: 18px; }
  .cjm-personas { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .cjm-persona { border-radius: 14px; }
  .cjm-stage { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "head" "feel" "goal" "touch" "pain" "extra"; }
  .cjm-cell--feel, .cjm-cell--pain { border-left: 0; }
  .cjm-extra-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .cjm-persona, .cjm-stage, .cjm-stage-btn, .cjm-chev, .cjm-face, .cjm-face-halo, .cjm-iconbtn, .cjm-textbtn { transition: none; }
  .cjm-stage.cjm-stage--on { transform: none; }
  .cjm-fade, .cjm-stage--on .cjm-extra { animation: none; }
}

/* =========================================================
   Showcase shell
   ========================================================= */
body {
  background: var(--ground);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--cjm-sans);
}
.shell { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 44px 20px 72px; display: grid; gap: 28px; }
.intro { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.kicker { font: 500 11px/1 var(--cjm-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.kicker span:last-child { color: var(--accent); }
.intro h1 { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(30px, 5vw, 44px)/1.05 var(--cjm-display); letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-wrap: balance; }
.intro p { margin: 0; max-width: 62ch; color: var(--muted); }

.stage {
  background:
    linear-gradient(100deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-peach) 45%, transparent), transparent 30%, transparent 70%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--cjm-lilac) 45%, transparent)),
    var(--stage);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 44px) clamp(12px, 3vw, 36px);
  display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 20px;
}
.stage-bar { width: 100%; max-width: 1000px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.note { margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 64ch; }
.note b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

.docs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); gap: 20px; }
@media (max-width: 820px) { .docs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.doc { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px; display: grid; gap: 14px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.doc h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 17px/1.2 var(--cjm-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.doc-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.fields-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.fields { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }
.fields td { padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
.fields tr:first-child td { border-top: 0; }
.fields td:first-child { font: 400 12.5px/1.5 var(--cjm-mono); color: var(--accent); white-space: nowrap; padding-right: 16px; }
.fields td:last-child { color: var(--muted); }
.fields code, .doc p code { font: 400 .9em var(--cjm-mono); }
.btn {
  appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--cjm-card); cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12px/1 var(--cjm-sans); color: var(--muted); padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 8px;
  transition: color .2s, border-color .2s;
}
.btn:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--faint); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.code-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--cjm-tint); }
.code { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px; font: 400 12.5px/1.7 var(--cjm-mono); color: var(--ink); white-space: pre; }
.code .t { color: var(--accent); }
.code .a { color: var(--muted); }
.doc p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
</style>

      $.sub.textContent = d.subtitle || "";

      $.personas.setAttribute("aria-label", L.personas);
      $.personas.replaceChildren(...personas.map(x => {
        const b = make("button", "cjm-persona");
        b.type = "button"; b.dataset.persona = x.id;
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(p && x.id === p.id));
        const av = make("span", "cjm-av", initials(x.name)); av.style.setProperty("--cjm-av", x.color); av.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const txt = make("span"); txt.append(make("b", null, x.name || x.id), make("small", null, x.role || ""));

      }));
      $.personas.hidden = personas.length < 2;

      $.sum.replaceChildren();
      if (p) { $.sum.append(make("b", null, (p.name || "") + (p.role ? ` · ${p.role}` : "")), p.summary ? `  ${p.summary}` : ""); }
      else $.sum.textContent = L.noPersona;

      // map
      const rows = [[L.rowStage], [L.rowGoal], [L.rowTouch], [L.rowPain], [L.rowFeel, L.rowFeelSub]];
      const labels = rows.map((r, i) => {
        const el = make("div", "cjm-rl", r[0]);

      curve.append(svgEl("svg", { focusable: "false" }));

      this.$.curve = curve;

      const target = entries.map(e => e.score);
      const from = this._scores;
      this._scores = target;
      this._entries = entries;
      if (animate && from && from.length === target.length && !reduceMotion()) this._tweenCurve(from, target);

    }

    _column(s, i, e, total, L, animate) {
      const col = make("div", "cjm-stage" + (i === total - 1 ? " cjm-stage--last" : ""));
      col.dataset.stage = s.id; col.dataset.tone = s.tone; col.dataset.feel = feelOf(e.score);
      col.style.setProperty("--cjm-col", String(i + 2));
      const cell = (mod, label) => { const c = make("div", "cjm-cell cjm-cell--" + mod); c.append(make("span", "cjm-cell-label", label)); return c; };

      const head = cell("head", L.rowStage);
      const btn = make("button", "cjm-stage-btn");
      btn.type = "button"; btn.dataset.stage = s.id;
      btn.append(make("span", "cjm-num", String(i + 1)), make("span", "cjm-stage-name", s.label));
      btn.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ICON_CHEV);
      btn.append(make("span", "cjm-sr", `, ${fill(L.stageOf, { n: i + 1, total })}, ${L.feeling.toLowerCase()} ${e.mood.toLowerCase()}`));
      head.append(btn);

      const goal = cell("goal", L.rowGoal); goal.append(make("p", "cjm-goal", e.goal || "—"));
      const touch = cell("touch", L.rowTouch);
      const ul = make("ul", "cjm-chips");
      e.touch.forEach(t => { const li = make("li", "cjm-chip"); li.innerHTML = glyph(t.kind); li.append(t.label || ""); ul.append(li); });
      touch.append(ul);
      const pain = cell("pain", L.rowPain);
      const pl = make("ul", "cjm-pains");
      e.pains.forEach(x => pl.append(make("li", null, x)));
      pain.append(pl);

      const feel = cell("feel", L.rowFeel);
      const mood = make("div", "cjm-mood", e.mood);
      mood.append(make("span", null, signed(Math.round(e.score))));
      const meter = make("div", "cjm-meter");
      const bar = make("span", "cjm-bar5");
      const sc = Math.round(e.score);
      for (let k = -2; k <= 2; k++) {
        const lit = sc === 0 ? k === 0 : sc > 0 ? k > 0 && k <= sc : k < 0 && k >= sc;
        bar.append(make("i", lit ? "cjm-lit" : null));
      }
      meter.append(faceSvg(e.score), make("b", null, `${e.mood} · ${signed(sc)}`), bar);
      feel.append(mood, meter);

      const extra = make("div", "cjm-extra");
      const row = make("div", "cjm-extra-row");
      row.append(this._block(L.opportunity, e.opportunity), this._metric(L, e.metric));
      extra.append(row);
      if (e.quote) extra.append(this._quote(L, e.quote));

      col.append(head, goal, touch, pain, feel, extra);
      if (animate && !reduceMotion()) [goal, touch, pain, feel].forEach((c, k) => {
        c.animate([{ opacity: 0, transform: "translateY(4px)" }, { opacity: 1, transform: "none" }], { duration: 320, delay: i * 40 + k * 25, easing: "ease-out", fill: "backwards" });
      });
      return col;
    }

    _block(label, text) {
      const b = make("div", "cjm-block");
      b.append(make("span", "cjm-label", label), make("p", null, text || "—"));
      return b;
    }
    _metric(L, m) {
      const b = make("div", "cjm-block");
      b.append(make("span", "cjm-label", L.metric), make("span", "cjm-metric-val", (m && m.value) || "—"));
      if (m && m.label) b.append(make("span", "cjm-metric-lab", m.label));
      return b;
    }
    _quote(L, q) {
      const p = this._current();
      const f = make("figure", "cjm-block cjm-quote");
      f.append(make("span", "cjm-label", L.quote));
      const bq = make("blockquote", null, `“${q}”`);
      f.append(bq, make("figcaption", null, `— ${(p && p.name) || ""}`));
      return f;
    }

    /* ---------- emotion curve ---------- */
    _drawCurve(scores) {
      const box = this.$.curve;
      if (!box) return;
      const svg = box.firstChild, w = box.clientWidth, h = box.clientHeight;
      if (!w || !h) { svg.replaceChildren(); return; }
      const br = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      const xs = [...this.$.map.querySelectorAll(".cjm-stage")].map(c => { const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.left + r.width / 2 - br.left; });
      const top = 26, bottom = 52, y = s => top + (2 - s) / 4 * (h - top - bottom);
      svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${w} ${h}`);
      const pts = xs.map((x, i) => [x, y(scores[i] ?? 0)]);
      // smooth path (cardinal spline)
      let d = "";
      pts.forEach((pt, i) => {
        if (!i) { d = `M${pt[0].toFixed(1)},${pt[1].toFixed(1)}`; return; }
        const p0 = pts[i - 2] || pts[i - 1], p1 = pts[i - 1], p2 = pt, p3 = pts[i + 1] || pt, t = 0.18;
        const c1 = [p1[0] + (p2[0] - p0[0]) * t, p1[1] + (p2[1] - p0[1]) * t];
        const c2 = [p2[0] - (p3[0] - p1[0]) * t, p2[1] - (p3[1] - p1[1]) * t];
        d += `C${c1[0].toFixed(1)},${c1[1].toFixed(1)} ${c2[0].toFixed(1)},${c2[1].toFixed(1)} ${p2[0].toFixed(1)},${p2[1].toFixed(1)}`;
      });
      const nodes = [svgEl("line", { class: "cjm-base", x1: 0, x2: w, y1: y(0), y2: y(0) })];
      if (pts.length > 1) {
        nodes.push(svgEl("path", { class: "cjm-area", d: `${d}L${pts[pts.length - 1][0].toFixed(1)},${h - bottom + 14}L${pts[0][0].toFixed(1)},${h - bottom + 14}Z` }));
        nodes.push(svgEl("path", { class: "cjm-path", d }));
      }
      const on = this.stage, ids = this._stages().map(s => s.id);
      pts.forEach((pt, i) => {
        const s = Math.round(clampScore(this._scores[i]));
        const g = svgEl("g", { class: "cjm-face" + (ids[i] === on ? " cjm-face--on" : ""), transform: `translate(${pt[0].toFixed(1)},${pt[1].toFixed(1)})` });
        g.dataset.feel = feelOf(s);
        g.append(
          svgEl("circle", { class: "cjm-face-halo", r: 24 }),
          svgEl("circle", { class: "cjm-face-bg", r: 15 }),
          svgEl("circle", { class: "cjm-face-eye", cx: -5, cy: -3.5, r: 1.7 }),
          svgEl("circle", { class: "cjm-face-eye", cx: 5, cy: -3.5, r: 1.7 }),
          svgEl("path", { class: "cjm-face-mouth", d: MOUTH[String(s)] })
        );
        nodes.push(g);
      });
      svg.replaceChildren(...nodes);
    }

    _tweenCurve(from, to) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf);
      const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 480;
      const tick = now => {
        const k = ease(Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur));
        this._drawCurve(to.map((v, i) => from[i] + (v - from[i]) * k));
        if (k < 1) this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

    _observe() {

    /* ---------- focus / selection ---------- */
    _applyFocus(announce) {
      const $ = this.$, on = this.stage, stages = this._stages(), L = this._labels();
      const cols = [...$.map.querySelectorAll(".cjm-stage")];
      cols.forEach(c => c.classList.toggle("cjm-stage--on", c.dataset.stage === on));
      $.map.classList.toggle("cjm-has-on", !!on);
      const btns = [...$.map.querySelectorAll(".cjm-stage-btn")];

      this._renderDetail(L);

      }
    }

    _renderDetail(L) {
      const $ = this.$, stages = this._stages(), on = this.stage, p = this._current();
      const box = $.detail;

      if (!p || !stages.length) return;
      const i = stages.findIndex(s => s.id === on);
      if (i < 0) {
        const es = this._entries;
        let hi = 0, lo = 0;
        es.forEach((e, k) => { if (e.score > es[hi].score) hi = k; if (e.score < es[lo].score) lo = k; });
        const wrap = make("div", "cjm-empty cjm-fade");

        const txt = make("div", "cjm-empty-text");

          make("span", null, fill(L.glanceText, { high: stages[hi].label, highMood: es[hi].mood.toLowerCase(), low: stages[lo].label, lowMood: es[lo].mood.toLowerCase(), first })));
        const btn = make("button", "cjm-textbtn", L.showLow);
        btn.type = "button";
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => this._select(stages[lo].id, true));

      const s = stages[i], e = this._entries[i];

      const top = make("div", "cjm-d-top cjm-fade");
      const title = make("div", "cjm-d-title");
      title.append(make("span", "cjm-kick", `${fill(L.stageOf, { n: i + 1, total: stages.length })} · ${p.name || ""}`), make("h3", null, s.label));
      const chip = make("span", "cjm-feel-chip");
      chip.append(faceSvg(e.score), `${e.mood} · ${signed(Math.round(e.score))}`);
      const nav = make("div", "cjm-d-nav");
      const mk = (icon, label, fn, disabled) => { const b = make("button", "cjm-iconbtn"); b.type = "button"; b.innerHTML = icon; b.setAttribute("aria-label", label); b.disabled = disabled; b.addEventListener("click", fn); return b; };
      nav.append(
        mk(ICON_PREV, L.prev, () => this._select(stages[i - 1].id, true), i === 0),
        mk(ICON_NEXT, L.next, () => this._select(stages[i + 1].id, true), i === stages.length - 1),
        mk(ICON_X, L.close, () => this._select(null, true), false)
      );
      top.append(title, chip, nav);
      const grid = make("div", "cjm-d-grid cjm-fade");
      grid.append(this._block(L.opportunity, e.opportunity), this._metric(L, e.metric));
      if (e.quote) grid.append(this._quote(L, e.quote));

    }

    _select(id, focusBtn) {
      const prev = this.stage;
      const next = id && this._stages().some(s => s.id === id) ? id : "";

      if (focusBtn && next) { const b = this.$.map.querySelector(`.cjm-stage-btn[data-stage="${next}"]`); if (b && !this.$.map.contains(document.activeElement)) b.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
      const stages = this._stages(), i = stages.findIndex(s => s.id === next), e = i >= 0 ? this._entries[i] : null;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("stageselect", {
        bubbles: true,
        detail: { stage: next || null, label: i >= 0 ? stages[i].label : null, index: i, persona: this.persona, emotion: e ? e.score : null, mood: e ? e.mood : null }
      }));
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.personas.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest(".cjm-persona");
        if (!b || b.dataset.persona === this.persona) return;
        this.persona = b.dataset.persona;
        const p = this._current();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("personachange", { bubbles: true, detail: { persona: this.persona, name: p ? p.name : "" } }));
        requestAnimationFrame(() => { const nb = $.personas.querySelector(`[data-persona="${b.dataset.persona}"]`); if (nb) nb.focus(); });
      });
      $.map.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const col = e.target.closest(".cjm-stage");
        if (!col) return;

        const btn = e.target.closest(".cjm-stage-btn");

        const btn = e.target.closest(".cjm-stage-btn");
        if (!btn) return;
        const btns = [...$.map.querySelectorAll(".cjm-stage-btn")];
        const i = btns.indexOf(btn);
        let ni = null;
        if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") ni = Math.min(btns.length - 1, i + 1);
        else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") ni = Math.max(0, i - 1);

        else if (e.key === "End") ni = btns.length - 1;

    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("customer-journey-map")) customElements.define("customer-journey-map", CustomerJourneyMap);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("event-note");
  const say = (strong, rest) => { const b = document.createElement("b"); b.textContent = strong; note.replaceChildren(b, rest); };
  el.addEventListener("stageselect", e => {
    const d = e.detail;
    if (!d.stage) say("Stage focus cleared.", " Fictional personas, not real client research.");
    else say(`${d.label} · ${d.mood}`, ` · stageselect fired. Fictional personas, not real client research.`);
  });
  el.addEventListener("personachange", e => say(`Persona: ${e.detail.name}`, " · personachange fired. Fictional personas, not real client research."));

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();

.wmr-act:hover { border-color: var(--wmr-ink); }

.wmr-weeks button:focus-visible, .wmr-act:focus-visible, .wmr-check input:focus-visible + .wmr-box { outline: 2px solid var(--wmr-red); outline-offset: 2px; }
.wmr-status { font: 500 12px/1.3 var(--wmr-sans); color: var(--wmr-faint); min-height: 1em; }
.wmr-status:empty { display: none; }
.wmr-fallback { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 140px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); background: var(--wmr-paper); color: var(--wmr-ink); font: 400 12.5px/1.55 var(--wmr-mono); resize: vertical; }

/* the sheet */
.wmr-sheet {
  position: relative;
  padding: 30px 36px 22px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(var(--wmr-grain) 1px, transparent 1.2px) 0 0 / 4px 4px,
    radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, var(--wmr-paper), var(--wmr-paper-2));
  border: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair);
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) inset, 0 26px 50px -36px var(--wmr-shadow), 0 2px 5px -3px var(--wmr-shadow);
}
.wmr-sheet::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 8px -8px -8px 8px; z-index: -1; border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--wmr-paper-2); border: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair);
}

/* masthead */
.wmr-mast { text-align: center; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.wmr-mast-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 600 10.5px/1.2 var(--wmr-sans); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wmr-muted); }
.wmr-name {
  margin: 0; font: 600 clamp(30px, 6.6cqi, 58px)/0.98 var(--wmr-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  font-variant: small-caps; text-wrap: balance;
}
.wmr-name span { color: var(--wmr-red); }
.wmr-dateline {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 7px 0; border-top: 3px double var(--wmr-rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wmr-rule);
  font: 500 12.5px/1.2 var(--wmr-serif); font-style: italic; color: var(--wmr-muted);
}
.wmr-dateline b { font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; color: var(--wmr-ink); letter-spacing: .02em; }

.wmr-body { display: grid; gap: 24px; margin-top: 22px; }

/* lead story */
.wmr-kicker { font: 700 10.5px/1 var(--wmr-sans); letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wmr-red); }
.wmr-story { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.wmr-headline { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(26px, 4.6cqi, 40px)/1.06 var(--wmr-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; max-width: 26ch; }
.wmr-lead {
  margin: 0; font: 400 16px/1.62 var(--wmr-serif); color: var(--wmr-ink);
  column-count: 2; column-gap: 34px; column-rule: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair);
  hyphens: auto; text-align: justify; text-wrap: pretty;
}
.wmr-lead::first-letter {
  float: left; margin: 6px 8px 0 0;
  font: 700 3.5em/0.8 var(--wmr-display); color: var(--wmr-red);
}

/* KPI strip */
.wmr-kpis { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-top: 2px solid var(--wmr-rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wmr-rule); }
.wmr-kpi { display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; padding: 14px 18px 14px; min-width: 0; }
.wmr-kpi:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.wmr-kpi + .wmr-kpi { border-left: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); }
.wmr-kpi dt { font: 700 10px/1.2 var(--wmr-sans); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wmr-muted); }
.wmr-kpi dd { margin: 0; }
.wmr-fig { display: block; font: 700 clamp(28px, 4.4cqi, 38px)/1 var(--wmr-serif); letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; }
.wmr-delta { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font: 500 12.5px/1.3 var(--wmr-serif); font-style: italic; color: var(--wmr-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.wmr-delta b { font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; color: var(--wmr-ink); }
.wmr-delta[data-tone="bad"] b { color: var(--wmr-red); }

/* sections */
.wmr-grid2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; }
.wmr-grid2 > * + * { border-left: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); padding-left: 24px; }
.wmr-grid2 > :first-child { padding-right: 24px; }
.wmr-main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; }
.wmr-main > :first-child { padding-right: 24px; }
.wmr-main > * + * { border-left: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); padding-left: 24px; }
.wmr-sec { display: grid; gap: 10px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.wmr-sec-h { margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wmr-rule); font: 700 19px/1.15 var(--wmr-serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.wmr-sec-h small { font: 600 10px/1 var(--wmr-sans); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wmr-faint); }
.wmr-points { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 9px; }
.wmr-points li { position: relative; padding-left: 20px; font: 400 14.5px/1.5 var(--wmr-serif); }
.wmr-points li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 2px; top: .6em; width: 8px; height: 8px; }
.wmr-points--up li::before { background: var(--wmr-ink); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
.wmr-points--down li::before { background: var(--wmr-red); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%); }

/* channel table */
.wmr-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 14px/1.3 var(--wmr-serif); font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; }
.wmr-table caption { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
.wmr-table th { font: 700 9.5px/1.2 var(--wmr-sans); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wmr-muted); text-align: right; padding: 0 0 8px 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.wmr-table th:first-child, .wmr-table td:first-child { text-align: left; padding-left: 0; }
.wmr-table td { text-align: right; padding: 9px 0 9px 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); white-space: nowrap; }
.wmr-table tbody tr { transition: background .2s; }
.wmr-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--wmr-red-soft); }
.wmr-table td:first-child { font-weight: 700; white-space: normal; }
.wmr-table .wmr-rowh { padding: 9px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); text-align: left; font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--wmr-serif); letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: var(--wmr-ink); white-space: normal; }
.wmr-table tfoot td { border-top: 2px solid var(--wmr-rule); font-weight: 700; }
.wmr-rate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.wmr-rate i { display: inline-block; width: 30px; height: 5px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--wmr-ink) calc(var(--p, 0) * 1%), var(--wmr-hair) 0); }
.wmr-table .is-best .wmr-rate i { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--wmr-red) calc(var(--p, 0) * 1%), var(--wmr-hair) 0); }
.wmr-table .is-best .wmr-rate b { color: var(--wmr-red); }
.wmr-dash { color: var(--wmr-faint); }
.wmr-tnote { margin: 0; font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--wmr-serif); font-style: italic; color: var(--wmr-faint); }

/* checklist */
.wmr-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.wmr-check { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 6px 0; cursor: pointer; font: 400 14.5px/1.45 var(--wmr-serif); }
.wmr-check input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: 0; }
.wmr-box {
  width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: 1px; box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; place-items: center;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--wmr-ink); background: transparent; color: var(--wmr-paper);
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
}
.wmr-box svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; opacity: 0; transform: scale(.6); transition: opacity .2s, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
.wmr-check input:checked + .wmr-box { background: var(--wmr-red); border-color: var(--wmr-red); }
.wmr-check input:checked + .wmr-box svg { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.wmr-check-text { -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; background: linear-gradient(var(--wmr-red), var(--wmr-red)) 0 55% / 0 1.5px no-repeat; transition: background-size .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), color .3s; }
.wmr-check input:checked ~ .wmr-check-text { color: var(--wmr-faint); background-size: 100% 1.5px; }
.wmr-check:hover .wmr-box { border-color: var(--wmr-red); }
.wmr-progress { font: 600 10px/1 var(--wmr-sans); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wmr-faint); }

.wmr-foot { margin: 22px 0 0; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--wmr-rule); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 400 11.5px/1.4 var(--wmr-serif); font-style: italic; color: var(--wmr-faint); }
.wmr-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; margin: 0; }

/* tablet */
@container wmr (max-width: 759px) {
  .wmr-sheet { padding: 24px 24px 18px; }
  .wmr-lead { column-count: 1; text-align: left; }
  .wmr-kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .wmr-kpi:nth-child(3) { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; }
  .wmr-kpi:nth-child(n+3) { border-top: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); }
  .wmr-main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; row-gap: 24px; }
  .wmr-main > :first-child { padding-right: 0; }
  .wmr-main > * + * { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
}
/* phone: single column, the table becomes labelled rows */
@container wmr (max-width: 519px) {
  .wmr-controls { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .wmr-weeks { justify-content: space-between; }

  .wmr-actions .wmr-act { flex: 1 1 0; justify-content: center; }
  .wmr-sheet { padding: 20px 16px 16px; }

  .wmr-mast-top { justify-content: center; }
  .wmr-dateline { justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
  .wmr-lead { font-size: 15.5px; }
  .wmr-kpi { padding: 12px 10px 12px 12px; }
  .wmr-kpi:nth-child(odd) { padding-left: 0; }
  .wmr-fig { font-size: 27px; }
  .wmr-grid2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; row-gap: 22px; }
  .wmr-grid2 > :first-child { padding-right: 0; }
  .wmr-grid2 > * + * { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
  .wmr-table thead { display: none; }
  .wmr-table, .wmr-table tbody, .wmr-table tfoot, .wmr-table tr, .wmr-table td, .wmr-table .wmr-rowh { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }
  .wmr-table .wmr-rowh { grid-column: 1 / -1; border: 0; padding: 0 0 4px; font-size: 15px; }
  .wmr-table tr { padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--wmr-hair); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; column-gap: 14px; }
  .wmr-table tfoot tr { border-top: 2px solid var(--wmr-rule); }
  .wmr-table td, .wmr-table tfoot td { border: 0; padding: 3px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; text-align: right; }
  .wmr-table td::before { content: attr(data-label); font: 700 9.5px/1.6 var(--wmr-sans); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wmr-muted); text-align: left; }
  .wmr-table td:first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 15px; padding-bottom: 4px; }
  .wmr-table td:first-child::before { content: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

<script>
/* =========================================================
   <weekly-marketing-report> — reusable custom element
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const LABELS = {
    week: "Week {n}", weeks: "Report week", prev: "Previous week", next: "Next week",
    copy: "Copy summary", copied: "Copied", print: "Print",
    copiedMsg: "Summary copied to the clipboard.", fallbackMsg: "Copy blocked by the browser. The summary is selected below; press Ctrl+C or ⌘C.",
    issue: "Issue {n}", leadStory: "This week",
    leads: "Leads", booked: "Booked calls", cpl: "Cost per lead", cplShort: "Cost/lead", spend: "Ad spend",
    vs: "vs {label}", noCompare: "No earlier week to compare",
    highlights: "Highlights", lowlights: "Lowlights", channels: "By channel", nextWeek: "Next week",
    channel: "Channel", bookRate: "Book rate", total: "Total",
    tableNote: "Cost per lead counts paid channels only in each row; the total is spend over all leads.",
    progress: "{done} of {total} done", example: "Example data",
    summaryNext: "Next week", announce: "Showing week {n}, {range}."
  };
  const ICON_L = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3.5 5.5 8l4.5 4.5"/></svg>';
  const ICON_R = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 3.5 10.5 8 6 12.5"/></svg>';
  const ICON_COPY = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="5.5" y="5.5" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5"/><path d="M10.5 5.5V3.8A1.3 1.3 0 0 0 9.2 2.5H3.8a1.3 1.3 0 0 0-1.3 1.3v5.4a1.3 1.3 0 0 0 1.3 1.3h1.7"/></svg>';
  const ICON_PRINT = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.5 6V2.5h7V6"/><rect x="2" y="6" width="12" height="5.5" rx="1.2"/><path d="M4.5 9.5h7v4h-7z"/></svg>';
  const ICON_TICK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.5 6.3 5 8.6 9.6 3.6"/></svg>';

  const TEMPLATE = `
    <div class="wmr">
      <div class="wmr-controls">
        <div class="wmr-weeks" role="group"></div>
        <div class="wmr-actions">
          <button type="button" class="wmr-act wmr-copy"></button>
          <button type="button" class="wmr-act wmr-print"></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="wmr-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      <article class="wmr-sheet">
        <header class="wmr-mast">
          <div class="wmr-mast-top"><span class="wmr-client"></span><span class="wmr-desk"></span></div>
          <h2 class="wmr-name"></h2>
          <div class="wmr-dateline"><b class="wmr-wk"></b><span class="wmr-range"></span><span class="wmr-issue"></span></div>
        </header>
        <div class="wmr-body"></div>
        <footer class="wmr-foot"><span class="wmr-by"></span><span class="wmr-ex"></span></footer>
      </article>
      <p class="wmr-sr" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>`;

  const num = v => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || !Number.isFinite(+v) ? null : +v);
  const fill = (s, vars) => String(s).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? "");
  const make = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let uidCount = 0;

  class WeeklyMarketingReport extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() { return ["week"]; }

    constructor() { super(); this._uid = "wmr" + (++uidCount); this._checks = new Map(); }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (this._built) return;
      if (!this._data) {
        const src = this.querySelector(':scope > script[type="application/json"]');
        try { this._data = src ? JSON.parse(src.textContent) : {}; }
        catch (e) { console.warn("<weekly-marketing-report>: the JSON data could not be read.", e); this._data = {}; }
      }
      this.innerHTML = TEMPLATE;
      const q = s => this.querySelector(s);
      this.$ = {
        weeks: q(".wmr-weeks"), copy: q(".wmr-copy"), print: q(".wmr-print"), status: q(".wmr-status"),
        client: q(".wmr-client"), desk: q(".wmr-desk"), name: q(".wmr-name"), wk: q(".wmr-wk"), range: q(".wmr-range"), issue: q(".wmr-issue"),
        body: q(".wmr-body"), by: q(".wmr-by"), ex: q(".wmr-ex"), sr: q(".wmr-sr"), root: q(".wmr")
      };
      this._wire();
      this._built = true;
      this._render(false);
    }

    disconnectedCallback() { clearTimeout(this._copyTimer); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (!this._built || oldVal === newVal) return;
      this._render(true);
    }

    /* Programmatic API */
    get data() { return this._data; }
    set data(d) { this._data = d || {}; this._checks.clear(); if (this._built) this._render(true); }
    get week() { const w = this._current(); return w ? w.week : null; }
    set week(v) { this.setAttribute("week", String(v)); }
    resetChecklists() { this._checks.clear(); if (this._built) this._render(false); }
    copySummary() { return this._copy(); }

    _labels() { return Object.assign({}, LABELS, (this._data && this._data.labels) || {}); }
    _locale() { return (this._data && this._data.locale) || "en-US"; }
    _weeks() { return (Array.isArray(this._data && this._data.weeks) ? this._data.weeks : []).filter(Boolean); }
    _index() {
      const list = this._weeks(), want = num(this.getAttribute("week"));
      const i = want == null ? -1 : list.findIndex(w => num(w.week) === want);
      return i > -1 ? i : list.length - 1;
    }
    _current() { return this._weeks()[this._index()] || null; }
    _money(v, digits) {
      try { return new Intl.NumberFormat(this._locale(), { style: "currency", currency: this._data.currency || "USD", minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits }).format(v); }
      catch (e) { return v.toFixed(digits); }
    }
    _int(v) { return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(this._locale()); }
    _pct(v, d = 1) { return v.toLocaleString(this._locale(), { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d }) + "%"; }

    _totals(w) {
      const rows = (Array.isArray(w && w.channels) ? w.channels : []).map((c, i) => ({
        name: (c && c.name) || `Channel ${i + 1}`,
        spend: Math.max(0, num(c && c.spend) ?? 0), leads: Math.max(0, num(c && c.leads) ?? 0), booked: Math.max(0, num(c && c.booked) ?? 0)
      }));
      const sum = k => rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r[k], 0);
      const t = { rows, spend: sum("spend"), leads: sum("leads"), booked: sum("booked") };
      t.cpl = t.leads > 0 ? t.spend / t.leads : null;
      return t;
    }
    _compare(i) {
      const list = this._weeks(), w = list[i], L = this._labels();
      if (i > 0) { const t = this._totals(list[i - 1]); return Object.assign(t, { label: fill(L.week, { n: list[i - 1].week }) }); }
      const p = w && w.prior;
      if (!p) return null;
      const t = { spend: num(p.spend) ?? 0, leads: num(p.leads) ?? 0, booked: num(p.booked) ?? 0, label: p.label || "" };
      t.cpl = t.leads > 0 ? t.spend / t.leads : null;
      return t;
    }
    _done(w, i) {
      const key = String(w.week);
      if (!this._checks.has(key)) this._checks.set(key, (w.next || []).map(n => !!(n && n.done)));
      return this._checks.get(key);
    }

    _render(animate) {
      const d = this._data || {}, L = this._labels(), $ = this.$;
      const list = this._weeks(), idx = this._index(), w = list[idx];

      // week switcher
      $.weeks.setAttribute("aria-label", L.weeks);
      const prev = make("button", "wmr-step"); prev.type = "button"; prev.dataset.go = "-1"; prev.innerHTML = ICON_L; prev.setAttribute("aria-label", L.prev); prev.disabled = idx <= 0;
      const next = make("button", "wmr-step"); next.type = "button"; next.dataset.go = "1"; next.innerHTML = ICON_R; next.setAttribute("aria-label", L.next); next.disabled = idx >= list.length - 1;
      const keep = document.activeElement && $.weeks.contains(document.activeElement) ? (document.activeElement.dataset.go || "w" + document.activeElement.dataset.week) : null;
      const items = [prev];
      list.forEach((x, i) => {
        if (i > 0) { const dot = make("span", "wmr-dot", "·"); dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); items.push(dot); }
        const b = make("button", null, fill(L.week, { n: x.week })); b.type = "button"; b.dataset.week = x.week;
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(i === idx));
        items.push(b);
      });
      items.push(next);
      $.weeks.replaceChildren(...items);
      if (keep) {
        const f = keep.startsWith("w") ? $.weeks.querySelector(`[data-week="${CSS.escape(keep.slice(1))}"]`) : $.weeks.querySelector(`[data-go="${keep}"]`);
        if (f && !f.disabled) f.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        else { const cur = $.weeks.querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]'); if (cur) cur.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
      }

      $.copy.innerHTML = ICON_COPY; $.copy.append(L.copy);
      $.print.innerHTML = ICON_PRINT; $.print.append(L.print);
      $.copy.disabled = !w;

      // masthead
      $.client.textContent = d.client || "";
      $.desk.textContent = d.desk || "";
      const title = d.publication || "Weekly Report";
      const words = title.split(" ");
      $.name.replaceChildren();
      if (words.length > 1) { $.name.append(words.slice(0, -1).join(" ") + " "); $.name.append(make("span", null, words[words.length - 1])); }
      else $.name.textContent = title;
      $.wk.textContent = w ? fill(L.week, { n: w.week }) : "";
      $.range.textContent = w ? (w.range || "") : "";
      $.issue.textContent = w ? fill(L.issue, { n: w.issue || w.week }) : "";
      $.by.textContent = d.preparedBy || "";
      $.ex.textContent = [d.client, L.example].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");

      $.body.replaceChildren(...(w ? this._body(w, idx, L) : []));
      if (animate && w) {
        if (!reduceMotion() && "animate" in Element.prototype) {
          $.body.animate([{ opacity: 0, transform: "translateY(6px)" }, { opacity: 1, transform: "none" }], { duration: 320, easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" });
        }
        $.sr.textContent = fill(L.announce, { n: w.week, range: w.range || "" });
      }
    }

    _body(w, idx, L) {
      const t = this._totals(w), c = this._compare(idx);
      const out = [];

      // lead story
      const story = make("section", "wmr-story");
      story.append(make("span", "wmr-kicker", L.leadStory), make("h3", "wmr-headline", w.headline || ""), make("p", "wmr-lead", w.lead || ""));
      out.push(story);

      // key figures
      const dl = make("dl", "wmr-kpis");
      const change = (cur, prev) => (prev ? (cur - prev) / prev * 100 : null);
      const kpis = [
        { k: L.leads, v: this._int(t.leads), d: c ? change(t.leads, c.leads) : null, better: "up" },
        { k: L.booked, v: this._int(t.booked), d: c ? change(t.booked, c.booked) : null, better: "up" },
        { k: L.cpl, v: t.cpl == null ? "—" : this._money(t.cpl, 2), d: c && c.cpl != null && t.cpl != null ? change(t.cpl, c.cpl) : null, better: "down" },
        { k: L.spend, v: this._money(t.spend, 0), d: c ? change(t.spend, c.spend) : null, better: "none" }
      ];
      kpis.forEach(x => {
        const box = make("div", "wmr-kpi");
        const dd = make("dd");
        dd.append(make("span", "wmr-fig", x.v));
        const delta = make("span", "wmr-delta");
        if (x.d == null || !c) delta.textContent = L.noCompare;
        else {
          const r = Math.round(x.d * 10) / 10;
          const arrow = r > 0 ? "▲" : r < 0 ? "▼" : "▶";
          delta.append(make("b", null, `${arrow} ${this._pct(Math.abs(r))}`), " " + fill(L.vs, { label: c.label }));
          const good = x.better === "up" ? r > 0 : x.better === "down" ? r < 0 : null;
          if (good === false && r !== 0) delta.dataset.tone = "bad";
        }
        dd.append(delta);
        box.append(make("dt", null, x.k), dd);
        dl.append(box);
      });
      out.push(dl);

      // highlights / lowlights
      const two = make("div", "wmr-grid2");
      const pointList = (title, items, cls, tag) => {
        const sec = make("section", "wmr-sec");
        const h = make("h3", "wmr-sec-h", title);
        h.append(make("small", null, tag));
        const ul = make("ul", "wmr-points " + cls);
        (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).forEach(s => ul.append(make("li", null, String(s))));
        sec.append(h, ul);
        return sec;
      };
      two.append(pointList(L.highlights, w.highlights, "wmr-points--up", "▲"), pointList(L.lowlights, w.lowlights, "wmr-points--down", "▼"));
      out.push(two);

      // channel table + checklist
      const main = make("div", "wmr-main");
      const tableSec = make("section", "wmr-sec");
      const th = make("h3", "wmr-sec-h", L.channels);
      th.append(make("small", null, w.range || ""));
      const table = make("table", "wmr-table");
      table.append(make("caption", null, `${L.channels}, ${fill(L.week, { n: w.week })}`));
      const cols = [L.channel, L.spend, L.leads, L.cplShort, L.booked, L.bookRate];
      const thead = make("thead"), hr = make("tr");
      cols.forEach(cn => { const x = make("th", null, cn); x.scope = "col"; hr.append(x); });
      thead.append(hr);
      const rates = t.rows.map(r => (r.leads > 0 ? r.booked / r.leads : 0));
      const bestRate = Math.max(0, ...rates);
      const tbody = make("tbody");
      const cell = (label, content, cls) => { const td = make("td", cls || null); td.dataset.label = label; if (content instanceof Node) td.append(content); else td.textContent = content; return td; };
      const rateEl = r => { const s = make("span", "wmr-rate"); const i = make("i"); i.style.setProperty("--p", (r * 100).toFixed(1)); i.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); s.append(i, make("b", null, this._pct(r * 100, 0))); return s; };
      const dash = () => make("span", "wmr-dash", "—");
      t.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
        const tr = make("tr");
        if (rates[i] === bestRate && bestRate > 0) tr.className = "is-best";
        const head = make("th", "wmr-rowh", r.name); head.scope = "row";
        tr.append(head,
          cell(L.spend, r.spend > 0 ? this._money(r.spend, 0) : dash()),
          cell(L.leads, this._int(r.leads)),
          cell(L.cplShort, r.spend > 0 && r.leads > 0 ? this._money(r.spend / r.leads, 2) : dash()),
          cell(L.booked, this._int(r.booked)),
          cell(L.bookRate, r.leads > 0 ? rateEl(rates[i]) : dash()));
        tbody.append(tr);
      });
      const tfoot = make("tfoot"), fr = make("tr");
      fr.append(cell(L.channel, L.total), cell(L.spend, this._money(t.spend, 0)), cell(L.leads, this._int(t.leads)),
        cell(L.cplShort, t.cpl == null ? dash() : this._money(t.cpl, 2)), cell(L.booked, this._int(t.booked)),
        cell(L.bookRate, t.leads > 0 ? rateEl(t.booked / t.leads) : dash()));
      tfoot.append(fr);
      table.append(thead, tbody, tfoot);
      tableSec.append(th, table, make("p", "wmr-tnote", L.tableNote));

      const nextSec = make("section", "wmr-sec");
      const nh = make("h3", "wmr-sec-h", L.nextWeek);
      const prog = make("small", "wmr-progress");
      nh.append(prog);
      const ul = make("ul", "wmr-list");
      const state = this._done(w);
      (Array.isArray(w.next) ? w.next : []).forEach((n, i) => {
        const li = make("li");
        const lab = make("label", "wmr-check");
        const input = make("input");
        input.type = "checkbox"; input.checked = !!state[i]; input.dataset.i = i;
        const box = make("span", "wmr-box"); box.innerHTML = ICON_TICK; box.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        lab.append(input, box, make("span", "wmr-check-text", (n && n.text) || ""));
        li.append(lab);
        ul.append(li);
      });
      const setProg = () => { prog.textContent = fill(L.progress, { done: state.filter(Boolean).length, total: state.length }); };
      setProg();
      ul.addEventListener("change", e => {
        const inp = e.target.closest("input[type=checkbox]");
        if (!inp) return;
        const i = +inp.dataset.i;
        state[i] = inp.checked;
        setProg();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("checklisttoggle", { bubbles: true, detail: { week: w.week, index: i, text: (w.next[i] && w.next[i].text) || "", done: inp.checked } }));
      });
      nextSec.append(nh, ul);
      main.append(tableSec, nextSec);
      out.push(main);
      return out;
    }

    _summary() {
      const w = this._current(), L = this._labels(), d = this._data || {};
      if (!w) return "";
      const idx = this._index(), t = this._totals(w), c = this._compare(idx);
      const chg = (a, b) => (c && b ? ` (${a >= b ? "+" : "−"}${this._pct(Math.abs((a - b) / b * 100))} ${fill(L.vs, { label: c.label })})` : "");
      const lines = [];
      lines.push(`${d.publication || "Weekly Report"} — ${fill(L.week, { n: w.week })}${w.range ? ", " + w.range : ""}${d.client ? " · " + d.client : ""}`);
      lines.push("");
      if (w.headline) lines.push(w.headline.toUpperCase());
      if (w.lead) lines.push(w.lead);
      lines.push("");
      lines.push(`${L.leads}: ${this._int(t.leads)}${chg(t.leads, c && c.leads)}`);
      lines.push(`${L.booked}: ${this._int(t.booked)}${chg(t.booked, c && c.booked)}`);
      if (t.cpl != null) lines.push(`${L.cpl}: ${this._money(t.cpl, 2)}${c && c.cpl ? chg(t.cpl, c.cpl) : ""}`);
      lines.push(`${L.spend}: ${this._money(t.spend, 0)}${chg(t.spend, c && c.spend)}`);
      const block = (title, items) => { if (!items || !items.length) return; lines.push(""); lines.push(title + ":"); items.forEach(s => lines.push(`- ${s}`)); };
      block(L.highlights, w.highlights);
      block(L.lowlights, w.lowlights);
      const state = this._done(w);
      if (Array.isArray(w.next) && w.next.length) {
        lines.push(""); lines.push(L.summaryNext + ":");
        w.next.forEach((n, i) => lines.push(`[${state[i] ? "x" : " "}] ${(n && n.text) || ""}`));
      }
      return lines.join("\n");
    }

    _copy() {
      const text = this._summary(), L = this._labels(), $ = this.$, w = this._current();
      if (!text) return Promise.resolve(false);
      const old = this.querySelector(".wmr-fallback");
      if (old) old.remove();
      const ok = () => {
        $.status.textContent = L.copiedMsg;
        $.copy.classList.add("is-done");
        $.copy.innerHTML = ICON_TICK; $.copy.append(L.copied);
        clearTimeout(this._copyTimer);
        this._copyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          $.copy.classList.remove("is-done");
          $.copy.innerHTML = ICON_COPY; $.copy.append(L.copy);
          $.status.textContent = "";
        }, 2200);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("summarycopy", { bubbles: true, detail: { week: w.week, text } }));
        return true;
      };
      const fallback = () => {
        const ta = make("textarea", "wmr-fallback");
        ta.readOnly = true; ta.value = text; ta.setAttribute("aria-label", L.copy);
        $.status.after(ta);
        $.status.textContent = L.fallbackMsg;
        ta.focus(); ta.select();
        return false;
      };
      try { return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(ok, fallback); }
      catch (e) { return Promise.resolve(fallback()); }
    }

    _go(i) {
      const list = this._weeks();
      if (i < 0 || i >= list.length || i === this._index()) return;
      this.week = list[i].week;
      const w = list[i];
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("weekchange", { bubbles: true, detail: { week: w.week, range: w.range || "", index: i } }));
    }

    _wire() {
      const $ = this.$;
      $.weeks.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const b = e.target.closest("button");
        if (!b || b.disabled) return;
        if (b.dataset.go) this._go(this._index() + (+b.dataset.go));
        else this._go(this._weeks().findIndex(w => String(w.week) === b.dataset.week));
      });
      $.weeks.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key !== "ArrowLeft" && e.key !== "ArrowRight") return;
        e.preventDefault();
        this._go(this._index() + (e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1));
      });
      $.copy.addEventListener("click", () => this._copy());
      $.print.addEventListener("click", () => window.print());
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get("weekly-marketing-report")) customElements.define("weekly-marketing-report", WeeklyMarketingReport);
})();

/* ---------- Showcase controls ---------- */
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById("demo");
  const note = document.getElementById("wmr-note");
  const say = (strong, rest) => {
    note.replaceChildren();
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = strong;
    note.append(b, " " + rest);
  };
  el.addEventListener("weekchange", e => say(`Week ${e.detail.week}.`, "The report sent a weekchange event. Fictional client, not real results."));
  el.addEventListener("checklisttoggle", e => say(e.detail.done ? "Ticked off." : "Unticked.", `“${e.detail.text}” · checklisttoggle event. Fictional client, not real results.`));
  document.getElementById("reset-checks").addEventListener("click", () => { el.resetChecklists(); say("Checklists reset.", "Fictional client, not real results."); });

  const copyBtn = document.getElementById("copy-usage");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const code = document.getElementById("usage-code");
    const done = t => { copyBtn.textContent = t; setTimeout(() => (copyBtn.textContent = "Copy"), 1600); };
    const select = () => {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(code);
      const s = getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); done("Selected");
    };
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(code.textContent).then(() => done("Copied"), select); }
    catch (e) { select(); }
  });
})();
</script>
